average joe.en: This one ecosystem brought together publishers and developers in a quality controlled, standardized marketplace, meaning it was finally possible for the average Joe to compete with pros.
average joe.zh: 这个在线商店给发布者 （个人开发者或开发商）提供了一个有质量保证、 标准化的市场， 这意味着普通的开发商和专业的开发商终于有机会同台竞技了。

avowedly.en: He remained for some years avowedly radical in his political outlook.
avowedly.zh: 译他激进的政见公然坚持了许多年。

avowedly.en: But the worst is that the essential songs avowedly do not stand in the proper order.
avowedly.zh: 但最糟糕的是， 基本的歌曲公然没有站在正确的顺序。

avowedly.en: Yet under Tony Blair, their most avowedly Europhile prime minister, Britons actually grew more hostile.
avowedly.zh: 然而，在最公开表示亲欧盟的托尼· 布莱尔的领导下， 英国正变得更加怀有敌意。

avowed.en: An aide avowed that the President had known nothing of the deals.
avowed.zh: 一位助理声明， 总统对这些交易一无所知。

avowed.en: The government's avowed aim, however, is to maintain " a substantially homogeneous society into which newcomers, from whatever sources, will merge themselves ".
avowed.zh: 然而， 政府公开宣称的目标是保持 “一个实质上同质化的社会， 无论出身何处的新来者都将融入其中”。
她公开声明自己是素食者。

award-winning.en: The award-winning novelist often has three or four books on the go at once.
award-winning.zh: 那位获奖小说家经常是三四部小说同时写的。

award-winning.en: D iscover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
award-winning.zh: 去发现、探索和享受屡获殊荣的图利别墅吧。在这精妙绝伦的博物馆和艺术馆中，你能看到历史悠久的藏品、欣赏当代艺术并且享受家庭乐趣。

award-winning.en: Reading award-winning literature may boost your ability to read other people, a new study suggests.
award-winning.zh: 一项新的研究表明， 阅读获奖文学作品可以提高你了解他人的能力。

awe-inspiring.en: The building was awe-inspiring in size and design.
awe-inspiring.zh: 这座建筑的规模和设计气势宏伟。

awe-inspiring.en: The higher we climbed, the more awe-inspiring the scenery became.
awe-inspiring.zh: 我们爬得越高，风景越是令人惊叹。

awe-inspiring.en: These assemblages, walls, even entire environments create a mysterious, almost awe-inspiring atmosphere.
awe-inspiring.zh: 这些组合、 墙壁、 甚至整个环境创造了一个神秘且几乎令人敬畏的氛围。

babble.en: I can't listen to his constant babble.
babble.zh: 我听不得他那没完没了的瞎扯。

babble.en: Kemp knocked loudly so as to be heard above the high babble of voices.
babble.zh: 肯普大声地敲门， 以压过唧唧喳喳的高声喧哗而让人听见。

babble.en: Babies speak baby languages like babble, and they respond to babies in the same baby language.
babble.zh: 婴儿会讲些咯咯咕咕的婴儿语， 而他们会以同样的婴儿语回应婴儿。

babble.en: I like it because it's a kind of image of the modern city that makes the modern city look like language, look like letters, look like a kind of scattered alphabet, a kind of babble.
babble.zh: 我喜欢它是因为它呈现出了一幅现代城市的图画,使得城市看起来像语言一样，像字母一样，像打乱分散的字母表一样，像模糊不清的牙牙耳语。

babble.en: So, Darwin writes, "Man has an instinctive tendency to speak, as we see in the babble of our young children, while no child has an instinctive tendency to bake, brew or write."
babble.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文写到,"人类拥有说话的本能倾向,我们会看到幼儿含糊吐字,然而儿童却并不具有烘焙,酿酒或是写作的本能倾向"

bacchanalian.en: And when they told him what one would expect of their age, he began to be merry, declaring that a vintage celebrated in such a manner was truly bacchanalian.
bacchanalian.zh: 当他们告诉他， 他们这个年龄的期望时， 他高兴起来， 说葡萄酒节这样庆祝， 就是真正的酒神节了。

bacchanalian.en: In a city where a " stag night " is an excuse for a bacchanalian party, that phrase took a new meaning with antlers and horns attached to the heads of the models.
bacchanalian.zh: 在这个 “单身夜” 是酒疯派对借口的城市里， 这一表达让模特头上的触角赋予了新意义。

bacchanalian.en: No vivacious Bacchanalian flame leaped out of the pressed grape of Monsieur Defarge: but, a smouldering fire that burnt in the dark, lay hidden in the dregs of it.
bacchanalian.zh: 欢快的酒神的火苗是无法从德伐日先生压榨出的葡萄汁上燃起来的，它的酒渣里也隐藏着一种在黑暗里闷着燃烧的火。

baby bust.en: We also know there's a baby bust generation following the baby boomers.
baby bust.zh: 我们还知道， 婴儿潮一代之后出生率骤然下降。

baby bust.en: This baby bust was a demographic echo of the rural famines that haunted China from 1958 to 1961, reducing the size of the cohort that would have been their parents ( see right - hand chart ).
baby bust.zh: 出生率的骤降是中国 1958年至1961年遭遇农村饥荒在统计学上的反应， 饥荒减少了本来会成为他们父母的那代的规模 （见右侧图表）。

baby bust.en: This obscures the point: for every big advanced country besides America and Israel, the alternative to “replacement rate” fertility is a baby bust.
baby bust.zh: 这种论调模糊了一个论点，即： 对于美国与以色列之外的先进国家而言，“替代生育率”与婴儿的低出生率，二者必居其一。

back into a championship.en: And a Laker Bryant remains, not only leading the team back into contention for the NBA championship, but leading cheers for the once - beleaguered general manager.
back into a championship.zh: 湖人的科比依旧在，他不仅继续带领球队冲击总冠军， 而且带头为曾经受围攻的经理喝彩。

back into a championship.en: But the championship is very important for us too because we want to come back into a better position in the table.
back into a championship.zh: 但是联赛也对于我们非常重要， 因为我们想在积分榜上反弹到一个更好的位置上。

baby boom.en: I'm a product of the postwar baby boom.
baby boom.zh: 我是战后婴儿潮的产物。
希望催生了美国的婴儿潮。

baby boom.en: The coming of age of the postwar baby boom and an entry of women into the male - dominated job market have limited the opportunities of teenagers.
baby boom.zh: 战后婴儿潮的到来， 以及女性进入男性主导的就业市场， 限制了青少年的就业机会。

baby boom.en: People got really scared, but what they did was they - this was the Baby Boom.
baby boom.zh: 人心惶惶,不过人们却...,那时出现了婴儿潮

backhaul.en: The results of the algorithm run by the selector are delayed because of backhaul.
backhaul.zh: 选择器所执行的算法结果由于回程而延迟。

backhaul.en: The communication between base stations via the wireless backhaul is presented finally.
backhaul.zh: 最后对基站的无线互联方案进行了探讨。

backhaul.en: Next up is backhaul, which is basically the connection between cell towers and the rest of the network.
backhaul.zh: 下一个问题是回程， 这基本上是指发射塔和网络的其余部分之间的连接。

backslapping.en: For all the backslapping and brave words, they have once again failed.
backslapping.zh: 尽管有这一切勾肩搭背的亲热和华丽的词句， 他们还是又一次失败了。

backslapping.en: Amid the backslapping, delegates had plenty of time for networking and arm-twisting.
backslapping.zh: 在一片赞美声中， 代表们有着充足的时间扩大人脉或施加压力。

backslapping.en: Do not do backslapping, elbowing, or other touching that gives the idea of close friendship or intimacy that does not exist.
backslapping.zh: 不要拍上司的背，也不要推肘， 或者做其他接触性动作来表示那本不存在的友情或亲密。

backcountry.en: The backcountry is far away from human activity.
backcountry.zh: 那些地方没有人类活动的痕迹。

backcountry.en: Much backcountry trash and litter originates from food items.
backcountry.zh: 很多野外垃圾和丢弃物通常由食物而来。

backcountry.en: But on a backcountry trip, ringing up a rescue isn'talways automatic.
backcountry.zh: 但是在偏远地区的旅行求救电话不是总是自动的。

backbiter.en: She is nothing but a backbiter.
backbiter.zh: 她是个当面诌媚、背后中伤人的东西。

backslider.zh: 但是， 我实在是一个没有毅力的人。

backslider.en: But Greece is viewed as a serial backslider.
backslider.zh: 但人们认为希腊积习难改。

backslider.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man [ shall be satisfied] from himself.
backslider.zh: 心中背道的， 必满得自己的结果； 善人必从自己的行为得以知足。

back into.en: He rushed back into the blazing house.
back into.zh: 他又返回， 冲进了燃烧着的房子。

back into.en: Gary hastily pushed the drawer back into place.
back into.zh: 加里匆忙把抽屉推回去。

back into.en: The frog plopped back into the water.
back into.zh: 青蛙扑通一声跳回水中。

back into.en: Now the brokerage industry - - The New York Stock Exchange goes back into the eighteenth century, it's very old.
back into.zh: 经纪行业历史悠久...,纽约股票交易所历史悠久,成立于18世纪

back into.en: And I went back to work when they went into school full - time.
back into.zh: 当她们去上学以后，我就回去做全职工作了。

backfire.en: Then, while those firefighters dig, others start a backfire.
backfire.zh: 然后， 当这些消防员挖洞的时候， 其他人却适得其反。

backfire.en: Scientists tell us this can backfire and actually have a negative impact on our wellbeing.
backfire.zh: 科学家告诉我们， 这可能适得其反， 实际上会对我们的幸福产生负面影响。

backfire.en: While this may seem justified by a noble goal, such " policy by people " tactics rarely work, and often backfire.
backfire.zh: 尽管这似乎符合一个崇高的目标，但这种 “人民的政策” 策略很少奏效， 而且往往适得其反。

backfire.en: On the other hand, some people say, well that would backfire.
backfire.zh: 此外,人们可能要说,这会起反作用

balkan.en: His novels are a rich synthesis of Balkan history and mythology.
balkan.zh: 他的小说是一个巴尔干半岛的历史和神话的丰富结合。

balkan.en: Parts of the Balkan region and Turkey follow the diet, as well as middle Eastern countries like Lebanon and Syria.
balkan.zh: 巴尔干半岛的部分区域和土耳其也遵循这一饮食方式， 黎巴嫩和叙利亚等中东国家也是如此。

balkan.en: Kosovo is not the only Balkan issue before the court.
balkan.zh: 科索沃对于法院不仅仅是巴尔干地区的争议。

balkan.en: You could have a conflagaration, a Balkan's type conflagaration through the entire Midlle East.
balkan.zh: 可能引发一场大火，巴尔干半岛那样的大火,席卷整个中东地区。

bait-and-switch.en: That's a classic bait-and - switch game, and it may indicate a problem with the company.
bait-and-switch.zh: 这是典型的下套游戏， 挑明了这家公司有问题。

bait-and-switch.en: Last year the g. O. P. pulled off two spectacular examples of bait-and - switch campaigning.
bait-and-switch.zh: 去年，共和党在两项规模宏大的诱饵掉包法选战战例中获胜。

bait-and-switch.en: A similar trick is used in so - called " bait-and - switch " ads, that is the customer is shown one product (the bait ) and then given another.
bait-and-switch.zh: 另一类似的诡计是所谓的 “偷梁换柱” 广告，也就是说消费者所见的是一种产品 ( 饵 ) 而实际买到的却是另一种产品。

ball and chain.en: " Men like to joke about the ball-and - chain, but this behavior robs men of independence and leads to a weaker connection between a husband and wife," continues Haltzman.
ball and chain.zh: 他还说：“男人喜欢拿球和链的情况开玩笑， 但是这种行为剥夺了男人的自由， 使得丈夫和妻子间的关系变得薄弱。”

ball and chain.en: Davina says, " Everything you own is energetically attached to you." Things you love are like golden threads. Conversely, clutter is like dragging around a ball and chain.
ball and chain.zh: 戴维纳说过，“你所拥有的一切与你都有一种能量上的联系，那些你喜欢的东西就像金丝一样， 相反，那些杂物就像被铁链和铁球拖着你的生活。”

ball and chain.en: The two bonus eps are titled “The Old Ball and Chain ” and “Free, ” and they take place a couple of days after the events of the season finale.
ball and chain.zh: 越狱》 的主创人员终于松口聊起了《越狱》全剧大结局的最后 2 小时的拍摄。 最后两集被命名为《旧时锁链》 和 《自由》，故事就发生在全季最终集的几天后。

backwood.en: She is fairies, the cute sea-sprite and sprite in backwood and marsh. She often appears in the field, forest, river and lake, sea and the wilderness.
backwood.zh: 山林水泽中的仙女，楚楚动人的海妖和小妖， 常出没于田野、 树林、江湖、 大海以及荒原之中。

backstabbing.en: BLITZER: a lot of bickering, backstabbing.
In that type of environment, a fierce competition develops between co-workers, and this opens the door to politics and backstabbing.
backstabbing.zh: 在这样的环境里， 员工之间形成了一种恶性竞争的关系， 这直接导致了勾心斗角和诬陷中伤的产生。

backstabbing.en: Never once in our relationship, I was proud to think, had I ever even been tempted to commit a single mortal friendship sin: being competitive, gossiping, or backstabbing.
backstabbing.zh: 我曾骄傲地认为， 对我们的友谊，我都一直没有被”凡夫俗子 “友谊中的任何罪恶所诱惑： 好胜、散布谣言或背地里说坏话。

ball-park.en: Remember, though, that during Inception, we are interested in ball-park Numbers only.
ball-park.zh: 记住，在初始阶段中， 尽管我们只对球场的数字感兴趣。

ball-park.en: Soda pop was more profitable than chewing gum: he 5 netted a nickel for every six bottles, and stuffed these COINS proudly into the ball-park - style nickel - plated money changer on his belt.
ball-park.zh: 汽水比口香糖赚钱多了： 每卖 6 瓶汽水， 他能挣 5 美分。沃伦把挣来的硬币自豪地塞进挂在腰带上的一个棒球场形状的镀镍零钱找换器。

ball-park.en: Take your kids out to the park and throw the ball around, play tag, etc.
ball-park.zh: 带你的孩子去公园玩， 或打球、 捉迷藏等等。

balmy.en: Eventually passion was distilled into the natural beauty of a balmy night.
balmy.zh: 激情最终融入了芬芳夜晚的自然美之中。

balmy.en: Those were golden days and balmy nights!
balmy.zh: 那些是金色的白天和芳香的夜晚！

balmy.en: It was April, balmy and warm.

baloney.en: Baloney. He's usually in bed by now.
baloney.zh: 一般来说，到现在这个钟点， 他已经上床睡觉了。

baloney.en: Well, archaeologists investigated this carefully, and the French School of Archaeology late in the nineteenth century dug everything up and concluded this was baloney; it was a myth.
baloney.zh: 十九世纪末期,法国建筑学院的,考古学家仔细调查了这个神庙,他们研究出了很多东西,包括以上说的故事,他们认为完全是个神话

baloney.en: We would be told that he was very honest and told his father he chopped down a cherry tree, which would be baloney, but we would be told that too. But I think we would be told also very many true things, which came down to us.
baloney.zh: 我们还被告知他很诚实,因为他告诉父亲,他砍倒了一棵樱桃树,这简直是胡扯,但我们还是会听到这些,除此之外,我们还会听到一些真实的历史事件

bamboo shoots.en: It is well - known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
bamboo shoots.zh: 众所周知， 竹笋是熊猫的主要食物。

bamboo shoots.zh: 他们把竹笋折下来吃着，发出嘈杂的声音。

bamboo shoots.en: T he special taste mostly comes from the sour bamboo shoots.
bamboo shoots.zh: 这种特殊的味道主要来自酸笋。

backstroke.en: " I see you know how to swim very well," she said, watching him do the backstroke.
backstroke.zh: 看来你很会游泳啊”， 她一边说一边看他仰泳。

bamboozle.en: You have no reason to bamboozle me!
Bamboozle has nothing at all to do with wooden drinking cups.
bamboozle.zh: 和木制酒杯完全没有关系。

bamboozle.zh: 也许如果被理解或理解， 我可以哄骗自己相信， 可我是个记者”(格拉姆 ·格林)。

balk at.en: Even biology undergraduates may balk at animal experiments.
balk at.zh: 即使是生物专业的大学生都可能会反对动物实验。

balk at.zh: 为了全人类的解放， 即使牺牲生命也在所不惜。

balk at.zh: 所以， 你如何证明你不会在电子数据表和图表方面畏缩不前呢？

banal.zh: 那首歌的歌词庸俗得让人尴尬。

bandwagon.en: The World Cup bandwagon is starting to roll.
bandwagon.zh: 世界杯足球赛热潮即将涌起。

bandwagon.zh: 几乎每所学校都搭上了这班变革列车。

banishment.zh: 你难道没有体验过被父母放逐吗？

banger.zh: 而现在，现存的几辆在老爷车手中也很流行。

banger.zh: 纯粹力量的一个单独球员并不一定使他有资格作为一个正当的硬汉。

bar mitzvah.en: Eric had a space - travel - themed bar mitzvah at the Chanticleer in Short Hills when we were both in seventh grade.

bar mitzvah.en: It was commissioned for my bar mitzvah, and was later used to decorate my childhood bedroom - the bedroom in which I now sleep.

barb.en: The barb stung her exactly the way he hoped it would.
barb.zh: 他的讽刺如期伤到了她。

barb.zh: 但是请叫我 Barb 就好了。

centripetal.en: Do not confuse ever the tangential acceleration, which is along the circumference, with centripetal acceleration.

cerebral.en: When he was little, a fever gave him cerebral palsy.

cesspool.en: That cesspool is an offence to the neighbourhood.

chagrined.en: The chair of the committee did not appear chagrined by the compromises and delays.
chagrined.zh: 委员会主席看起来并未因为让步和延误而懊恼。

chagrined.zh: 我为浪费了精力而感到懊恼。

chagrined.zh: 但是他们也因密切的比较而懊恼。

chain smoker.zh: 似乎每个人都有奖励， 除了这位吞云吐雾的烟民。

chain smoker.zh: 她出生在罗马尼亚一个名叫 Rosenberg 的犹太家庭，自小在舒适和豪华的环境中长大，在瑞士学习。 她甘于奉献、聪颖过人、 举止矜持，但烟瘾极大，这令人难忘。

cessation.zh: 他不会同意敌对状态的停止。

cessation.zh: 墨西哥要求立即停止敌对行动。

cessation.en: There is still no universally agreed-on explanation for why there should be such a dramatic cessation of tree growth at the upper timberline.
cessation.zh: 对于为什么树线以上的树木会突然停止生长，至今还没有一个公认的解释。

chalet.en: The two-bedroom chalet is in good condition.

chancy.zh: 投资正在成为一项冒险的事业。

chamberlain.zh: 由约瑟夫· 张伯伦发起的英国关税改革运动带来了新的反对曼彻斯特主义的反对者。

chancel.en: The left pillar closest to the chancel is installed with a gold-plated marble pulpit.
chancel.zh: 左列最靠近祭台的一根柱子上设有大理石镏金讲道坛。

chancel.zh: 历史上那些杰出的英国国教徒葬于教堂被称为圣坛的区域。

chance meeting.en: It was a chance meeting that would change my life.
chance meeting.zh: 那次偶然的会面改变了我的一生。

chance meeting.zh: 这次偶然的相遇是一段持久友情的开始。

chance meeting.zh: 特蕾莎在一家社交网站上晒出了这次偶然会面的照片，并配上感人的文字：“这个年轻人对我们家来说真是福气！”

charismatic.en: Like all truly charismatic people, he can work his magic on both men and women.
charismatic.zh: 像所有真正富有魅力的人一样， 他让男人和女人都很着迷。

charismatic.zh: 她以出众的相貌和富有魅力的个性闻名遐迩。

charismatic.en: When the Endangered Species Act was signed in 1973, it was expected to protect charismatic fauna such as the bald eagle and Yellowstone's grizzly bears.
charismatic.zh: 当 1973年《濒危物种法案》 签署时， 人们期望它能保护一批引人注目的动物， 如秃头鹰和黄石公园的北美灰熊。

charismatic.en: We have speakers who are very outgoing, very charismatic and tall, attracting the masses into these workshops, seminars and lectures.
charismatic.zh: 热情外向的宣讲者，颇具领袖气质，且身材高大，吸引大众参与他们的专题讨论讲座。

charismatic.en: I think that he's very charismatic. He wears the best suits.
charismatic.zh: 我认为他很有号召力。他总是穿着最好的西服。

chancery.zh: 一个被留下还剩下四个。

chancery.en: I think perhaps the Court of Chancery might have regretted that since.
chancery.zh: 我认为或许衡平法院从那以后就为此而感到遗憾。

chancery.en: In its place, a republic was re-established where Machiavelli occupied the office of secretary to the second chancery, a kind of diplomatic post which he held for 14 years from 1498 to 1512.
chancery.zh: 取而代之的是一个共和的重新建立,其中马奇亚维利,占据国务院及副总理职，一种类似外交官的职位,他在职，14，年，从，1498，年到，1512，年。

The only legitimate fighting is man against man, shield against shield, chest against chest, everybody else is a pussy.

crick.zh: 沃森和弗朗西斯· 克里克发现了 DNA 的结构， 这是所有生物的遗传信息载体。

crick.zh: 他说，他和克里克之所以成功， 是因为他们意识到，在寻求答案的科学家中，他们并不是最聪明的。

devour book.en: Overall, throughout my childhood, I paid a huge price to devour every book in those several dozen villages which surrounded my home.
devour book.zh: 总之， 在我的童年时代， 我付出了巨大的代价， 把我们周围那十几个村子里的书都读完了。

devour book.en: You know when you find a book and 2 ferociously you want to devour it.
devour book.zh: 你知道， 当你找到一本好书，你就极想一股脑儿地把它吞下去。

detractor.en: But the pipe has one major detractor: It's something of a black box.
detractor.zh: 但是， 管道有个大缺点： 它像是黑箱子。

detractor.en: Probably the biggest detractor from getting up early is not getting enough sleep.
detractor.zh: 睡眠不足可能是早起最大的障碍。

detractor.en: But for every fan there is a detractor, critical not just of the monastery's approach but Shi's own lifestyle.
detractor.zh: 有一个粉丝， 就会有一个批评者。人们不仅批评少林寺的经营方式，还批评释本人的生活方式。

detergent.en: The detergent comes in powder or liquid form.
detergent.zh: 这种洗涤剂有粉状或液态两种。

detergent.en: This detergent is good for getting stains out.
detergent.zh: 这种洗涤剂能清除斑渍。

detergent.en: Grease marks can be removed with liquid detergent.
The blood of sacrificial animals is assigned by God as a detergent, if you will, to cleanse the sanctuary of the impurities that are caused by the sinful deeds of the Israelites.
detergent.zh: 祭祀动物的血液被上帝指定为清洁剂，如果你想，它可以用来清除圣所中,由以色列人的罪恶行为带来的不洁。

detritus.en: These unassignable animals include a large swimming predator called Anomalocaris and a soft-bodied animal called Wiwaxia, which ate detritus or algae.
detritus.zh: 这些无法归类的动物包括被称为奇虾的会游泳的大型食肉动物，以及叫做威瓦亚虫的软体动物，它们以岩屑和藻类为食。

detritus.en: Indeed, with the deaths of so many other animals and with much dead plant material, the food chain based on detritus would have been well-supplied.
detritus.zh: 事实上， 由于许多其他动物的死亡以及植物的大量枯萎， 基于腐殖质的食物链本会得到很好的供应。

detritus.en: There is no guano comparable in fertility with the detritus of a capital.
detritus.zh: 任何鸟粪都没有首都的垃圾肥效高。

detritus.en: What you find when you actually open up Pynchon's novels is an incredibly rich world of human detritus, of history.
detritus.zh: 当你真正看Pynchon的书,你能够发现一个难以置信的。

dexterity.en: You need manual dexterity to be good at video games.
dexterity.zh: 玩好电子游戏手要灵巧。

dexterity.en: Although full integration of sound into movies was complete by 1930, it would take a bit longer for films to regain their stylistic elegance and dexterity.
dexterity.zh: 虽然在 1930 年就完成了声音与电影的完全融合，但对诸多影片来说，还需要更长的时间才能重拾其高雅和灵巧的风格。

dexterity.en: His manual dexterity and fine spatial skills were wasted on routine tasks.
dexterity.zh: 他的手巧和很好的感悟空间的技能被浪费在日常事务中了。

dexterity.en: They're capable of these extraordinarily delicate feats of dexterity, and that's because the poet has mastered his touch.
dexterity.zh: 反而能够灵巧地完成精细的动作，这是因为诗人已经完全掌握了自己的触觉。

diarrhoea.en: But the food itself was barely digestible, and many team members suffered from diarrhoea or constipation.
diarrhoea.zh: 但食物本身难以消化, 许多队员患了腹泻或便秘。

diarrhoea.en: The result is disease, particularly diarrhoea.
diarrhoea.zh: 这就导致了疾病的产生， 尤其是腹泻。

diaphanous.en: She was wearing a dress of diaphanous silk.
diaphanous.zh: 她穿着一件薄如蝉翼的绸服。

diaphanous.en: The cloth is so fine that it looks diaphanous.
diaphanous.zh: 这种布料细到看起来像透明的。

diaphanous.en: I remember The Times when love seemed more pure and diaphanous.
diaphanous.zh: 我记得， 当爱情时代似乎更纯净、 澄明。

diatribe.en: At times it is little more than a self-serving diatribe.
diatribe.zh: 有时这就是一个供自我谩骂发泄的平台。

diatribe.en: On Christmas Eve, 2004, Graham posted a diatribe on the website 8 a.
diatribe.zh: 在 2004年的圣诞节前夜， Graham 给 8 a. nu 网站寄了一封信。

diatribe.en: The blogger who started off the diatribe wrote a post attacking me publicly.
diatribe.zh: 一个博客开始谩骂， 写了一篇帖子公开攻击我。

dictator.en: The quality of independence is so indispensable for us that parents had better act as a tutor, not a dictator.
dictator.zh: 独立的品质对我们来说是不可或缺的，所以父母最好是做一个指导者， 而不是独裁者。

dictator.en: Following the fall of the military dictator in March, the country has had a civilian government.
dictator.zh: 军事独裁者 3月垮台之后， 该国已有了一个平民政府。

dictator.en: IT HAS been a rotten week for the dictator.
dictator.zh: 对卡扎菲来说, 这是极其糟糕的一周。

dictator.en: They were afraid he was going to set himself as dictator, which of course he did.
dictator.zh: 他们担心他自立为独裁官，当然他后来也是这么做了。

diddle around.en: I'm not much of a musician. I just like to diddle around.
diddle around.zh: 我还不是个音乐家，我只不过喜欢玩弄乐器。

dictum.en: The facts of cases should be read, unless the case is relied upon only for an obiter dictum.
dictum.zh: 案件的事实应予以阅读， 除非案件仅为附带意见的参考。

dictum.en: Eventually, perhaps soon, the market must obey Mr Micawber's dictum.
dictum.zh: 最终， 也许很快， 市场肯定会兑现米考伯的格言。

dictum.en: The disciples were absorbed in a discussion of Lao-tzu's dictum.
dictum.zh: 弟子在一次老子论断研讨会上全神领会。

dictum.en: As I've just noted, Milton quotes Paul's dictum that "to the pure, all things are pure."
dictum.zh: 我之前提到，弥尔顿引用彼得的格言,“对于纯洁的人，世间一切都纯洁“

dictum.en: Thus, the dictum could be dared in the psychoanalytic school: at bottom, nobody believes in his own death.
dictum.zh: 在精神分析学院会有这种说法：,说到底，没人相信自己的死亡。

dictum.en: Are the philosophers or are the poets you might say the true legislators for mankind?! if you want to use Shelley's dictum?
dictum.zh: 是哲学家或是诗学家,或者你可以说，人类的真正立法者,如果你想要借用雪莱名言的话？

descend upon.en: While revelers continue to descend upon that seaside retreat, another corner of Turkey’s Aegean coastline has begun to emerge as a stylish alternative: the once - sleepy villages of the Cesme Peninsula.
descend upon.zh: 当宴会狂欢者依旧突然造访海边度假寓所时，土耳其爱琴海岸线边的角落 - 切什梅半岛那些曾经沉睡的村庄成了时尚旅游的新选择。

descend upon.en: I descend upon all those cities, and rise from them again.
descend upon.zh: 我降落在所有那些大城市上， 然后又离开它们。

descend upon.en: His glory will descend upon you.
descend upon.zh: 他的荣耀要降临在你的身上。

die-hard.zh: 古老的本能是很难消失的。

die-hard.en: But for some, old habits die hard, it seems.
die-hard.zh: 但对于某些人， 看起来老习惯难改。

dietary adherence.en: The term adherence means taking the drugs exactly as prescribed, on time, and following any dietary restrictions.
dietary adherence.zh: 长期坚持意味着完全按规定的时间服药， 并遵照所有饮食限制。

dietary adherence.en: With type 2 diabetes, scrupulous attention to blood sugar levels and strict adherence to dietary rules can have payoffs in terms of reducing disease severity, the researchers suspect.
dietary adherence.zh: 研究者们推测说患有第2 型糖尿病的人，他们小心谨慎关注血糖的含量， 严格遵守饮食规定会有助于他们降低疾病的严重程度。

digit.en: Australia had 15 years of double- digit inflation.
digit.zh: 澳大利亚有长达15 年的双位数通货膨胀。

digit.en: Her telephone number differs from mine by one digit.
digit.zh: 她的电话号码跟我的差一个数字。

digit.en: " With the first subject, after about 20 hours of training, his digit span had risen from 7 to 20," Ericsson recalls.
digit.zh: 对于第一个实验对象， 经过大约 20 小时的训练， 他的数字跨度从 7 上升到 20。” 爱立信回忆道。

digit.en: The bill was passed, and within five months after the bill was passed, we had double digit unemployment for the first time.
digit.zh: 法案顺利通过，法案通过后五个月，失业率就达到了两位数,是史上第一次。

digit.en: Glancing at the bottom, this is pretty arbitrary, but I chose to format my string as follows: % 1f so at the bottom here I'm printing out %.1f, which quick sanity check means print just one digit after the decimal place.
digit.zh: 看下这个底部，这个是相当随意的，但我选择把我的字符串格式化成这样：,所以在这个底部我打印输出，提醒一下，这是一个只打印出,小数点后一位的方法。

dietitian.en: The dietitian was helpful, making suggestions as to how I could improve my diet.
dietitian.zh: 这位饮食学家很有帮助，就我如何能改善膳食提出了建议。

dietitian.en: "The typical American diet is a lot higher in protein than a lot of us think," says registered dietitian Angela Pipitone.
dietitian.zh: 典型的美国饮食中的蛋白质含量比我们想象的要高得多。” 注册营养师安吉拉 · 皮皮托内说道。

dietitian.en: "The typical American diet is a lot higher in protein than a lot of us think," says registered dietitian Angela Pipitone with Johns Hopkins McKusick Nathans Institute of Genetic Medicine.
dietitian.zh: 约翰 ·霍普金斯大学麦库西克·内森遗传医学研究所的注册营养师安吉拉 · 皮皮托内说：“典型的美国人饮食中蛋白质的含量比我们想象的要高得多。”

digestive tract.en: That's how it makes a difference to your digestive tract.
digestive tract.zh: 这就是它对消化道的影响。

digestive tract.en: Foods are broken down in the digestive tract.
digestive tract.zh: 食物在消化道内被分解。

digestive tract.en: These muscles move food, fluids and gas through your digestive tract.
digestive tract.zh: 这些肌肉通过消化道移动食物、 液体和气体。

dignitary.en: Dignitary Bingo, ten bucks a sheet; are you in?
dignitary.zh: 猜人物宾果游戏， 一页十美元， 怎么样?。

dignitary.en: Anglican Church an ecclesiastical dignitary usually ranking just below a bishop.
dignitary.zh: 英国国教教会中) 仅排列在主教之下的教会的显要人物。

dignitary.en: One dignitary was conspicuously absent from the gala: the event's third honorary co-chair, Michelle Obama.
dignitary.zh: 然而， 真正的重量级人物却没有到场： 本次盛会的第三位荣誉主持——米歇尔·奥巴马。

dilapidated.en: Small cars hoot and jostle in a race against three-wheeled auto-rickshaws, dilapidated buses, and the odd bullock cart.
dilapidated.zh: 道路上混杂着相互鸣笛争道的小型汽车、电动三轮车、 破旧的公共汽车和牛拉单车。

dilapidated.en: The house is a little more dilapidated than when I last saw it.
dilapidated.zh: 这幢房子比我上次看到时更破一些了。

dilapidated.en: The walls of the dilapidated shed lean outward.
dilapidated.zh: 那座破棚屋的墙向外倾。

dingy.en: The landlord pays cleaners who come daily, and there is a dingy shared washroom where residents can clean their belongings.
dingy.zh: 房东雇了清洁工每天来打扫， 还有一个昏暗的公用盥洗室， 供住户们洗自己的东西。

dingy.en: Shaw took me to his dingy office.
dingy.zh: 肖把我带到他那又暗又脏的办公室。

dingy.en: My older brother and I lived with Mom in a dingy multi-family house in Detroit.
dingy.zh: 我和哥哥和妈妈住在底特律一所肮脏的多户住宅里。

dinner roll.en: Alec went home for dinner and found they were having a jelly roll for dessert.' I'm not eating that, Mum,' he said,' It's five years old!'
dinner roll.zh: 亚力克回家吃晚饭， 发现甜点是一个果子冻卷。“我不吃那个， 妈妈，” 他说，“它五岁了！”

dire.en: We're in dire need of your help.
It was a high compliment to Peter that at that dire moment their thoughts turned to him.
dire.zh: 他们在那个可怕的时刻想起了彼得， 这对他来说是一种高度的赞扬。

dire.en: In recent years, we have all been exposed to dire media reports concerning the impending demise of global coal and oil reserves.
dire.zh: 近年来， 我们都接触到有关全球煤炭和石油储备即将枯竭的可怕媒体报道。

dire.en: The defenses had to do with necessity, their dire circumstance, and, implicitly at least, the idea that numbers matter.
dire.zh: 有人说他们在那样的处境下，不得已而为之，并且暗含了“人数重要“的理念。

dire.en: He separated from her because of dire necessity.
dire.zh: 而他又在流亡中与妻子走散

dirge.en: A light song overcomes me like a dirge.
dirge.zh: 轻快的歌曲竟似挽歌使我压抑。

dirge.en: She threw down her basket and intoned a peasant dirge.
dirge.zh: 她撂下菜篮，唱起庄稼人的哀歌。

dirge.en: With a month to go, Americans may hear a dirge of glum economic news nearly every day between now and the election.
dirge.zh: 从现在起离大选还剩一月之余， 美国人也许每天都会听到阴森森、 像哀乐一般的经济新闻。

diminishing returns.en: S uch strict parents should know the law of diminishing returns (
diminishing returns.zh: 这样严格的父母应该知道收益递减规律。

diminishing returns.en: But even there, the risk is of diminishing returns.
diminishing returns.zh: 但是就算那样，还是存在收益递减的风险。

diminishing returns.en: The key is finding the point of diminishing returns for your team.
diminishing returns.zh: 关键是找到减少对团队的回报的要点。

disagreeable.en: This afternoon he did not give any medicine or leave any new orders and he was spared any disagreeable scenes.
disagreeable.zh: 今天下午， 他没有给我开什么药， 也没有留下新的医嘱，也没有什么不愉快的场面。
他是个浅薄、 不友好的人。

disagreeable.en: That was one of her unhappy, disagreeable ways.
disagreeable.zh: 那正是她不讨人喜欢的习惯之一。

disarming.en: Leonard approached with a disarming smile.
disarming.zh: 伦纳德带着令人消除怒气的微笑走近了。

disarming.en: They outlined their aims with disarming frankness.
disarming.zh: 他们友好坦诚地简述了他们的宗旨。

disarming.en: We will agree to disarming troops and leaving their weapons at military positions.
disarming.zh: 我们将同意解除部队的武装， 并把他们的武器留在军事阵地上。

dirty little secret.en: But the tech industry has a dirty little secret: it has toxic waste of its own.
dirty little secret.zh: 但是， 高新技术产业有一个肮脏的小秘密： 它自己就含有有毒废料！

dirty little secret.en: Password protection — or lack thereof — is the it industry's dirty little secret.
dirty little secret.zh: 密码保护 —— 或者缺少 —— 是 IT 行业的不为人知的小秘密。

dirty little secret.en: But if he's consistently logging long hours in the bathroom, he may be hiding a dirty little secret: narcissism.
dirty little secret.zh: 但是如果他总是在浴室呆很长时间，他可能隐藏了一个龌龊的小秘密： 自恋。

disastrously.en: How could everything go so disastrously wrong?
disastrously.zh: 怎么会事事都出这么大的错呢？

disastrously.en: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule.
disastrously.zh: 蔬菜收割灾难性地滞后于计划。

disastrously.en: N ot very long ago, it was also unthinkable that a virus would shut down nations and that safety nets would be proven so disastrously lacking in flexibility.
disastrously.zh: 不久以前，人们还无法想象一种病毒能使众多国家封闭，而安全网被证明是如此灾难性地缺乏灵活性。

disavowal.zh: 否认疼痛是有确实根据的。

disavowal.en: I know that disavowal is an unusual form of betrayal.
disavowal.zh: 我知道， 否认就是一种不寻常的背叛形式。

disavowal.en: Your disavowal is informed by a misunderstanding.
disavowal.zh: 你的推卸是由一种误解造成的。

disband.en: The council voted to disband and re-form as a confederation.
disband.zh: 该政务会投票决定解散，再以联盟的形式重组。

disband.en: In July he issued a decree ordering all unofficial armed groups in the country to disband.
disband.zh: 月份， 他颁布了一项法令， 命令解散该国所有非官方武装团体。

disband.en: However, as Amy Edmondson of Harvard points out, organizations increasingly use " team " as a verb rather than a noun: they form teams for specific purposes and then quickly disband them.
disband.zh: 然而， 正如哈佛大学的艾米 ·埃德蒙森所指出的那样， 越来越多的组织将“团队” 用作动词而非名词，原因是他们往往为了一些特殊目的组建团队， 之后迅速地又解散团队。

disconcerted.zh: 他的回答使她颇感难堪。

disconcerted.en: His compliments disconcerted her a little.
disconcerted.zh: 他的恭维让她有点儿尴尬。

disconcerted.en: He was disconcerted to find his fellow diners already seated.
disconcerted.zh: 他有些尴尬地发现与他同桌就餐的人已经入席了。

discontinuation.en: No side effects requiring discontinuation of T were detected.
discontinuation.zh: 组患者中止试验后没有发生副作用。

discontinuation.en: Apple has never been externally friendly. Xsan discontinuation anyone?
discontinuation.zh: 苹果对外从来都不是友好的。

discontinuation.en: Symptoms of adverse events that led to discontinuation included rash, gastrointestinal problems and anemia.
discontinuation.zh: 导致停止治疗的不良事件的症状包括皮疹、 胃肠道问题和贫血。

disclaimer.en: The company asserts in a disclaimer that it won't be held responsible for the accuracy of information.
disclaimer.zh: 该公司在一项免责声明里宣称它不会对信息的准确性负责。

disclaimer.en: He added a disclaimer implying that Runge's letter didn't influence his work.
disclaimer.zh: 他补了一个免责声明， 称朗格的信没有影响他的工作。

disclaimer.en: Advertisers sometimes offset or counterbalance an exaggerated claim with a disclaimer — a qualification or condition on the claim.
disclaimer.zh: 广告商有时会通过补偿或者免责的形式，即对索赔要求的一种限定或条件，来平衡夸大的说辞。

disclaimer.en: And so as a way of understanding what at this point is really the sheer repetitiveness of this disclaimer, I want to propose a metaphor.
disclaimer.zh: 因此为了理解这个论点是否真的,是这种放弃的纯粹的重复，我将会提出一个隐喻。

disclaimer.en: He's making exactly the same disclaimer that he had made in Sonnet Seven.
disclaimer.zh: 他发表了和他的十四行诗第七首中同样的免责声明。

disconsolate.en: He did not have much success, but tried not to get too disconsolate.
disconsolate.zh: 他没有获得太大的成功， 但也试着不让自己太过郁闷。

disconsolate.en: Now some of us were left disconsolate.
disconsolate.zh: 现在我们当中已经有人悲不自胜了。

disconsolate.en: She is disconsolate at the death of her cat.

discursive.en: The internet is making news more participatory, social and diverse, reviving the discursive characteristics of the era before the mass media.
discursive.zh: 互联网使新闻更具参与性、 社会性和多样性， 恢复了大众媒体出现之前那个时代的散漫特征。

discursive.en: But again, this requires an active and discursive attitude, and practice.
discursive.zh: 这再次要求积极商谈的态度和实践。

discursive.en: In one side, the emerging of performance art needs the presence of discursive concept.
discursive.zh: 在一方面，在表演艺术新出现的需求的话语概念的存在。

discursive.en: He writes "The nations in cold locations particularly in Europe are filled with spiritedness." There is that platonic word again Thumos thumos are filled with thumos " "but lacking in discursive thought " lacking in the deliberative element in other words.
discursive.zh: 生存在寒冷地区的民族,特别是在欧洲,都充满了意志“，等同柏拉图的用词,“Thumos，他们都充满了,但缺乏推论的思考能力“,即缺乏商议的要素。

disdainful.en: She had an affected air and a disdainful look.
disdainful.zh: 她不仅做作， 而且还有一副瞧不起人的样子。

disdainful.en: He is highly disdainful of anything to do with the literary establishment.
disdainful.zh: 他对任何涉及文学机构的事都极端的蔑视。

disdainful.en: Snape stared at Harry with a disdainful look.
disdainful.zh: 斯内普轻蔑的看了一眼哈利。

disenfranchised.en: No one is immune — not the rich and famous, not the poor and disenfranchised.

dopamine.zh: 这能促进大脑中的多巴胺浓度上升。

dopamine.en: So why do dopamine neurons treat information as a reward?
dopamine.zh: 那为什么多巴胺神经元将信息作为奖赏对待呢？

dopamine.en: That can be supplied by an antagonist called Aldopa - which is not exactly the same as dopamine, it's slightly different.
dopamine.zh: 这种物质能够由一种拮抗剂,叫做阿多巴转化而来,但它与多巴胺的结构并不完全相同,有一点差别

dopamine.en: Another example is in the nervous system, patients that have Parkinson's disease have too little of a natural ligand called dopamine.
dopamine.zh: 另一个例子有关神经系统,帕金森氏病的患者,缺乏一种叫做多巴胺的天然的配体

domineering.en: Mick was stubborn and domineering with a very bad temper.
domineering.zh: 麦克既固执又刚愎自用，脾气还很坏。

domineering.en: He is a domineering sort of fellow.
domineering.zh: 他是一个飞扬跋扈的人。

domineering.en: I'm also not so domineering in the boardroom.
domineering.zh: 我对董事会也不是那么大的支配的想法。

doormat.en: If you always give in to others you will end up feeling like a doormat.
doormat.zh: 如果总向别人屈服， 你最终会觉得自己像个门垫。

doormat.en: Today's busy families hardly have time to load the dishwasher, much less clean the doormat.
doormat.zh: 如今忙碌的家庭几乎没有时间把碗碟放进洗碗机，更不用说擦擦门垫了。
我们能吃门前擦脚垫吗？

doppelgängers.en: They found that there's about a one in 135 chance that a pair of complete doppelgängers exist somewhere in the world.
doppelgängers.zh: 他们发现在世界上的某个地方存在一对完美的二重身的可能性大约为 1/135。

doozy.en: Man, that English test was a doozy. I think I failed.
doozy.zh: 老兄， 这英文考题太难了， 我想我挂了。

doozy.en: She concocted a doozy to get her husband to see the doctor.
doozy.zh: 为了让老公去看医生， 她自己就编造了一个谎言。

doozy.en: This bubble was a doozy and its pop was felt around the world.
doozy.zh: 这是一个巨大的泡沫， 世界各地都能感受到它破裂的影响。

dote on.en: I love my husband and my children, and I positively dote on my grandchildren.
dote on.zh: 我深爱自己的丈夫和孩子， 对孙儿们更是疼爱有加。

dote on.en: I've seen lots of parents that dote on everything their kids do, who are worried about every little thing their kid might touch or that might cause a fall.
dote on.zh: 我见过很多父母对孩子做的每一件事都十分在意， 很关注他们会摸到什么，担心孩子会跌倒。

double-barrelled.en: His word was a double-barrelled compliment.
double-barrelled.zh: 他的话是双重意义的恭维。

double-barrelled.en: The true lumen, false lumen, " double-barrelled aorta", LV morphology and signal contrast were described.
double-barrelled.zh: 对真腔、 假腔、“双腔主动脉”、 左室形态和信号对比进行了描述。

double-barrelled.en: As for our method of knowing them, it can be and is summed up in a word, albeit a double-barrelled word: hypothetico - deductive.
double-barrelled.zh: 至于我们认识它们的方法， 可以用一个词，准确地说一个由两部分组成的词，来概括： 假说演绎。

douchebag.en: Got to class and my douchebag professor gave me an f.
douchebag.zh: 到了班里的时候我发现我的烧饼教授给了我个不及格。

douchebag.en: As long as I never have to date another douchebag again.
douchebag.zh: 只要我不必再和混蛋约会。

douchebag.en: This is just our douchebag military contractors trying to make a buck.
douchebag.zh: 这仅仅是我们的恶棍军工承包商试图赚些美元罢了。

doublets.en: The lords wore their hunting gear-short purple doublets and black hose.
doublets.zh: 那些贵族主们一身打猎行头打扮，短小的紫色紧身衣和黑色的长筒袜。

doublets.en: It was surprising when the alkali spectra showed unmistakable doublets.
doublets.zh: 当堿金属光谱显示出不容怀疑的双线结构时， 是令人惊奇的。

doublets.en: Anything else? Any other sorts of doublets or contradictions, because there are a few more?
doublets.zh: 还有发现其他矛盾之处吗？，补充几点？

doublets.en: Anything else? Any other sorts of doublets or contradictions, because there are a few more?
doublets.zh: 还有发现其他矛盾之处吗？,补充几点？

double talk.en: He gave us no real reasons, just the usual politician's double-talk.
double talk.zh: 他没告诉我们真正理由， 只说了些政客常说的空话。

double talk.en: A novel nonparametric classifier called NNL classifier is introduced to detect double-talk.
double talk.zh: 一种称为 NNL 分类器的新的非参数分类器被用来检测双端通话。

double talk.en: This paper presents a novel double-talk detector ( DTD ) based on a nearest neighbor line (NNL) classifier.
double talk.zh: 本文提出了一种基于最近邻线分类器的新的双端检测器 ( DTD )。

double-dyed.en: Jacob is a double-dyed scoundrel who would rob his own mother!
double-dyed.zh: 雅各布是个连他自己母亲的东西都要抢窃的恶贯满盈的坏蛋！

double-dyed.en: The pupa protein fiber is a new style regenerative protein fiber, is dyed with double- group reactive dyes, and have carried on some optimization tests to the craft of dyeing.
double-dyed.zh: 蚕蛹蛋白纤维是一种新型再生蛋白纤维， 采用了双活性基染料在中性浴和中温条件下进行染色，对染色工艺进行了一些优化试验。

double-dyed.en: The pupa protein fiber, a blended spun fiber with viscose and pupa protein, is dyed with double- group reactive dyes, and the dyeing conditions are tested emphatically.
double-dyed.zh: 由粘胶和蚕蛹蛋白混纺而成的蚕蛹蛋白纤维， 采用双活性基活性染料染色， 对染色工艺条件作了重点试验。

doughy.zh: 又冷又湿，像面团—— 几乎像油灰。

doughy.en: It should be tender and moist but not gummy or doughy.
doughy.zh: 它应该很柔软潮湿， 不黏也不软稠。

doughy.en: Pasty, doughy. Term applied to some very heavily coloured wines rich in dry extract.
doughy.zh: 浆状的、 糊状的： 用于描述某些颜色非常浓郁， 富含干提取物的葡萄酒。

down payment.en: For every down-payment, after all, there is a balance outstanding.
down payment.zh: 毕竟每一种首付款，都意味着还存在未付清的款项。

down payment.en: For borrowers, authorities imposed higher down-payment requirements.
down payment.zh: 对于贷款者来说， 相关部门提高了首付比重。

down payment.en: Celeste asked for the money as a down payment on an old farmhouse.
down payment.zh: 西莱斯特索要那笔钱用作一座旧农舍的首付款。

down-home.en: Betty had learned a thing or two about down-home cooking from her mother.
down-home.zh: 贝蒂从她妈妈身上学到了简单的乡村式烹饪。

down-home.en: Its pure, unvarnished truth is told with down-home common sense.
down-home.zh: 书中单纯质朴的事实是用地道的常识来讲述的。

down-home.en: Tom Hardy ’s rugged charm and Evangeline Lilly’s down-home toughness would provide the bang needed to bring Bonnie and Clyde to life.
down-home.zh: 汤姆 • 哈迪 （Tom Hardy）粗线条的魅力和伊万杰琳 •莉莉（Evangeline Lilly）乡土味的坚韧将提供需要的劲爆复活《邦妮和克莱德》。

down for the count.en: If appearance did not count, why would people dress up for such interviews - even if the job they are hoping to get is dressed down?
down for the count.zh: 如果长相不重要，那为什么人们要打扮一番来参加面试呢， 即使他们希望得到的工作不需要穿着方面的要求？

down for the count.en: I watch the clock impatiently waiting for 5 o' clock.i count down the days of the week until the weekend.
down for the count.zh: 我烦躁地盯着时钟等着它走到 5 点，我每天数着日子等着周末来临。

down for the count.en: I watch the clock impatiently waiting for 5 o' clock. I count down the days of the week until the weekend.
down for the count.zh: 我烦躁地盯着时钟等着它走到 5 点，我每天数着日子等着周末来临。

down-and-out.en: One good blow would topple him over and down and out.
down-and-out.zh: 只要好好的一拳， 就能把他打倒，叫他完蛋。

down-and-out.en: People should lend him a helping hand; he's really down and out.
down-and-out.zh: 人们应该助他一臂之力， 他已经穷困潦倒了。

down-and-out.en: Right now the poor guy is really down and out.
down-and-out.zh: 现在，可怜的旦尼尔真是处于穷困潦到的境况。

down-and-out.en: One by one he subdued his father's trees By riding them down over and over again Until he took the stiffness out of them - And not one but hung limp, not one was left for him to conquer.
down-and-out.zh: 他一株一株地征服他父亲的树,一次又一次地把它们骑在胯下,直到把树的倔强劲儿完全制服：,一株又一株都垂头丧气地低下来。

down-and-out.en: Let me come down hazardously off this stage, and figure out - - Let's get the mics up a bit for a second, we can get some mics ready.
down-and-out.zh: 我先走下讲台看看各位,麻烦准备好麦克风

downcast.en: She was silent, her eyes downcast.
downcast.zh: 她不做声， 目光低垂。

downcast.en: She was so downcast, so afraid that it should die!
downcast.zh: 她是那么沮丧，那么害怕它会死去！

downcast.en: The people observe thy downcast head, thy clouded mien, and they take it for an omen.
downcast.zh: 人们看到你低垂的头，你闷闷不乐的样子， 就以为是不好的预兆。

down the ages.en: These customs have been handed down through the ages.
down the ages.zh: 这些风俗是世世代代传下来的。

down the ages.en: Even frescoes and ICONS from the early Middle Ages already have the basic look down pat.
down the ages.zh: 即使在中世纪早期的壁画和肖像中，上帝的容貌也与上文所描述的基本相同。

down the ages.en: DOWN the ages stuttering has been blamed on many things.
down the ages.zh: 多年来， 口吃可以归咎于许多事。

down-to-earth.en: She seems very grounded and down-to - earth.
down-to-earth.zh: 她看上去非常现实， 注重实际。

down-to-earth.en: The book is a friendly, down-to - earth introduction to physics.
down-to-earth.zh: 这是一本简明、 实用的物理学入门书。

down-to-earth.en: Gloria is probably the most down-to - earth person I've ever met.
down-to-earth.zh: 格洛丽亚可能是我见过的最脚踏实地的人。

down-to-earth.en: breaking down maybe, crashing, coming back to earth like Icarus, the over - reacher.
down-to-earth.zh: 可能会损坏它，彻底的，回到地面,像伊卡洛斯一样。

down-to-earth.en: And I felt that people here were the most, like, down-to - Earth,
down-to-earth.zh: 我觉得普林斯顿的学生最踏实，

down-to-earth.en: I think that his deadpan way of bringing things down to earth when they get a little too highfalutin' involves the skill of a genuine stand - up comic.
down-to-earth.zh: 我认为他是真的有漫画人物的效果,当他总是面无表情的’,让那些过分骄傲的人回归现实。

double bind.en: If he eats the cake, it could kill him; if he refuses it, it will make his wife angry and she will reject him: a double bind.
double bind.zh: 如果他吃了蛋糕， 它足可以要了他的命；如果他拒绝这么做，就会激怒太太而且她就会拒绝接纳他： 一个双重约束。

double bind.en: 'This is something of a double bind as they have to say' yes'.
double bind.zh: 当他们说是的时候就会是双重约束。

double bind.en: Double bind questions are questions that, whichever way you answer, the result is the same.
double bind.zh: 无论你怎么回答， 结果都是一样的—— 发问者的目的达成。这种问题就是 “两难问题”。

downdraft.en: The downdraft trumped two other developments that should have shored up the market.
downdraft.zh: 印度科技业前景黯淡对股市的影响显然超过了另外两个股市利好消息。

downdraft.en: Trouble is, a lot of that capital has gone away in the market downdraft of the past two years.
downdraft.zh: 问题是，其中的许多资金在过去两年市场的下行中都已经损失了。

downdraft.en: According to the character of IC engine and its requirement on gas quality, designed the downdraft biomass gasifier.
downdraft.zh: 根据内燃式燃气发电机的性能参数和对燃气质量的要求，对下吸式生物质气化炉进行了设计。

downtrodden.en: But this was no ordinary group of the downtrodden.
downtrodden.zh: 但是， 这一次来的却不是被欺压的普通人群。

downtrodden.en: A downtrodden region is getting a taste of freedom.
downtrodden.zh: 一个饱压迫的地区正在尝试自由的滋味。

downtrodden.en: It might even be enough to make other people feel a bit downtrodden.
downtrodden.zh: 它甚至可能足够使其他人体会到一点被压迫的感觉。

downtrodden.en: Now I'm a kind--now,over here-- I'm a kind,compassionate, warm individual who cares about the downtrodden.
downtrodden.zh: 现在的我是一个-,善良，有同情心，会在乎弱者的人。
但到300岁的时候，我会觉得。

downstream.en: The logs are drifted downstream to the mill.
downstream.zh: 原木顺流漂到木材加工厂。

downstream.en: Others point out that decreased sediment loads will likely lead to erosion of downstream riverbanks and the Mekong Delta.
downstream.zh: 其他人指出， 泥沙负荷的减少可能会导致下游河岸和湄公河三角洲的侵蚀。

downstream.en: Because in doing that, Python would then have a value that it could pass on into some other part of a computation, and if it wasn't what I wanted, I might be a long ways downstream in the computation before I actually hit some result that makes no sense.
downstream.zh: 因为如果这样做的话，Python会将,输入的值传递到下面的,一些运算中去，如果这个值的类型不是我想要的，我可能会在得到,一个毫无意义的结果之前,经历一个很长时间的,计算过程。

downsizing.en: Organization theory cannot adequately explain downsizing; non-economic factors must also be considered.
downsizing.zh: 组织理论不能充分解释裁员现象； 非经济因素也必须考虑。

downsizing.en: There's a surplus of physical shopping space for the crowds, which is one reason why stores are downsizing and closing.
downsizing.zh: 大众的实体购物空间过剩是商店缩小规模和关闭的原因之一。

downsizing.en: "There's rising work demand coupled with the insecurity of mergers, takeovers, downsizing and other factors," Moen said.
downsizing.zh: 摩恩说：“伴随着合并、 接管、 裁员和其他因素带来的不安全性， 工作需求在增加。”

dowry.en: In prosperous northern Indian states, women whose families have failed to stump up a sufficient dowry still get killed or disfigured.
dowry.zh: 在繁荣的印度北部地区， 如果女子的家人不能拿出足够的嫁妆，她们还会被杀或是毁容。

dowry.en: I wonder if the dowry depends on tonnage?
dowry.zh: 我想知道，难道嫁妆取决于吨位吗？

dowry.en: I only need to save up for the dowry, which is manageable.
dowry.zh: 我只需要给他存嫁妆钱了， 这就比较好办了。

doze off.en: Some students often doze off in class.
doze off.zh: 有些学生经常在课堂上打瞌睡。

doze off.en: I occasionally doze off, only to be awakened by the agonizing pain of another collapsed vein and infiltrating fluids.
doze off.zh: 我时不时地会打一会瞌睡，但每次都被静脉破裂和输液的液体漏出引起的难忍的痛苦弄醒。

doze off.en: We couldn't help but doze off during his lecture.
doze off.zh: 他演讲时我们忍不住打瞌睡。

doxology.en: Th' Magic listened when tha' sung th' Doxology.
doxology.zh: 当你们在唱赞美诗的时候， 魔法正在听着呢。

doxology.en: "Tha' might sing th' Doxology," he suggested in his dryest grunt.
doxology.zh: 你或许该唱唱赞美诗。”他用干嗓子咕哝着建议说。

doxology.en: Colin was of an exploring mind and he knew nothing about the Doxology.
doxology.zh: 科林有着爱探索的头脑， 他也对赞美诗一无所知。

drama queen.en: Do you know a drama queen that always calls to talk to you when they're going through their crises?
drama queen.zh: 你知不知道有个做戏的人， 总是打电话跟你说她们正在经历危机。

drama queen.en: She made her feature film debut in Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen but it was her role in the 2007 summer blockbuster Transformers that shot her to stardom.
drama queen.zh: 长篇电影 《高校天后》 是她的首次演出， 但真正让她获得演员身份的是她在 2007年夏季大片《变形金刚》中的角色。

draconian.en: But lowering birth rate need not be so draconian.
draconian.zh: 但降低生育率无需如此严苛。

draconian.en: Stop with all the " Apple's Draconian rules " crap.
draconian.zh: 终止与苹果的所有严格规则。

draconian.en: That's perhaps a little more draconian but that's a quick action.
draconian.zh: 那可能是有点更苛刻的， 但是那是个快动作。

draconian.en: But Hobbes' teaching about law is, in some ways, less Draconian than it might first appear.
draconian.zh: 但一定程度上讲，霍布斯关于法律的学说，比早期的法律要宽容得多。

draconian.en: Now this sounds like a draconian measure; let me tell you why.
draconian.zh: 这个听起来很像苛政;,让我告诉你原因。

drawing-room.en: If they moved in the drawing-room, the apple only turned its yellow side.
drawing-room.zh: 如果他们在客厅走动， 苹果只会显露出黄色的一面。

drawing-room.en: A big drawing-room, two bedrooms, and a nursery are situated on the second floor.
drawing-room.zh: 二楼有一间大客厅、 两间卧室和一个婴儿房。

drawing-room.en: Two servants came in rich livery and carried the Fir Tree into a large and splendid drawing-room.
drawing-room.zh: 两个穿得很讲究的仆人走来了，把这枞树抬到一间漂亮的大客厅里去。

drawn.en: I've always been drawn to tough, gutsy women.
drawn.zh: 我总是被坚强、 勇敢的女性所吸引。

drawn.en: He was drawn to the monastic life.
And I don't know why, but since time immemorial that is the way computer scientists have drawn trees.
drawn.zh: 叶子是在最下面的，我不知道为什么,但从记事以来他们就是这么画树的,这也许就是为什么我们。

drawn.en: It seems formal and analytical in contrast to Machiavelli's combination of historical commentary and reflection drawn from personal experience.
drawn.zh: 它看起来更正式，分析得更透彻,这是与马基雅维利的,从个人经验出发,历史性的评论和反思相结合相比。

drawbridge.en: Hearing the wheels on the drawbridge, Puss in Boots hastened out.
drawbridge.zh: 听见吊桥上车轮的声音，穿靴子的猫急忙跑了出来。

drawbridge.en: The chains clanked as the drawbridge opened.
drawbridge.zh: 吊桥放下时， 铁链发出叮当声。

drawn-out.en: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
drawn-out.zh: 通向和平的路将是漫长而延宕的。

drawn-out.en: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most egregiously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
drawn-out.zh: 改革一直遭到强烈反对， 最让人惊讶的可能是在教育业， 其中的特许学校、 学会和绩效工资都面临着持久的斗争。

drawn-out.en: A drawn-out game is now about to start.

dregs.en: Colum drained the dregs from his cup.
dregs.zh: 科拉姆将杯中所剩一饮而尽。

dregs.en: Pour the dregs away and rinse the pot.
dregs.zh: 倒掉沉渣， 把壶涮干净。

dreamboat.en: When he saw her at the party, he knew that he found dreamboat.
dreamboat.zh: 当他在舞会上看见她时， 知道自己已经找到梦中情人了。

dreamboat.en: When he saw her at the party, he knew that he found his dreamboat.
dreamboat.zh: 当他在舞会上看见她时， 知道自己已经找到梦中情人了。

drink to the dregs.en: People who live long, who will drink of the cup of life to the very bottom, must expect to meet with some of the usual dregs.
drink to the dregs.zh: 长寿之人既能饮尽生命之杯，就必须有在杯底看见残渣的心理准备。

drive a wedge between.en: Clarke would also have offered a plum opening: Brown would only have had to mention Europe to drive a wedge between a Eurosceptic party and its Europhile leader.
drive a wedge between.zh: 克拉克也给一个很好的开场白： 布朗只有提及欧洲才能挑拨欧洲怀疑派的内部纷争，导致亲欧领导人与其他成员的不合。

fateful.en: She looked back now to that fateful day in December.

forfeiture.en: He was deep in debt and faced with forfeiture of his property.

formulaic.en: His paintings are contrived and formulaic.

frilly.zh: 百褶裙过时了，仿制的香奈儿裙装正流行。

frilly.en: Would I embrace frilly dresses or ban Barbies?
frilly.zh: 我应该大力支持她穿百褶裙还是禁止她玩芭比娃娃？

frilly.en: Hope is a frilly pink dress that exposes your knees.
frilly.zh: 希望是件粉色褶边连衣裙， 使你暴露出膝盖。

fret over.en: However, there is no need to fret over your meanness, as it seems to be the norm.
fret over.zh: 但是， 没有必要为你的吝啬而感到烦恼， 因为这似乎是惯例。

fret over.en: As much as we shampoo it, style it, cut it, and fret over it, hair continues to be a mystery to us.
fret over.zh: 不管我们如何来洗头发、弄发型、 剪头发、 甚至为头发烦恼，头发对我们来说仍是个奥秘。

fret over.en: She was confident of having performed her duty, and to fret over unavoidable evils, or augment them by anxiety, was no part of her disposition.
fret over.zh: 她相信她已经尽了自己的责任，至于要她为那些无法避免的害处去忧闷， 或者是过分焦虑， 那她可办不到。

frieze.en: TheVIP preview of FRIEZE began on a Wednesday morning.
frieze.zh: 佛利兹艺术博览会为贵宾所作的预展在一个周三的上午开始。

frieze.en: A careful reconstruction of the frieze is a persuasive reason for visiting Liverpool.
frieze.zh: 这次能让游客走访利物浦展览会，其中一个具有说服力的原因则是壁画得到了精心的重建。

frieze.en: Isn't it more like a trivial luxury for the same fabled Russian moneyed elite who buy their art yachts at Frieze?
frieze.zh: 这类享受细节化奢侈的人群难道不和在费里兹购买艺术游艇的俄罗斯财富精英们属于同一个类型吗？

frivolity.en: It was just a piece of harmless frivolity.
frivolity.zh: 这仅是无恶意的愚蠢行为。

frivolity.en: There is just not enough fun and frivolity in culture today.
frivolity.zh: 当今文化中太缺少乐趣和轻松。

frivolity.en: There is a serious message at the core of all this frivolity.
frivolity.zh: 所有这些轻松乐事的核心传递着一个严肃的讯息。

frivolous.en: Toad ceased his frivolous antics at once.
frivolous.zh: 托德立刻停止了他那轻浮的滑稽动作。

frivolous.en: " There's a common belief that reading literature is frivolous, or not practical," Mar said.
frivolous.zh: 人们普遍认为阅读文学作品是轻浮的， 或者是不切实际的。” 马尔说。

frivolous.en: Some critics will point out subjects such as Art or Music and label them as being frivolous and time-wasting.
frivolous.zh: 一些评论家会指出艺术或音乐之类的学科， 并为它们贴上轻浮和浪费时间的标签。

frippery.en: She often wears ornaments of frippery.
frippery.zh: 她常戴些低俗的装饰品。

frippery.en: Affections of manner and speech are mere frippery.
frippery.zh: 态度和语言的做作只是矫饰而已。

frippery.en: Affectations of manner and speech are mere frippery.
frippery.zh: 态度和语言的做作只是俗丽服饰而已。

frock.en: She stood up and smoothed down her frock.
frock.zh: 她站了起来， 抚平了自己的连衣裙。

frock.en: She waited in a new frock because the old one simply would not meet; but he never came.
frock.zh: 她穿着一件新连衣裙等着， 因为旧的那件根本穿不上； 但是， 他没有来。

frock.en: One more frock passed in at the gate, and Tom's heart gave a great bound.
frock.zh: 又有一件连衣裙从门口飘进来， 汤姆的心猛地一跳。

frock.en: And here in the middle of the page a little ways down: My love's striped black-and-white cotton frock, jaunty blue cap, white socks and brown moccasins were not quite in keeping with the large, beautifully cut aquamarine on a silver chainlet which gemmed her throat, a spring rain gift from me.
frock.zh: 在这一页中间偏下的地方：,我的小情人穿着黑白条子的棉布裙，带着鲜艳的蓝色帽子，白袜子和亮皮鞋与她脖子上那条优美的,蓝宝石项链有些不协调,这是由于那场春雨我送给她的礼物。

fuddled.en: Fuddled by brandy, her brain fumbled over the events of the night.
fuddled.zh: 她喝了白兰地后口齿不清，也记不清晚上发生的事。

fuddled.en: The more he talked, the angrier he became. Fuddled with drink, he clumsily knocked over his wine cup.
fuddled.zh: 他越说越气， 毛手毛脚地喝酒，把酒杯都打翻了。

fuddled.en: If a person lacks a beacon light-ideal, his life will be fuddled.
fuddled.zh: 如果一个人缺少一颗指路明灯 ——理想，就会醉生梦死。

frugal.en: Everyone says this, but it really is a top tip for frugal eaters.
frugal.zh: 每个人都这么说， 但这确实是给节俭的食客最好的建议。

frugal.en: The honourable worker who lives a very frugal life gives away most of his money to charities.
frugal.zh: 这位可敬的工人过着非常节俭的生活， 他把他的大部分钱都捐赠给了慈善机构。

frugal.en: They learned how to trim almost 20 percent off their monthly child care bills during the 30-day " Frugal Family Challenge ".
frugal.zh: 在为期 30天的“节俭家庭挑战”活动中， 他们学会了如何削减每月近 20% 的育儿费用。

frothy.en: Blend a banana, strawberries, and blueberries into a frothy smoothie, and you've got a delicious arsenal of disease-fighting vitamins and minerals.
frothy.zh: 饮用一杯用香蕉、 草莓和蓝莓混合而成的泡沫奶昔， 不仅美味，它其中所含有的维他命和矿物质还能帮你抵御疾病，增加抵抗力。

frothy.en: Soapberries can be whipped into a frothy treat.
frothy.zh: 可以将无患子属植物打成泡沫状。

frothy.en: The appearance of sputum also showed the process from watery frothy sputum to mucus sputum to mucopuraleat sputum.
frothy.zh: 痰液的出现也显示了从含水泡沫状痰液到粘液痰液到粘膜粘液痰液的过程。

frothy.en: So in the sense there is opportunity, and there may be more opportunity in the long run even if kind of the entrepreneurial opportunities are less frothy than they might have been in the short run.
frothy.zh: 因此从这个意义上讲现在是大好时机，长期来看会有更多的机遇,如果创业的机会不像短期机遇,看起来那么空洞的话。

full-dress.en: The sword hasn't had a military function for a hundred years, but is still part of an officer's full-dress uniform, precisely because a sword always symbolized "an officer and a gentleman ".
full-dress.zh: 刀剑失去军事功能已有一百年了， 但它仍然是军官全套制服的一部分， 因为刀剑总是象征着 “军官和绅士”。

full-dress.en: He put on his full-dress uniform complete with MEDALS and insignia.
full-dress.zh: 他穿上了佩有勋章和徽章的军礼服。

full-dress.en: My wedding dress has a very full skirt so I need to wear a good quality slip.
full-dress.zh: 我的结婚礼服有一个非常宽大多褶的下摆， 所以我需要穿一条质地好的衬裙。

fumbling.en: When she came within a score of feet of the desired goal, she observed a young gentleman in a grey clerk suit, fumbling his watch-chain and looking out.
fumbling.zh: 当她离目标还有二十英尺远的时候，她看到一个穿着灰色职员服的年轻绅士在摸索着表链，向外望着。

fumbling.en: Peter drove jerkily, cornering too fast and fumbling the gears.
fumbling.zh: 彼得开车很不平稳， 转弯太快，换档也不熟练。

fumbling.en: She was fumbling around in the dark looking for the light switch.

full-throated.en: Singest of summer in full-throated ease. 10.
full-throated.zh: 放开喉咙、 自在地歌唱着夏季。

full-throated.en: More broadly, you might argue that what Obama has lacked is a theme: there hasn't been much full-throated condemnation of the bad old ways, much vision of things being different.
full-throated.zh: 更广泛地说， 你可能会认为奥巴马缺乏的是一个主题： 没有全面谴责糟糕的旧方式，具体是什么，不同的人有不同的见解。

full-throated.en: She saw me, began to choke with laughter, and then let it out in full throated peals.
full-throated.zh: 她看见我， 开始时憋住没笑出声来， 接着忍不住放声大笑起来。

full-ride.en: The reality of it is that a lot of low - income kids could be going to elite universities on a full ride scholarship and don't even realize it.
full-ride.zh: 现实情况是， 很多低收入家庭的孩子可以拿着全额奖学金进入名牌大学，但他们自己却没有意识到。

full-ride.en: I can ride it together with other kids to keep healthy. It's full of fun.
full-ride.zh: 我可以和其他孩子一起乘坐它来保持健康。有趣极了。

full-ride.en: She was indeed offered a scholarship, a full ride, to a Division I, NCAA women's basketball team.
full-ride.zh: 她真的获得了奖学金， 一个全面资助的奖学金，并且进入美国全国大学体育协会其中一队女子甲组篮球队。

fugitive.en: The detention of the fugitive was lawful.
fugitive.zh: 对逃亡者的拘留是合法的。

fugitive.en: He was just another fugitive to us.
fugitive.zh: 他只是我们的一个逃犯而已。

fugitive.en: If you're on a witness protection program or you're sort of fugitive you probably don't want to sit on the front roll.
fugitive.zh: 如果你在证人保护计划之内,或者是个逃犯级人物,就尽量不要坐在前排了

fugitive.en: That's in Exodus 21:26-27. Moreover, the slave is entitled to the Sabbath rest and all of the Sabbath legislation. And quite importantly, a fugitive slave cannot be returned to his master.
fugitive.zh: 这是在《出埃及记》第21章26-27节的描述，另外，奴隶有权,享受安息日的休息和所有关于安息日的法规，十分，重要的一点是，逃亡的奴隶不能再被归还给他的主人。

fundamentalism.en: Is this countrified bleak fundamentalism a spoof?
fundamentalism.zh: 这种质朴冷酷的原教旨主义也许只是一种讥讽？

fundamentalism.en: Fundamentalism has spread from rural areas to the affluent suburbs.
fundamentalism.zh: 正统基督教派从乡村传播到了富裕的市郊。

fundamentalism.en: Perhaps some of them are getting ready to convert from fundamentalism to common sense.
fundamentalism.zh: 也许他们中的一些人正准备从原教旨主义变得更通情达理些。

functionary.en: He raised his hands to the sky, then gestured toward a state functionary visiting his farm.
functionary.zh: 他举手向天， 随后又指了指查看其农田的国家公务员。

functionary.en: The book's hero, the Englishman Winston Smith, is a minor party functionary in one of these states.
functionary.zh: 主人公是一位英国人温斯顿· 史密斯， 是一位小职员。

functionary.en: Any judicial functionary who commits a crime mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs shall be given a heavier punishment.
functionary.zh: 司法工作人员犯前两款罪的， 从重处罚。

fume.en: As I said, it's a particularly hazardous substance and is worked with in fume hoods.
fume.zh: 就像我说过的， 这是尤其有害的物质， 在通风柜中才能用。

fume.en: Lie precariously at the edge of the mattress and fume if you must, but lie in the same bed.
fume.zh: 躺在床的边沿， 摇摇欲坠， 如果你一定要的话，可以发火， 但要躺在同一张床上。

fume.en: It has slashed the cost of toll roads to almost one-tenth of the normal level, attracting yet more people on to fume -choked roads.
fume.zh: 它将收费公路的成本削减至正常水平的近十分之一， 然而致使更多的人走上烟雾弥漫的道路。

fume.en: As I said, it's a particularly hazardous substance, this is worked with in fume hoods.
fume.zh: 就像我说过的，这是特别有害的物质，在通风柜中才能用。

fungus.en: 200,000 specimens of fungus are kept at the Komarov Botanical Institute.
fungus.zh: 万个真菌标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。

fungus.en: These are not single individual plants; each one is a symbiotic combination of an alga and a fungus.
fungus.zh: 这些不是单个的植物； 每一种都是藻类和真菌的共生组合。

fungus.en: But this particular fungus nibbles away only at certain layers in the wood, leaving other layers alone.
fungus.zh: 但是这种特殊的真菌只会慢慢啃食木头的特定几层结构，而不去啃其他层。

furor.zh: 那么， 如何解释这份狂热呢？

furor.en: The furor died down, and I realized that none of it had any relevance to what I was doing.
furor.zh: 对这本书的狂热逐渐平静下去了， 我意识到这和我的写作没有任何关系。

furor.en: Do you know where he went?” But we do not want to create what you would think of as a public furor.

fuss over.en: All that fuss over a few pounds!
fuss over.zh: 为几英镑就那么大惊小怪的！

fuss over.en: Auntie Hilda and Uncle Jack couldn't fuss over them enough.
fuss over.zh: 希尔达婶婶和杰克叔叔再宠爱他们不过了。

fuss over.en: But it is wrong to dismiss the week's woes as an over - precautionary fuss over nothing.
fuss over.zh: 但是仅仅将这一周的痛苦作为一个过度小心的麻烦而忽略掉是错误的。

funeral home.en: In Yell County my campaign was run by my cousin Mike Cornwell, the local funeral-home operator.
funeral home.zh: 在耶尔县， 我的竞选活动由我的表哥麦克。 康沃尔负责， 他经营着一家当地殡仪馆。

funeral home.en: Funeral-home companies thought they could grow by acquisition and cut costs through consolidation.
funeral home.zh: 殡葬公司曾认为能够通过合并以及合并所带来的支出减少而得到成长。

funeral home.en: Jason and Rachael Storm held their wedding at a funeral home in US State of Michigan, where he is a funeral director.
funeral home.zh: 美国密歇根州一对新人日前在一家殡仪馆举行了婚礼，因为新郎詹森在殡仪馆工作， 是一名丧葬承办人。

furniture.en: The room was empty of furniture.
furniture.zh: 房间里什么家具都没有。

furniture.en: We sent our furniture on by ship.
furniture.zh: 我们提前把家具水运过去了。

furniture.en: I'm not certain it's meaningful, unless you are in the habit of giving your furniture personal names.
furniture.zh: 我不确定它有意义，除非你们热衷于,给你们的家具起名字。

furniture.en: And maybe I can rearrange the furniture a little bit.
furniture.zh: 也许我可以重新布置一下家具的位置。

gadfly.en: FOR a week the Gadfly lay in a fearful state.
gadfly.zh: 整整一个星期， 牛虻的病都处于严重的状态。

gadfly.en: No matter I live, or I die, I was a gadfly, happy flying.
gadfly.zh: 不管我活着， 还是我死去，我都是一只牛虻， 快乐地飞来飞去。——《牛虻》。

gadfly.en: After 13 years, an ugly man called Gadfly returned to Italy.
gadfly.zh: 年后， 一个长相丑陋的叫牛虻的人回到了意大利。

gadfly.en: He brings with it important benefits and in the passage that I'm referring to, he defines himself as a gadfly, everyone will remember that, the gadfly who improves the quality of life in the city.
gadfly.zh: 他强调能带来显著好处,在我将引用的段落中，他自称是只牛虻，众人都将铭记，是牛虻改善了,城邦的生活质量。

funky.en: The place is quirky, funky and dazzlingly imaginative in design.
funky.zh: 这个地方非同凡响、 时髦别致且设计极富想像力。

funky.en: She would love to buy her daughter funky little leopard-print skirts.
funky.zh: 她过去爱给女儿买时髦别致的豹纹小短裙。

funky.en: Inside their home, the mood was all about entertainment — sleek furnishings and a funky cocktail bar.
funky.zh: 在他们的家里， 一切氛围都是为了娱乐—— 井然有序的家具陈设和时髦独特的鸡尾酒吧。

funky.en: It's got this funky looking form, right, it says, I've got something that I'm going to call a class, got that key word class right here.
funky.zh: 以及我们怎么来使用这些方法，因此我要回到类这个概念上来，让我们来建立第一个类吧,就在你们课堂手册的这儿，我会去定义一个类。

funky.en: And then there's an area called Williamsburg and Greenpoint which are younger, a little more funky.
funky.zh: 那里有叫威廉斯堡和绿点的地方，它们充满朝气，又多一点时尚。

funky.en: There's one more piece that we'd like to get out of that, and that is-- you may have been wondering, what's with the funky stuttering here of three double-quotes in a row. All right? And that is a specification.
funky.zh: 但是你没有屏蔽这个函数的使用细节,在这里我们还想再讲一讲,那就是--你可能正在想,这里连续3个奇怪双引号,是干什么用的。

gaga.en: The fans went totally gaga over the band.
gaga.zh: 乐迷们对这个乐队完全着迷了。

gaga.en: Lady Gaga wore this tuxedo-ish number, with what looks like portions of an Elizabethan neck ruff protruding from the jacket.
gaga.zh: 穿着一件燕尾服式的礼服， 一圈类似于伊丽莎白时期的颈部飞边从外套里突了出来。

gaga.en: This time, however, Gaga is calling the shots.
gaga.zh: 然而， 这个时代， 嘎嘎自己说了算。

gabfest.en: The event in Toronto this week was not a frontiersman's gathering, however, but the world's biggest mining gabfest.
gabfest.zh: 但这一周在多伦多举行的年会可不是又一次勘探者的狂欢聚会， 而是世界上最大的矿业会议。

gad-about.en: Don't think you'll keep me here while you gad about.
gad-about.zh: 别指望你自己去闲逛的时候把我留在这儿。

gad-about.en: The Tories also enjoy funds that dwarf the Liberal Democrats' (and Mr Clegg does not habitually gad about in private planes ).
gad-about.zh: 保守党筹款能力也使自民党相形见绌 ( 克莱格也不经常坐私人飞机四处游荡 )。

gad-about.en: While they gad about the world, their children are neglected at home.
gad-about.zh: 他们在世界各地游荡， 孩子在家无人照看。

gain on.en: Yesterday London was playing catch - up after Wall Street's tremendous 500 - point gain on Wednesday night.
gain on.zh: 星期三晚上华尔街获得 500 点巨长之后， 昨天伦敦也开始了奋起直追。

gain on.en: But the Dow Jones Industrial Average eked out a mere 22 - point gain on the day of the announcement.
gain on.zh: 然而道琼斯工业平均指数在计划公布当天竭力维持了一个仅仅 22点的增长。

gain on.en: Of course, if member countries were willing to pool all their borrowing, they might gain, on average, a small reduction in debt - service costs.
gain on.zh: 当然， 成员国家愿意共同担当它们所有的借贷风险， 平均算来， 它们可能可以少量减少债务偿付的成本。

gamine.en: She had a gamine charm which men found irresistibly attractive.
gamine.zh: 她的男孩气对男人们有不可抗拒的吸引力。

gamine.en: The photo shows Hepburn posing for one of the movie's iconic publicity shots with pencil lines marking up her face, supposedly indicating where the gamine star could use a bit of smoothing.
gamine.zh: 这张照片是赫本为电影拍摄的宣传照的其中一张，我们可以看到照片上赫本的脸上有一些铅笔画过的痕迹，按道理推测那些痕迹就是需要一点 “修饰” 的地方了。

gainsay.zh: 没人能够反驳他的说法。

gainsay.en: No one can gainsay his honesty.
The doctors certainly think so, and who am I to gainsay them?
gainsay.zh: 医生确定地这么认为， 而且我是谁否定他们？

gangly.zh: 程序代码就变得越来越腐浊了。

gangly.en: I had never seen a chap as tall and gangly as he was.
gangly.zh: 我从没见过像他那样又瘦又高的人。

gangly.en: I was an awkward child. Tall, gangly, and, like everyone else in my family, severely myopic.
gangly.zh: 我是一个不讨人喜欢的孩子， 瘦高个，还像我家里的每个人一样，眼睛严重近视。

gain traction.en: In this case, Freemium can help you gain traction if you use an effective invitation mechanism.
gain traction.zh: 从这方面来说， 如果你采用一个有效的邀请机制， 免费商业模式可以帮助你获得牵引力。

gain traction.en: The group would fill a gap in Microsoft's Internet strategy, which has so far struggled to gain traction.
gain traction.zh: 微软的互联网战略迄今一直在苦苦寻找牵引力， 而雅虎可填补这一空白。

gain traction.en: Let's face it, even some of the craziest claims can quickly gain traction. I've had some experience in that regard.
gain traction.zh: 让我们面对这些， 即使有的最疯狂的说法也会很快得到反馈， 我自己就有过这方面的经历。

garb.en: He wore the garb of a scout.
garb.zh: 他穿了一身童子军的装束。

garb.en: The garb was presented to Obama by elders in Wajir.
garb.zh: 这身装扮是瓦基的一位老人家送给奥巴马的。

garb.en: I wonder what our garb will look like in the future.

grim reaper.en: Although death is the central theme of Halloween celebrants deal with the grim reaper only on a playful level.

groggy.zh: 我看见她时， 她正感觉到有一点头晕脑胀。

groggy.zh: 两个小时后， 伍醒了， 感到脑袋发晕且很不舒服。

gripe.zh: 我对这家旅馆唯一不满的是伙食。

gripe.en: The host generally pays, and no one wants to hear you gripe about appetizer prices or shrimp count.
gripe.zh: 主人通常都会支付账单， 没人想要听到你抱怨关于开胃菜的价格或者小虾的个数。
时间是另一个让人诟病的因素。

gripping.en: His books are always so gripping.
gripping.zh: 他的书总是那么扣人心弦。

gripping.en: It's got a gripping story, great acting, superb sets, and stunning effects.
gripping.zh: 电影有扣人心弦的故事情节、 精湛的表演、绝妙的布景和惊人的特效。

gripping.en: His thrillers are always a gripping read.
gripping.zh: 他的惊险小说向来引人入胜。

gripping.en: Let's look at what is, for me, the most gripping example of this kind of poem: "Home Burial," on page 204.
gripping.zh: 我们来看看，我认为，这类诗中最引人注意的例子：,“家冢“，在204页。

gritty.en: MGM tended to put out a lot of all-star productions while Paramount excelled in comedy and Warner Bros, developed a reputation for gritty social realism.
gritty.zh: 倾向于推出大量全明星的作品， 而派拉蒙擅长喜剧， 华纳兄弟则建立了坚韧不拔的社会现实主义的名声。

gritty.en: The sheets fell on the gritty floor, and she just let them lie.
gritty.zh: 床单落在满是沙砾的地板上， 而她却置之不理。

gritty.en: Time ran out before we could get down to the real nitty- gritty.
gritty.zh: 我们还没来得及探讨真正的细节， 时间就过去了。

gritty.en: Today we're going to come to what I would call the nitty- gritty of the course.
gritty.zh: 今天我们要开始,我所指的实质性课程了

grist to the mill.en: The Scandinavians cluster at the top — grist to the mill for those who believe more equal societies are more mobile.
grist to the mill.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚人排在了最前面， 对于那些相信较平等的社会有着较强流动性的人们无疑是有利的。

grit teeth.en: There is going to be hardship, but we have to grit our teeth and get on with it.
grit teeth.zh: 磨难会有的， 但我们必须下定决心继续做下去。

grit teeth.en: Mexico, in its current chastened mood, will no doubt grit its teeth and say nothing.
grit teeth.zh: 而墨西哥， 以其当前的成熟心态， 无疑将紧闭嘴巴，什么也不说。

grit teeth.en: There is grit in my teeth from the dust on Juba's dirt roads.
grit teeth.zh: 我感到从朱巴的土路上飞驰而过之后有嘴里满是沙土。

groomer.en: You may or may not wish to know that your pet groomer, hairdresser, mailman and UPS guy all expect a holiday tip
groomer.zh: 你可能想知道，也可能不想知道， 你的宠物美容师、 发型师、 邮递员和 UPS 快递员都希望得到假期小费。

groomer.en: Three months later, a relative of the neighbors saw the pet at a dog groomer.
groomer.zh: 个月后， 邻居的亲戚在一个狗美容店里看到这条狗，邻居才知道自己的爱犬并没有死。

groomer.en: I'm a dog groomer and I'm constantly working with water and other irritants.
groomer.zh: 我是一个狗饲养员，我经常要和水还有其他的一些刺激物打交道。

ground coffee.en: The beans are then ground and packaged for sale as ground coffee.
ground coffee.zh: 咖啡豆接着被磨碎、 包装， 以研磨咖啡销售。

ground coffee.en: He won't sell you ground coffee — whole beans only.
ground coffee.zh: 他也不肯卖咖啡粉 —— 要买就买完整的咖啡豆。

ground coffee.en: Ground coffee can deteriorate at a pretty quick clip...
ground coffee.zh: 粉末状的咖啡 ( ground coffee )很快就会有质量问题..。

ground rule.en: Another important ground rule is that participation in exercises during a retrospective is optional.
ground rule.zh: 另一项重要的基本规则是可选的， 即在回顾中参与练习。

ground rule.en: Transliteration will serve as a key component to solving multiple linguistic challenges, and provides a common ground for you to build a standardization rule set with predictability.
ground rule.zh: 音译是解决多语言挑战的一个关键组件， 提供一个公共基础来构建一个可预测的标准化规则集。

ground rule.en: When researchers at the University of Toronto put rats on a 40 - percent - fat diet, the rats lost ground in several areas of mental function, including memory, spatial awareness and rule learning.
ground rule.zh: 当多伦多大学的研究人员使老鼠增加40%的脂肪，老鼠在脑功能的几个区域有所减退， 包括记忆、 空间识别和口令学习。

groin.en: He kneed his attacker in the groin.
groin.zh: 他用膝盖猛撞攻击者的下身。

groin.en: She kicked her attacker in the groin.
groin.zh: 她朝袭击者的下身踢了一脚。

groin.en: I underwent an operation on my groin once.
groin.zh: 我的腹股沟部位曾动过一次手术。

groin.en: If you see somebody being kicked in the groin in a movie, you might yourself tense up.
groin.zh: 如果你看到电影里有人阴部被踢中，你自己可能也会绷紧一下。

groin.en: If I had a competition where I'd give $100,000 to the person who looks the most as if they are in pain, it is a very good tactic to take a pen and jam it into your groin because you will look extremely persuasively as if you are in pain.
groin.zh: 如果我在这里举行一个竞赛,谁最能将痛苦表演的和真的一样,谁就能拿到10万美元，那么最好用的一招莫过于拿根笔,狠狠地戳进你的腹股沟,因为此时的你看上去真的,足以使他人相信你非常痛苦。

grok.en: Children grok this show immediately but their parents take longer to get it.
grok.zh: 孩子很快就通过感觉理解了这一演出， 他们的父母却花了更长的时间才理解。

grok.en: If the graph is hard to grok, or appears tweaked too much, we cease to believe it.
grok.zh: 如果图表很难理解或扭曲， 我们就不再相信它。

grok.en: If you really want to get your hands dirty with an Object Database, go to the Resource section and go through the Grok Tutorial.
grok.zh: 如果您真正希望动手使用对象数据库，请转到参考资料部分并仔细阅读 Grok 教程。

grok.en: To use an ancient expression from the 1970's, which only John and I will appreciate, it's really hard to grok what that code is doing, to understand what it's trying to make happen.
grok.zh: 我和约翰都会同意，70年代的一句话来概括，那就是很难理解编码的内容，以及它想要完成的工作。

grok.en: I'll let you just grok it but you can see it's basically doing what I did over there. Setting up two indices for the two sub-list,it's just walking down, finding the smallest element, putting it into a new list. When it gets to the end of one of the lists, it skips to the next part, and only one of these two pieces will get called because only one of them is going to have things leftovers.
grok.zh: 你们可以大体的浏览一下,但是它们基本就是我在那里所做的事情,为两个子列表设置了两个指针,指针顺着列表走下去，找到最小的元素,把它放入到一个新的列表中去,当它走到一个列表的尾部时,它会跳到下部分去,两部分中只有一个会被执行,因为只有一个会有元素剩余。

ground to a halt.en: The production lines ground to a halt for hours while technicians tried to debug software.
ground to a halt.zh: 生产线陷入停顿数小时，与此同时， 技术人员尽力排除软件故障。

ground to a halt.en: The peace process has ground to a halt while Israel struggles to form a new government.
ground to a halt.zh: 当以色列力图建立新政府时， 和平进程已逐渐停顿下来。

ground to a halt.en: The tanks ground to a halt after a hundred yards because the fuel had been siphoned out.
ground to a halt.zh: 坦克在行驶100 码后由于燃料被抽走而轰隆隆地慢慢停了下来。

groundhog.en: We once watched a red fox attacking a groundhog.
groundhog.zh: 我们曾看见一只红狐攻击一只土拨鼠。

groundhog.en: The groundhog Phil emerged from his burrow in Pennsylvania to see his shadow, meaning six more weeks of winter weather.
groundhog.zh: 土拨鼠菲尔从他在宾夕法尼亚州的洞穴中钻出去看他的影子， 这意味着寒冬仍将持续六周。

groundhog.en: The Government lost the vote then and it can expect a Groundhog Day next time.
groundhog.zh: 政府在投票表决中失利， 下一次也会是同样的结果。

groundless.en: I can say with confidence that such rumours were totally groundless.
groundless.zh: 我可以很有把握地说这些传言完全没有根据。

groundless.en: Fears that the world was about to run out of fuel proved groundless.
groundless.zh: 担心地球燃料即将用尽被证明是没有根据的。

groundless.en: Provided this technology is effective, those fears are groundless.
groundless.zh: 如果这项技术是有效的， 那些担心则是没有根据的。

grove.en: I might as well recommend you to go to the " Grove ".
It's how we can get our grove back or find our mojo.
grove.zh: 这就是如何找回我们的小树林或找到我们的魔力的办法。

grove.en: When I finished the minimill story, Grove said, " OK, I get it."
grove.zh: 当我结束小钢铁厂的故事时， 格罗夫说：“好，我明白了。”

grove.en: Go into Grove Street Cemetery some go visit his grave and say, "It's not your fault Eli."

grubby.en: He hoped she wouldn't notice his grubby shirt cuffs.
grubby.zh: 他希望她不会注意到他肮脏的衬衫袖口。

growling.zh: 我们听到了一声更大的咆哮。 猜猜是谁在咆哮？

growling.zh: 我没有打你。” 第一个咆哮着回答。

growling.en: I know it's only been a few hours but my stomach is growling.
growling.zh: 我知道才过了几个小时，但我的胃已经饿得咕咕叫了。

gruelling.zh: 我一天下来累得筋疲力尽。

gruelling.zh: 紧张的考试过后， 他感觉筋疲力尽了。

gruelling.en: He had complained of exhaustion after his gruelling schedule over the past week.
gruelling.zh: 完成上星期紧张的日程安排后， 他抱怨自己已筋疲力尽。

grumpy.en: One online pundit said that Obama sounded " like a grumpy old man ".
grumpy.zh: 一位网络权威人士表示， 奥巴马听起来 “像一个脾气暴躁的老头”。

grumpy.en: Do your kids go off to school feeling calm and confident? Or are they upset and grumpy?
grumpy.zh: 你的孩子们去上学的时候， 是心情平静、 充满信心，还是心烦意乱、脾气暴躁？

grunt.en: Clive made a noise, something like a grunt.
grunt.zh: 克莱夫发出了一阵噪声， 有点像呼噜声。

grunt.en: It was not an unfriendly grunt, but it was a grunt.
grunt.zh: 这不是不友好的咕哝， 但它是一声咕哝。

grunt.zh: 你或许该唱唱赞美诗。”他用干嗓子咕哝着建议说。

guffaw.en: Fat people will gab, giggle, guffaw, gallumph, gyrate and gossip.
guffaw.zh: 胖的人会喋喋不休、 咯咯笑、 狂笑、 放肆、摇摆不定、 说长道短。

guile.en: I love children's innocence and lack of guile.
guile.zh: 我爱儿童的天真无邪不狡狯。

guile.zh: 本文希望帮助您了解 Guile 的威力。

guile.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

guile.zh: 现在，它展现出来的他的狡猾，是捉摸不定的，我觉得，对他来说很自然。

guile.en: In other words, not Lorenzo at all, but precisely princes who have or will achieve their authority through their own guile, their own force, or their own virtu, to use the famous Machiavellian term that I want to talk about later.

guardrail.zh: 楼梯过陡、 不防滑以及扶手护栏不符合安全要求等。

guild.zh: 行会会员对裁缝师和女裁缝师的意义截然不同。

guild.en: Their guild was composed not of family units but of individual women who enjoyed unusual legal and economic privileges.
guild.zh: 她们的行会不是由家庭成员组成而是由享有特殊法律和经济特权的女性组成。

guild.en: Like most other guilds, the Wildberg weaver's guild banned women from becoming masters, however, it exempted master's widow.
guild.zh: 像其他公会一样， 怀尔德伯格编织者公会禁止女性成为主人， 但是主人的遗孀除外。

gumption.en: He suspected that deep down, she admired him for having the gumption to disagree with her.
gumption.zh: 他认为， 她内心深处其实钦佩他有魄力反对自己的意见。

gumption.zh: 任何有营销头脑的人无疑都应该能在一年中任何时候卖掉好书。

gumption.zh: 一位老师看她很有进取心，给她进行辅导。

guinea pig.zh: 说到这里， 另一只豚鼠欢呼起来， 也被制止了。

guinea pig.zh: 科学实验展示了难以置信的杀死豚鼠的方法， 这是一种毛茸茸的小动物。

guinea pig.en: If you want a small pet that you can actually pet, a guinea pig is a good choice.
guinea pig.zh: 如果你只是想要一只小宠物， 豚鼠是一个很好的选择。

gush about.en: I sometimes suspect that those who gush about book odor might not like to read.
gush about.zh: 我有时怀疑， 那些对书香味滔滔不绝的家伙可能根本就不喜欢读书。

guatemalan.en: In fact, artifacts and pottery from Teotihuacán have been discovered in sites as far away as the Mayan lowlands, the Guatemalan highlands, northern Mexico, and the Gulf Coast of Mexico.
guatemalan.zh: 事实上， 来自特奥蒂瓦坎的手工艺品和陶器已经在远至玛雅低地、 危地马拉高地、 墨西哥北部和墨西哥海湾海岸的地方被发现。

guatemalan.en: The Guatemalan army says rebels ambushed and killed 10 patrolmen.
guatemalan.zh: 危地马拉军方称叛军伏击并杀死了 10 名巡逻兵。

guatemalan.zh: 我告诉她一个朋友为了这个场合送给我的危地马拉编织手镯。

guilt-trip.en: To which he replied, " So now you're going to guilt-trip me?" And off he went.
guilt-trip.zh: 对此他回答：“所以， 你要让我产生内疚感吗?“他走了。

guilt-trip.zh: 即使是那些认为旅行只不过是一场派对或庆祝活动的父母， 也会因为孩子被留在家里而感到内疚。

guilt-trip.zh: 我不是说这是诱发内疚的旅行。

gung-ho.en: Senate Republicans are less gung-ho about tax cuts.
gung-ho.zh: 共和党的参议员们对减税并不热心。

gung-ho.en: The first expressed reservations; the second was more gung-ho.
gung-ho.zh: 第一次是持保留态度； 第二次却是不可思议的激进。

gung-ho.en: The fact that Israel is America's strongest ally emboldens this gung-ho stance.
gung-ho.zh: 以色列是美国最坚定的盟友的事实也鼓励了这种同心协力的姿态。

gutsy.en: I've always been drawn to tough, gutsy women.
gutsy.zh: 我总是被坚强、 勇敢的女性所吸引。

gutsy.en: They admired his gutsy and emotional speech.
gutsy.zh: 他们十分欣赏他坚定而饱含深情的讲话。

gutsy.en: It's a gutsy move to wear ugly clothes.'.
gutsy.zh: 穿丑服装是个勇敢的举动。

gussy up.en: Buy plain oatmeal and gussy it up yourself for breakfast with fruit or simply sub in oats instead of breadcrumbs in your favorite meatloaf or meatball recipe.

gussy up.en: She is well turned out, while I have been known to use a kitchen sponge to gussy up my pants for work.
gussy up.zh: 她穿的很漂亮， 而我是出了名的会用厨房的海绵来打理工作时穿的裤子。
