hat tip.zh: 速溶咖啡Via 的命名是为了纪念瓦伦西亚，但在开发过程中它被称为大白鲨 ( 只加水，搅拌)。

hat tip.en: I have just ( hat-tip Kamil Tchorek) been sent a link to this masterly essay by Stanislaw Krajewski, in the online Jewish magazine Covenant.
hat tip.zh: 刚才卡米尔•特霍雷克传给了我一个网址链接， 上边有篇克拉尼斯瓦克拉尼夫斯基创作的精致随笔，发布地址是“犹太人杂志契约”的网站。

hat tip.en: Pick a hat that will break up the line from the brim to the tip of your nose.
hat tip.zh: 挑一顶能你的鼻子与帽沿部分的线不那么长的帽子。

hat tip.en: There are philosophers - - and here I'll tip my hat and say, I'm one of them - - there are philosophers who believe that, in fact, the idea of free will is not incompatible with determinism.
hat tip.zh: 有哲学家,这里我要对他们敬意并声明,我也是他们中的一员,有哲学家相信,事实上,自由意志的观点,和决定论并非是不相容的

hauteur.en: Once, she had been put off by his hauteur.
hauteur.zh: 她以前对他的傲慢很反感。

hauteur.en: The intense vitality that had been so remarkable in the garage was converted into impressive hauteur.
hauteur.zh: 先前她在车行里的那种旺盛的活力， 转眼间变成了一种明显的骄傲情绪。

hauteur.en: A deeper shade of hauteur overspread his features, but he said not a word, and Elizabeth, though blaming herself for her own weakness, could not go on.
hauteur.zh: 一阵傲慢的阴影罩上了他的脸， 可是他一句话也没有说。 伊丽莎白说不下去了， 不过她心里却在埋怨自己软弱。

haughty.en: He spoke in a haughty tone.
You appear haughty, too much and you are inquisitive.
haughty.zh: 你看起来很傲慢， 太过好奇。

haughty.en: The present Catherine has no other likeness to her, except a breadth of the forehead and a certain arch of the nostril that makes her appear rather haughty.
haughty.zh: 现在的凯瑟琳没有别的地方像她， 除了宽额和有点拱起的鼻孔， 这使她显得简直有点高傲。

haughty.en: He could have be arrogant and haughty and condescending and uh.
haughty.zh: 他本可以很自大高傲，充满优越感。

have a bearing on.en: Lack of access to safe water, poor housing, and unsanitary conditions all have a strong bearing on the health of the mother and child.
have a bearing on.zh: 缺乏安全用水、 住房条件差以及不卫生条件都对母亲和儿童的健康有很大的影响。

have a bearing on.en: What happens here will have a bearing on the future of European rice production and the overall health of southern European wetlands.
have a bearing on.zh: 这里发生的事情将会对未来欧洲的稻米生产和南欧湿地的整体状况产生影响。

have a bearing on.en: Further in the future looms another big challenge for his party, one that could have a bearing on Mrs Merkel's future.
have a bearing on.zh: 未来的绿党还面临着另外一个挑战， 这个挑战可能会改变默克尔夫人的未来。

have a bone to pick.en: If you have a bone to pick with someone in your workplace, you may try to stay tight - lipped around them.
have a bone to pick.zh: 如果你对职场上的同事有意见， 可以试着在他们面前保持沉默。

have a bone to pick.en: 3： Joe, I'm afraid I have a bone to pick with you - frankly, I don't like this last ad you designed for us.
have a bone to pick.zh: 这位总裁说： Joe, 恐怕我得挑一下你的毛病了。 老实说,我并不喜欢你们最近为我们设计的这个广告。

have a bone to pick.en: Honey, I have a bone to pick with you. Could you tell me what you want to buy when you ask me to accompany you shopping?
have a bone to pick.zh: 亲爱的， 我对你有点小抱怨，你叫我陪你去买东西时能不能告诉我你想买些什么？

have been a brake on.en: The effect clouds have on climate has been something of a mystery to atmospheric scientists, with some researchers hoping they would provide a silver lining by acting as a brake on climate change.
have been a brake on.zh: 对大气科学家来说， 云层对气候的影响一直有点像是个谜， 一些研究人员希望云层能够成为遏制气候变化的卫士，从而给我们带来一线希望。

have been a brake on.en: At present, electronic power steering and brake - by - wire has a number of European models have been used in this system has been reduced a lot of mechanical parts such as hydraulic pumps and so on.
have been a brake on.zh: 目前， 电子动力方向盘和线控刹车已经在一些欧洲车型上被采用，在这个系统中已经削减了相当多的机械部件， 如液压泵等。

have a blast.en: It's thought a gas leak may have caused the blast.
have a blast.zh: 人们认为可能是煤气泄漏引起了爆炸。

have a blast.en: After the initial phase when you're getting used to exercise, you'll start to have a blast and look forward to it.
have a blast.zh: 在经过了最初的适应阶段后， 你会开始玩得尽兴， 并期待着这一时刻的到来。

have a blast.en: This new software of Limera1n is expected to have a blast among the people after it is released.
have a blast.zh: 这款新软件预计在发布后会在人们中间带去一次轰动。

have something under your belt.en: You should make use of your vacation to learn something useful. It is always a good thing to have more skills under your belt.
have something under your belt.zh: 你应该善用假期多学一些有用的东西。 身怀越多技能作为筹码总是有利的。

have the floor.en: On the top floor we have sleeping quarters for women and children.
have the floor.zh: 在顶楼我们有供妇女和孩子睡觉的地方。

have the floor.en: We'd have long talks while she helped me wax the floor.
have the floor.zh: 她帮我给地板上蜡时， 我们闲聊了很长时间。

have the floor.en: Huge fans will have to cool the concrete floor to keep it below 150 degrees.
have the floor.zh: 为了让水泥地温度一直低于 150 度， 必须用巨大的风扇来降温。

have the last word.en: She does like to have the last word in any discussion.
have the last word.zh: 她的确喜欢在任何讨论中发表最终意见。

have the last word.en: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
have the last word.zh: 在任何争论中总是得他最后说了算。

have the last word.en: But, for once, he won't have the last word on this.
have the last word.zh: 但是，这一次他不会有最后的发言权了。

hawkish.en: He is one of the most hawkish members of the new cabinet.
hawkish.zh: 他是新内阁中最具鹰派色彩的成员之一。

hawkish.en: Central Banks sounded hawkish last week.
hawkish.zh: 各国央行上周听起来还很强硬。

he feuded with his ex-wife.en: He feuded with his ex - wife.

hawser.en: Last hawser, in you creaks my last longing.
hawser.zh: 是你身上的绳索叩响我最后的渴望。

hawser.en: The hawser can either be thick, heavy ropes.
hawser.zh: 缆绳既可以指粗重的绳子。

hawser.en: Pay out the hawser fast. I do not want that anchor to drag.
hawser.zh: 快放松粗绳， 我不希望那锚被拖走。

head-to-toe.en: She gets sunburned even when she plasters herself from head to toe in factor 7 sun lotion.
head-to-toe.zh: 即使她从头到脚涂抹上防晒系数是7的防晒霜，她也会被晒伤。

head-to-toe.en: He studied me from head to toe.
head-to-toe.zh: 他把我从头到脚打量了一遍。

head-to-toe.en: H e was wet from head to toe and trembling because of cold.
head-to-toe.zh: 他从头到脚都湿透了，冷得发抖。

hearken.en: Look at'em dartin' about, an' hearken at'em callin' to each other.
hearken.zh: 看着他们四处疾飞， 听着他们互相呼唤彼此。

hearken.en: As he stood still to hearken, a rabbit came running hard towards him through the trees.
hearken.zh: 当他正不出声站着听时，突然一只兔子穿过树林向他跑来。

hearken.en: Hearken well and spread my tidings.
hearken.zh: 请仔细听好并将它广为流传。

headwind.zh: 一个潜在的不利问题是失业。

headwind.en: Encountering a headwind at night is a worry.
headwind.zh: 晚上顶风是最值得担心的。

headwind.en: That is a headwind the global economy could do without.
headwind.zh: 这是全球经济仍可避免的逆风。

headstrong.en: I see that I have been a headstrong and a wilful Toad!
headstrong.zh: 我明白了，我是一只顽固任性的癞蛤蟆！

headstrong.en: He's young, very headstrong, but he's a good man underneath.
headstrong.zh: 他年轻、 任性， 但骨子里是个好人。

headstrong.en: Every action to save nature will improve our collective and personal futures and the only way to respond to a threat of this scale is with determined action rooted in headstrong optimism.
headstrong.zh: 拯救自然的每一个行动都将改善集体和个人的未来， 而应对如此规模的威胁的唯一方法就是坚决乐观地采取果断行动。

heady.en: After the heady days that led it to power amid the protests of the so-called Tulip Revolution of 2005, the government is now under pressure to show results.
heady.zh: 在 2005年那场被称为郁金香革命的抗议中， 政府兴奋的时光里登台， 如今， 它面临着展示政绩的压力。

heady.en: The heady aroma of wood smoke emanated from the stove.
heady.zh: 木头燃烧的浓郁香味从炉子里散发出来。

heady.en: But they were fully formed adults and intellectuals, and that was a heady experience for a kid from Chicago.
heady.zh: 但他们是很成熟的成人和知识分子，而这对一个来自芝加哥的小孩来说很不同。

heady.en: And I think that was a heady feeling, and I would always be very grateful to have the chance to do that.
heady.zh: 这是一个很刺激的感觉，同时我也会永远感谢,能够有这样一个机会。

hearsay.en: Much of what was reported to them was hearsay.
hearsay.zh: 他们听到的汇报大多都是道听途说。

hearsay.en: We can't make a decision based on hearsay and guesswork.
hearsay.zh: 我们不能根据传言和猜测作决定。

hearsay.en: He urged the committee to discount any secondhand knowledge or hearsay.
hearsay.zh: 他敦促该委员会不要相信任何二手的消息或传闻。

hearsay.en: It's better than just rumor or hearsay or oral tradition.
hearsay.zh: 它比传闻或口传传统要好。

hearse.en: A s the hearse went slowly through the streets, people said together "Grandpa Yuan, rest in peace" over and over again.
hearse.zh: 灵车缓缓驶过街道，人们一遍遍地齐声说着“袁爷爷，安息吧”。

hearse.en: The boy remained as dismal as a hearse.
hearse.zh: 那孩子依然死气沉沉得像一口棺材。

hearse.en: They don't see the hearse anymore.
And it's at the height of this vision of our floral decoration of Lycidas' hearse that the speaker is suddenly caught up short.
hearse.zh: 都到了用鲜花装饰利西达斯的灵车,的时候了读者才突然领会到。

hearse.en: There's not going to be a hearse. Why not? There's no body!
hearse.zh: 就连灵车都不会有，为什么呢？，因为没有尸体！

hearse.en: Milton asks the Sicilian muse -- this is the muse of pastoral poetry - asks the muse to help him strew the flowers over the hearse, to strew with flowers the casket in which Lycidas' body lies.
hearse.zh: 弥尔顿让西西里缪斯--掌管田园诗的缪斯,-帮他将花撒在灵车上，将花撒在装有利西达斯尸体的棺材上。

hearten.en: This reminder did not hearten the servants much; they still held back.
hearten.zh: 这个提示并没有使仆人们振作起来； 他们仍然踌躇不前。

hearten.en: He said a lot to hearten me.
hearten.zh: 他对我说了许多鼓励的话。

hearten.en: This good news will hearten you.
hearten.zh: 这个好消息会使你振作起来。

hearten.en: To receive in the closing pages of your book one word of recognition for this aspiration, if it were possible for you to give such recognition honestly, would hearten all who believe in American ideals.
hearten.zh: 其实，在座的很多人,也认同这个，如果我们所有人都持有这种理想,并让其作为星星之火，得以燎原的话,那美国式的理想。

heart-searching.en: My soul, take heed that thou be in all things honest and true, as in the sight of the heart-searching God.
heart-searching.zh: 你心须在上帝面前诚信真实，因祂是鉴察人心的。

heart-searching.en: Journalists initially saw this as a threat but are coming to appreciate its benefits, though not without much heart-searching.
heart-searching.zh: 记者们起初将之视为一种威胁， 但正渐渐感受到它的益处， 当然也伴随着对自己职业角色的深刻思考。

heart-searching.en: But after several bitter years of heart-searching, Tess determined to leave home again — this time to be dairymaid at Talbothays, a large, fertile farm in the valley of the Great Dairies.
heart-searching.zh: 但是， 通过几年痛苦的内心反省， 苔丝决定再次离家，来到塔布塞斯当牛奶场女工。 这是大牛奶场山谷里的一个肥沃的大农场。

heart-wrenching.en: More often than not, IVF takes repeated, costly and heart-wrenching attempts.
heart-wrenching.zh: 试管婴儿往往需要经过反复的、 昂贵的而且是心痛的尝试。

heart-wrenching.en: There’s nothing more heart-wrenching —and, let ’s face it, sometimes nerve - wracking— than a wailing infant.
heart-wrenching.zh: 我们必须正视一个事实， 没有什么事情比哭闹的婴儿更加让人心疼， 有时甚至伤透脑筋。

heart-wrenching.en: And that is what has happened in southern Somalia, where people have had to make heart-wrenching choices simply to stay alive.
heart-wrenching.zh: 这就是发生在索马里南部的情况： 人们仅仅为了存活下去， 就不得不作出痛彻心扉的选择。

heartrending.en: Jean Valjean directed upon her that heartrending smile to which he occasionally had recourse.
heartrending.zh: 冉阿让向她苦笑， 有时他就这样笑着。

heartrending.en: With Cosette, and behind her, there had entered a man with white hair who was grave yet smiling, though with a vague and heartrending smile.
heartrending.zh: 在珂赛特后面陪着她进来的是一位白发老人，态度庄重， 但含着微笑，可这是一种捉摸不定和沉痛的微笑。

heaven-sent.en: It will be a heaven-sent opportunity to prove himself.
heaven-sent.zh: 那将是他证明自己的一个天赐良机。

heaven-sent.en: But how can they understand that our love is just heaven-sent.
heaven-sent.zh: 但是他们怎么会明白， 我们的爱是天赐的。

heaven-sent.en: " Life and love, both headed by a heaven-sent," says language poetry, thinking that correct?
heaven-sent.zh: 生命与爱， 两者皆由天赐”， 诗语如是说， 以为对否？

heath.en: He served under Edward Heath in the 1970 s.
heath.zh: 他曾于 20世纪70 年代在爱德华 • 希思手下任职。

heath.en: Unfortunately, this inability to say " no " may be hurting women's heath as well as their career.
heath.zh: 不幸的是， 这种无法说 “不”的能力可能会损害到女性的健康和事业。

heath.en: That would be the Joker, of course, a demonic creation and the three-ring circus of one wholly inhabited by Heath Ledger.
heath.zh: 当然， 那将是小丑， 一个恶魔般的三环马戏团人物，被希斯·莱杰完全地发挥出来。

heath.en: I've just come from the Heath. A friend was over from Rome, so we caught up today.
heath.zh: 我刚从希思公园过来。一个来自罗马的朋友过来了，我们今天碰了面。

heath.en: And I remember me and her and my friend Laura and my friend Heath and her brother,
heath.zh: 而且，我记得我和她还有我的朋友劳拉，西斯，她哥哥，

heave.en: The thought of it makes me heave.
The greasy food made her stomach heave.
heave.zh: 油腻腻的食物让她胃里恶心。

heave.en: I managed to heave the trunk down the stairs.
heave.zh: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

hearth.en: He stoked up the fire in the hearth.
A log fire roared in the open hearth.
hearth.zh: 柴火在敞开着的壁炉里熊熊燃烧。

hearth.en: The embers still glowed in the hearth.
hearth.zh: 余烬仍在炉膛里发出暗淡的光。

hearth.en: The building of buildings in the shape of what the Greeks called a megaron, a rectangular center, which has a hearth in it, a front porch, and a back porch which will be the style in which Greek temples are built in the historical period.
hearth.zh: 建筑物呈现出希腊人所称的,中央大厅的形状,一个矩形的大厅,有一个壁炉在中间,一个前走廊,和一个后走廊,具有古希腊神庙的风格,修建于有史料记载的时期

hectic.en: It was a hectic disorganized weekend.
hectic.zh: 这个周末忙乱得一塌糊涂。

hectic.en: My life was very hectic but empty before I met him.
hectic.zh: 我的生活在遇见他之前忙碌却空虚。

hectic.en: It seems to ease all the aches and pains of a hectic and tiring day.
hectic.zh: 它似乎可以减轻繁忙疲劳的一天带来的所有疼痛。

hectic.en: It can really turn into a pretty hectic schedule.

hedge your bets.en: The term “ hedge ” ( from hedging your bets ) derives from the aim of making money whether a market goes up or down.
hedge your bets.zh: 对冲”（来自为你的赌注两面都下注） 这个术语取自不论市场风向如何都能获利这个目标。

hedge your bets.en: It's only logical to hedge your bets by ordering early.
hedge your bets.zh: 因此， 也只能通过提早下订单来对冲这种风险。

hedge your bets.en: Rather than celebrating and immediately writing the lower amount into the new budget, hedge your bets a little.
hedge your bets.zh: 现在不是庆祝并立即将较低的金额 （80美元） 写进新的预算里的时候，它只是让你少损失一点罢了。

hedge.en: He gave the hedge a clip.
Well,if hedge funds first became mainstream maybe fifteen years ago, then what are you looking at in terms of history?
hedge.zh: 如果对冲基金,在15年前就变成主流,那么你会在它们的历史记录中看到什么呢

hedge.en: Think about the advent of hedge funds -twenty or twenty-five years ago, hedge funds were a blip on the radar screen.
hedge.zh: 想想对冲基金刚出现时,差不多20或25年前,它就像雷达屏幕上的一个小点

hefty.en: He gave the door a hefty kick.
She was quite a hefty woman.
hefty.zh: 她是个相当高大的女人。

hefty.en: They sold it easily and made a hefty profit.
hefty.zh: 他们毫不费力地卖掉了它， 得到了一笔可观的利润。

hedonistic.en: 9 a.m. - After a hedonistic night, culture is due.
hedonistic.zh: 早上9 点， 经过一个快乐的晚上， 是时候感受下文化了。

hedonistic.en: But that said, geeks are kind of hedonistic, in their own way.
hedonistic.zh: 但是有一种现象就是，geek 是可以用他们自己的方式自娱自乐。

hedonistic.en: However hedonistic or naive they may be, children have long memories.
hedonistic.zh: 无论孩子多么享乐抑或天真， 他们具有长时记忆。

hegemony.en: Future global hegemony is at stake.
hegemony.zh: 未来的全球霸权在面临关键时刻。

hegemony.en: It is a thumbing of the nose at hegemony.
Should our are capable of attaining it seems a single hegemony a single regime are if in fact circumstances developed.
hegemony.zh: 我们是否应我们是否能达致这看似,单一霸权的单一政体,如果在实作上，情况顺势发展的话。

heightened.en: The move has heightened tension in the state.
heightened.zh: 这一举动加剧了该州的紧张局势。

heightened.en: Tension has heightened after the recent bomb attack.
heightened.zh: 最近的炸弹袭击之后， 情势更加紧张。

heightened.en: And that was accessible only to the high priest and only on the Day of Atonement following a series of heightened purity observances.
heightened.zh: 只有大祭司再赎罪日当天能够进入,在里面进行一系列的更高纯度的仪式。

heightened.en: By the way, they are videotaping it in a sort of heightened technology this year.
heightened.zh: 顺便说一下，他们正在拍摄,今年的科技更高超了点。

heifer.en: The LORD said, " Take a heifer with you and say,' I have come to sacrifice to the LORD."'
heifer.zh: 耶和华说：“你可以带一只牛犊去，就说：‘ 我来是要向耶和华献祭。”’

heifer.en: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
heifer.zh: 祭司要把香柏木， 牛膝草， 朱红色线都丢在烧牛的火中。

heifer.en: The unlucky heifer was exploring the drum of a fly-tipped washing machine when its head became trapped.
heifer.zh: 这只小母牛在 “探究” 洗衣机的圆桶时不幸地把头卡在了里面。

helping.en: These are the people who are helping us.
helping.zh: 这些是正在帮助我们的人。

helping.en: I really like the idea of helping people.
helping.zh: 我非常喜欢帮助他人这个主意。

helping.en: Her motives for helping are questionable.
helping.zh: 她帮忙的动机令人生疑。

heirloom.en: Heirloom seeds come from plants that were traditionally grown in human populations, as opposed to the seeds used for large-scale agricultural production.
heirloom.zh: 传家宝种子来自传统的人类种植的植物，而不是来自用于大规模农业生产的种子。

heirloom.zh: 今年， 她计划种她们家祖传的稀有蔬菜， 在店里是买不到的。

heirloom.en: This is especially true with heirloom varieties, which are cultivated for taste over appearance.
heirloom.zh: 传统的品种尤其如此， 它们的培养特别注重滋味多于注重外观。

hemorrhage.zh: 底蜕膜在出血形成胎盘后血肿。

helpmate.en: It turns out, though, that he was a conscientious helpmate.
helpmate.zh: 尽管人们证明他是一个认真尽责的帮手。

hendiadys.zh: 第二部分讨论形容词性重言法；

herbaceous.en: The rabbits nibbled away on the herbaceous plants.
herbaceous.zh: 野兔把那些草本植物慢慢啃光了。

herbaceous.en: The long warm rain had done strange things to the herbaceous beds which bordered the walk by the lower wall.
herbaceous.zh: 长时间的温暖的雨水使小路旁紧靠矮墙的草本花圃发生了奇怪的变化。

herbaceous.en: Black fruit flavors combine with herbaceous brambly flavors.
herbaceous.zh: 黑加仑和紫罗兰的芳香混合在一起。

heterodox.en: Jason's ideas have always been very heterodox.
heterodox.zh: 杰森的想法总是非常特异。

heterodox.en: Paul did not indulge some of my more heterodox economic thinking.
heterodox.zh: 保罗没有过分迁就我某些更显异端的经济学思路。

heterodox.en: Rethinking Economics wants curricula to cover heterodox schools of thought.
heterodox.zh: 反思经济学” 希望经济学课程能够涵盖非正统的思想流派。

heterodox.en: He embraces the heterodox idea of monism, sometimes called animist materialism or vitalism, which is essentially a denial of any distinction between the body and the soul.
heterodox.zh: 他赞同一元论的异端观点，一元论也叫做万物有灵论或者生机论,强调肉体和灵魂没有界限。

heterodox.en: The only thing that matters is the salvation of the incorporeal, the bodiless soul, but Milton is so unorthodox, or at least heterodox, in his insistence on the importance of the body in this poem.
heterodox.zh: 基督教强调只有非物质的非肉体的心灵的救赎，才是重要的，但弥尔顿是如此异端，至少不正统，在诗中一直强调肉体的重要性。

heterodox.en: Individuals of heterodox belief but whose own views may stimulate others to question and think for themselves, all to the good, Milton, John Locke, people like Voltaire argued something like this.
heterodox.zh: 如苏格拉底持非正统信念的个体,他们的观点,可能激励其它人反省,及内思，所有的好人，米尔顿，洛克及像伏尔泰等人,都做过类似的申辩。

herd.en: She pushed her way through a herd of lunchtime drinkers.
herd.zh: 她从一群午餐时饮酒的人中间挤了过去。

herd.en: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower.
herd.zh: 一群山羊正在啃着塔基周围的草皮。

herd.en: With no natural predators on the island, the herd increased rapidly.
herd.zh: 由于岛上没有天然食肉动物， 牧群的数量迅速增加。

herd.en: When demons are cast out by the apostles and sent into a herd of pigs, and the pigs go running off a cliff and die; that's one image.
herd.zh: 第一个是魔鬼们被使徒们赶出了天界,赶到了一群猪的中间，然后那些猪就跑向了悬崖,摔死在了那里。

herd.en: "That man" he says "is much more a political animal " than any kind of bee or herd animal is clear."
herd.zh: 他说,“人类是政治动物的潜力,明显地远远超过任何种类的蜜蜂或群牧动物“

hermit.en: The true hermit is a rare aberration.
hermit.zh: 真正的隐士是一种罕见的反常现象。

hermit.en: You'd have to do that if you was a hermit.
hermit.zh: 如果你是隐士，你就得这么做。

hermit.en: The hermit muttered, "So-- his heart is happy ".
hermit.zh: 隐士自言自语道：“哼—— 他的心里倒是快乐的。”

herculean task.en: But undertaking a renovation can be a Herculean task.
herculean task.zh: 但做翻修工作却可能是一项异常艰巨的任务。

herculean task.en: But persuading large swathes of the citizenry to spend less time watching sport on television and more time actually working up a sweat is a Herculean task.

herculean task.en: The more than Herculean task which is now at last completed began with the appointment of the Statutory Commission in 1927.
herculean task.zh: 这一始于 1927年指定法律委员会的艰巨无比的任务终于完成了。

hepatitis.en: The doctor tested him for hepatitis.
hepatitis.zh: 医生对他进行了肝炎病检查。

hepatitis.en: As a major health risk hepatitis is second only to tobacco.
hepatitis.zh: 肝炎仅次于烟草是主要的健康隐患之一。

hepatitis.en: We should require that every student is immunized against hepatitis B.
hepatitis.zh: 我们应该要求每一位学生都注射乙肝疫苗。

hepatitis.en: Or vaccines that could be transported more easily— the hepatitis vaccine that we get is not stable unless it's refrigerated.
hepatitis.zh: 或者令疫苗更易于运输,现在的肝炎疫苗一定要冷藏,否则它就不稳定

heteronomous.en: A design that combines autonomy and heteronomous awakens the surrounding poetic level.
heteronomous.zh: 结合自主性和异质性的设计为周边环境营造了一种诗意的氛围。

heteronomous.en: Theirs is a heteronomous morality: they have few rules of their own, but out of fear of reprisal, may follow the rules of others.
heteronomous.zh: 他们的道德观与众不同， 他们少有自己的准则， 或许会遵循别人的准则， 但却是出自于害怕受到报复。

hide your light under a bushel.en: Become a producer and not a prisoner of society. Don't hide your light under a bushel.
hide your light under a bushel.zh: 成为社会的一个主持人， 而不是一个囚徒。露出你的锋芒。

hide your light under a bushel.zh: 如果你有一点疯狂， 上帝会更爱你的。千万不要掩藏你的才华。

hide your light under a bushel.en: John, don't hide your light under a bushel. Let the world see what you can do.
hide your light under a bushel.zh: 约翰， 不要过于谦虚。 让大家知道你的才能吧。

hew.en: The astounded brothers were dragged away to hack and hew and carry.
hew.zh: 震惊的兄弟俩被拖着去砍树、 削枝、 搬运东西。

hew.zh: 但是， 那样做就违背了阿姆斯特朗的梦想。

hew.en: Hew out of mountain of despair a stone of hope.

higher-up.zh: 他们希望看到更多女性担任公司或职业阶梯上更高的职位。

horrendous.en: He presented Albert with a rat, and every time the baby reached out to touch it, Watson hit a steel bar with a hammer to produce a horrendous clang.

horrendous.zh: 他把那件事形容为他生活中最恐怖的经历。

ideation.zh: 偏执因子在 40-49 岁组与正常对照有非常显著的差异。

ideation.en: This photo has lovely composition, great ideation and beautiful colours.
ideation.zh: 该照片既构图动人，又设计精妙，还色彩怡人。

ideation.en: “ I had six weeks' worth of slow ideation,” he said, “of all the different ways you could wrap a cable.”
ideation.zh: 我用了六个星期的时间慢慢构思，” 他说，“我想了缠线的所有的不同方法。”

iceberg lettuce.en: In a study at Oregon State University, consumers were shown three samples of iceberg lettuce, two of them with varying degrees of light brown on the edges and at the base.
iceberg lettuce.zh: 一项由俄勒冈州立大学发起的调查中， 展示给了消费者三个卷心莴苣， 其中两个的边缘和中心有着不同程度浅棕色。

iceberg lettuce.en: Replace the nutritionally vacuous iceberg lettuce with baby spinach in tacos or mix sweet potatoes in your regular mashed potatoes.
iceberg lettuce.zh: 可代替有营养的生菜或红薯和马铃薯的混合食物。

iceberg lettuce.en: Now that spinach and iceberg lettuce have been approved, it is focusing on persuading the F.D.A. to permit irradiation of hot dogs and deli meats.
iceberg lettuce.zh: 既然菠菜和卷心莴苣已经被批准， 现在重心应放在说服美国食品及药物管理局批准热狗和熟食肉品采用辐照杀菌。

hysteresis.en: The substance is then said to exhibit hysteresis.
hysteresis.zh: 因此人们说这类物质出现滞后现象。

hysteresis.en: The exact shape of the hysteresis curve is very sensitive to it.
hysteresis.zh: 迟滞曲线的具体形状对背景噪音非常敏感。

hysteresis.en: There is hysteresis between the sorption and desorption curves.
hysteresis.zh: 吸湿与脱湿曲线间有一定的滞后现象。

idiosyncratic.en: She still appeared to be an idiosyncratic figure.
idiosyncratic.zh: 她似乎仍然是一个特殊的人物。

idiosyncratic.en: His teaching methods are idiosyncratic but successful.
idiosyncratic.zh: 他的教学方法很奇特， 但很成功。

idiosyncratic.en: The speaking voice, by contrast, is something idiosyncratic, irregular, particular.
idiosyncratic.zh: 相反地， 说话的声音是与众不同的， 不规律的， 特别的。

idiosyncratic.en: But, I think-- It's not so much idiosyncratic, but it's a different emphasis that I put forth.
idiosyncratic.zh: 但是，我认为-,也不是那么不同寻常，我讲述的着重点也许有些不同罢了。

idiosyncratic.en: I'll present my view of the situation, but maybe it's a rather idiosyncratic view that I have.
idiosyncratic.zh: 我会讲讲我的观点，可能我的观点不同寻常。

idiosyncratic.en: The speaking voice, by contrast, is something idiosyncratic, irregular, particular.
idiosyncratic.zh: 相反地说话的声音，是与众不同的，不规律的，特别的。

idle away.en: Don't idle away your precious time.
Be practical. Don't daydream or spend time fantasizing. You can't afford to idle away your time on dreams and fantasies that can never be realized.
idle away.zh: 现实点儿。 不要做白日梦或者花时间幻想。 你没时间在梦上闲扯， 并且想像的事物永远不会成现实的。

idle away.en: It seemed that the boy liked to idle away his time.
idle away.zh: 看起来这个男孩喜欢虚度时光。

ill-advised.en: They would be ill-advised to do this.
ill-advised.zh: 他们这么做是不明智的。

ill-advised.en: Her remarks were ill-advised, to say the least.
ill-advised.zh: 她的话不够谨慎，至少可以这么说。

ill-advised.en: You would be ill-advised to travel on your own.
ill-advised.zh: 你要独自旅行是不明智的。

idyllic.en: It appears to be an idyllic domestic setup.
idyllic.zh: 它看起来是一种田园式的家庭组织方式。

idyllic.en: Rosie's idyllic world came to an abrupt end when her parents' marriage broke up.
idyllic.zh: 当她的父母婚姻破裂后， 罗茜的田园诗一般的世界骤然结束了。

idyllic.en: The island boasts two exceptional beaches: Tung Wan, a popular bathing area with idyllic beach houses and Kwan-yin Wan, known as a windsurfing haven.
idyllic.zh: 岛上自称有着两个特殊的沙滩： 东湾，它是一个受欢迎游泳区， 具有大批田园诗般的海滨别墅，还有观音湾， 著名帆板运动的避风港。

ill-conceived.en: Part of the reason is that the space race was ill-conceived from the start.
ill-conceived.zh: 其中部分原因应当归咎于： 太空竞赛从一开始就是个病态的构想。

ill-conceived.en: Free - speech defenders were outraged, seeing the move as doubly ill-conceived.
ill-conceived.zh: 自由言论捍卫者被激怒了， 因为他们看到了这次的行动倍加不周。

ill-conceived.en: An ill-conceived proposal dooms the project even if it somehow gets through the Thesis Supervisory Committee.
ill-conceived.zh: 一个构思欠佳的研究计划会毁了整个项目， 即使它勉强通过了论文答辩委员会。

ill-fated.en: If the banks opt to pull the rug from under the ill-fated project, it will go into liquidation.
ill-fated.zh: 如果这些银行选择不再支持那项倒霉的工程， 它就将破产。

ill-fated.en: John clapped his hands on the ill-fated pirate's mouth to stifle the dying groan.
ill-fated.zh: 约翰用手捂住那个倒霉的海盗的嘴， 想止住他临死前的呻吟。

ill-fated.en: Scott and his crew stayed at the hut before their ill-fated Terra Nova expedition to the South Pole in January 1912.
ill-fated.zh: 在 1912年1月， 斯科特和他的船员在命运不佳的 Terra Nova 探险队前往南极之前， 他们一直住在那个小木屋里。

ill-fated.en: But when it came to treason, he was less likely to be merciful, as the case of Alexis, his ill-fated son would demonstrate.
ill-fated.zh: 只是对于背叛者,他是绝不手软的,他那不幸的儿子阿列克思就是一个例证

idle.en: Now the machine is lying idle.
idle.zh: 现在这台机器正处于闲置状态。

idle.en: In idle moments, he carved wooden figures.
Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
idle.zh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

idle.en: Milton's not making just any idle suggestion that he will write a poem that future generations will find themselves incapable of forgetting.
idle.zh: 弥尔顿不是仅仅在做一个无用的提议,他将写首后人无法忘却的诗。

idle.en: I hate it when students are idle.
idle.zh: 我讨厌学生们无所事事。

imbecile.en: It was an imbecile thing to do.
He was an imbecile to sign a contract with them.
imbecile.zh: 他跟他们签合同，真是愚不可及。

imbecile.en: Starving, with three francs fifty staring you in the face! Imbecile!
imbecile.zh: 三个半法郎就摆在你面前，你却快饿死了！

imbecile.en: When he comes to one of the common sort, he says, "You bloody imbecile, get the hell back to where you belong."
imbecile.zh: 而当他遇到一个普通士兵时,他就说,"你这该死的蠢货,还不打哪来回哪去"

illicit.zh: 但丁明确地谴责不正当的恋情。

illicit.en: Consequently, a black market in imported illicit CFC's has grown.
illicit.zh: 因此， 非法进口氯氟化碳的黑市已经扩大。

illicit.en: Unfortunately, the cheap alternatives are even more harmful than the illicit drugs they replace.
illicit.zh: 不幸的是， 这些廉价的替代品比它们所替代的非法药物更有害。

illicit.en: So, they come to the conclusion that their father is going to castrate them because of their illicit love for their Mom.
illicit.zh: 所以他们最终总结出,父亲会因为他们对母亲,抱有非分之想而阉割他们。

illicit.en: There is legal homicide, of course, judicial death and so on in the Bible, but illicit homicide, whether intentional or unintentional, murder or accidental homicide. The manslayer bears blood guilt, what is referred to as "blood guilt."
illicit.zh: 当然，合理的杀人是有的，审判处死或者其他的一些，但是非法杀戮，不管有意无意，谋杀或意外杀人，杀人者犯了杀人罪，杀人罪指什么呢？

ill-omened.en: It was a ill-omened place. Death walked there in the sunlight.
ill-omened.zh: 那是个倒霉的地方， 死亡在光天化日之下游荡。

ill-omened.en: " Said she, while her ill-omened physiognomy seemed to cast a shadow over the cheerful newness of the house."
ill-omened.zh: 她说， 她那不祥的外貌象是给这座住宅的欣欣向荣的气氛投上了一层阴影。

ill-omened.en: There was no law, not even an unwritten law, against frequenting the Chestnut Tree Cafe, yet the place was somehow Ill. omened.
ill-omened.zh: 没什么法律不准常去栗树咖啡馆， 连不成文的法律也没有， 然而那地方却颇有点凶险。

ill-suited.en: I was ill-suited to work in the mental health field.
ill-suited.zh: 我不适合于在精神健康领域工作。

ill-suited.en: The dwarf seahorses, or Hippocampus zosterae, are particularly ill-suited to escape.
ill-suited.zh: 尤其是侏儒海马或绣眼海马不会逃脱灾害。

ill-suited.en: Not everyone is meant for every job — some people, no matter how talented they may be, are ill-suited for certain jobs.
ill-suited.zh: 不是所有人都胜任任何一份工作 —— 有的人不管他们天资如何聪颖， 可他就是不能胜任某些工作。

illuminati.en: He did so at great risk to himself, and he paid the ultimate price when the Illuminati were tipped off by some of the song titles on the Dangerous album.
illuminati.zh: 他冒着非常巨大的风险在他《Dangerous》专辑中，利用几首歌的标题影射光明会， 最终他为此付出了代价。

illuminati.en: The anger and discontent at the problems of the world is understandable, as you have been led into the planned chaos and failure scripted by the Illuminati.
illuminati.zh: 对于世界问题的 “愤怒” 和 “不满” 是可以理解的， 由于你们被 “光照派”带入“混乱”和“失败” 的计划中。

illuminati.en: Skeptics say there's no evidence to support the existence of the Illuminati, but conspiracy theorists say that the lack of evidence actually proves the group exists.
illuminati.zh: 怀疑者说， 没有证据表明光照派确实存在， 但是阴谋论者说， 缺少证据恰恰就证明了这个组织的存在。

immanence.en: And this garb was a perfectly transparent sheath, through which he recognized the glory of the Divine Immanence.
immanence.zh: 这种装扮是完美的透明外壳， 他透过这个外壳认识了神无处不在的荣耀。

immanence.en: It's not a promise of infinite and lacerating repetitions: it's what makes moments caught up in the immanence of return suddenly appear as ends.
immanence.zh: 它并不是许渃无限与令人懊恼的重复。它是使陷身于回归的内在性的时刻， 突然出现充当目标。

immunocompromised.en: CMV is usually seen in immunocompromised hosts and can be widespread in many organs.
immunocompromised.zh: 巨细胞病毒通常在免疫缺陷宿主中可见， 并在许多器官中蔓延。

immunocompromised.en: The presence of systemic symptoms is variable and more likely in immunocompromised patients.
immunocompromised.zh: 全身性症状不一定会出现，往往见于免疫缺陷患者。

immunocompromised.en: For cervical spondylosis Yaotui whole body aching pain immunocompromised persons have very good results.
immunocompromised.zh: 对于颈椎病腰腿疼痛全身酸痛免疫力低下者有着很好的效果。

immanent.en: Modern capitalist economy follows its own immanent laws.
immanent.zh: 现代资本主义经济遵循着它自己的固有法则。

immanent.en: In vice, the attraction of the abnormal creates troubling anxiety: the spirit seems to have become blood and stirs in the flesh like an immanent force.
immanent.zh: 在邪恶中， 异常事物的吸引创造出令人不安的焦虑： 精神似乎已经变成了血液， 像一股内在的力量搅动着肉体。

immanent.en: This is the most perfect immanent action possible to nature.
immanent.zh: 这是最完美的内在行动可能性质。

impale.en: Researchers observed one bird impale a rodent on a cactus.
impale.zh: 研究人员观察到， 一只鸟把一个啮齿动物钉到了一棵仙人掌上。
摧毁他们！ 刺穿他们！

impale.en: Impale now affects Overpower instead of Execute.
impale.zh: 刺穿现在影响压制而非斩杀。

immaterial.en: Whether we like him or not is immaterial.
immaterial.zh: 我们喜不喜欢他都不重要。

immaterial.en: Given this existence of this immaterial soul, it's a possibility, indeed a fair likelihood, that we will survive our deaths.
immaterial.zh: 鉴于这个非物质灵魂的存在， 这是可能的， 也的确是有这样的可能性的， 让我们能在死亡后继续存在。

immaterial.en: And given this existence of this immaterial soul, it's a possibility, indeed a fair likelihood, hat we will survive our deaths.
immaterial.zh: 鉴于它们的存在，这是可能的，也的确是有这样的可能性的，让我们能在死亡后继续存在。

immaterial.en: But dualism doesn't so much offer the explanation typically as just say, "Well, maybe we'd be better off positing something immaterial."
immaterial.zh: 但是二元论还没有给出,这样的解释,也许我们假设非物质的存在会好一些

immaterial.en: We are immaterial souls that possess physical bodies, that have physical bodies, that reside in physical bodies, that connect to physical bodies.
immaterial.zh: 我们是拥有生理客体的无形心灵,我们的心灵占据着生理客体,寄居其中,与其形成紧密的联系

impart.en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
impart.zh: 传授知识并博得尊敬的能力对老师们来说是基本的条件。

impart.en: You need to have specialist teachers who impart what they know.
impart.zh: 你需要有专业的老师来传授他们所知道的知识。

impart.en: Forcing a child to behave morally may prevent her from internalizing the lesson you're trying to impart.
impart.zh: 强迫孩子按道德行事可能会妨碍她将你试图传授的教训内化。

impart.en: God can impart holiness to, he can sanctify, persons and places and things when they're brought into a specific kind of relationship with him, a relationship that's best described as a relationship of ownership.
impart.zh: 上帝可以将神圣给予一些人、地方，和事物,如果它们能够和上帝产生某种特殊的联系，对这个关系的最好描述就是从属关系。

impart.en: I will impart to you a love of classical music.
impart.zh: 我会传递给你们对古典音乐的热爱

impassioned.zh: 他充满热情的请求无人倾听。

impassioned.en: She made an impassioned plea for help.
He made an impassioned appeal for peace.
impassioned.zh: 他做了个向往和平的激昂慷慨的呼吁。

impasse.en: The negotiations have reached an impasse.
A deadlock, as in negotiations; an impasse.
impasse.zh: 僵局僵局， 如在谈判中的；死路。

impasse.en: So the Lady in the 1637 version of this poem, of this mask,is at an impasse.
impasse.zh: 所以在1637年版本的《面具》中，这位女士，陷入了僵局。

impeach.en: To this thing itself I am impeach.
impeach.zh: 对这件事本身我是存疑的。

impeach.en: Richard M. Nixon: They can't impeach me for bombing Cambodia.
impeach.zh: 尼克松： 他们不能控告我对柬埔寨的轰炸。

impeach.en: I impeach him in the name and by virtue of those eternal laws of justice, which he has violated.
impeach.zh: 我以他所违背的永恒的正义的法律的名义， 并根据这些法律控告他。

impassive.en: He's a large, languid man with a round and impassive face.
impassive.zh: 他是一个无精打采的大汉，长着一张毫无表情的圆脸。

impassive.en: He searched Hill's impassive face for some indication that he understood.
impassive.zh: 他在希尔没有表情的脸上搜寻着一些他理解的迹象。

impassive.en: He turned to the impassive woman.
impassive.zh: 他转向毫无表情的女人。

impenitent.en: Endless, of the impenitent and unbelieving.
impenitent.zh: 无止境的， 对不知悔改的和不信。

impenitent.en: Throughout his entire life Rizal was nothing but an impenitent dreamer, a poet.
impenitent.zh: 里泽尔一生就是一个从不后悔的梦想家，一个诗人。

impenitent.en: We need to remember that God's wrath does burn against impenitent sinners (Psalm 38:1-3).
impenitent.zh: 我们必须铭记上帝的愤怒曾烧死了不知悔改的恶人 (圣歌38：1 - 3)。

impassible.en: Of course I told myself that's impassible.
impassible.zh: 当然我告诉我自己， 那是不可能的。

impassible.en: This sort of impassible terrain has no grid overlaid on it.
impassible.zh: 这类不觉疼痛的地形没有在它上涂上的闸极栏。

impassible.en: I told myself that's impassible, the ghost doesn't exists again and again.
impassible.zh: 我一遍又一遍的告诉自己， 那是不可能的，根本就没有鬼。

imperialistic.en: The impact impaired the power of the imperialistic country.
imperialistic.zh: 这种冲击削弱了这个帝国主义国家的实力。

imperialistic.en: The movement is national and not imperialistic. There is room in Syria for us both.
imperialistic.zh: 这场运动是民族主义运动而非帝国主义运动， 在叙利亚， 有我们共同可以容身的地方。

imperialistic.en: An imperialistic country extends its power and influence into neighbouring countries.
imperialistic.zh: 一个帝国主义国家将其势力与影响伸展至邻国。

imperialistic.en: Again a critique not only of Sparta but also of Athens and its imperialistic ambitions.
imperialistic.zh: 我们再次看到，他的评论不局限于斯巴达,同时还扩及雅典及其帝国野心。
它是具有侵略性和帝国主义性质的。

impervious.en: She seems almost impervious to the criticism from all sides.
impervious.zh: 她好像对各方批评无动于衷。

impervious.en: This also makes the painting impervious to water.
impervious.zh: 这也使得该幅画能防水。

impervious.en: It dispels the notion that the plants are impervious.
impervious.zh: 这样一来， 认为这里的核电站不受影响的念头打消了。

impervious.en: The boundary is impervious to transfer of heat like a thermos Anything that happens inside of the thermos is an adiabatic change because the thermos has no connection in terms of energy to the outside world.
impervious.zh: 边界不能传递热量,像热水瓶一样,热水瓶里发生的任何事,都是绝热变化,因为热水瓶与外部世界,没有能量方面的联系。

impermanent.en: We are reminded just how small and how impermanent we are.
impermanent.zh: 我们刚被提醒，我们多么渺小，我们的生命又是多么短暂。

impermanent.en: Oral communication is fast-moving and impermanent.
impermanent.zh: 口头交流速度快但持续时间短。

impermanent.en: Gudo smiled.'Everything in this life is impermanent' he explained.
impermanent.zh: 笑道：“世事无常， 人生短暂。”
仪式上的不洁也是暂时的。

imperialism.en: Our two peoples share the same experience of having been oppressed by imperialism.
imperialism.zh: 我们两国人民都有遭受帝国主义压迫的共同经历。

imperialism.en: The executives acknowledge that they try to swing national eating habits to food created in America, but they deny that amounts to economic imperialism.
imperialism.zh: 高管们承认， 他们试图将国民饮食习惯转向美国创造的食物， 但他们否认这等同于经济帝国主义。

imperialism.en: Roosevelt was determined to destroy imperialism.
imperialism.zh: 罗斯福在摧毁帝国主义的问题上意志坚决。

imperialism.en: and at some point I'm sure there was a question of cultural imperialism involve.
imperialism.zh: 我相信，在某些时候,文化帝国主义确实存在过。

imperialism.en: I think there is an essential sort of imperialism.
imperialism.zh: 我认为有这样一种本质帝国主义的存在。

impetuous.en: Although a man of blood and violence, Richard was too impetuous to be either treacherous or habitually cruel.
impetuous.zh: 虽然理查德是一个血腥暴力的人，但他过于冲动， 既不奸诈， 也不惯于残忍。

impetuous.en: James Purnell An impetuous young minister.
impetuous.zh: 詹姆斯· 珀内尔年轻浮躁的大臣。

impetuous.en: And--or people would talk to him and he'd just stare at them and say--and people would say-- would be intimidated by his bold and impetuous stare when actually he just totally didn't know anything.
impetuous.zh: 别人跟他说话，他就会盯着人看,人们就会-,被他大胆无礼的凝视吓怕,其实他根本不知道别人在说什么。

impetuous.en: It is not to bind them from voluntary actions but to direct and keep them in such motion as not to hurt themselves by their own impetuous desires, rashness or indiscretion as hedges are set not to stop travelers but to keep them on their way."
impetuous.zh: 不是约束他们去做本该做的事,而是约束他们不做不该做的事,以免因自己的欲望，轻率，鲁莽而危机自身，这就像是篱笆的功能一样,不是要阻挡行路而是为小路指引方向“

impish.en: Garcia is well known for his impish sense of humour.
impish.zh: 加西亚搞笑式的幽默感广为人知。

impish.en: I first met her in 1974, when she was a slightly impish 21-year-old home from Oxford on summer vacation.
impish.zh: 我在 1974年第一次遇到贝布托， 当时她还是个二十一岁的少女， 从牛津返乡度暑假。

infotainment.en: The MyFord touch touchscreen and Ford Sync infotainment system generally worked well.
infotainment.zh: 触摸屏和福特同步娱乐信息系统配合得天衣无缝。

infernal.en: Satan has reigned too long in this infernal realm.
infernal.zh: 撒旦在这个地狱里统治了太长时间。

infernal.en: Others idled under the tent, reluctant to head back outside into the infernal heat.
infernal.zh: 而其他人却在帐篷下懒洋洋地走动， 不愿意回到外面炼狱般火热的地方。

ingrained.en: Morals tend to be deeply ingrained.
ingrained.zh: 道德观念往往是根深蒂固的。

ingrained.en: His insistence on putting users first, and focusing on elegance and simplicity, has become deeply ingrained in his own company, and is spreading to rival firms too.
ingrained.zh: 他坚持用户至上， 注重优雅和简洁，这种理念在他自己的公司里已经根深蒂固， 且已经传播到竞争对手那去了。

ingrained.en: The associative guilt was ingrained in his soul.
ingrained.zh: 这种联想式内疚在他心中根深蒂固。

ingrained.en: so their grammar is very ingrained in Spanish, which is different than English.
ingrained.zh: 他们的语法是基于西班牙语的，与英语截然不同。

ingrate.en: Above the ingrate world and human fears.
ingrate.zh: 超越了忘恩的尘世和人间的忧惧。

ingrate.en: Ingrate! A woman who laughs is such a good thing!
ingrate.zh: 你真不识好歹！ 一个老笑着的女人有多好！

ingrate.en: Thanksgiving is a small German, ingrate is evil.
ingrate.zh: 感恩是小德， 忘恩是大恶。

inhibited.en: According to the conventional view, serfdom in nineteenth-century Russia inhibited economic growth.
inhibited.zh: 根据传统观点， 十九世纪俄国的农奴制抑制了经济增长。

inhibited.en: Moreover, when the antibody was given to chimpanzees, it inhibited rhinoviral growth, and in humans it lessened both the severity and duration of cold symptoms.
inhibited.zh: 此外， 当把这种抗体注射到黑猩猩身上时， 它能抑制鼻病毒的生长， 而在人类身上，它能减轻感冒症状的严重程度和持续时间。

inhibited.en: Men are more inhibited about touching each other than women are.
inhibited.zh: 触摸同性时男人比女人要更加拘谨。

inhibited.en: I found that he was inhibited by doing the reading because some are coming in and telling me about why do I have to do it.
inhibited.zh: 我发现在做阅读时他很内向,因为阅读时会有人过来,告诉我为什么我要阅读。

inhumane.en: Turning Cuban boat people away would be an inhumane action.
inhumane.zh: 不准这些古巴船民入境将是一种不人道的行为。

inhumane.en: To pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.
inhumane.zh: 迫使动物园减少在动物身上的开支， 将导致珍稀动物遭到不人道的虐待。

inhumane.en: The arbalest is a dangerous weapon and is sometimes considered inhumane.
inhumane.zh: 最野蛮的武器是危险的武器， 有时被认为是不人道的。

inhumane.en: Why did an inhumane institution of course not everybody who defended it thought it was inhumane but why did that system survive, persist and grow?
inhumane.zh: 为什么一个不人道的制度,当然不是所有捍卫它的人都觉得不人道,为什么奴隶制度还是会生根,发芽,成长

inhumane.en: they don't pay fair wages, their hours are inhumane,
inhumane.zh: 工资不合理，工作时间太没人性了。

inoculation.en: This may eventually lead to routine inoculation of children.
inoculation.zh: 这最终可能发展为儿童定期接种疫苗。

inoculation.en: At an orientation meeting, the travelers were told that a visa, a landing card, and evidence of inoculation against typhoid fever would be needed by each of them.
inoculation.zh: 在一次介绍会上， 这些旅行者被告知每人都需要签证、 入境卡和伤寒疫苗接种证明。

inoculation.en: Serum samples were collected on 30, 60 and 140th days post inoculation.
inoculation.zh: 分别于接种后 30 、 60 和 140 天收集血清样本。

inoculation.en: Well, that problem was partly solved by saying,'Well,if I'm giving the inoculation to one person, and that's what would happen.
inoculation.zh: 这个问题一定程度上可以这样解决,如果我给一个人接种,然后就可以解决了

innate.en: Americans have an innate sense of fairness.
innate.zh: 美国人有一种天生的公平感。
知识是后天获得的， 不是先天就有的。

innate.en: Correct ideas are not innate in the mind.
innate.zh: 人的正确思想不是自己头脑中固有的。

innate.en: They have an innate feel for it and it happens organizationally that it happens from a leadership standpoint.
innate.zh: 有着敏锐的直觉,通过团体落实任务,这样就可以从领导者的高度统领一切。

innate.en: One kind of response is called the innate response and innate means that it's present from the beginning.
innate.zh: 其中之一称为先天性免疫反应,先天的意思是生来就有的

innate.en: And the question that preoccupies developmental psychologists is how do we come to have this knowledge, and in particular, how much of it is hard-wired, built-in, innate.
innate.zh: 发展心理学家们所关心的问题,就是我们如何获得这些知识的,特别是,这其中有多少是固有的,内在的,天生的

inoculate.en: A corps of doctors arrived to inoculate the recruits.
inoculate.zh: 一队医生来给新兵打防疫针。

inoculate.en: Entrepreneurs can't completely inoculate their businesses from the vagaries of the market.
inoculate.zh: 创业者不能完全让自己的事业规避市场中难以预测的行为。

inoculate.en: The size of the batch depends on how many eggs a manufacturer can obtain, inoculate and incubate.
inoculate.zh: 批量大小是根据制造商能得到、 接种和孵化多少鸡蛋来决定的。

inner tube.en: I step off the barge and creep gingerly around the inner-tube as it bobs in the green - blue water.
inner tube.zh: 从游艇上下楼之后， 我小心翼翼的在内管周围转了一圈，当时正好有气泡从蓝绿色的海水中挣脱出来。

inner tube.en: If you tie him to a blown - up inner tube, he floats.
inner tube.zh: 如果你把他拴在一个充气的内胎上， 他就能浮起。

inner tube.en: Coast Guard rescuers airlifted the men from the mangled raft, which by then had also lost its floor and resembled a giant, battered black inner tube.
inner tube.zh: 海岸警卫营救队员们将几个人从破烂不堪的救生筏中救了出来，筏底已经不知去向，整个救生筏就如同一只巨大的黑色残破内胎。

innocuous.en: Modern readers can, with some effort, discover that sixteenth-century teachers selected some seemingly dangerous classical texts while excluding other seemingly innocuous texts.
innocuous.zh: 现代读者通过一些努力可以发现， 十六世纪的教师选择了一些看似危险的经典文本， 而排除了其他看似无害的文本。

innocuous.en: It seemed a perfectly innocuous remark.
innocuous.zh: 那像是一句毫无恶意的话。

innocuous.en: There are times when people do lie to children — about Santa Claus, for example, but also in less innocuous situations.
innocuous.zh: 有些时候， 人们也对孩子们撒谎 —— 比如关于圣诞老人的事， 但是通常是无害的情况下。

innocuous.en: If you've ever been using some program, you did something completely innocuous, pull something down from a menu, click a button, you didn't do anything wrong and yet all of a sudden the thing just starts hanging there or you get a little spinning beach ball or the hour glass or whatever it is.
innocuous.zh: 如果你之前在用一些程序，做一些无伤大雅的事情，拉下一个菜单，点击一个按钮，你没有做任何错误的事情,突然间有东西开始一直运行,或者一个沙滩上的小球旋转,或滴漏或是别的什么。

innocuous.en: Now, this looks like a very innocuous thing, but you will find out,it is the only thing that really gets my back up. Most of the time I don't really care.
innocuous.zh: 我知道这也许比较令人难以接受,但是这是我唯一的小小的要求,大部分时候我还是很随和的

injurious.en: They are injurious to women's health.
injurious.zh: 它们对妇女的健康有害。

injurious.en: He was cashiered for conduct injurious to the reputation of a soldier.
injurious.zh: 他因有损军人声誉的行为而被革职。

injurious.en: The action of malicious or injurious falsehood has similarities to an action for libel.
injurious.zh: 恶意或有害的谎言的行为与诽谤的行为有相似之处。

inoperable.en: The policy was thought to be inoperable.
inoperable.zh: 这项政策被认为行不通。

inoperable.en: He was diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer.
inoperable.zh: 他被诊断患有无法手术的肺癌。

inoperable.en: Failures at this stage will leave the application inoperable.
inoperable.zh: 这一阶段的失败将导致应用程序不可操作。

inquiring.en: A growing number of customers have been inquiring about the pending price rises.
inquiring.zh: 越来越多的顾客在询问即将出现的价格上涨问题。

inquiring.en: Tom turned an inquiring look toward Hertford, who whispered, " Your Majesty will signify consent."
inquiring.zh: 汤姆带着询问的目光望着赫德福， 他低声说：“陛下应表示同意。”

inquiring.en: Many have reservations, but keep these to themselves in what they perceive as a climate hostile to the pursuit of understanding for its own sake and the idea of an inquiring, creative spirit.
inquiring.zh: 许多人对此有所保留， 但在他们所认为的一种不利于为求知而求知和追求探究、 创造精神的气氛中， 他们却把这些保留了下来。

inordinate.en: They spend an inordinate amount of time talking.
inordinate.zh: 他们聊天时间长得超乎想像。

inordinate.en: Either keeping personal creditors accounts or making sundry creditors adjustments can consume inordinate amounts of administrative and accounting time.
inordinate.zh: 无论是保留个人债权人账户， 还是进行各种各样的债权人调整， 都可能耗费过多的行政和会计时间。

inordinate.en: Babies and small children require an inordinate amount of clobber.
inordinate.zh: 携带婴儿和幼儿需备有非常大量衣物。

inordinate.en: In patriarchal societies there tends to be an inordinate degree of interest placed on the virginity of young women.
inordinate.zh: 在父权社会里,对于年轻女性的贞操,人们有着极大的兴趣。

inordinate.en: The code is unusually conspicuous, complex, and enigmatic; it attracts an inordinate amount of attention to itself, and this attention has to acquire the rigor of a method.
inordinate.zh: 这种代码通常很显著，复杂，神秘;,它把大量的注意力都吸引到自己身上，这种注意力得有一种方法的严肃性。

inpatient.en: VA patients are sent to community hospitals for inpatient care.
inpatient.zh: 军转医院患者在社区医院里接受住院治疗。

inpatient.en: The atmosphere on an inpatient ward is tense because of this exerted energy.
inpatient.zh: 由于这种表露的干劲， 住院病房的氛围很紧张。

inpatient.en: Patients were recruited from inpatient, outpatient, and emergency department settings.
inpatient.zh: 患者是从住院部、 门诊部和急诊部招募的。

insinuate.en: What are you trying to insinuate?
He insinuate his doubt of her ability.
insinuate.zh: 他暗示了他对她能力的怀疑。

insinuate.en: He tried to insinuate himself into the boss's favor.
insinuate.zh: 他设法巧妙地渐渐取得老板的欢心。

insinuate.en: There are others who like to show you how much mathematics you could somehow insinuate into the process.
insinuate.zh: 还有些人喜欢跟你炫耀数学用的多,尽管过程显得非常繁琐

insomnia.en: Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.
insomnia.zh: 抑郁症几乎总是伴有失眠。

insomnia.en: Acute insomnia means consistent inability to sleep well for a period of three weeks to six months.
insomnia.zh: 严重失眠意味着连续三周到六个月都睡不好觉。

insomnia.en: Telling yourself to stop being anxious when you're feeling anxious is a bit like telling yourself to fall asleep when you have insomnia — it doesn't work.
insomnia.zh: 当你感到焦虑时， 告诉自己不要焦虑， 这有点像当你失眠时，告诉自己要入睡一样—— 是行不通的。

insomnia.en: This is good bedtime reading. Do any of you suffer from insomnia?
insomnia.zh: 这是本不错的睡前读物,你们失眠吗

insomnia.en: It's very good bedtime reading if you suffer from insomnia.
insomnia.zh: 你要是失眠它绝对是最好的睡前读物

instructive.en: The Hawaiian Islands provided a very instructive answer.
instructive.zh: 夏威夷群岛提供了一个非常有益的答案。

instructive.en: It is instructive to see how other countries are tackling the problem.
instructive.zh: 了解别的国家如何处理这个问题是具有启发性的。

instructive.en: While it will be fun, the seminar also promises to be most instructive.
instructive.zh: 这次专题讨论会将会很有趣， 也一定会非常有启发性。

instructive.en: It would be, I think, extremely instructive to read it alongside The Return of the Soldier or Mrs. Dalloway for the reasons I've mentioned.
instructive.zh: 我觉得如果把这本书和《戴洛维夫人》或,《军士返乡》拿来一起看肯定更受启发。

instructive.en: We're making a lot of very strong assumptions here, but nevertheless, it's going to be instructive to look at this model.
instructive.zh: 我们做了很多强制性的假设,但无论怎样,这个模型对我们仍然具有指导意义

instructive.en: One that I found most instructive is called The Cambridge World History of Food, which is this very--two very large volumes.
instructive.zh: 我觉得最具指导性的是,《剑桥世界饮食史》,它有两大卷

instrumental.en: Asian-American parents are enthusiastic supporters of the competitive instrumental music program.
instrumental.zh: 亚裔美国人的父母是这个竞争激烈的器乐项目的热情支持者。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties are social links formed when we cooperate with other people to achieve some goal.
instrumental.zh: 工具性联系是我们为了实现某种目标而与他人合作时形成的社会联系。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties predominate in secondary groups; we perceive people as means to ends rather than as ends in their own right.
instrumental.zh: 工具性关系在次级群体中占主导地位； 我们把人当作达成目的的手段， 而不是目的本身。

instrumental.en: It works its magic, again, through purely instrumental means, so we can't really call those songs, and this puzzled me.
instrumental.zh: 纯器乐的演奏方式,容我重申,能产生神奇的效果,所以我们其实不能把器乐称为歌曲,这让我很困惑

instrumental.en: It could be purely instrumental but it's called "Buy a song," But we don't want to use that sort of parlance.
instrumental.zh: 可能买的是纯器乐,却被称为"买首歌",但我们不想用那种说法

insubstantial.en: Mars has an insubstantial atmosphere, consisting almost entirely of carbon dioxide.
insubstantial.zh: 火星周围有一个薄薄的大气层， 几乎全由二氧化碳构成。

insubstantial.en: After this, a man is as insubstantial as a cloud.
insubstantial.zh: 之后， 男人就是浮云了。

insubstantial.en: Obama brushes aside the notion that his rhetoric is insubstantial.
insubstantial.zh: 奥巴马不理会那些认为他言辞空洞的见解。

installment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things, soap operas and installment plans introduced in the 1970 s.
installment.zh: 此外， 玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70 年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。

installment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things, soap operas and installment plans introduced in the 1970 s. Both played an important, although indirect, role in lowering the birth rate.
installment.zh: 玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70 年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。 尽管是间接的，但两者在降低出生率方面都发挥了重要的作用。

installment.en: After the first installment, Dickens wrote to the artist and asked him to correct a drawing Dickens felt was not faithful enough to his prose.
installment.zh: 在第一期之后， 狄更斯写信给这位画家， 请他修改一幅狄更斯认为和自己的散文不那么相符的画。

insuperable.en: In a similar sense, the ever increasing number of online conversations may be disrupted by misinterpretations and anxiety that are produced by insuperable delays in the Internet connection.
insuperable.zh: 同样地， 越来越多的在线对话可能会被互联网连接上无法克服的延迟问题所造成的误解和焦虑所打断。

insuperable.en: But not, I think, an insuperable one.
insuperable.zh: 但我认为这并不是无法克服的困难。

insuperable.en: That, and his age, may be insuperable handicaps.
insuperable.zh: 还有他的年纪也成为不能制胜的障碍。

insuperable.en: Even to raise such a question seems to pose insuperable obstacles.
insuperable.zh: 光是提出这样的问题,就像是丢出了许多不能克服的障碍。

insurmountable.en: The crisis doesn't seem like an insurmountable problem.
insurmountable.zh: 这场危机不像是无法克服的。

insurmountable.en: The falls have always been an insurmountable obstacle for salmon and sea trout.
insurmountable.zh: 这些瀑布始终是鲑鱼和海鳟鱼不可逾越的障碍。
这些问题似乎不可逾越。

intellectual history.en: Mr Wade has a clear mind and limpid prose style which guides the reader almost effortlessly through 200 years of intellectual history.
intellectual history.zh: 韦德先生以其清楚的思路、简洁的诗一般的语言引导读者几乎毫不费力地了解了200 年的知识史。

intellectual history.en: He read a lot so as to learn about the intellectual history of Europe.
intellectual history.zh: 他大量阅读以便了解欧洲思想史。

intellectual history.en: Before he died in 2009, John Patrick Diggins, a respected professor and writer of intellectual history, waded into the Niebuhr fervour with an unfinished manuscript entitled " Why Niebuhr Now?"
intellectual history.zh: 约翰·帕特里克·迪金斯是一个受人尊敬的思想史教授与作家，在他于2009年去世之前，他用一份未完成的命名为为什么现在流行尼布尔？

intellectual history.en: Anyway, that shows that I think probability theory does have a long history, but - - it not being an intellectual discipline - - it didn't really inform a generation of finance theory.
intellectual history.zh: 不管怎样,这个故事表明概率论,确实有很悠久的历史,但,那时它并非以学科形式存在,也没有对金融理论的产生有过指导意义

intellectual history.en: I am so sad this weekend - - it was Russian intellectual history.
intellectual history.zh: 这周末我真的很伤心,当时我选了俄国思想史

insupportable.zh: 这种想法在某种程度上不能让人接受。

insupportable.en: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation's productive capacity.
insupportable.zh: 过于庞大的重整军备开支会给国家的生产力带来难以承受的负担。

insupportable.en: Now the King's joy was nearly insupportable.
insupportable.zh: 现在国王的喜悦几乎叫他无法忍受。

insurgent.en: Pakistan denies sponsoring any insurgent groups.
insurgent.zh: 巴基斯坦否认资助任何反叛组织。

insurgent.en: Playing insurgent basketball did not guarantee victory.
insurgent.zh: 像游击队那样打篮球并不一定能带来胜利。

insurgent.en: A fifth soldier was killed in an insurgent attack in eastern Afghanistan.
insurgent.zh: 第五名士兵在阿富汗东部的一次反叛分子袭击中丧生。

insurgent.en: It never lost entirely its original character as an insurgent movement, independent of the state and hostile to it, making claims that challenge the secular authority.
insurgent.zh: 它从来没有失去充满,反抗精神的本原色,它独立于国家并与之格格不入,公然向世俗权威发起挑战

insurrection.en: The problem was, of course, Nat Turner's Insurrection; it had just occurred in October of 1831 and they held these debates in the wake of it.
insurrection.zh: 问题当然是纳特· 特纳的起义； 它发生在 1831年 10月， 他们把这些议题推到起义之后。

insurrection.en: First, the insurrection of February has been overshadowed by that of June.
insurrection.zh: 首先， 二月革命被六月革命盖过了风头。

insurrection.en: The next round is likely to spark further insurrection.
insurrection.zh: 而下一轮计划有可能激起进一步的大反水。

insurrection.en: If they started looking like insurrection would happen, the Romans didn't do it.
insurrection.zh: 如果叛乱要发生了，罗马人不会坐视不理。

insurrection.en: The problem was, of course, Nat Turner's Insurrection; it had just occurred in October of 1831 and they held these debates in the wake of it.
insurrection.zh: 问题是,在1831年爆发了,纳特特纳的起义,他们把这些议题推迟到起义之后

interloper.en: The scientists' description of the interloper is certainly consistent with the bloom shown in this image.
interloper.zh: 科学家们对这种闯入者的描述与这幅图像中显示的水华现象吻合。

interloper.en: She felt like an interloper in her own family.
interloper.zh: 她感到在自己家里像个外人。

interloper.en: The interloper, though, has never been found — until now.
interloper.zh: 不过， 这另一半闯入者直到现在才发现。

inter-disciplinary.en: This is a new inter-disciplinary journal.
inter-disciplinary.zh: 这是一本新的综合性学科杂志。

inter-disciplinary.en: It takes times and procedures to train the inter-disciplinary talents.
inter-disciplinary.zh: 这需要时间和步骤来培养内部纪律性人才。

inter-disciplinary.en: but it incorporates a lot of inter-disciplinary majors
inter-disciplinary.zh: 但是它包含了很多跨学科的专业，

interdiction.en: But battlefield air interdiction is not so crisply defined.
interdiction.zh: 而对于战场空中遮断的定义并不像这样容易。

interdiction.en: The interdiction of a nation's lines of communication at sea by the use of naval power.
interdiction.zh: 通过使用海军能力的在海上一条国家的通讯的线的禁止。

intermediary.en: He acted as an intermediary between Copeland and the villagers.
intermediary.zh: 他充当科普兰和村民之间的中间人。

intermediary.en: First, Venice's intermediary functions in the Adriatic Sea, where it had dominated the business of shipping for other parties, were lost to direct trading.
intermediary.zh: 首先， 威尼斯在亚得里亚海的中介功能被直接贸易所取代。威尼斯在该海域曾主导着其他国家的航运业务。

intermediary.zh: 能够参与社交的机器人可以帮助缓解孤独感并发挥认知功能， 但机器人本身并不需要直接参与， 它可以作为人类交流的中介。

intermediary.en: An intermediary is a bank, so when they pull out of banks they were disintermediating and going from banks into REITs.
intermediary.zh: 这里的中介就是指银行,所以人们将资金从银行转向REITs,就是去中介化

intermediary.en: Although, in some sense, it wasn't really disintermediation because you could say a REIT is a different kind of intermediary between the individual and the investment.

interlocutor.en: Orion had the habit of staring motionlessly at his interlocutor.
interlocutor.zh: 奥利恩有个一动不动地盯着谈话对象的习惯。

interlocutor.zh: 他们受到激励去寻找巧妙的方法去说服他们的对话者。

intermittently.en: Deane continued diving on the site intermittently until 1840, recovering several more guns, two bows, various timbers, part of a pump and various other small finds.
intermittently.zh: 迪恩继续间歇性地在这个地方潜水直到 1840年，期间又找到了几支枪、 两张弓、 各种木材、 一个水泵的一部分和其他各种小物品。

intermittently.en: The talks went on intermittently for three years.
intermittently.zh: 会谈断断续续地进行了3年。

intermittently.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
intermittently.zh: 我们能够通过暂停来消除我们固有的反应，这是我们与动物的不同之处： 狗思考未来只能断断续续地或只能维持几分钟。

intermittently.en: Behaviors last longer if they're reinforced intermittently " and this is known as "the partial reinforcement effect."
intermittently.zh: 间隔强化会使行为持续时间更久,这就是所谓的“部分强化效应“

interment.en: I enjoy cuddling with my love one and interment moments.
interment.zh: 我喜欢拥抱我的爱一个人和安葬的时刻。

intestine.en: Mice that have been given morphine are very likely to develop blood poisoning because bacteria that normally reside in the intestine typically respond to morphine by migrating into the bloodstream.

intestine.zh: 采用三袖套血管吻合法建立大鼠节段性异位小肠移植模型。

intestine.en: The key is to take a supplement of the two main probiotics we need for the intestine, lacto-bacillus acidophilus and bifidobacterium bifidum.
intestine.zh: 关键是补充肠道所需的两种主要益生菌： 嗜酸乳杆菌和双歧杆菌。

intestine.en: What happens in the intestine is that food gets broken down into constituent molecules, some of those molecules are absorbed into our bodies.
intestine.zh: 在肠道中,食物必须分解成基本的组成分子,其中一些分子才能被我们的身体吸收

intestine.en: There's a continuous path from the outside world right through the intestine.
intestine.zh: 从体外经由肠道的路径,是一条连贯的通道

intestate.zh: 我知道他没有留下任何合法的意志因为他死了没有留下遗嘱。

intestate.zh: 从遗嘱继承制度和无遗嘱继承制度的相关方面可了解这一变迁。

interminable.zh: 这次开车好像没有尽头。

interminable.en: The forest seemed interminable; nowhere did he discover a break in it, not even a woodman's road. He had not known that he lived in so wild a region.
interminable.zh: 连绵不绝的森林似乎没有尽头； 他发现这座森林里没有任何缝隙， 连一条伐木小道也没有，他不知道自己竟然居住在如此荒凉的地方。

interminable.en: But these interminable situations do not include the millions more uprooted people who are displaced within their own countries and who far outnumber the world's refugees.
interminable.zh: 但是， 这些无休止的状况尚未包括另外数百万人在自己的国境内流离失所，而这些人的数量远远超过世界上难民的总数。

invigorating.zh: 他们正在寻找激发这个部门活力的方法。

irrefragable.zh: 宇宙是一个各种固执的个体的社会， 而不是原因和结果之间无懈可击的链条。

irrevocable.zh: 他说过这项决定是不可改变的。

junkie.en: Are you a social media junkie?
junkie.zh: 你是社交媒体的成瘾者？

junkie.zh: 怎样改造状态成瘾者呢？

junkie.zh: 马奇亚维利曾经几乎是政治弱能，可以这样说，关于发生于意大利及其它地方的事务。

jury-rigging.en: By jury-rigging a microscope with a bellows camera, Bentley was able to capture for the first time the exquisite delicacy of a snowflake.

junky.en: The possible culprits: food additives and junky diets.
junky.zh: 可能的罪犯： 食品添加剂和垃圾饮食。

jury box.en: Alice looked at the jury-box, and saw that, in her haste, she had put the Lizard in head downwards, and the poor little thing was waving its tail about in a melancholy way, being quite unable to move.
jury box.zh: 爱丽丝看着陪审员席， 发现由于自己的疏忽，竟将壁虎头朝下放上了， 那个可怜的小东西无力动弹，只是滑稽地摇摆着尾巴。

jury box.en: At its premiere at the Cannes festival, the audience booed, but it won the Jury Prize and became a box - office success all over the world.
jury box.zh: 在戛纳电影节的首映式上，虽然观众报以嘘声， 它仍然获得了评委会大奖， 并在世界范围内取得了票房的成功。

jury box.en: He has had more social and educational advantages than any one of you in the jury box.
jury box.zh: 他在社会地位方面， 教育方面，要比你们陪审席上任何一位都要高出一筹。

justified.en: This sort of increase simply cannot be justified.
justified.zh: 这种增长完全没有道理。

justified.en: Only time will tell whether Broughton's optimism is justified.
justified.zh: 只有时间能证明布劳顿的乐观有没有道理。

justified.en: The data in the cells should be left- justified.
justified.zh: 存储单元里的数据应该左对齐。

justified.en: But despite this enormous concession and this realization, Satan is still justified, I think, in his cynical demystification of God's behavior before the defeat of the rebel angels.
justified.zh: 尽管后来做出了如此重大的妥协和转变，但我认为撒旦在叛乱天使战败前对上帝行为,冷嘲热讽的行为还是有其道理的。

justified.en: But what we seem to be justified in believing is not just any old explanation, but the "Best explanation."
justified.zh: 但是,我们认为正确并坚信着的,不是某些随便的陈旧解释,而是,最佳解释

justifiably.en: He was justifiably proud of his achievements.
justifiably.zh: 他无可非议地为自己的成就感到骄傲。

justifiably.en: The university can be justifiably proud of its record.
justifiably.zh: 这所大学有理由为自己的纪录而自豪。

justifiably.en: Indeed, she now says she intends to Sue for harassment, and justifiably.
justifiably.zh: 确实， 她现在说她要起诉被骚扰了， 并且证据确凿。

justifiably.en: We don't expect everybody to be a course six major, contrary to popular opinion, so for those are you not in that category, the second thing we want to do is we want to help students who don't plan to major in course six to feel justifiably confident in their ability to write and read small pieces of code.
justifiably.zh: 和大众意见正相反，我们不希望所有人都变成course，six的主修学生，所以对于那些不在第一梯队里的人来说，我们想做的第二件事情就是,希望帮助还不想,主修这门课的人,都能获得在自己能力范围内,读写小编码的自信。

kale.en: A bunch of curly kale is usually devoured in one sitting.
kale.zh: 通常一口吃掉一束羽衣甘蓝。

kale.zh: 羽衣甘蓝也应该是嫩嫩的。

but that can all fit into karma.

kebab.en: Famished, I went to try the Persian shish kebab with pomegranate sauce.
kebab.zh: 极其饥饿的我想尝试石榴汁波斯羊肉串。

kebab.en: Stick with a straightforward chicken shish kebab and you cannot go wrong.
kebab.zh: 坚持一个简单的鸡肉烤羊肉串， 你不能出错。

kebab.zh: 你的零件也可在某种器官捐献商店里预定。

kaleidoscopic.en: Thoughts appear as kaleidoscopic patterns of light and sound.
kaleidoscopic.zh: 思想显现为光和声的万花筒般的图案。

kaleidoscopic.en: Flaming hoops and torches added deep orange flashes to the kaleidoscopic scene.
kaleidoscopic.zh: 燃烧的火圈和深橘色的火炬映照着这个缤纷炫丽的场景。

kaleidoscopic.en: Their most frequent responses read like a kaleidoscopic view of our best and worst attributes.
kaleidoscopic.zh: 他们常见的回答读起来像是关于我们亦邪亦正的特性的万花筒。

keep tabs on.en: It was obvious Hill had come over to keep tabs on Johnson and make sure he didn't do anything drastic.
keep tabs on.zh: 显然， 希尔是来严密监视约翰逊的，以确保他不做什么过激的事。

keep tabs on.en: It's not always possible to keep tabs on everyone's movements.
keep tabs on.zh: 监视每个人的行动并不总是能办得到的。

keep tabs on.en: Your friends can also keep tabs on you.
keep tabs on.zh: 您的朋友也可以了解您的动向。

keen.en: John was very keen to help.
keen.zh: 约翰很热心， 愿意帮忙。
我的妻子是个热衷园艺的人。

keen.en: She herself was not a keen gardener.
keen.zh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

keen.en: Thus isolated, thus removed, the vision acquired an especially keen charm that made me race with all speed toward my lone gratification.
keen.zh: 如此形影相吊，如此销魂，这景色生出,一种勾人心魄的诱惑力，促使我全速跑向,我孤独的尤物。

keen.en: They always find a new angle, a different part to keen on especially this class. I think they are really keen on.
keen.zh: 他们总能找全新的角度，和兴趣点,尤其是这个班级，我认为他们很有热情。

keep your chin up.en: Depression is closely associated with fatigue, so try to keep your chin up and your energy level will follow suit.
keep your chin up.zh: 疲劳和消沉沮丧的情绪有很大的关系， 所以打起精神来， 能量也会随之而来。

keep your chin up.en: Keep your chin up and your eyes forward, even when you're walking down the street by yourself.
keep your chin up.zh: 抬起你的下巴， 注视前方， 即使是你一个人在街上行走。

keep your chin up.en: Keep your chin up and keep trying, the importance of grades, scores and degrees may vary, but the one thing the remains as rewarding as ever is the' never say die' spirit.
keep your chin up.zh: 打起精神尝试一下， 等级， 分数， 学位的重要性可能会有变化， 但是永不言败的精神是终身受益的。

kick about.en: While we were keen to getting a kick-about, our opponents were keen to win these matches.
kick about.zh: 当我们关注如何处理一个球时， 我们的对手却在如何赢得这些比赛。

kick about.en: As Brazil geared up for the World Cup, 230 miles above Earth, astronauts had their own microgravity kick-about.
kick about.zh: 巴西世界杯开幕之际， 宇航员们在几乎没有重力的230 英里高空踢起了足球。

kick about.en: Don't kick up a row about such trifle.

kibbutz.en: He was pained to see many youngsters deserting kibbutz life.
kibbutz.zh: 他痛心地看到许多年轻人放弃集体农场生活。

kibbutz.en: Ilana arrived in kibbutz Yagur in 1988 with her husband and settle down ever since.
kibbutz.zh: 年，伊拉娜。利维恩-玛哈兹瑞跟随丈夫来到雅格·基布兹并且定居。

kibbutz.en: He said the militants were apparently planning to attack a kibbutz collective farm or to kidnap a soldier.
kibbutz.zh: 加兰特说， 很显然， 这些激进分子原来计划袭击基布兹集体农庄或者绑架一名军人。

kibbutz.en: They enforced complete sharing and if you belonged to a kibbutz you were completely stuck with the common consumption.
kibbutz.zh: 强迫人们绝对共享,如果你是某个集体农场的一员,就彻底受到共同消费的制约。

kibbutz.en: When someone gets a gift and the other people at the kibbutz say, "Well you can't have that by yourself, we share everything."
kibbutz.zh: 当某人收到一件礼物,农场里的其他人就指责道，你不能把它据为己有，我们必须分享一切“

kibbutz.en: I've heard a lot of stories about a lot of bickering at the kibbutz.
kibbutz.zh: 我听过许多发生在,以色列集体农场的争执与矛盾。

kinship with.en: She evidently felt a sense of kinship with the woman.
kinship with.zh: 她明显地感到对这个女人有一种亲切感。

knackered.en: A family friend said: " David's knackered and was relieved to get a break."
knackered.zh: 某个家庭朋友说：“大卫可是精疲力竭，终于能放松休息了。”

knackered.zh: 许多时候都看来筋疲力尽而世界杯似乎打击了他的自信心。

kingpin.en: AOL became the kingpin and along came the Internet.
kingpin.zh: 成了主脑角色，继而诞生了互联网。

kingpin.en: But there is no kingpin on the "most wanted" posters.
kingpin.zh: 但是其中没有最高通缉令上的中心人物。

kingpin.zh: 所以在一个项目或者交易中的最重要人物就是 “中央木柱”。

kiln.en: The bricks are left in the kiln to bake.
They are charring wood in a kiln.
kiln.zh: 他们正在窑内将木头烧成木炭。

kiln.en: The slats are waxed and kiln dried again.

kink.en: Be careful not to kink the hemp rope.
kink.zh: 小心别把麻绳绞在一起。

kink.zh: 这折下是明显地开始出现了。

knee-jerk.zh: 然而， 这将是对微妙争论的下意识反应。

knee-jerk.zh: 如果共和主义要在英国生存，就要克服这种下意识的反应， 认识到这种表面上的狡猾是君主制的秘密武器。

knee-jerk.en: It was a knee-jerk reaction on her part.

knave.zh: 红桃 J 小心翼翼地用一只脚翻转着。

knave.en: Once a knave, always a knave.
knave.zh: 一次耍无赖，终身臭名在。

knock it off.en: I dare you to knock it off - - and anybody that'll take a dare will suck eggs.

knock it off.zh: 尽管仍会有突发事件打断进程，但只要美国继续保有至少是大体应向哪个方向走的概念， 它就更可能成功。

knock-on effect.en: The increase in the price of oil had a knock-on effect on the cost of many other goods.
knock-on effect.zh: 石油价格上涨对其他许多商品的价格引起了连锁反应。

knock-on effect.en: " There will be a knock-on effect for car production in the UK, but we don't yet know what it is," he said.
knock-on effect.zh: 他说，“这对我们在英国的汽车生产会形成连锁反应， 但是目前为止我们还不知道是什么样的”。

knock-on effect.en: Would the perturbation grow and have a knock-on effect, thus affecting the rest of the brain, or immediately die out?
knock-on effect.zh: 这个干扰会变大和有撞击效应， 进而影响大脑的其他部分， 还是迅速消失呢？

knock-down.en: Please don't knock down all those cans.

knock-down.zh: 办公室经理打破了这一隔阂， 鼓励团队建设。

knocker.en: Our door knocker is cast in solid brass.
knocker.zh: 我们的门环是纯铜铸造的。

knocker.en: I felt loath to sully the gleaming brass knocker by handling it.
knocker.zh: 我不愿意用手去抓那个闪亮的黄铜门环以免把它弄脏。

knocker.en: If the knocker is gone, I can still use my feet.
knocker.zh: 如果门环没了， 我还可以用我的脚。

knot-head.en: I also recognized the body, the head with the hair gathered in an unfamiliar knot, the neck, the broad back, and the strong arms.

knot-head.en: Then I also recognized the body, the head with the hair gathered in an unfamiliar knot, the neck, the broad back, and the strong arms.

knot-head.en: Tie Guanyin, a variety of oolong tea: Tea bar curly, fat circle knot, heavy even, colour and lustre arenaceous green, the overall shape like dragonfly head, leptospirosis, frogs legs.
knot-head.zh: 按溪铁观音， 茶条卷曲， 肥壮圆结， 沉重匀整， 色泽砂绿， 整体形状似蜻蜓头、 螺旋体、 青蛙腿。

knotty.en: The new management faces some knotty problems.
knotty.zh: 新的管理层面临着一些棘手的问题。

knowingly.en: He repeated that he had never knowingly taken illegal drugs.
knowingly.zh: 他反复说自己从未故意吸毒。

knowingly.en: She was accused of knowingly making a false statement to the police.
knowingly.zh: 她被指控故意向警方提供虚假供词。

knowingly.en: The company has consistently denied it had knowingly broken arms embargoes.
knowingly.zh: 该公司始终否认故意违反了武器禁运规定。

knowingly.en: She's confronted him with having knowingly taken the father's words the wrong way: "You stop that lying.
knowingly.zh: 她母亲已对理查,使用的方法心知肚明：,““不要再撒谎了“

knowingly.en: and so they just, knowingly or unknowingly, they steal and copy what someone else has already said.
knowingly.zh: 所以他们就，有意识或无意识地，偷窃或者拷贝别人说过的东西。

know the score.en: You don't have to lie to me. I know the score.
know the score.zh: 你不必瞒我。 我知道是怎么回事。

know the score.en: Not only will you know the score, but you'll find live fan reviews and outlooks that you'll get nowhere else.
know the score.zh: 你除了会知道得分， 还会看到绝无仅有的现场观众的评论和见解。

know the score.en: We'll let you know the score as it happens.
know the score.zh: 如果正好发生了， 我们会让你知道分数的。

know-it-all.en: I'm not trying to be a bossy know-it - all.
know-it-all.zh: 我不想做个自以为是的万事通。

know-it-all.en: If you come across as a know-it - all ( even if you really do know it all!), it really pushes people away.
know-it-all.zh: 如果你被认为是一个 “百事通”（即使你真的无所不晓）， 那会使人们疏远你。

know-it-all.en: I'm not saying this to brag or that I know it all.
know-it-all.zh: 我说这些不是吹嘘也不表明我知晓一切。

know-it-all.en: Quickly to reread it - - I know that you all have it glued to your wrists, but in case you don't, I'll reread it: I am Tony the Tow Truck. I live in a little yellow garage.
know-it-all.zh: 我快一点复述一下 - - 我知道你们肯定都读过了，但是以防万一有人没读过，我还是要重读一遍：,我是拖车托尼，我住在一间狭小的黄色车篷里。

know-it-all.en: - On the other hand, we have to ask ourselves - - and this the question that I left us with last time - whether it would really, all things considered, be better to know how much time you had.
know-it-all.zh: 另一方面，我们不得不问自己 -,这是上一次课我留下来的问题 -,从全面考虑，知道你还有多少时间，是不是会更好。

laborious.en: Keeping the garden tidy all year round can be a laborious task.
laborious.zh: 保持院子全年整洁会是一项费时费力的任务。

laborious.en: Photography was once an expensive, laborious ordeal reserved for life's greatest milestones.
laborious.zh: 摄影曾经是一件昂贵且耗时费力的事情， 仅用于记录生命中的重大事件。

laborious.zh: 弥尔顿一直在为诗人辛苦的日子可能不会带来突然的名声而感叹。

laborious.en: It's the pursuit of fame, the noble pursuit of fame, that spurs us to scorn delights and to live laborious days.
laborious.zh: 是对名望的追求，这高尚的追求，迫使我们批判享乐，艰苦度日。

laborious.en: Jefferson:"Northerners are cool, sober, laborious, persevering, independent, jealous of their own liberties, chicaning, superstitious, and hypocritical in their religion."
laborious.zh: 杰斐逊说,"北方人冷静,稳重,勤劳,坚毅,独立,珍惜自身的自由,奸诈,迷信,还假装是虔诚宗教信徒"

magnum opus.en: His latest offering is a magnum opus on philosophy.

make a bonfire of.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Woe to the bloody city, of which I will make a great bonfire.

make hay while the sun shines.en: You've got only a week, Soyou have to make hay while the sun shines.

make hay while the sun shines.en: If you want to become a million aire, you must make hay while the sun shines.

make hay while the sun shines.en: Make hay while the sun shines.
make hay while the sun shines.zh: 趁着大晴天，赶紧晒饲草。

make a virtue of.en: Everyone has his shortcomings, but we can make a virtue of our own shortcomings and turn them into our advantages.
make a virtue of.zh: 每个人都有缺点， 但是我们可以利用我们自己的缺点， 并将其转化为优点。

make a virtue of.en: Even though the anchor investors and some of the insiders may be locked in for a while, they are still in a position to make huge profits by virtue of their connections.

make a virtue of.en: Specialists make a virtue of lending to people who cannot get credit elsewhere, because that means they are not loaded up with debt.

make no bones about.en: Nearby, dozens of other vendors are selling counterfeit Nokia, Motorola and Samsung phones - as well as cheap look - alikes that make no bones about being knockoffs.

make no bones about.en: I'll make no bones about it - I don't think you did a good job of painting my house.
make no bones about.zh: 我对此事直言不讳——我认为你没把我的房子粉刷好。

make no bones about.en: I shall make no bones about doing what I think is best.
make no bones about.zh: 只要我认为是最好的，我便会毫不犹豫地去做。

make out of the whole cloth.en: One of the things my company does is go and check this stuff out. It's amazing how much stuff companies make up out of whole cloth.
make out of the whole cloth.zh: 我公司做的其中一项业务就是出去检查这些事件， 令人吃惊的是，这些公司在它们的表面之外做了许多虚饰。

make out of the whole cloth.en: If I can make clothes out of those cloths, my clothes will be the best in the whole world. Hurry and show me the cloth.
make out of the whole cloth.zh: 如果能用这些布制成衣服，那我的衣服不就是世界上最好的衣服。 赶紧把布给我瞧瞧。

make out of the whole cloth.en: Could there really be such a cloth? If I can make clothes out of those cloths, my clothes will be the best in the whole world.
make out of the whole cloth.zh: 难道真的有这样的布？ 如果我能利用这些布衣服， 我的衣服将成为全世界最好的。

maladapted.en: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
maladapted.zh: 在这种情况下利用隐私法来牵制科技巨头并不适宜。

maladapted.en: The tragedy surrounding those two storms underline just how maladapted major population centers in the region are to today's conditions.
maladapted.zh: 从那两场灾难就可以看出该地区主要人口密集区与当前环境的强烈不适。

make-believe.zh: 萨姆说：“咱们来玩假装的游戏吧。”

make-believe.en: It is only make-believe, isn't it, that I am their father?
make-believe.zh: 我是他们的父亲，不过是假装的，对吗？

make-believe.en: If they broke down in their make-believe he rapped them on the knuckles.
make-believe.zh: 如果他们在假装的时候半途而废了， 他就会敲他们的指关节。

make-believe.en: He says in the middle of the poem on page 225: First there's the children's house of make-believe, Some shattered dishes underneath a pine, The playthings in the playhouse of the children.
make-believe.zh: 他在225页这首诗的中间说到：,首先是假扮的孩子们的房间，松树下的一碟碟食物，那些玩具室里孩子们的玩具。

makeshift.en: A few cushions formed a makeshift bed.
makeshift.zh: 临时用几个垫子拼了一张床。

makeshift.en: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria.
makeshift.zh: 人们四仰八叉地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。

makeshift.en: Not far from them, other survivors in the earthquake wail in pain at the makeshift hospital.
makeshift.zh: 离他们不远处， 地震中的其他幸存者在临时搭建的医院中痛苦地哀号。

makeshift.en: What would happen is these people who were enslaved from different cultures would develop a makeshift communication system so they could talk to one another.
makeshift.zh: 这些来自不同文化的被奴役的个体,会创造出一种临时的交流系统,以便他们之间能够互相交流

makeshift.en: They take this makeshift communication system developed by adults and, again, they turn it into a full-blown language, suggesting that to some extent it's part of our human nature to create languages.
makeshift.zh: 他们继承了成人发展出来的临时交流系统,将这个临时交流系统,再次发展成一种成熟的语言,这表明从某种程度上来说,创造语言是我们人类本性的一部分

make short work of.en: PHP has many functions that make short work of XML both in and out of an application.

malady.zh: 他停了下来， 涨红了脸， 然后继续低沉而悲伤地说：“啊， 我的病又来折磨我了，我精神错乱了。”

Oh, I also want a manicure while I'm having the perm.

manifesto.zh: 他把自己的宣言简明地概括成了“努力工作，努力训练，努力玩耍。”

manifesto.zh: 因此，行为主义者的目标,是建立一门科学,将一切不可观测的事情都排除在外,取而代之的是应用,诸如刺激，反应，强化，惩罚,以及表示现实世界和客观事件的环境,之类的概念来进行研究。
