mean-spirited.zh: 长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是使社会变得更加刻薄、 更缺乏包容性， 通常还会阻止或逆转权利和自由的进步。
这种行为是卑鄙的、 危险的。

mediocrity.en: To make up for the mediocrity, zealous parents send their kids to the expensive cram schools.
mediocrity.zh: 为了弥补平庸， 积极的父母把孩子送到昂贵的补习班。

mediocrity.en: His acting career started brilliantly, then sank into mediocrity.
mediocrity.zh: 他的演艺生涯开场时轰轰烈烈， 然后就变得庸庸碌碌。

mediocrity.en: Mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
mediocrity.zh: 平庸的工作表现不再足以成为辞退的正当理由。

mediocrity.en: He called the North a, quote, "Happy state of mediocrity, a hardy race of free, independent republicans."
mediocrity.zh: 他说北方是,"快乐的平庸之地,这里住着一群自由独立的共和主义者"

melancholy.zh: 史蒂夫将它称之为“忧郁之花”。

melancholy.en: Huck's face lost its tranquil content, and took a melancholy cast.
melancholy.zh: 哈克脸上悠然自得的表情消失了，流露出一脸的忧郁。

melancholy.en: There was a cold drizzle of rain; the atmosphere was murky; it was a melancholy day.
melancholy.zh: 外面下着冰冷的小雨； 气氛阴沉； 这是一个令人忧郁的日子。

meddlesome.en: Don't be a meddlesome wench and poke your nose where it's no cause to go.
meddlesome.zh: 不要做一个爱管闲事的丫头，在没有必要的地方瞎管闲事。

meddlesome.en: But now this meddlesome bedbug has inspired tenfold the terror.
meddlesome.zh: 但是现在， 这个爱管闲事的臭虫所造成的恐怖感觉十倍于此啊。

meddlesome.en: FOR decades Turkey's meddlesome generals inspired fear and respect.
meddlesome.zh: 几十年来， 土耳其那些爱惹是生非的将领们常常令人畏惧而又尊敬。

melanoma.en: The good news is that a combination of sunscreen and covering up can reduce melanoma rates, as shown by Australian figures from their slip-slop-slap campaign.
melanoma.zh: 好消息是， 防晒霜和遮阳两种方式结合在一起可以降低黑色素瘤的患病率， 澳大利亚人在日光浴前的准备活动就证明了这一点。

melanoma.en: The good news is that a combination of sunscreen and covering up can reduce melanoma rates, as shown by Australian figures from their slip slop slap campaign.
melanoma.zh: 好消息是， 防晒霜和遮盖物的结合可以降低黑色素瘤的发病率， 这一数据来自澳大利亚的 slip slop slap 运动。

melanoma.en: Most of the risk factors for melanoma are unavoidable.
melanoma.zh: 导致黑素瘤的危险因素中大部分都是难以避免的。

medley.zh: 她参加了 400 米混合泳比赛。

medley.en: Japan won the Men's 200 metre individual medley.
medley.zh: 日本赢得了男子 200 米个人混合泳比赛。

medley.en: ' People need to save money outside of their retirement account,' says Mr. Medley.
medley.zh: 麦德利说， 人们需要在他们的退休账户之外另行存钱。

medley.en: They play with these partials on each of these notes, but this is just one sound with all of these other things mixed in to the medley that produces the quality or timbre of a particular instrument.
medley.zh: 它们改变音符中的分音的强度,不过这只是一个声音,要算上其它所有分音的集合,才能构成一个特定乐器的音色

melange.en: Using dual-constant Kubelka-Munk theory for colour matching of melange fibres is discussed.
melange.zh: 对双常数库贝尔卡-芒克理论用于混色纤维配色进行了探讨。

melange.en: Granted that a catalog is by its very nature a melange.
melange.zh: 诚然， 一份目录，就其本质来说便应当是混杂的。

melange.en: In the 2010 image, the same area is melange -broken glacier ice and sea ice covered with snow.
melange.zh: 在 2010年的图片中， 同样的地区则是混杂一片——取而代之的是覆盖这积雪的破碎的冰川冰和海冰。

melange.en: like a melange of all different sort of things.
melange.zh: 像一个汇集了各种事物的大杂烩。

meld.en: The key is to meld the old with the new.
meld.zh: 关键是要讲旧的和新的数据融合在一起。

meld.en: You can then wrap just about any class with it to meld in the logging capability.
meld.zh: 然后您可以用它包装任何类以结合日志功能。

meld.en: Above the Trans-Alaska Pipeline in midwinter, sundogs meld into a halo around the sun.
meld.zh: 在跨阿拉斯加输油管道上， 隆冬天气里的幻日融合成了一个围绕太阳的光环。

mellow.en: His voice was deep and mellow.
Mellow music and lighting helped to create the right atmosphere.
mellow.zh: 柔和的音乐和灯光衬托出了适宜的氛围。

mellow.en: His voice was deep and mellow and his speech had a soothing and comforting quality.
mellow.zh: 他的嗓音深沉柔美，他的演讲令人舒心宽慰。

melodramatic.en: " Don't you think you're being slightly melodramatic?" Jane asked.
melodramatic.zh: 你不觉得你有点夸张吗？” 简问道。

melodramatic.en: It is the melodious drama of ancient Greek theater, the term "melodious drama" being shortened eventually to " melodrama " because operas frequently are melodramatic, not to say unrealistic.
melodramatic.zh: 它是富有优美声调的一段戏剧，源自古希腊剧院。“声调优美的戏剧” 这个表达最终被简化成了“情节剧”， 因为歌剧往往是音乐性的，而且有戏剧情节的，甚至是超现实的。

melodramatic.en: It's a late Victorian image of an archaic singer rendered in the melodramatic manner of Pre-Raphaelite art and thoroughly removed from the aesthetic values of modernism, such as naturalism, formal clarity, emotional restraint and so on.
melodramatic.zh: 这是维多利亚时代晚期古代吟唱诗人的肖像,用戏剧化的前拉斐尔派,风格表现，完全摒弃了,现代主义的审美观，比如自然主义，形式明确，感情自制等等。

mellifluous.en: I grew up around people who had wonderful, mellifluous voices.
mellifluous.zh: 我是在一群有着悦耳动听嗓音的人周围长大的。

mellifluous.en: He can whisper mellifluous nothings in my ear.
mellifluous.zh: 他可以整日在我耳边甜言蜜语。

mellifluous.en: Soon the room is filled with Bates' mellifluous tones.
mellifluous.zh: 很快， 房间里便充满了贝茨动听的声音。

memorabilia.en: The wedding memorabilia is being made with bone China.
memorabilia.zh: 婚礼纪念品是用骨瓷制成的。

memorabilia.en: Republic has brought out its own royal wedding memorabilia.
memorabilia.zh: 共和党已经展示出它的皇室婚礼大事记。

memorabilia.en: A little research and I found a sports memorabilia shop in d.c..
memorabilia.zh: 只是查阅一些资料然后我在特区找到了一个体育纪念品商店。

meningitis.en: Epidemic meningitis is not the biggest killer in Africa, but it is one of the most greatly fearful of all diseases.
meningitis.zh: 流行性脑膜炎并非是非洲最大的杀手， 但是， 它是所有疾病中最令人感到恐惧的一个。

meningitis.en: The invasive disease can present as bacteraemia or meningitis.
meningitis.zh: 侵入性疾病可以表现为菌血症或脑膜炎。

menstruate.en: Some girls may first ovulate even before they menstruate.
menstruate.zh: 有些女孩初次排卵可能甚至早于她们的月经。

menstruate.en: Lean, hard-training women athletes may menstruate less frequently or not at all.
menstruate.zh: 清瘦、训练艰苦的女运动员行经可能不那么频繁或根本没有月经。

mennonite.en: He was from the Netherlands, the son of a Mennonite minister, and was drawn to Judaism.
mennonite.zh: 他来自荷兰，父亲是门诺派牧师，本人却信奉犹太教。

mennonite.en: Mennonite and other large landowners this week defended the deforestation, arguing that it created jobs.
mennonite.zh: 本周门诺教派和其他大地主为自己的毁林行为进行了辩护， 强调这种做法创造了就业机会。

mennonite.en: To make a long story short, the Mennonite Amish were so conservative that they made more enemies than friends.
mennonite.zh: 长话短说，亚米希 · 门诺那特人由于太过保守以致树立的敌人比交到的朋友还多。

mentee.en: As a mentee, it's best to establish a process and always have a mentoring date on the calendar, Zachary advises.
mentee.zh: 扎克利建议， 作为学员， 最好确立一个流程， 安排时间定期接受导师的指导。

mentee.en: To make the most of the partnership, Sherman says, " we reviewed my responsibilities as a mentee, and my expectations and goals."
mentee.zh: 谢尔曼称， 为了充分发挥这份师徒关系的作用，“我们讨论了我作为学员的责任， 以及我的预期和目标。”

mentee.en: He talked about his mentee and his new, soon to be published book, and encouraged us all to find someone to be our own GTY person.
mentee.zh: 他说了他的聆听者、他即将出版的新书， 并且鼓励我们寻找我们自己的聆听教导者。

memorably.en: British cars, once memorably described as a skip on wheels, have come to embody the national humiliation of that benighted era.
memorably.zh: 英国汽车在记忆中一度被称为车轮上的跳板，如今已成为那个愚昧时代的国耻象征。

memorably.en: A tagline is a slogan which succinctly, memorably, and descriptively sums up a company or product.
memorably.zh: 口号是一条简洁而令人印象深刻的标语，用来描述一个公司或产品。

memorably.en: Mrs. Obama has worn black and red before — memorably, on the night her husband was elected president.
memorably.zh: 奥巴马夫人在其丈夫的就职典礼上， 穿的也是红黑礼服。

menstruation.en: Menstruation may cease when a woman is anywhere between forty-five and fifty years of age.
menstruation.zh: 月经可能在女性 45 至 50 岁之间停止。

menstruation.en: For the first 21 days after menstruation, estrogen hormones create a feeling of well-being and give generally happy feelings.
menstruation.zh: 大多数绝经前的女性在月经之后的 21 天里，体内的雌激素会产生一种健康幸福感。

menstruation.en: Menstruation (a period) is a major stage of puberty in girls; it's one of the many physical signs that a girl is turning into a woman.
menstruation.zh: 月经 （例假） 的来到是女孩青春期中经历的一个重要阶段； 它是女孩变为女人的众多生理变化之一。

mental institution.en: She was locked in the basement of a mental institution outside of Boston.
mental institution.zh: 她被所在波士顿城外一个精神医院的地下室里。

mental institution.en: If you were filming a movie about a mental institution, what better place to shoot than an actual psychiatric hospital?
mental institution.zh: 如果你在拍摄一部关于精神病人的影片，会有哪比在一个真正的疯人院更合适呢？

mental institution.en: He turned out to be an escapee from a Tennessee mental institution.
mental institution.zh: 后来才知道他是从田纳西州的一个精神病院里逃出来的。

mercenary.en: She's interested in him for purely mercenary reasons.
mercenary.zh: 她对他感兴趣完全是为了贪图金钱。

mercenary.en: For a full minute, the mercenary couldn't speak.
mercenary.zh: 整整一分钟， 雇佣兵没法开口。

mercenary.en: The brothers desire to hear justice praised for itself alone, and that seems to be expressive of their own freedom from mercenary motives and incentives.
mercenary.zh: 这对兄弟档,想听到正义自我礼赞，这似乎也显露出,他们不受金钱目的,及奖励约束的自由。

mercenary.en: There were no kings with the wealth to hire mercenary soldiers.
mercenary.zh: 国王的财富不足以,招募雇佣军

meretricious.en: Of the meretricious splendour I had heard so much there is not a trace.
meretricious.zh: 我听到过很多对此地豪华装饰的描述，但是我找不到一丝这样的痕迹。

meretricious.en: The perspective just as moral truths, that are presented in their simplicity without the meretricious AIDS of ornament or glitter.
meretricious.zh: 远景就象真理一样的朴实无华， 没有任何矫揉造作和脑人耳目的虚饰。

meretricious.en: It was a platinum fob chain simple and chaste in design, properly proclaiming its value by substance alone and not by meretricious ornamentation — as all good things should do.
meretricious.zh: 这礼物就是一条白金表链，款式简单朴素，货真价实， 不是靠花哨的包装、而是靠真正的质量正当地显示自己的价值， 一切好的东西都应该如此。

meritocracy.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
meritocracy.zh: 我也不喜欢定额； 它们与我信奉的英才统治、能者治理的理念背道而驰。
有人称这是一种精英制度。

meritocracy.en: It is, in many ways, a pure meritocracy.
meritocracy.zh: 从许多方面来看， 这都是纯粹的实力主义。

merry-go-round.en: He was tired of the merry-go - round of romance and longed to settle down.
merry-go-round.zh: 他厌倦了没完没了的风流韵事， 渴望安定下来。

merry-go-round.en: It is one big merry-go - round of happiness. Join the ride.
merry-go-round.zh: 这是一个幸福的循环，就像旋转木马， 坐上木马来吧。

merry-go-round.en: Feeling that you are on the merry-go - round of life and just want to get off;
merry-go-round.zh: 感觉你在过旋转木马的生活并且你只想下马；

metamorphose.en: The tadpoles metamorphose and emerge onto land.
metamorphose.zh: 蝌蚪变形并现身在陆地上。

metamorphose.en: The simplest explanation for this is that the axolotl lineage alone lost the ability to metamorphose, while others retained it.
metamorphose.zh: 对此最简单的解释是， 只有蝾螈谱系失去了变形的能力， 而其他族系则保留了这种能力。

metamorphose.en: From a detailed analysis of the salamanders' family tree, however, it is clear that the other lineages evolved from an ancestor that itself had lost the ability to metamorphose.
metamorphose.zh: 然而，通过对蝾螈族谱的详细分析，我们可以清楚地看到， 其他谱系分支是从一个本身已经失去了变形的能力的祖先演化而来的。

metallic.en: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
metallic.zh: 一声金属碰撞的咔嗒声后， 大门打开了。

metallic.en: He had painted all the wood with metallic silver paint.
metallic.zh: 他把所有木料涂上了有金属光泽的银漆。

metallic.en: Even the smallest metallic object, whether a nail file or cigarette lighter, is immediately confiscated.
metallic.zh: 即便是最小的金属物品， 不论是指甲锉刀还是打火机， 都会立刻被没收。

metallic.en: In an aqueous solution, he passes electric current and causes silver ions to deposit and form metallic silver.
metallic.zh: 在水溶液中，他接通电流，这得银离子,沉淀，并形成金属银。

metallic.en: Here is an example that shows some very, very metallic elements, groups one and two, and some non- metallic elements over here, five, six and seven.
metallic.zh: 举个例子,这个例子表明金属元素，第一族和第二族，与一些非金属元素,在这里，第五族，第六族，和第七族。

meteoric.en: GM's survival would be in even greater doubt without the meteoric growth it is seeing in China.
meteoric.zh: 如果没有在中国的迅速增长， 通用汽车的生存将更有疑问。

meteoric.en: The secret of Wal-Mart's meteoric rise over the past five decades has been its obsession with low prices.
meteoric.zh: 沃尔玛过去 50 年的飞速崛起， 秘诀就在于一直采用低价策略。

meteoric.en: What accounts for the sudden meteoric rise in a sport which, after all, is played best by people who are unusually tall?
meteoric.zh: 这项毕竟还是由高得出奇的人打得最好的运动是如何迅速兴起呢？

metastasis.en: This process is referred to as metastasis.
metastasis.zh: 这一过程被称之为转移。

metastasis.en: The research could lead to new therapies for preventing cancer metastasis.
metastasis.zh: 这项研究将会引发癌转移的新疗法。

metastasis.en: The metastatic part: Metastasis means the tumor spread outside its original site.
metastasis.zh: 关于转移： 转移意味着散肿瘤向外扩散。

metastasis.en: The Presbyterians needed to halt the endless generation of dangerous religious propaganda and continued what they felt on some level was the continued metastasis of Protestant sects.
metastasis.zh: 长老派需要停止无穷无尽不断产生的,危险的宗教宣传,继续他们认为的在一定程度上,继续转移的清教徒派系。

metastasize.en: A major reason why many cancers are so dangerous is that they metastasize.
metastasize.zh: 癌症的危险因素主要在于癌细胞转移。

metastasize.en: " Those are the ones you want to catch," she said, " because they could metastasize and prove lethal."
metastasize.zh: 她说：“那些是你们想要处理的， 因为它们会转移和被证明是有致死性的。”

metastasize.en: Younger women have fewer treatment options, she said. " Those types of breast cancer tend to metastasize (spread) early."
metastasize.zh: 同意这一个观点， 说道， 年轻的女性缺少检查的选择， 这些形式的乳癌早期会转移，有可能转移到脑部。

metronome.en: These vibrations turn the ion into a sort of superfast metronome.
metronome.zh: 铝离子因为这些振动成为一种超高速节拍器。

metronome.en: If you're looking for a metronome, you've come to the wrong place.
metronome.zh: 如果你在找一个节拍器，你已经走错了地方了。

metronome.en: Metronome is designed to provide RT behavior to existing applications.
metronome.zh: 的设计目的是为现有的应用程序提供 RT 行为。

miasma.en: A miasma of stale alcohol hung around him.
miasma.zh: 他身上老有股难闻的酒精味。

miasma.en: As time went on, his ambition to be part of the U.S. Supreme Court faded in a miasma of alcohol and despair.
miasma.zh: 随着时间的推移， 他要跻身美国最高法院的雄心壮志在酒精和绝望中消逝。

miasma.en: I hauled his face out of the miasma, yanked him to his feet.
miasma.zh: 我从毒气拖了他的脸，强拉了他到他的脚。

methadone.en: My first experience with methadone was when I worked in palliative care.
methadone.zh: 我的第一次有关镇静剂的经历还是我在救护中心工作的时候。

methadone.en: Results: The approach of methadone maintenance treatment is effective, valid, and easy to operate and is potential to scale up.
methadone.zh: 药物维持治疗效果明显， 方法可靠， 操作技术简便，具有良好的推广价值和市场潜力。

methadone.en: The methadone maintenance treatment (MMT) is playing the more important role in drug control work, but its practice is not as effective as expected due to various reasons.
methadone.zh: 美沙酮维持治疗在禁毒防艾中的重要性日益凸显， 然而这种疗法的实践效果却因为种种原因而显得不太理想。

mid-section.en: A full - scale reconstruction of a mid-section had been made in 1996, primarily to see how Bronze - Age replica tools performed.
mid-section.zh: 年对中部进行了全面的重建， 主要是为了了解青铜时代的复制工具是如何工作的。

mid-section.en: Linda had gained fifty pounds, almostentirely around her mid-section.
mid-section.zh: 的体重增长了五十磅，几乎全都集中在中间部分。

mid-section.en: An electric motor replaces the gasoline engine and a 16.5 kilowatt - hour battery system, made by Tesla Motors, is in the mid-section of the car.
mid-section.zh: 电动马达取代了汽油引擎和 16.5 千瓦小时的电池系统， 由特斯拉汽车公司提出， 在中赛车的部分。

microbe.en: Genes involved in microbe siderophore production and uptake are derepressed.
microbe.zh: 微生物铁载体产生和吸收的基因被抑制了。

microbe.en: We have a microbe doing something different than life as we know it.
microbe.zh: 我们培养了一种和我们所知的生命完全不同的微生物。

microbe.en: One day, when he was using a microscope to watch the microbe, a messenger visited him.
microbe.zh: 一天， 他正在用一台显微镜观察微生物的时候，一个送信者来拜访他。

middle-of-the-road.en: Their music is very middle-of - the - road.
Consensus need not be weak, nor need it result in middle-of - the - road policies.
middle-of-the-road.zh: 多数人的意见不一定就软弱， 也不一定会导致中立的政策。

middle-of-the-road.en: I actually don't want to be a middle-of - the - road person, married with a mortgage.
middle-of-the-road.zh: 我真的不想作一个平庸的人， 结完婚，背着抵押贷款。

midwife.en: The midwife gave him a warm bath.
midwife.zh: 助产士给他洗了个温水澡。
她是受过专门训练的助产士。

midwife.en: You don't have to call the midwife as soon as labour starts.

parishioner.zh: 教区居民的损失是巨大的。

play up.zh: 在这里面学校扮演了主要角色,所以这些说着,方言或者普罗旺斯语或者加斯科涅语的孩子们,我把加斯科涅语忘了,在波尔多附近,他们操着勉强能接受的法语唱着马赛曲,上前线等待被屠杀

plaza.en: Their rendezvous would be the Plaza Hotel.
plaza.zh: 他们的会面地点将是广场大酒店。

plaza.zh: 或者是孚日广场,它是目前为止,巴黎最漂亮的广场,在那里你能看到类似的建筑物

plaza.en: And I mean, there's... you can walk down Sproul Plaza and you know,

pleasantry.en: I seem to be in evil case— and all for an innocent and thoughtless pleasantry.
pleasantry.zh: 我似乎陷入了不幸的境地—— 而这一切都是出于一种天真而轻率的玩笑。

pleasantry.en: I said: " Any other time you would have laughed at my little pleasantry."
pleasantry.zh: 我说：“其他任何时候你都可以笑我无聊。”

pleasantry.en: Elizabeth tried to join in her father's pleasantry, but could only force one most reluctant smile.
pleasantry.zh: 伊丽莎白尽量凑着父亲打趣， 可是她的笑容显得极其勉强。 父亲的俏皮幽默，从来没有象今天这样不讨她喜欢。

pliable.en: Birch bark is pliable and very easy to bend.
pliable.zh: 桦树皮很柔韧， 很容易弯曲。

pliable.en: The four states make up the brass buckle on that tough but pliable leather belt.
pliable.zh: 这四个州组成了这条坚韧而柔软的皮带上的铜扣。

pliable.en: As your baby grows bigger, his bones become less pliable.
pliable.zh: 随着你的宝宝慢慢长大， 他的骨头柔韧性会变弱。

plebeian.en: It was a boy, bareheaded, ill shod, and clothed in coarse plebeian garments that were falling to rags.
plebeian.zh: 那是个孩子， 没戴帽子，没穿鞋， 穿着破烂的粗布平民衣服。

plebeian.en: Some mass media tend to please people of plebeian tastes.
plebeian.zh: 有些媒体有讨好低俗品味者的倾向。

plethora.en: Both it and its companions would then decay almost instantly into a plethora of less fleeting bits, some of which could be detected.
plethora.zh: 然后， 它与它的伙伴们将会几乎在瞬间衰变为大批寿命更短的微粒子，其中有一些能被检测出来。

plethora.en: He has a plethora of styles in his designs.
plethora.zh: 他的设计拥有很多风格。

plethora.en: Classes with a plethora of imports have many unique types.
plethora.zh: 具有过多导入的类会有许多惟一类型。

plough into.en: Why should any entrepreneur plough money into a new factory when he has no idea what taxes he will eventually be asked to pay?
plough into.zh: 在他还不确定将征收何种税款时， 为什么企业家应该将资金投入到新建工厂？

plough into.en: The executive search firm is to plough the landscape for someone who has the relevant experience and credentials. Fresh graduates do not come into the picture given this backdrop.
plough into.zh: 猎头公司要尽量发掘有相关经验和资历的人，在这种前提下毕业生不会被考虑。

plough into.en: After the wheat crop has been gathered, many farmers burn the remains and plough the ash into the soil, so as to enrich it.
plough into.zh: 小麦收割完成后， 农夫们把剩余物烧掉，然后用犁把灰埋入地里， 使土地更肥沃。

plough on.en: You can start again on mathematics, until is it is time to learn to plough.
plough on.zh: 你可以重新开始学习数学， 直到该学犁地的时候。

plough on.en: Farmers have always relied on seasonal workers to plough the fields and pick the crops.
plough on.zh: 农场主往往要请季节工耕地和摘绵花。

plough on.en: It will not be easy, but Mr Erdogan seems determined to plough on.
plough on.zh: 这不会是容易的， 但埃尔多安似乎坚定不移。

ploy.en: It was all a ploy to distract attention from his real aims.
ploy.zh: 那全是障眼法，借以转移对他真实目的的注意。

ploy.en: It was a ploy, of course.

ploy.zh: 所以就弥尔顿而言，是一个可理解的事,他需要通过认同那伟大的诗句来贬低莎士比亚，用Comus来压倒比他年纪较大的同时代人。

plucky.en: The real Tom and Jerry: Plucky mouse shows prowling cat that he's no pip-squeak.
plucky.zh: 勇敢的老鼠用行动向潜行而来的猫表示自己绝不是无足轻重的懦夫。

plucky.en: David and Goliath: The plucky rodent decides he's not going to let Felix eat him.
plucky.zh: 大卫和歌利亚(以弱胜强的事例)：但是， 勇敢的啮齿动物果断地做出了决定：决不让自己成为菲利克斯的盘中餐。

plucky.en: Thanks to a plucky woman from Frenchtown, Montana, we now know how to deal with at least one animal menace.
plucky.zh: 感谢勇敢的来自蒙大拿州弗伦奇敦的一个女人， 我们知道了怎样处理 (来自) 至少一个动物的威胁。

plump.en: He pushed a plump little hand toward me.
plump.zh: 他向我伸出一只胖乎乎的小手。

plump.en: Maria was a pretty little thing, small and plump with a mass of curly hair.
plump.zh: 玛丽亚是个漂亮的小家伙， 小小的， 胖乎乎的，生着一头浓密的卷发。

plump.en: How plump, how beautiful she is!

plug away at.en: Set a timer ( use a kitchen timer, or use a countdown timer on your computer ), and plug away at your work.

plug away at.zh: 每天努力工作， 作为回报我们获得薪水。

pneumonia.zh: 年 11月， 佩恩患了严重的肺炎。

podium.zh: 如果他们颁发毅力金牌， 卡伦应该站在领奖台上。

plumage.zh: 许多雄鸟的鲜艳羽毛被认为是为吸引雌鸟而进化来的。

plumage.zh: 例如， 鸵鸟的羽毛构造使它的羽毛长而不密。

plumage.zh: 鸸鹋是一种大型的澳大利亚不会飞的鸟， 类似于鸵鸟， 但是有三趾的脚和灰色或棕色的羽毛。

poignantly.zh: 一个 12岁的女孩在她的日记中沉痛地指出，“只有 Tanya (女神？”)

poignantly.zh: 随后，祖博克痛心疾首地、细致地描述了这代俄国知识分子漫长而痛苦的衰落： 粗俗的赫鲁晓夫厌恶文化精英的自命不凡；

pointy-headed.zh: 目前还不清楚， 是否是我们圆圆的脑袋造就了今天这具有极高智商的人类。

pointy-headed.zh: 突然间，对监管 ( 在许多人士看来这是个令人生厌的话题，认为它是那些阻塞市场头上长角的官僚们的同义词 )的要求正从意想不到的地方传了出来。

pointy-headed.en: Still, no matter how many pointy-headed tests are dreamed up, there will always be pet owners who believe their dogs possess the magical ability to apprehend their larger place in the world.
pointy-headed.zh: 不管臆想出多少诡妙的实验， 仍然会有宠物主人相信他们的狗拥有神奇的能力可以领会世界上更多的东西。

pointed.zh: 之后我问你,你认为这辆火车,和之前看到的是同一辆吗。

polar opposite.zh: 游牧民的生活方式同集体化的生活方式刚好相反。

pole vault.zh: 当我开始撑竿跳时， 他们说。

pole vault.en: Bob Richards, the former pole-vault champion, shares a moving story about a skinny young boy who loved football with all his heart. Practice after practice, he eagerly gave everything he had.
pole vault.zh: 前撑杆跳冠军， 分享了一个感人的小故事， 这是一个关于十分瘦弱却很喜欢橄榄球的小男孩的故事。

pole vault.en: The night's track and field events had ended except for the women's pole vault, a sport that rarely gets top - billing.
pole vault.zh: 晚上举行的田径赛事除了女子撑杆跳高以外的其它项目都已经结束。

point of entry.en: Incident and change Management - Initial point-of - entry support for incidents and change control.
point of entry.zh: 突发事件及变更管理 ——提供应对突发事件及变更控制的初级支持。

point of entry.en: Introduce a new software technology incrementally with enough successes over time for the technology to gain traction from the point-of - entry outward into the rest of the organization.
point of entry.zh: 随着时间的推移，通过足够的成功递增引入一项新技术， 对于技术来讲，可以获得切入组织其余部分的牵引力。

point of entry.en: A typical composite service, providing a single point of entry to these claim - processing systems is presented in Figure 3.
point of entry.zh: 图 3 给出了一个典型的组合服务，用于为这些索赔处理系统提供单一的入口点。

polemicist.en: As a polemicist Mr Mamet is impressive — but at the cost of intellectual honesty.
polemicist.zh: 作为一个善辩者， 马梅先生令人影响深刻—— 但他牺牲了理智上的诚实。

polemicist.en: American observers from Walter Laqueur, an academic, to Mark Steyn, a conservative polemicist, argue that Europe is fast becoming a barren, ageing, enfeebled place.
polemicist.zh: 美国的观察者， 从学者 Walter Laqueur 到保守的善辩者Mark Steyn 认为欧洲在很快变成不育， 年迈， 衰弱的地方。

polio.en: He was crippled by polio as a child.
polio.zh: 他幼年患过小儿麻痹症，结果腿就瘸了。

polio.en: Polio was then endemic among children my age.
polio.zh: 小儿麻痹症在当时是在我这个年纪的儿童中常见的疾病。

polio.en: Gladys was crippled by polio at the age of 3.
polio.zh: 格拉迪丝3岁时因小儿麻痹症而瘸了。

polio.en: I want to spend some time on that until we talk about-- before we talk about development of the polio vaccine.
polio.zh: 我想多花些时间讨论这个问题,在我们讨论,在我们讨论脊髓灰质炎疫苗的发展之前

polio.en: If you just introduced this polio virus, which you could make in large quantities into people now, you would be causing polio.
polio.zh: 如果你直接接种脊髓灰质炎病毒,将大量的病毒直接接种到人体,就会引起小儿麻痹症

politic.en: It seemed politic to say nothing.
Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
politic.zh: 许多城镇经常发现改变拥戴对象不失为明智之举。

politic.en: They were a very politic race.
This is a recurring rhetoric, this notion that there is a cancer in the body politic.
politic.zh: 这是一种经常反复出现的修辞，这个国家的政治体系是有潜在的危险的。

pollyannish.en: She is not one of the Pollyannish " feel-good ", " let's make them all feel good " at all cost. Not at all.
pollyannish.zh: 她不是不切实际的感觉良好， 我们不惜一切代价让他们感觉良好， 根本不是。

pollyannish.en: These kids were optimistic, Not optimistic in the detached Pollyannish sense., optimistic in that they believe in things that would work out well.
pollyannish.zh: 这些孩子都很乐观， 不是那种不切实际的盲目乐观，而是乐观地相信， 事情会圆满地解决。

polymath.en: In this, one hopes that the great polymath was wrong.
polymath.zh: 在这点上，有人希望这个大师错了。

polymath.en: After discussion with the Polymath administrator, I have concluded that her method for picking winners is reasonably random.
polymath.zh: 在与 “博学者” 管理人讨论后， 我得出的结论是， 她挑选获奖者的方式基本能够保证结果的随机性。

polymath.en: FOR the past century mathematicians have struggled to prove the conjecture of a late-19th-century French polymath, Henri poincare.
polymath.zh: 世纪晚期的法国博学家亨利 ·庞加莱(Henri poincare)提出了一个猜想，结果数学家们为之奋斗了整整一个世纪。

polysemic.en: Semantic opacity in Japanese mainly results from the use of semantically vague, polysemic, and general lexis.
polysemic.zh: 日语中主要使用语义模糊词语、 多义词和语义概括(笼统) 词语等来表达不明确的语义。

polysemic.en: The application of categorical theory into cognitive study of polysemic paradigms is of considerable significance.
polysemic.zh: 运用范畴理论，把词的多义聚合现象纳入认知的研究领域是十分有意义的。

polysemic.en: Homonymous phenomena are a comparatively common occurrence in terminology and are considered to be polysemic phenomena.
polysemic.zh: 同音异义现象较为普遍地存在于在术语词汇中，而且常常被当作多义现象。

polygon.en: Next, the team built a table of the segments of the polygon.
polygon.zh: 接下来， 该团队构建了一个多边形片段表。

polygon.en: If the horizontal line drawn is aligned with a polygon vertex, then only the segments that are below the line are counted.
polygon.zh: 如果所绘制的水平线与一个多边形顶点对齐， 那么只计算位于该线下方的部分。

polygon.en: Although the bounding box is a polygon defining the area represented for the user, I simplify and use one point of this data.
polygon.zh: 尽管这个边界框是一个用于定义表示用户的区域的多边形，但我简化并使用该数据的一个点。

polytechnic.en: The Polytechnic is all adults and mostly preparation for exams like the Cambridge certificates.
polytechnic.zh: 理工学院的学生都是成年人， 而且大部分都在准备剑桥证书之类的考试。

polytechnic.en: He attended college at the Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, where he took part in a program with IBM and in 1963 he received a Bachelor of Science in electrical engineering.
polytechnic.zh: 他就读于伦斯勒理工学院， 在那里他参加了 IBM 的一个项目，1963年他获得了电子工程理学学士学位。

polytechnic.en: Yes, whereas with the Polytechnic position, I'd be stuck in the school all day.
polytechnic.zh: 是啊，可是如果是在理工学院任职， 我就得整天呆在学校里了。

pompous.en: The service was grand without being pompous.
It's not his fault he's so pompous —he was born that way.
pompous.zh: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

pompous.en: He was somewhat pompous and had a high opinion of his own capabilities.
pompous.zh: 他有些爱摆架子，并且高估自己的能力。

pompous.en: and it's much more relevant and less pompous than it used to be.
pompous.zh: 它与过去相比更亲民，不那么傲慢了。

pompous.en: We're told that Lane isn't exactly a Yale man, but he sure looks a lot like a Yale English major, dare I say, such an unpleasant character, and so, so pompous.
pompous.zh: 我们知道，Lane准确地说并不是一个耶鲁的学生，但他长得真的很像是耶鲁英语专业的学生，恕我直言，这样一个不讨人喜欢的角色，如此自大的。

pomegranate.en: The pomegranate flowers that blossom in the gardens of Tyre are redder than roses which are not so red.
pomegranate.zh: 在泰尔的花园里盛开的石榴花， 比没有那么红的玫瑰还红。

pomegranate.en: Mechanistic studies would help identify the active ingredients in the pomegranate and their direct mode of action.
pomegranate.zh: 机制研究将有助于确定石榴中的活性成分及其直接作用模式。

pomegranate.en: You may never know whether spending a fortune on pomegranate juice or the like is worth it.
pomegranate.zh: 你可能永远不知道花一大笔钱买石榴汁或类似的东西是否值得。

ponce.en: Ponce was not a man to wast time in any undertaking.
ponce.zh: 庞塞是位做任何事情都不耽搁时间的人。

ponce.en: Ponce was not a man to waste time in any undertaking.
ponce.zh: 帮塞是个不论办理什么事都不浪费时间的人。

ponce.en: Ponce was as heartless and unfeeling as any wild beast.
ponce.zh: 帮塞毫无心肝， 凶残犹如野兽。

pomposity.en: The prince's manner was informal, without a trace of pomposity.
pomposity.zh: 王子的态度平易谦和， 没有一点傲气。

pomposity.en: Einstein was a scientist who hated pomposity and disliked being called a genius.
pomposity.zh: 科学家爱因斯坦不喜欢摆架子，也不喜欢被称为天才。

pomposity.en: He has a deep voice and a thick accent, which people sometimes confuse with pomposity.
pomposity.zh: 他声音低沉， 而且有很重的口音。 这让人们有时候误以为这是傲慢。

pomposity.en: And I'm worried about e-mail! Talk about pricking my pomposity.
pomposity.zh: 用电子邮件不行吗，谈论一下对我自大的打击。

poncho.en: The poncho is made of nylon.
poncho.zh: 这雨披是用尼龙制造的。

poncho.en: One poncho will take up minimal space.
poncho.zh: 一个雨披将占用最小的空间。

poncho.en: If the weather looks iffy, you'll want to add rain gear: a poncho or nylon jacket.
poncho.zh: 如果天气状况难测， 你就会想加带雨具： 一件斗篷或尼龙夹克。

pontificate.en: Politicians like to pontificate about falling standards.
pontificate.zh: 政客喜欢自以为是地谈论不断下降的标准。

pontificate.en: Pope Formosus died after a pontificate of four and a half years.
pontificate.zh: 教皇福尔摩苏斯上任四年半后去世。

pontificate.en: The central meaning of his pontificate is to restore papal authority.
pontificate.zh: 他任职教皇的中心意图就是要恢复教皇权力。

pore.en: What happens depends on pore size.
pore.zh: 所发生的一切取决于孔隙大小。

pore.en: This pore space is known as porosity and is expressed as a percentage of the total rock volume.
pore.zh: 这个孔隙空间被称为孔隙度，用岩石总体积的百分比表示。

pore.en: This addition of a chemically precipitated substance into pore spaces is termed " permineralization ".
pore.zh: 这种化学沉淀物质进入孔隙的过程被称为“完全矿化”。

pore.en: Why isn't sight like touch, diffused through all parts of the body "that she might look at will through every pore?"
pore.zh: 为什么视力不能像触觉那样遍布人体各个部位,那样“她就能看到身体的每个毛孔“

pore.en: So obvious and so easy to be quench't And not as feeling through all parts diffus'd That she might look at will through every pore?
pore.zh: 如此显露，如此易受损伤,为什么不像触觉，分布在全身各部,可以通过每一根毛细管去自由观看？

pore.en: many of these ion channels have this size exclusion pore, it's a very important part of them.
pore.zh: 很多离子通道也都有这样的具有尺寸排斥性的小孔，这是它们非常重要的组成部分。

porcelain.en: There were lilies everywhere in tall white porcelain vases.
porcelain.zh: 到处都是插在白瓷高花瓶里的百合花。

porcelain.en: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
porcelain.zh: 属于这类物质的有云母、 瓷器、 石英、 玻璃、 木材等等。

porcelain.en: Her skin is porcelain with a smattering of freckles and she is slender, almost fashion-skinny.
porcelain.zh: 她的皮肤像瓷器那样，还带着一点雀斑。 她还很瘦，瘦得几乎像个模特。

pop in.en: The magazine has been celebrating pop in all its myriad forms.
pop in.zh: 该杂志一直在赞美各种形式的流行音乐。

pop in.en: He likes to pop in at times.
I am going to pop in next door.
Occasionally, you do run into pop pieces, folk songs, in minor, but most of them are in major - - probably about eighty percent in major.
pop in.zh: 大家偶然也会碰到小调的流行音乐和民歌,但大多数还是大调,大概百分之八十是大调

pop in.en: I don't know.The bass isn't as loud as in some of the pop music but I think it - - but I think that's what the tonic is.
pop in.zh: 我不知道，低音并不像有些流行音乐那样大声,但是我认为，这认为这就是主音应该的样子。

pop quiz.en: A book falls off the desk next to you. Suddenly, the teacher hands you a pop quiz.
pop quiz.zh: 一本书从你旁边的书桌上掉下来， 突然， 老师递给你一份突击测试。

pop quiz.en: Let's start off with a pop quiz: Who is the CEO of your career?
pop quiz.zh: 首先让我们来做一个很流行的测试： 谁是你所从事行业里的领袖人物？

pop quiz.en: Pop quiz: What country has the world's largest national debt per capita?
pop quiz.zh: 突击测验： 世界上哪个国家人均主权债务最高？

portal.en: The site acts as a portal for thousands of online dealers.
portal.zh: 该站点为数千名网络交易者的门户网站。

portal.en: This setting only works together with an enterprise portal.
portal.zh: 此设置仅与企业门户一起运作。

portal.en: Suddenly little Gerda stepped through the great portal into the palace.
portal.zh: 突然， 小小的格尔达走进了宫殿的大门。

portal.en: You need to take a pragmatic approach, because in the beginning, we saw the portal companies, well, feed us.
portal.zh: 采取切实有效的方法，因为一开始，可以找到门户网站。

portal.en: China, and any major portal company you can think of in China.
portal.zh: 以及其他主要的,门户网站公司。

portal.en: We didn't have a feasible business model, let's put it this way, because when we started, the business model is to provide the backend search technology to the portal companies in China.
portal.zh: 或者说没有一个，可行的商业模式，因为公司成立初期的商业模式，是给门户网站公司,提供后台搜索技术。

porthole.en: I peep out the porthole and see a sea of clouds.
porthole.zh: 我从飞机的舷窗向外张望， 看到一片云海。

porthole.en: And Bar Zilli, with its curved walls and porthole Windows.
porthole.zh: 而朱莉酒吧有着曲线的墙面和舷窗般的窗户。

porthole.en: " It's a bit like looking through a porthole in a submarine," said Schnitzer.
porthole.zh: 这有点像通过潜水艇的舷窗往里看，”施尼策尔说。

portentous.en: There was nothing portentous or solemn about him. He was bubbling with humour.
portentous.zh: 他身上一点也不装腔作势或故作严肃。 他幽默十足。

portentous.en: In social politics, too, the city's contribution to 20th century thought and culture was no less portentous.
portentous.zh: 从社会政治学上看， 该市对 20 世纪思想、 文化的贡献也同样意义重大。

portentous.en: There are flaws, of course ( and not just the portentous title ).
portentous.zh: 当然，小说中也有瑕疵 （还不只是那个怪异的书名）。

portico.en: And slept in the portico of the temple where you would gladly have sheltered me.
portico.zh: 虽然你们邀我留宿时，我却睡卧于圣殿的门廊。

portico.en: Splendid carriages would draw up under the portico, and visitors would be constantly coming and going.
portico.zh: 豪华马车会停到门廊下， 而且总是有客人来来往往。

portico.en: The first thing he did was create a proper entrance where a proper entrance should always have been: in the portico.
portico.zh: 他做的第一件事就是在恰当的位置修建了一个恰当的入口：就在柱廊下。

posse.en: The result was her own personal " cancer posse ": a rock concert tour manager, a model, a fashion magazine editor, a cartoonist and MTV celebrity, to name a few.
posse.zh: 结果她组成了自己的“癌症反击队”： 一名摇滚音乐会巡演经理、一名模特、一位时尚杂志编辑、一位漫画家和 MTV 名人等等。

posse.en: A posse of tough competitors is waiting for them.
posse.zh: 一批强有力的竞争者在等着他们。

posse.en: She formed a “ posse ” with other young women with cancer.
posse.zh: 她同患有癌症的妇女们成立了一个 “群社”。

posse.en: Because he wasn't a very good card player his posse took him for fairly sizable amounts of money.
posse.zh: 由于他不是个打牌高手,他的警卫队,把他看作等身的钞票

posse.en: And,so,but it's not--he has his entourage, he has his posse, he has his entourage.
posse.zh: 他有自己的随从,有自己的警卫队,他有自己的随从

post hoc.en: " I would hesitate to do post-hoc analysis," she says.
post hoc.zh: 我会犹豫要不要做因果分析，” 她说。

post hoc.en: Historically, the role of a Tester or QA has often been post-hoc, taking place after software has been created.
post hoc.zh: 过去的观点认为， 测试人员或质量保证人员的角色通常是在软件开发好以后才介入的， 因果颠倒。

post hoc.en: A trial might have 20 or more papers about it but most of them are post-hoc analyses, which are not included for what we do.
post hoc.zh: 一个试验可能写出20 页或更多的论文， 但绝大多数是事后分析， 这并不包括在我们的研究范围内。

pore over.en: Downstairs, visitors pore over planning applications, with staff on hand to help.
pore over.zh: 在楼下， 参观者可以仔细观看学员们规划应用程序，学员们遇到疑难问题， 有工作人员随时帮助他们解决。

pore over.en: He and his team of colleagues, including a German theoretical physicist, pore over vast quantities of data gleaned from soldiers spread across the country.
pore over.zh: 他和他的队伍， 包括一名德理论物理学家， 仔细钻研了传遍整个国家、 来自士兵们的大量情报。

pore over.en: In the meantime, if you're tempted to pore over your stock holdings every minute, do yourself a favor — don't.
pore over.zh: 在此期间， 如果你很想每分钟都窥探一下你持有的股票的话， 帮自己一个忙 ——不要这样做。

post-mortem.en: The post-mortem revealed traces of poison in his stomach.
post-mortem.zh: 验尸发现他胃中有微量毒物。

post-mortem.en: Meat inspection consists of ante -mortem inspection of slaughter animals and post-mortem inspection of slaughtered animals.
post-mortem.zh: 肉类检验包括屠宰前和屠宰后的检验。

post-mortem.en: So they did a post-mortem analysis of gene expression in the brains of smokers, alcoholics and those who had done both during their lives.
post-mortem.zh: 于是， 他们对吸烟者、 酗酒者和在生前既饮酒又抽烟的人做了尸体检验， 以研究他们的大脑所表达出来的基因。

poster child.en: Zidane has become the poster child for a whole generation of French - born youths of North African extraction.
poster child.zh: 齐达内已成为法国出生、 北非血统的一整代青年的榜样。

poster child.en: Ethiopia understandably yearns to shed its reputation as the world's poster child for famine.
poster child.zh: 不难理解， 埃塞俄比亚希望摆脱其世界饥饿海报儿童的名声。

poster child.en: They started pointing to Conley's case in lectures, and writing about him in their books. He became their poster child.
poster child.zh: 他们开始在演讲中提到康利案件，在书里写到他的事，康利成了他们的典型事例。

pot smoking.en: On smoking it decrees: " Always use a proper ashtray - - never a wine bottle, flower pot or used plate - - and avoid allowing smoke to billow out of the nostrils.
pot smoking.zh: 对于吸烟， 它说：“永远使用得体的烟灰缸 — 永远不要使用酒瓶、 花盆或者盘子 — 不要让烟从鼻孔中翻腾而出。

pot smoking.en: All day and paint, paint to deal with those, or around there like smoking, should at least put a pot in the workplace ferns.
pot smoking.zh: 成天与油漆、 涂料打交道者， 或者身边有喜好吸烟的人， 应该在工作场所放至少一盆蕨类植物。

pot smoking.en: The troubled pop star has reportedly accused Kevin Federline of smoking pot around the couple's sons - to counter claims she boozes in front of the kids.
pot smoking.zh: 据传这位陷入麻烦的明星控告凯文 · 费德林在他们孩子面前吸大麻，依次来反诉她在孩子面前醉酒的行为。

postlude.en: The benediction closes the service, and then, as the organ plays a postlude, everybody turns to greet his neighbors.
postlude.zh: 最后以祈祷祝福结束了礼拜， 在风琴弹奏中， 各人都转向邻座的人招呼问好。

posthumous.en: The comic novel, The Posthumous Papers of the Pickwick Club, appeared serially in 1836 and 1837, and was first published in book form in 1837.
posthumous.zh: 喜剧小说 《匹克威克外传》 在 1836年和 1837年连载发布， 并于 1837年首次以书的形式出版。

posthumous.en: " Keiun " comes from the posthumous name of the former owner.
posthumous.zh: 庆云”这个名字来源于前主人的谥号。

posthumous.en: All but one have been posthumous.
posthumous.zh: 除了一个以外的所有的都是死后追授的。

potato.en: On the menu is wiener schnitzel and potato salad.
potato.zh: 菜单上有维也纳炸小牛排和土豆沙拉。

potato.en: All main courses are served with chips or baked potato.

putrid.zh: 他们闻不到卡特里娜飓风过后覆盖新奥尔良第九区的腐烂泥土的味道。

putrid.en: At night, it was too cold to sleep.He said, "The water was putrid."
putrid.zh: 晚上因为太冷而难以入睡。

putrid.en: He said, “ The water was putrid. If you took a sip, you could taste it forhours.
putrid.zh: 他说：“喝的水散发着腐烂的气味， 就算你嘬一小口，也够你回味几个小时的。

putative.en: The overall result of this is the loss of a putative anaphase promoting complex gene.
putative.zh: 整体结果丢失了一个假定的后期促进复合基因。

putative.en: I've created a paradox, neat as can be — and simply by using your putative p.
putative.zh: 我迅速创建了一个悖论， 简单地使用了你所假定的 P 。

putative.en: Like all putative natural language processing by computer, your mileage may vary.
putative.zh: 但就像其他由计算机实现的自然语言一样， 实际的结果可能会有些不同。

putative.en: Now let's go and fill the molecular states for the putative He2.
putative.zh: 现在我们要填充分子状态,对于假定的He2来说。

pyre.zh: 整个世界变成了火葬的柴堆！

pyre.en: The glow of a funeral pyre slowly dies by the silent river.
pyre.zh: 火葬灰中的红光在沉静的河边慢慢地熄灭下去。

pyre.en: " They still hope when they die, that their son probably will come and light their pyre," she says.
pyre.zh: 她们还巴望着她们死的时候， 儿子可能会过来为她们， 然后为她们火葬，” 她说。

pyre.en: He was up on a pyre, and he was going to be burned when he remembered Solon, the Greek, who had come to him and warned him about the vain glory, and he said,oh Solon, oh Solon.
pyre.zh: 他在火葬柴堆上,在即将被烧死之时想到梭伦,这个希腊人曾警告过他,这只是虚荣而已,他感叹着,哎,梭伦,哎,梭伦

quadrangle.en: The court or quadrangle was stone-paved, and open to the sky.
quadrangle.zh: 四方的庭院是用石头铺成的，上面露天。

quadrangle.en: Our maths teacher told us a square is a special quadrangle.
quadrangle.zh: 数学老师告诉我们正方形是一个特殊的四边形。

quadrangle.en: Coming through the high driveway into the quadrangle a sense of abysmal futility always came over me.
quadrangle.zh: 从马路上一路走进四合院， 我总会产生一种深切的徒劳无功的感觉。

quaint.en: This quaint custom should be revived.
quaint.zh: 应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

quaint.en: It is a quaint and marvellous thought!
quaint.zh: 这是一个古怪而又奇妙的想法！

quaint.en: Lord, how marvellous a thing it is, the grip his memory doth take upon his quaint and crazy fancies!
quaint.zh: 主啊， 这是多么奇妙的一件事啊！ 他的记忆抓住了他那古怪而疯狂的幻想！

quaint.en: Hardy is full of all those quaint gothic, archaic dictions and fancies.
quaint.zh: 哈迪满是那样奇特有趣的哥特式想法，古代措辞和想象力。

quaint.en: Honor to so many of us sounds quaint, like an honor code or the Boy Scouts' code or something like that or something primitive, some kind of primitive ethic which we therefore don't really understand.
quaint.zh: 荣誉，对我们中大多数而言，听起来都会很奇怪，这就像是在说荣誉代码,童子军守则或一些类似的东西一样，亦或是一些非常原始的理论,以致于我们根本不知道这是在说什么。

quarry.en: The hunters lost sight of their quarry in the forest.
quarry.zh: 猎人在森林里跟丢了猎物。

quarry.en: We ended up in an abandoned quarry.
quarry.zh: 我们最后到了一个废弃的采石场。

quaver.en: There was a quaver in Lena's voice.
You could hear the quaver in her voice.
quaver.zh: 她的声音中能听出有些颤抖。

quaver.en: Full, can eat lunch quaver some novel vegetable, fish and lean.
quaver.zh: 午餐八分饱， 能够吃一些新颖蔬菜、 鱼类和瘦肉。

put on the brakes.en: She put on the brakes suddenly.
Teachers must put the brakes on, as it were, when they notice students looking puzzled.
put on the brakes.zh: 当老师发现学生神色茫然时， 就应该在一定程度上放慢速度。

put on the brakes.en: My uncle must put the brakes on my traveling plans.
put on the brakes.zh: 我叔叔必须中止我的旅行计划。

queer.en: His face was a queer pink colour.
If you ask me, there's something kind of queer going on.
queer.zh: 如果问起来的话， 是有点奇怪。

queer.en: You made me feel quite queer.
I think it's the queer community.

quasi.en: At the time, medicine was still a primitive quasi -science.
quasi.zh: 当时， 医学仍是原始的准科学。

quasi.en: The opposition has even been presented in quasi -political terms—of radical liberalism vs elitist conservatism.
quasi.zh: 对立甚至以类政治术语的形式出现了——即激进自由主义与精英保守主义之争。

quasi.en: Germany thinks the euro must be saved by stricter rules on borrowing, spending and competitiveness, backed by quasi -automatic sanctions for governments that do not obey.
quasi.zh: 德国认为， 必须通过在借贷、 支出和竞争力方面制定更严格的规则来拯救欧元，并对不遵守规则的政府实施准自动制裁。

quasi.en: There's something else called quasi -magical thinking, which was a term coined many years later by Eldar Shafir and Amos Tversky.
quasi.zh: 第七,准神奇式思考,这个术语是多年后,由埃尔德·沙菲尔和阿莫斯·特沃斯基提出的

quasi.en: After all,if the personality theory is right, since he does have all of these memories,or semi-memories, or quasi -memories,or whatever we should call them.
quasi.zh: 说到底，如果人格理论是正确的，既然他拥有所有这些记忆，或半记忆，或准记忆，诸如此类的名称。

quick-sighted.en: I do not mean to say that i am particularly observant or quick-sighted in general.
quick-sighted.zh: 我并不是说我在一般的事情上特别细心或是目光敏锐。

quick-sighted.en: But many are quick-sighted to pry into other people's ways, who are careless of their own.
quick-sighted.zh: 但许多快速短视窥探其他人的方式， 谁是自己的粗心大意。

quick-sighted.en: Children who play video games well must be quick with their hands and sharp -sighted.
quick-sighted.zh: 能熟练玩电子游戏的孩子必须眼疾手快。

quinceanera.en: When I went to practice Ballet Folklorico, Venadi and Nathareth, two sisters, handed me an invitation for Nathreth quinceanera party.
quinceanera.zh: 去练墨西哥舞的时候，维丹妮和纳萨勒姐妹俩递给我一张请帖，是纳萨勒的成年礼晚会。

quick-witted.en: She was quick-witted and had an extraordinarily agile mind.
quick-witted.zh: 她很机智并且有一个特别敏锐的头脑。

quick-witted.en: " Sharp " meant genuinely discerning, alert, acute rather than quick-witted or clever.
quick-witted.zh: 的意思是真正具有辨识力、 警觉、 敏锐， 而不是机敏或聪明。

quick-witted.en: Under these rules no politician, no matter how quick-witted, can win.
quick-witted.zh: 在这样的规则下， 无论多么机敏的政客都将落败。

quick.en: Come on! Quick! They'll see us!
quick.zh: 快点吧！ 快！ 他们会看见我们的！

quick.en: She gave him a quick glance.
Listen to how quickly Yeats modulates from one feeling, one image, to another in these really very short, quick, three-beat lines.
quick.zh: 听一听叶芝是怎么快速地,从一种情绪，一个情景中，转换到另一个里去的,就在这些三音韵的短诗句中。

quick.en: All right. Let's take 10 more seconds on that, this should be a quick identification for us to do.
quick.zh: 好，给你们１０秒钟，这对你们来说应该很快就能答上来了。

quintessential.en: Clad in leather chaps, a denim shirt and a white rancher's hat, he looks the quintessential cowpoke.
quintessential.zh: 他身穿皮套裤和一件斜纹粗布衬衫，头戴一顶农场主的白帽，显出一副典型的牛仔模样。

quintessential.en: He was the quintessential tough guy.
Everybody thinks of him as the quintessential New Yorker.
quintessential.zh: 每个人都认为他是个典型的纽约人。

quintessential.en: It's the quintessential sort of expression of individualism, but it's more than that.
quintessential.zh: 这是对个人主义典型的诠释,但是不止这些

quintessential.en: And so going to Gama-Go, I think, is one of the coolest like, quintessential San Francisco places to go check out.
quintessential.zh: 也是最具旧金山特色的地方之一，很值得一去。

quintessentially.en: It is a familiar, and quintessentially Japanese ritual.
quintessentially.zh: 它是个熟悉而又典型的日式仪式。

quintessentially.en: The ideal of harmony is quintessentially Confucian.
quintessentially.zh: 和谐的思想是孔夫子的精华。

quintessentially.en: Its heritage and brand are quintessentially English.
quintessentially.zh: 该集团的传统和品牌是典型的英国式。

quorum.en: Which nodes act as quorum nodes.
quorum.zh: 哪些节点是 quorum 节点。

quorum.en: Well, it looks like we have a quorum!
quorum.zh: 嗯， 看起来我们法定人数够了！

quorum.en: The tiebreaker disk on the quorum node.
quorum.zh: 节点上的 tiebreaker 磁盘。

race to the bottom.en: They fear that they will engage in a race to the bottom with rivals unencumbered by the fine feelings of shareholders and domestic customers, and so are bound to lose.
race to the bottom.zh: 他们担心自己将参加一场紧追不舍的比赛，而竞争对手却不受股东和国内消费者的细微感觉的羁绊， 因此他们注定会失败。

race to the bottom.en: That they could afford that race to the bottom may have something to do with the strange way India's mobile spectrum was auctioned off in 2008.
race to the bottom.zh: 他们能够进行价格竞争的原因可能与印度移动通讯频谱在 2008年以一种奇怪的方式被拍卖有关。

race to the bottom.en: If every state were equally generous with its incentives, it might inspire a race to the bottom.
race to the bottom.zh: 如果每个州都能给出同样慷慨的优惠， 那么这些州将会出现不顾底线的竞争。

quotidian.en: I had hopes of escaping my quotidian world.
quotidian.zh: 我曾希望能逃离自己的日常生活。

quotidian.en: PEOPLE remember emotionally charged events more easily than they recall the quotidian.
quotidian.zh: 和曰常发生的事情比起来， 人们往往会记住引起强烈情绪反应的事件。

quotidian.en: Since then, other researchers have come up with other quotidian examples of event horizons.
quotidian.zh: 而之后， 其他研究人员也提出了关于视界的其它司空见惯的种种例子。

quickening.en: Quickening his pace, he soon left all the other runners behind.
quickening.zh: 他加快速度， 不一会就把别的运动员都甩在后头了。

quickening.en: She can feel the child quickening at times.
quickening.zh: 她能感到胎儿有时在动。

quickening.en: And there are some real risks: higher blood pressure and a quickening of heartbeats.
quickening.zh: 但是也有一些切实的风险： 高血压， 心跳加速。

rack with.en: If you have only one sink, stack washed dishes in a dish rack and rinse them with a pan of hot water.
rack with.zh: 如果你只有一个水槽， 把洗过的盘子堆在碗碟架上， 然后用一锅热水冲洗。

rack with.en: You need a wok with a steaming rack for this; if you don't have one, improvise.
rack with.zh: 你需要一口带有蒸笼的锅， 如果没有就临时凑合一下。

rack with.en: Carefully set your plate on the rack, then cover with the lid.
rack with.zh: 把鱼盘小心的放在蒸架上， 盖上锅盖。

ragtag.en: The rebels are a ragtag force.
ragtag.zh: 利比亚反叛军是一群乌合之众组成的军事力量。

ragtag.en: It was a luxury the ragtag team obviously couldn't afford.
ragtag.zh: 显然， 这支乌合之军买不起。

ragtag.en: Which is where the ragtag army of “ business angels ” comes in.
ragtag.zh: 这是零零散散的 “商业天使”们的切入点。

ragamuffin.en: The giant looked contemptuously at the tailor, and said," You ragamuffin!"
ragamuffin.zh: 巨人轻蔑地看了看裁缝， 说：“你这个邋遢鬼！”

ragamuffin.en: At the Pearl Tower, one of Shanghai's most famous attractions, a sign forbids " ragamuffin, drunken people and psychotic " from entering.
ragamuffin.zh: 在上海最著名的景观之一——东方明珠电视塔，其入口处有着一块标牌写着：“禁止衣衫不整者、 酗酒者及精神病患者入内。”

raffle.en: The draw for the raffle takes place on Saturday.
I asked her what cause the raffle supported.
raffle.zh: 我向她询问彩票所支持的是什么事业。

raffle.en: Not every device would have a photo of course, so getting one would be like winning a raffle.
raffle.zh: 当然， 不是每个设备都有一张照片， 所以得到一个就像是中了彩。

ramble on and on.en: Sorry if I seem to ramble on and on about my daily life.
ramble on and on.zh: 很抱歉， 如果我似乎漫步在和我的日常生活。

ramble on and on.en: A lot of people tend to ramble when they're nervous and that can make this meeting feel like it's dragging on and on.
ramble on and on.zh: 许多人紧张时往往变得絮叨，这会有拖延面试的感觉。

rally around.en: I think the founders, the employees, and the investors need to rally around just one powerful idea at the very beginning.
rally around.zh: 我认为，无论是公司创始人、 员工还是投资者，都要在创始阶段围绕某一个强有力的理念众志成城、共同努力。

rally around.en: So what you're seeing there are people trying this, seeing if it works, seeing if other people rally around it.
rally around.zh: 由此， 你所看到的是人们如何尝试某种标准， 了解它是否有效，了解其他人是否热衷于该标准。

rally around.en: But they are nationalists whose instinct in the face of external attack will surely be to rally around their leaders, no matter how flawed.
rally around.zh: 但是他们是民族主义者， 面对外来的进攻，他们会本能地聚集在他们领导者的周围， 不管这个领导有多少缺点。

ramadan.en: But to traditional scholars, Mr Ramadan is clearly going too far.
ramadan.zh: 但对于传统学者来说， 拉马丹走得太远了。

ramadan.en: It was Ramadan, and he had to prepare Sehur, the last meal before sunrise.
ramadan.zh: 那天是月斋， 他得准备好“舒尔”，即日出前的最后一顿饭。

ramadan.en: A Palestinian boy plays with fireworks to celebrate the holy month of Ramadan, in Gaza City
ramadan.zh: 加沙市， 一名巴勒斯坦男孩玩焰火庆祝斋的圣月。

ramadan.en: In terms of myself individually I can honestly say on the month of Ramadan, it's an experience on an individual level, it's very beneficial.
ramadan.zh: 对于我自己，老实说,赖买丹月是一次,非常个人的经历，也非常的有益。

ramadan.en: I remember with a Muslim friend of mine, we were comparing Lent to Ramadan.
ramadan.zh: 我记得有一次和一个穆斯林朋友，讨论基督教的大斋期和伊斯兰教的赖买丹月。

rambling.en: What is she rambling on about now?
rambling.zh: 她现在又在东拉西扯些什么呀？

rambling.en: We spent the summer rambling in Ireland.
rambling.zh: 我们花了一个夏天漫游爱尔兰。

rambling.en: Prune rambling roses when the flowers have faded.
rambling.zh: 花儿已经凋谢了的时候， 修剪那些凌乱的蔷薇。

rake through.en: SCHEMA_INFO was created through the rake db: migrate command. Querying the SCHEMA_INFO table shows the following output.
rake through.zh: 是通过 rake db ： migrate 命令创建的。

rake through.en: Principles of reasonable values and reference data of saw tooth's rake, relief, wedge angles and radius of bottom arc can be determined through finite element method of calculation and optimum design.
rake through.zh: 通过有限单元法计算和优化设计， 确定锯片齿形前角、后角、 楔角及槽底圆弧半径合理值的原则及其参考值。

rake through.en: Heating steam shall be introduced into the water stored in the feed water tank through a rake of sparger steam pipes below the minimum water level.
rake through.zh: 加热蒸汽应通过最低水位下的喷洒器蒸汽管耙导入给水箱内储存的水里。

ramification.en: The bank has ramification throughout the world.
ramification.zh: 这家银行的分支机构遍布世界。

ramification.en: Exterior activator is ramification of emulsifying agent, dust - proofing agent, hydrous lanolin.
ramification.zh: 表面活性剂是乳化剂、 防尘剂、 含水羊毛脂衍生物。

ramification.en: This is potentially an increasing problem, and we have to be aware of this ramification of our cytologic diagnosis.
ramification.zh: 这是一个潜在上升中的问题， 我们必须了解这一细胞学诊断上的分岐。

rancorous.en: The deal ended after a series of rancorous disputes.
rancorous.zh: 经过一连串充满敌意的争吵，该交易泡汤了。

rancorous.en: His speech was a bilious, rancorous attack on young people.
rancorous.zh: 他的演讲是对年轻人的一次充满怒气与怨恨的抨击。

rancorous.en: As with marriage, ideally such partings are not rancorous;
rancorous.zh: 与婚姻一样， 理想的分手是无怨无恨。

ramp up.en: Instead, most companies have no choice but to ramp-up marketing expenditures.
ramp up.zh: 相反， 绝大多数公司别无选择，只能不断加大营销方面的投入。

ramp up.en: This setting helps the server ramp up smoothly, without having connection timeouts during the ramp-up phase.
ramp up.zh: 该设置帮助服务器顺利地完成自举， 在自举阶段不存在连接超时。

ramp up.en: This was in line with our expectations, since we'd fully intended to ramp up slowly.
ramp up.zh: 这是在我们的预料之中的， 因为我们有意的让进度稍微慢一点。

rangy.en: A rangy middleweight, he fought in Cameroon and Senegal.
rangy.zh: 他四肢较长，是一个中量级拳击手， 在喀麦隆与塞内加尔打过拳击。

rangy.en: Manu Brabo, a rangy Spanish photographer, also had a ready grin.
rangy.zh: 消瘦的西班牙摄影师 Manu Brabo同样也随时对人面露笑容。

rangy.en: The architect is Rick Mather, an experienced American Londoner for whom the term " rangy " might have been coined.
rangy.zh: 设计者里奇·马瑟是一位来自美国的伦敦人，“瘦削”一词就像是为他度身定造的。

rampart.en: Rampart certainly has a lot of room for improvement.
rampart.zh: 肯定还有很多改进的空间。

rampart.en: Rampart and Rahas modules: Provide WS-SX ( security-related specifications ) support.
rampart.zh: 和 Rahas 模块： 提供 WS - SX ( 安全相关规范 ) 支持。

rampart.en: The policy document containing the Rampart configuration is shown in Listing 3.
rampart.zh: 清单 3 展示了包含有 Rampart 配置的策略文档。

ransack.en: Not lost, for I will ransack the land till I find thee again.
ransack.zh: 不要迷路， 因为我要彻底搜查这片土地， 直到找到你为止。

ransack.en: He began to ransack his mother's workbox for a piece of thread.
ransack.zh: 他要找一根线， 开始翻腾妈妈的针线盒。

ransack.en: Some also fear that he will ransack Volvo's intellectual property to boost Geely's less sophisticated cars.
ransack.zh: 还有一些担心他会侵占沃尔沃的知识产权以提高吉利相对落后的车。

rant and rave.en: Over time I found that he started turning to me.He knew I wouldn't rant and rave at him, nor kiss up.Instead, I would offer candid, helpful advice.
rant and rave.zh: 经过一段时间， 我发现他开始主动向我征询意见，因为他知道我不会冲他夸夸其谈，大喊大叫，或是溜须拍马，而是会提出真诚而有用的建议。

rant and rave.en: You can learn a great deal more if you listen rather than rant and rave.
rant and rave.zh: 若能试着聆听而不是大叫大嚷的话， 你就能学到更多。

rant and rave.en: There is nothing wrong with this, it is only when you lose control of your feelings and begin to rant and rave unnecessarily about something very trivial that it is seen as a problem.
rant and rave.zh: 一般的愤怒不会有什么事， 但是如果你在鸡毛蒜皮是事上情绪失控而大吵大闹，那么此时的愤怒就是个问题了。

rare steak.en: I specifically asked for this steak rare.
rare steak.zh: 我明确要求了要把这份牛排做成半熟的。

rare steak.en: Suddenly Lisa threw herself to the boa, opening her mouth and bit into the boa's back as if trying to eat a rare steak.
rare steak.zh: 丽莎突然扑向蟒蛇， 张开嘴， 咬着它的背部， 好像要吃一块半生不熟的牛排。

rare steak.en: then please bring me the steak medium rare.Thank you.
rare steak.zh: 给我来一份三分熟的牛排， 谢谢。

rap session.en: John and I had a two - hour rap session yesterday.
rap session.zh: 昨天我和约翰畅谈了两个小时。

rap session.en: On March 23, 2007, the regional rap session of Entertainment Technology of Guangdong Province was held in Guangzhou.
rap session.zh: 年 3月 23日，“《演艺设备与科技》 广东地区座谈会” 在广州举行。

rapt.en: She listened to the speaker with rapt attention.

ratchet up.en: He fears inflation will ratchet up as the year ends.
ratchet up.zh: 他担心通胀会随着年底临近而只升不降。

readily.en: The components are readily available in hardware stores.

raw sewage.en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.
raw sewage.zh: 向大海里倾倒污水既不卫生也不安全。

raw sewage.en: The sea is coated with a film of raw sewage.
raw sewage.zh: 海上覆盖着薄薄一层未经处理的污水。

raw sewage.en: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea.
raw sewage.zh: 仅用水泵将未经处理的污水排入海中是不够的。

ravine.en: The bus overturned and fell into a ravine.
ravine.zh: 这辆公共汽车翻了车， 掉进了一处深谷。

ravine.en: A ravine delimited the property on the south.
ravine.zh: 一条沟作为南边那块地产的边界。

ravine.en: They watch five people hike along a track bordered by a ravine.
ravine.zh: 他们看到五个人在一个被峡谷包围的地方徒步沿着铁轨行走。

razzle-dazzle.en: He lost the election because the voters didn't care for his razzle-dazzle style of campaigning.
razzle-dazzle.zh: 他没有当选， 因为选民不喜欢他那种“乱阵进攻的竞选作风。”

razzle-dazzle.en: He returned to Broadway almost three decades later, filling in as the razzle-dazzle lawyer Billy Flynn in " Chicago " in 2003.
razzle-dazzle.zh: 近 30 年后他重返百老汇， 在 2003年的《芝加哥》 中扮演了绝无人性的律师 Billy Flynn 。

razzle-dazzle.en: Even though the Champions League final is a monument to the riches and razzle-dazzle of modern football, there were some eternal truths on show in the eternal City.
razzle-dazzle.zh: 即使冠军联赛决赛体现了现代足球的财富和浮华，人们还是在罗马这座永恒之城看到一些永恒的真理。

reactionary.en: Critics viewed him as a reactionary, even a monarchist.
reactionary.zh: 批评者们把他看成是反动分子， 甚至是君主主义者。

reactionary.zh: 反动警察打垮并逮捕了许多激进学生。

reactionary.zh: 反动派警察破门而入， 逮捕了许多激进学生。

reactionary.en: There's a kind of, well, masculinism in Yeats, and it's part of what I meant last time when I spoke of Yeats's anti-modernism or his reactionary modernism.
reactionary.zh: 叶芝有点大男子主义，我上次提到叶芝反对,现代主义是就在指这点。

reactionary.en: Is this guy a revolutionary or is he a reactionary?
reactionary.zh: 此人到底是革命派还是保守派？

reassuring.en: It was reassuring to hear John's familiar voice.
reassuring.zh: 听到约翰熟悉的声音令人感到安慰。

reassuring.en: I liked her way of reassuring you with a squeeze of the hand.
reassuring.zh: 我喜欢她捏捏手来安慰人的方式。

reassuring.en: It's reassuring (to know) that we've got the money if necessary.
reassuring.zh: 我们有了应急的钱， 这就不必担心了。

reassuring.en: I find that strangely reassuring and troubling at the same time because I think we like to think how special we are.
reassuring.zh: 我认为这种说法特别令人放心,同时也令人苦恼,因为我们总想着自己多么特别。

reassuring.en: The dead are raising their objections here to guns that will be used very shortly in the Great War. God reassures them, though, of course, what he says here is not reassuring.
reassuring.zh: 死者在这里提出了他们对枪声的反对,那不久就会被用于世界大战中，上帝让他们放心，当然尽管他在此所说的并不是宽慰之言。

realtor.en: So I went to a realtor. And I liked this area, the shopping street.
realtor.zh: 很喜欢这个地区， 这一条商店街， 于是去找地产经纪。

realtor.zh: 我问房产经纪人：“你认为会有人买这幢破房子吗？”

realtor.zh: 于是我们一起前往房地产经纪的店铺，把这公寓租下来。

rebuttal.zh: 这些指控受到了坚决的驳斥。

rebuttal.zh: 他正在对前同事的指责逐条加以驳斥。

The rate of recidivism is not known.

recessive.en: Sickle-cell anaemia is passed on through a recessive gene.
recessive.zh: 镰状细胞贫血通过隐性基因遗传给后代。

recessive.zh: 大多数明显的创始人突变都是隐性的，可以解释这种明显的异常现象： 只有双亲都拥有受影响基因副本的人才会生病。

recessive.en: The subspecies Acinonyx jubatus guttatus may also have been a variation due to a recessive gene.
recessive.zh: 亚种猎豹也可能是一种隐性基因变异。

recessive.en: New genes emerge as dominant, no longer recessive or latent, and organisms change.
recessive.zh: 新的基因出现并支配，不在隐性潜伏，然后生物就突变了。

recliner.en: I sat in my father's chair, a mustard-coloured recliner.
recliner.zh: 我坐在父亲的椅子上， 一把褐黄色的躺椅。

recliner.zh: 我的父亲就在这个房间里， 坐在他的躺椅里 —— 他一直都在这里。

recliner.en: But on Sunday afternoons, Dad would sit back in his recliner and ask me to play for him.
recliner.zh: 但在星期天下午， 父亲会靠在他的躺椅上， 让我为他演奏。

rector.zh: 在 《人人都是大管家》一书中，葡萄酒商兼作者赛勒斯·雷丁写道：“干红葡萄酒配主教， 波特酒配牧师， 醋栗酒配助理牧师，杜松子酒配职员”。

rector.en: Rector and others argued that once "the habit of dependency is cracked," then the country can make other policy changes aimed at improving living standards.
rector.zh: 雷克特和其他一些人认为， 一旦 “依赖的习惯被打破”， 那么国家就可以做出其他旨在提高生活水平的政策改变。

referendum.en: The groundswell of opinion is in favour of a referendum.

red herring.zh: 当史密斯医生离开时， 他说该调查是转移注意力的事情。

regimen.zh: 很少有人能坚持这么苛刻的养生法， 尤其是坚持这么多年。

regimen.zh: 她刚刚开始采用诸多广为人知的减肥食谱的第一项： 全流食养生法， 这让她脾气暴躁。

regimen.zh: 不管制订的是什么样的养生计划，都要严格遵守。

scapula.zh: 为了增加肩关节的运动范围， 就必须先要治疗肩胛骨。

scapula.en: Scapula retraction is a fancy way of saying to squeeze your shoulder blades together.
scapula.zh: 肩胛骨往回收也就是说将你的肩胛往后挤到一起。

scarecrow.en: Michael Jackson sported the Scarecrow outfit in The Wiz.
scarecrow.zh: 迈克尔· 杰克逊在 《新绿野仙踪》中穿着稻草人服装。

scarecrow.en: The Tin Woodman built a truck and pulled the Lion with the Scarecrow.
scarecrow.zh: 铁皮人造了一辆卡车， 拉着稻草人和狮子。

scarecrow.en: Luckily, the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman were not troubled by the smell.
scarecrow.zh: 幸运的是， 稻草人和铁皮人并不为这气味所困扰。

scatterbrained.en: The handwriting of this scatterbrained fellow was totally illegible.
scatterbrained.zh: 这个没头脑的家伙写的字简直无法辨认。

scatterbrained.en: From what I have heard from other faculty, he's really scatterbrained.
scatterbrained.zh: 我从其他老师那里听说了， 他真的是粗心大意。

scatterbrained.en: In a business meeting, men view a woman thinking aloud as being scatterbrained, undisciplined or unintelligent.
scatterbrained.zh: 在商业会议上， 男人会觉得出声思考的女人没有逻辑，没有组织性， 或者很愚蠢。

scavenge.en: Some fish scavenge on dead fish in the wild.
scavenge.zh: 在大自然中， 有的鱼以死鱼为食。

scavenge.en: No squirrels are known to hunt vertebrates, or even scavenge meat.
scavenge.zh: 没有发现有松鼠猎取脊椎动物， 或者以肉为食。

scavenge.en: Serial uses a single GC thread, whilst ParNew and Parallel Scavenge both use multiple threads.
scavenge.zh: 连续式使用了一个单独的 GC 线程， 而同新式与并行扫描式都使用了多线程。

scepter.en: Later, the Cullinan I was placed in the monarch's scepter.
scepter.zh: 卡利南一号后来镶嵌在了英王权杖上。

scepter.zh: 女皇拥有一个能指挥里斯美尔金龙的权杖。

scepter.en: Elsa manages to set the orb and scepter back down on the pillow before anyone notices the ice.
scepter.zh: 安娜设法在别人注意到冰块之前把宝球和权杖放回垫子上。

scheming.en: A combination of public policy decisions and corporate scheming saw to it that countless convenient and efficient urban streetcar and intra-city rail systems were dismantled.
scheming.zh: 公共政策决定和企业策划相结合，而这导致了无数便捷高效的城市有轨电车和城市内部的铁路系统被拆除。

scheming.en: Her enemies were scheming her downfall.
scheming.zh: 她的敌人正密谋把她搞垮。

scheming.en: She seemed to feel that we were all scheming against her.
scheming.zh: 她似乎觉得我们都在算计她。

schizoid.en: With calm, dreamy, almost schizoid logic, she explains that her appearance will be important.
schizoid.zh: 她以镇定、 迷惘、 近乎自相矛盾的逻辑说明她的仪表将是很重要的。

schizoid.en: A notice on his door offered " Psychoanalysis for your typewriter, whether it's frustrated, inhibited, schizoid, or what have you," and he was as good as his word.
schizoid.zh: 泰特尔的门上贴有一则通知 “为阁下的打字机进行心理分析，分析他是否沮丧、抑郁亦或精神分裂”。这可不是吹牛。

scintillating.en: You can hardly expect scintillating conversation from a kid that age.
scintillating.zh: 你几乎很难想象那么小年纪的孩子会说出妙趣横生的话来。

scintillating.en: Statistics on unemployment levels hardly make for scintillating reading.
scintillating.zh: 失业统计数据读来不大会有趣味。

scintillating.en: It will be a truly scintillating occasion.
scintillating.zh: 那将是一个真正闪亮着光芒的情景。

schoolmarm.en: Naturally, Wasik is worried about coming off like a scolding schoolmarm, especially because his cure for our Internet-fired ADD is a bit obvious: Slow down and consider the long view.
schoolmarm.zh: 自然， 韦斯基担心留下指手画脚的老古板印象， 特别是他在关于网络引发的注意力缺失紊乱治疗中说教意味有些明显：放慢速度，着眼长远。

schizophrenic.en: He was diagnosed as a paranoid schizophrenic.
schizophrenic.zh: 他被诊断为偏执性精神分裂症患者。

schizophrenic.en: Serum homovanillic acid ( HVA ), FSH, LH and testosterone ( TS ) were examined in healthy first degree relatives of schizophrenic patients.
schizophrenic.zh: 应用高压液相和放免分析法测定精神分裂症病人一级健康亲属的血清高香草酸 （HVA）、 FSH 、 LH 和睾酮 （TS）浓度。

schizophrenic.en: Thus it is that many people have a somewhat schizophrenic attitude towards climate change.
schizophrenic.zh: 这也就是为什么很多人一提到气候变化就发狂的原因。

schizophrenic.en: There is a blunting in this activation, and this blunting is correlated with this schizophrenic self-reported lack of desire negative symptorms.
schizophrenic.zh: 这部分的活动被关闭了，而这种关闭活动的结果和精神分裂症患者,缺少欲望症状的报告相符。

sclerosis.en: The parameters of glomerulus sclerosis rate and the number of peritubular capillary were different between LBL and SLBL groups.
sclerosis.zh: 组和 SLBL 组的肾小球硬化率参数和肾小管周围毛细血管数目不同。
她得了 MS ( 多发性硬化症)。

sclerosis.en: Aaron McKenzie's grandmother has multiple sclerosis.
sclerosis.zh: 亚伦· 麦肯齐( Aaron McKenzie)的祖母有多发性硬化症。

scooter.en: A half-way house for many people is a scooter or motorbike.
scooter.zh: 小型摩托车或者摩托车是许多人的折中之选。

scooter.en: The rising popularity of the craft has raised the question of water scooter regulation.
scooter.zh: 随着水上摩托车越来越受欢迎，人们开始质疑水上摩托车的监管问题。

scooter.en: Water scooter operators have been killed or seriously injured in collisions with other watercraft.
scooter.zh: 水上摩托车操作员在与其他水上交通工具的碰撞中死亡或严重受伤。

scone.en: They have a scone -like consistency and as well as a popular breakfast item, they ’re also used to bulk up goulash meals.
scone.zh: 类似于烤饼并作为普遍的早餐项目， 它们也被用于扩充菜炖牛肉餐。

scone.en: They have a scone -like consistency and as well as a popular breakfast item, they're also used to bulk up goulash meals.
scone.zh: 类似于烤饼并作为普遍的早餐项目， 它们也被用于扩充菜炖牛肉餐。

scone.en: That has to be the traditional cream tea - a giant home-made scone, caked with clotted cream and jam, and all washed down with a good cuppa.
scone.zh: 那得是传统的奶油茶点了— 一种很大的自做的烤饼，上面有厚厚一层浓缩奶油和果酱，和一杯好茶一并入肚。

schizophrenia.en: Schizophrenia is not a " split mind " as is popularly believed.
schizophrenia.zh: 精神分裂症并不是普遍认为的“分裂了的精神”。

schizophrenia.en: Susan had a mental breakdown and was diagnosed with schizophrenia.
schizophrenia.zh: 苏珊精神崩溃， 被诊断为精神分裂。

schizophrenia.en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
schizophrenia.zh: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

schizophrenia.en: A psychology that will look at also things that work, that were not just study-- depression, anxiety, schizophrenia and neurosis.
schizophrenia.zh: 需要着眼于有用的东西，不仅仅是研究-,抑郁，焦虑，精神分裂，神经症。

schizophrenia.en: I feel bad saying that. But his schizophrenia has been under control.
schizophrenia.zh: 谈起这些我真的很同情他。不过他的精神分裂症已经得到控制。

scour.en: He decided to scour the sink.
scour.zh: 他决定把水池擦洗干净。

scour.en: I had to scour out the pans.
Please scour rust spots from the knife.

scowl.zh: 克里斯听到这句话面带怒容。

scowl.en: The psychologist alone can ask such questions: Why do we smile when pleased and not scowl?
scowl.zh: 只有心理学家才会问这样的问题： 为什么我们高兴时微笑， 而不是怒容满面？

scowl.en: He carefully observed the shrug of one man's shoulders, the position of another's hands, the scowl on one face and the frown on another.
scowl.zh: 他仔细观察一个男人的耸肩、 另一个人手的位置、一个人脸上的怒容和另一个人的皱眉。

scowl.en: So, he writes: To the psychologist alone can such questions occur as: Why do we smile when pleased and not scowl?
scowl.zh: 他这样写到：,对哲学家本身说,会出现这些问题：,为什么开心时我们微笑而非皱眉？

scrawny.en: When the Europeans arrived, Rapa Nui was grassland, with only a few scrawny trees.
scrawny.zh: 当欧洲人到达时，拉帕努伊还是一片草原， 只有几棵瘦骨嶙峋的树。

scrawny.en: And another construction worker is small and scrawny.
scrawny.zh: 另外一位建筑工人又小又瘦。

scrawny.en: It seems to mean something like " scrawny."

score.en: I'll text you the final score.
score.zh: 我会发短信告诉你最终的比分。
这是我得到过的最好分数。

score.en: Suppose there is an epiphany at 11:54 and you get a perfect score on that question 25% and it is worth 25% of the paper.
score.zh: 假设在11：54的时候灵感来了4,你在那个问题上有一个完美的分数,占试卷的。

score.en: I guess you got a higher score, as you are a Brown student. How did you prepare for the test?
score.zh: 能被布朗大学录取，我猜你的分数一定很高。你是如何准备考试的呢？

scrambled eggs.en: I like proper coffee, scrambled eggs and crispy bacon.
scrambled eggs.zh: 我喜欢正统咖啡、 炒蛋和煎培根。

scrambled eggs.en: Egg products can be used in baking or cooking, for example, scrambled eggs.
scrambled eggs.zh: 蛋制品能够用于焙烤和烹饪， 比如炒蛋。

scrambled eggs.en: We can put the scrambled egg to a dish and add the rest of the chopped green onions over the top of the scrambled eggs.
scrambled eggs.zh: 我们可以把炒蛋放到一个盘子里， 把剩下的碎葱花放在炒蛋上。

scramble.en: There was an undignified scramble for the best seats.
scramble.zh: 大家争抢最好的位子，真是有失体统。

scramble.en: More than three million fans are expected to scramble for tickets.
scramble.zh: 预计会有三百万以上的歌迷抢购门票。

scramble.en: She managed to scramble out of the vehicle as it burst into flames.
scramble.zh: 她设法从突然起火的车里爬了出来。

scramble.en: If you have some plain text, some message that you want to send, well, you can encrypt it or you can scramble it using a key, a secret key, which might be a physical machine like the Enigma 13 or it might be a number like 13.
scramble.zh: 如果你有没有加密的文本，你想要寄送的一些消息,你就可以加密它,或者你可以用一个密钥使其变得混乱，那就像一个英格玛的物理装置,或者他就是一个数字。

scramble.en: If you just scramble a sentence, it's pretty useless because the recipients are never going to be able to reverse the process.
scramble.zh: 如果你只是加密一个句子，这是毫无用处的,因为收件人没法将这个句子,反加密出来。

scribblings.en: One can also search his scribblings by subject.
scribblings.zh: 人们同样可以按主题搜索他的草书评语。

scribblings.en: Wipe off these scribblings from the blackboard.
The book would also be cleared of scribblings, notes or folds.
scribblings.zh: 书本是绝对没有图鸦、 笔记或绉折的。

scrooge.en: One Christmas Eve, Scrooge sees the ghost of Jacob Marley, his dead business partner.
scrooge.zh: 一个圣诞夜， 斯克鲁奇看到了他死去的商业伙伴雅各布 · 马利的鬼魂。
他是个不折不扣的守财奴。

scrooge.en: What Scrooge actually says is, “ Are there no prisons?”
scrooge.zh: 克鲁奇实际上说的是，“难道没有监狱吗？”

scrumptious.en: San Sebastian is a coastal town that the best thing to do is to lay on the beach and wait for the next scrumptious meal.
scrumptious.zh: 圣塞巴斯蒂安是一个海滨城镇， 在这里你最好做的事情是， 躺在沙滩上， 等待下一顿美味的大餐。

scrumptious.en: DEEP-FRIED beer may sound scrumptious, but is it patentable?
scrumptious.zh: 炸啤酒听起来美味， 但它能申请专利吗？

scrumptious.en: Add a berry sweet touch to your Easter gathering with this scrumptious cake.
scrumptious.zh: 这种美味的蛋糕能给你的复活节聚会加上一点浆果的甜美味道。

scrimmage.en: Bloom scored two touchdowns Saturday in a scrimmage.
scrimmage.zh: 布卢姆在周六的一场混战中两次达阵得分。

scrimmage.zh: 熊队在争球线积聚了额外的防守队员来阻挡进跑。

scrimmage.en: One of the players on the line of scrimmage.
scrimmage.zh: 在争球线上控球的队员的位置。

scrunch up.en: To relax, I scrunch up my shoulders to my ears and then slowly let them fall down.
scrunch up.zh: 为了达到彻底的放松， 我把耸到与耳朵大致相平的位置， 然后慢慢的把肩膀松弛下来。

scrunch up.en: Never scrunch up or grip the floor with your toes in any of the standing poses.
scrunch up.zh: 在任何站姿体式里都不要用脚蜷缩或者紧抠地板。

scrunch up.zh: 她把它揉成一团， 扔进了垃圾箱。

scuffle.zh: 他和一名摄影记者发生了肢体冲撞。

scuffle.zh: 它们太忙了， 只能草草了事。

scuffle.zh: 好吧，我承认是在扭打之后。 起初，我试图阻止她。

scurry about.en: Millions of terrified beings scurry about through senseless mazes of tunnels and lanes.
scurry about.zh: 数百万惊恐万状的生物在毫无意义的迷宫般的隧道和小巷里跑来跑去。

scurry about.zh: 千百万惶恐的生灵在莫名的隧道迷宫和小巷中蹿行。

scurry about.en: Instead of going home to grade homework or writing up a test, you just sit back and watch the students as they scurry about trying to finish their projects.
scurry about.zh: 这是真的， 回家不用改作业， 也用不着为写考试题头痛。 你可以坐下来，舒舒服服地靠在那里， 看着你的学生们像没头苍蝇似的忙忙碌碌，赶在 “课题研究”的期限前完成任务。

scruple.en: They wriggled uncomfortably, for they knew he would not scruple [hesitate] to ram them down with poles.
scruple.zh: 他们不安地扭动着身子， 因为他们知道他会毫不犹豫地用棍子把他们打下去。

scruple.en: He did not scruple to use it.
scruple.zh: 他满不在乎地打算用这笔钱。

scruple.zh: 当党的利益需要维护时，几乎是毫不顾忌后果的。

scruple.zh: 那么我们就来看一下这条脚注：,在诗产生后，语言的意思也就跟着产生了,这种意思如果和原始的形式不同,就不该有对作者意图的顾虑。
完全没有一点道德顾虑。

scrub.en: I started to scrub off the dirt.

scrub.zh: 我把地板彻底擦洗了一遍。

scrub.zh: 我会把你的脑子刮得一干二净,这样你就不会记得你是Shelly，Kagan了。

scurvy.en: Not eating enough of vitamins can result in problems such as scurvy, dermatitis or dry, scaly skin.
scurvy.zh: 维生素摄入不足能导致坏血病、 皮炎或干燥、 鳞状皮肤之类的问题。

scurvy.zh: 如果你只吃肉， 可能会像海盗一样得坏血病（译者注：海盗易患坏血病）。

scurvy.zh: 如果担心坏血病也可以添加一些切碎的香菜。

sea change.zh: 这是职业定义的巨大变化。

seal the deal.en: While he cautions there's more to an encounter than the temperature of the refreshments served, a hot drink might seal the deal.
seal the deal.zh: 他还提醒道， 对偶然遇到的人来讲，我们送上来的茶点的温度意味着更多， 一杯热饮可能就能搞定所谈的事情。

seal the deal.en: Kinship ties foster trust, so they can seal the deal and get the umbrellas to Jakarta before the rainy season ends.

searching.en: Fifty officers, including dog handlers, are searching for her.
searching.zh: 名警官， 包括警犬训导员， 正在寻找她。

searching.en: Relief workers are still searching through collapsed buildings.
searching.zh: 救援人员仍在塌了的建筑物里搜寻。

searching.en: Detectives are still searching for those who violated the graveyard.
searching.zh: 侦探们还在查找那些亵渎了墓地的家伙。

searching.en: Wow, OK, maybe not so wow, but this is now constant. This is constant time access. So I can do searching in constant time which is great.
searching.zh: 喔，当然，可能没那么,但是现在是常数级了,这是常数时间的访问。

searching.en: When you are searching a list to see whether it has an element, you don't randomly probe the list, hoping to find whether or not it's there.
searching.zh: 当我们在一个数组中,寻找目标元素的时候,我们不会随机的调查数组来看。

secluded.zh: 我们被藏在那房间的一个隐蔽角落里。

secluded.zh: 极小的与世隔绝的海滩能在鲜有人至之处找到。

seamy.zh: 安妮在富裕安逸的环境中长大， 不大知道生活的阴暗面。

short-termism.en: " Short-termism " or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane.

short-termism.zh: 在美国，《2002 年萨班斯 - 奥克斯利法案》 已促使大多数上市公司将高管的绩效奖金推迟一年左右发放， 略微有助于减少 “短期主义”。

shore up.en: So, store -up, shore-up and build -up your energy reserve with a power nap.
shore up.zh: 因此， 一个有效的午睡就能存储、增加和积聚你的能量储备。

shortlisted.zh: 他曾数次获得诺贝尔文学奖提名。

shrine.zh: 这座纪念碑已经变成了纪念那些过世或失踪的人的圣地。

shrine.en: N ear a shrine, she found a beautiful bird singing on a big stone.
shrine.zh: 在一个神龛附近，她发现一只美丽的鸟在一块大石头上唱歌。

shrine.en: Fourth, there's generally some arrangement, either for the publication of the treaty, or its deposition, its safe-keeping in some sort of shrine.
shrine.zh: 第四是一些笼统的安排，对条约的公布，或者废除，然后放在圣坛里，安全保管。

shrine.en: And then the inner shrine is the holiest area: it's accessible only to the holiest member of the nation, the high priest.
shrine.zh: 更内部的神殿是最神圣的区域：,只有这个国家最神圣的人，大祭司可以进入。

shrill.en: Her voice was shrill and penetrating.

shrill.zh: 更清晰的是小叮当尖锐的声音。

shrill.zh: 使她大吃一惊的是，此时兔子用刺耳的嗓音尖叫道：“爱丽丝！”

shrill.en: That woman's days were spent In ignorant good will, Her nights in argument Until her voice grew shrill.
shrill.zh: 那个女人的白天是在,天真无知的善意中度过，可她的夜晚却是在,声嘶力竭的争论中度过。

shrewdly.en: " Aye, that I did," he answered with a shrewdly significant air.
shrewdly.zh: 是啊， 我看到了。” 他颇狡黠地回答道。

shrewdly.en: It's become clear that terrorists have been shrewdly factoring the weaknesses of our system into their plans.
shrewdly.zh: 可以看出， 恐怖分子在他们的计划中狡猾地利用了我们系统的弱点。

shrewdly.en: Both parties to this deal shrewdly hope to score some domestic gains.
shrewdly.zh: 囚犯交易的双方都强烈希望在各自国内有所收益。

shot.zh: 他射门击中球门的横梁。

shot.en: You know, just the idea of taking clay figures and moving them bit by bit by bit by bit and then filming shot per shot.
shot.zh: 就像拿着泥人，把它们一点一点地摆弄然后再一个镜头一个镜头地拍成电影。

shudder.en: She gave a dramatic shudder of repulsion.
shudder.zh: 她由于厌恶而身体剧烈发抖。
她不由自主地抖了一下。

shudder.zh: 电梯猛震一下， 升上去了。

shudder.en: A shudder in the loins engenders there The broken wall, the burning roof and tower And Agamemnon dead.
shudder.zh: 腰肢的猛一颤动,残破的墙垣，燃烧的屋顶和塔巅,阿伽门农死去。

shudder.en: In the arts generally people who teach you the arts are going to shudder if you would say oh I interesting in this because it's such fun, because it tells you what life is like or tells you a story and then you'll repeat the story.
shudder.zh: 艺术一般来说,如果你对教你们艺术的人,说，哦，我对这个很感兴趣,因为它很有趣，因为它告诉你生活是什么,或说它告诉了你一个很好的故事，他会很震惊。

shrink.zh: 我已经看过了精神病医生。

shrink.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
shrink.zh: 如果你放弃锻炼， 肌肉就会萎缩， 脂肪会增多。 同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

shrink.en: For a shirt verminously busy Yon soldier tore from his throat, with oaths Godhead might shrink at, but not the lice.
shrink.zh: 衬衫上满是虫,士兵用诅咒撕开他的喉咙,上帝可能会退缩而不是虱子。

shrink.en: I want to conclude with problems, which may sound kind of negative but this is--I don't shrink from negativism.
shrink.zh: 我想以保险业的缺陷作为本课总结,它可能听起来有点否定意味,但这是,我并不讨厌否定

shut-eye.en: Some 40% of Americans get less than 7 hours of shut-eye on week nights.
shut-eye.zh: 大约 40% 的美国人在工作日晚上的睡眠时间不足 7 小时。

shut-eye.en: If the most health - conscious among us have such deep swings in our shut-eye levels throughout the year, how much sleep are the rest of us losing?
shut-eye.zh: 如果连我们当中最注重健康的人一整年的睡眠水平都有这么大的波动，那么我们其他人会损失多少睡眠呢？

shut-eye.en: It's no surprise, then, that more than half of American adults don't get the 7 to 9 hours of shut-eye every night as recommended by sleep experts.
shut-eye.zh: 因此， 超过半数的美国成年人没有按照睡眠专家的建议每晚合起眼睛睡 7 到 9 个小时， 就不足为奇了。

shriveled.en: So, when supply chains shriveled, entrepreneurial Ohmori became a manufacturer.
shriveled.zh: 所以， 当供应链紧缩，作为一个企业家 Ohmori开始生产。

shriveled.en: Bamboo groves they harvested to sell to toy and chopstick makers shriveled and died.
shriveled.zh: 他们过去卖给玩具和筷子制造商的毛竹都枯死了。

shriveled.en: You know very well that I ’m no longer pretty. Look how wrinkled I am, how shriveled I’ve become!
shriveled.zh: 你很清楚我不漂亮了， 看我多皱， 变得多枯萎了啊！
现在我们的食道萎缩了。

shuffle off.en: You are old. You live alone. You suffer a heart attack. You cannot raise the alarm. You die. That, unfortunately, is the way that many people in the rich world shuffle off this mortal coil.
shuffle off.zh: 当你年纪大了， 独自生活，而又心脏病突发时，你会仅仅因为不能按响警报而死亡。 很不幸， 发达国家的许多人都以这种方式走完了终有一死的人生旅途。

shuffle off.en: You die. That, unfortunately, is the way that many people in the rich world shuffle off this mortal coil.
shuffle off.zh: 不幸的是， 发达国家的许多人都是以这样的方式离开人世。

shuffle off.en: The kids shuffle off, rinsing the " wound " under cold water, packing it with gauze, and pretending to take their charges to the hospital.

sickening.en: She tripped and fell with a sickening thud.
sickening.zh: 她绊倒了，发出一声吓人的闷响。

sickening.en: A sickening consternation struck through him; he recognised his mother!
sickening.zh: 一阵极不愉快的惊恐袭上他的心头； 他认出了他的母亲！

sickening.zh: 一切似乎是搅在一种乏味的、 恶心的灰白中， 我膝盖发软。

sickening.en: And the same way that I indicated previously that although I like chocolate-- I love chocolate--the prospect of having to eat more and more and more and more and more chocolate, eventually the idea becomes a sickening one.

sicko.en: Like all other immersive games - including tennis, fantasy football and chess - Twitter is spellbinding when you're in it, and seems nuts and like a sicko waste of time when you're not.
sicko.zh: 和其他所有电子游戏 —— 包括网球、 梦幻足球和国际象棋一样， 当你置身其中会觉得欲罢不能，下线之后，却只会为浪费了时间而后悔不已。

shy away from.en: We frequently shy away from making decisions.

shy away from.zh: 中国人从不畏避艰苦的工作。

sickle.zh: 镰状细胞贫血通过隐性基因遗传给后代。

sickle.zh: 他挥动镰刀嗖嗖地割掉了杂草的草尖。

sickle.zh: 刚才例子中,特性就是在正常的基因中,有酶切位点,而在患者的基因中却没有

sickle.zh: 是一种单基因缺陷,而且我们准确地知道,镰状红细胞贫血的基因缺陷在哪里

signet.zh: 时至今日， 湖边仍有一条掘了一半的沟 ——它便是人们对仙人不敬的罪证。

similitude.zh: 这对兄妹之间惊人的相似首次引起了我的注意。

similitude.zh: 胸腺肽及核苷酸类似物如拉米呋定、法昔洛韦等。

single-serving.zh: 从便携黄油以及飞机座椅之间的世界中挣脱。 还有瑞士家具。

single-serving.zh: 这种餐食基本不需加工， 而且包含了一顿单人餐所需的所有成分。

silhouette.zh: 群山的轮廓衬托了出来。

silhouette.en: The dark silhouette of the castle ruins stood out boldly against the fading light.
silhouette.zh: 城堡遗迹的黑暗轮廓在暗淡光线下显得格外突出。

silhouette.en: Next to it are the silhouette of Giacometti's " Walking Man " and an untranslatable blast from the exhibition's famous solitary creator.
silhouette.zh: 它旁边是贾科梅蒂的作品《行走着的人》的侧影轮廓像，还有出自本次展览的有名的孤独创作者戈达尔先生的无法翻译的惊人之语。

signature.zh: 每个人的签名是独一无二的。

sisyphean.zh: 内部会话维护的无休止工作。

sisyphean.en: A Sisyphean task perhaps-but worth a go all the same.
sisyphean.zh: 这项任务也许十分艰辛，但仍旧值得一试。

sisyphean.en: Yet fighting counterfeit crabs - like fighting any fake product here - is a Sisyphean task.

sit out.zh: 到了晚上， 父亲会坐在花园对面的凉台上， 我被叫来唱歌给他听。

snarl up.en: The centre has helped her regain her home, sort out the benefit snarl-up that led to the arrears and get money to repair the place.

snarl up.en: China may be the world's largest car market but the 100 km traffic snarl-up that has blocked the beijing - tibet expressway for more than a week was not caused by a build -up of passenger traffic.

snarl up.en: One snarl up this month along a highway leading into Beijing was at one point over 100 km long and left traffic gridlocked for eleven days until it mysteriously vanished on Thursday August 26th.
snarl up.zh: 这个月发生在通往北京的高速路上的交通拥挤一度超过一百公里，以至于所引发的交通僵局持续了十一天直到八月二十六日星期四才神奇地消失。

snarky.zh: 而每当他面对众人时， 常常因为不善表达遭到尖刻批评。

spill the beans.zh: 在俄罗斯，人们最好奇的是为什么 Vasilyeva 夫人，这个在干过厨师和其他工作后于2009 年菜获得法律从业资格的人， 选择泄露秘密。

spill the beans.zh: 如果你看见你朋友的男朋友跟别的女人在一起，你会不会去告密？

spill the beans.en: All those with access to the web now have a voice to air their grievances, vent their anger, parade their biases, push the boundaries of decency, spill the beans.
spill the beans.zh: 只要能上网，谁都可以任意表达自己的不满， 发泄内心的愤怒， 宣扬一已偏见，冒犯他人，以及泄密。

spine-tingling.en: Fritz, the writer, spins a spine-tingling tale to cheer up Karl, the apprentice clockmaker.
spine-tingling.zh: 弗里茨， 作家， 旋转 1 脊柱刺痛故事欢呼起来卡尔，学徒钟表匠。

spine-tingling.en: Search a mysterious manor for spooky specters in this spine-tingling seek - and - find adventure. As a new employee of g.
spine-tingling.zh: 这是一款令你毛骨悚然的探险游戏： 在一个神秘的庄园里寻找恐怖的幽灵。

spine-tingling.en: Shaking with fear, the children peer through the window of his cottage before a spine-tingling scene in which he creeps up behind them.
spine-tingling.zh: 孩子们害怕得直发抖，他们透过窗户偷偷往小屋里面窥视。正在此时， 令人毛骨悚然的一幕出现了， 这个男人从他们身后出现了。

spiny.en: The platypus ( Ornithorhynchus anatinus ) is one of only two mammals, the other is the echidna ( spiny anteater ) that lays eggs.
spiny.zh: 鸭嘴兽 （Ornithorhynchus anatinus） 是仅有的两种卵生的哺乳动物之一， 另一种为食蚁兽 （spiny anteater），它产卵。

spiny.en: The most significant neuropathological change is a preferential loss of medium spiny neurons in the neostriatum.
spiny.zh: 最显著的神经病理改变是新纹状体中度多刺的神经元的优先丢失。

spiral down.en: After completing some work on his laptop while soaking in the hot tub, he walks down the spiral staircase, under the hanging chandelier and into the pool room for some' down time'.
spiral down.zh: 洗澡时顺便完成工作，然后他沿着螺旋梯往下走， 经过华丽的吊灯，跳进室内游泳池尽享他的水下时间。

spiral down.en: So then, anchor in the heart of One, then simply feel yourself as if you are drifting down the sacred spiral, staying within, into the Fifth.
spiral down.zh: 锚定在合一的心， 然后简单的感觉你自己，感觉你就像飘落的神圣螺旋， 保持在内在， 进入第五维度。

spiral down.zh: 帕克： 要不我用个完美弧线把它打下来吧。

spinal column.en: Myelin a protective substance is beginning to coat the spinal column.

spit.en: Notices in the waiting room requested that you neither smoke nor spit.
spit.zh: 等候室的告示要求人们不要吸烟也不要随地吐痰。

spit.en: He spit it out, saying it was awful.
spit.zh: 他吐了出来， 说真难喝。

spit.en: He'll make a fine fire for this spit.
spit.zh: 他会让火旺起来， 发出噼啪声音的。

spit.en: Eventually you'll hopefully stop, and a value gets spit out, and you're done.
spit.zh: 最终你可能会停下来，一个结果运算出来，你就完成了。

spit.en: If you're just trying to spit up stuff you've memorized, it's not really going to work.
spit.zh: 如果你只是把学到的知识分开来看，那也不会起到什么作用。

spitting distance.en: But anyone who found themselves within spitting distance of the Earth's real core would " instantly vaporise ", Prof Perkowitz says.
spitting distance.zh: 但是任何只要发现他们自己在真的地心分散距离范围内的人都会 “l 立刻蒸发，”伯寇维兹教授说道。

spitting distance.en: So what if you've built this eco - city, if down the road, within spitting distance, is a city of 19 million people that is so unsustainable it's unbelievable?
spitting distance.zh: 如果一段时间之后，在很短的距离内有一座1900万人的城市， 这是难以维持的。 这太不可思议了吗？

splashy.en: Every gnarled hack knows that the best way to bury bad news is to counter it with a splashy new announcement.
splashy.zh: 每个政坛老手都知道， 掩盖坏消息的最好方法是用一个引人注目的好消息来反击。
