splashy.zh: 在成千上万的投资者面前， 此次的介绍为绿诺科技的初次登台起到了引人注目的作用。

splashy.en: Prince William and Kate Middleton's love story now features in a splashy comic book.
splashy.zh: 威廉王子和凯特· 米德尔顿的爱情故事现在被画成漫画咯~。

spoke.en: This is a poet who, with his wife, practiced automatic writing, who believed that the dead spoke through the living.
spoke.zh: 他是这样的诗人，和他妻子一起，尝试着，自动写作，他们相信死人通过活人说话。

spoke.en: a lot of people want to maintain the language that their family, either themselves or their parents spoke.
spoke.zh: 其中很多人，不管是学生自己还是他们的家长，都想要保留自己种族的语言。

split second.en: She had to make a split-second decision.
split second.zh: 她必须在瞬间作出决定。

split second.en: The success of the raid depended on split-second timing.
split second.zh: 袭击的成功取决于分秒不差的时间安排。

split second.zh: 在执法中我们不得不做瞬间决定。

split second.en: So, studies with police officers using reaction time in split-second choices on who to shoot find that your stereotypical attitudes play a huge role in who you're likely to shoot when they're holding an object in their hand that's unclear.
split second.zh: 一些针对警察的研究,用霎间的反应时间让他们作出选择,应该向谁开枪，研究发现这些刻板态度,能极大的影响你选择向谁开枪,当他们手里拿着不明物体时。

split-level.en: This split-level house is for rent. It's a bargain.
split-level.zh: 这所错层平房是出租的。租金很便宜。

split-level.en: Their interior planning is experimental, with apartments ranging from neat one - bedders with fold - out beds to split-level apartments.
split-level.zh: 其室内规划是实验性的， 从整洁的单床配备折叠床到分层公寓。

split-level.en: The prominent split-level form also combines with cantilevers to create usable, multipurpose spaces within the surrounding landscaping.
split-level.zh: 突出的错层形状也与悬臂结合， 在周围景观里创建可用的多功能空间。

sporadic.en: Her attendance in school was sporadic.
sporadic.zh: 她在学校的出勤率很低。
米凯尔的进步是零星的。

spore.zh: 种子的存活率大大高于裸孢子的存活率。

spore.zh: 在母细胞裂解后，在孢子囊内形成一个包涵体，并保留在孢子中。

spree.zh: 这没关系， 只要它们是令人愉快的， 而且不太可能有负面影响， 比如喝酒过量或者在预算紧张的情况下疯狂消费。

squatter.zh: 对错姑且不论， 但当地人就是认为他们脏兮兮的，爱干坏事，到处乞讨，还在美丽的景区旁安营扎寨，有碍观瞻。

squeaky clean.en: The energy implications are converted into letter grades, from squeaky-clean A to dirty G.
squeaky clean.zh: 能源意蕴被转化为字母等级， 从非常干净的A级到脏污的G级。

squeaky clean.zh: 丹尼尔和艾玛· 沃特森 （Emma Watson） 为了保持公众形象承受了比以往更大的压力。

squirt.zh: 这种蛇能把毒液喷射到一米处远。

squirt.en: It just needs a little squirt of oil.

squeak.zh: 当演示完 Squeak 软件后， 她停了下来， 说自己有事得走了， 并在纸上写下了些东西。

stage fright.zh: 一种可怕的怯场感攫住了他， 他两腿发抖，几乎要窒息了。

stage fright.zh: 我一上台就紧张，舌头也开始打结。

stage-manage.zh: 该党雇她精心策划他们的大会。

stage-manage.zh: 大卫· 布林，一部科幻小说的作者， 同样从“主动探寻地外生物” 辞职，指则其密谋策划辩论。

stage-manage.en: The interview was the latest indication of efforts by Chinese authorities to stage-manage Mr. Obama's visit here and the shaping of his public image in China.
stage-manage.zh: 中国官方不遗余力地监督奥巴马的访华之行并塑造着他在中国的公众形象， 这次访谈可谓是这种操纵的最后一次体现。

squint at.en: At the blast of its horn, I squint into the bright autumn sun.
squint at.zh: 在它的号角声中， 我斜视着秋日明媚的阳光。

squint at.zh: 在危险的时期， 我们紧握拳头， 眯着眼睛看那些看起来好得不能错过的交易， 怀疑它简直好得难以置信。

staggering.zh: 皮奥特说， 这种疾病自 1981年被首次发现以来， 已经达到了惊人的比例。

staggeringly.zh: 这本书的 85张彩色平版看起来异常鲜艳醒目。

staggeringly.en: The full details are staggeringly complicated —the text al one runs to 385 pages —and trying to summarise it is no easy task.
staggeringly.zh: 完整的细节惊人地复杂 —— 文本总共有385 页 —— 试图总结它不是一件容易的事。

staggeringly.en: And it is staggeringly hard to kill.
staggeringly.zh: 它是那样难以消灭，真是令人震惊。

staggeringly.en: What follows, it seems to me, is one of the most staggeringly beautiful, wonderful, amazing riffs on a passage of literature that you can encounter.
staggeringly.zh: 接下来这段节选，我认为，是你们能读到的文学作品里,最美妙，最惊艳的段子。

stand up.en: She started out as a stand-up.
stand up.zh: 她出道时是个独角喜剧演员。

stand up.en: When did you start doing stand-up?
stand up.zh: 你什么时候开始表演独白喜剧的？

stand up.en: He makes a living as a stand-up comic.
In a moment I'm going to ask you to humor us and stand up but not just yet; and then you're going to each take on the number 1 - - think to yourself I am number 1.
stand up.zh: 待会儿我让大家站起来,一起娱乐一下,不过不是现在,一会儿你们每人都代表一个数字1，心里默想，“我是1号“

stand up.en: Stand up my very left - wing guy, Sudipta, way at the end, and stand up my very right - wing guy.
stand up.zh: 一个绝对左派的人参选,苏迪普塔,在最边上,以及一个绝对右派的人参选

stamp out.en: This new sort of punch could stamp out 3,000 bonnets an hour.
stamp out.zh: 这种新型冲床每小时可冲压出三千个汽车引擎盖。

stamp out.en: We use it to isolate and stamp out transmission of the poliovirus.
stamp out.zh: 我们利用它分离脊髓灰质炎病毒并消灭其传播。

stamp out.en: They take emergency measures to stamp out crime.
stamp out.zh: 他们应采取紧急措施来消灭犯罪。

stanza.en: The conflictedness that Milton is encapsulating here is probably most intense in the last lines of this wonderful stanza.
stanza.zh: 弥尔顿在这儿概括的冲突，在这美妙的诗节的最后一行中可能是最激烈的。

stanza.en: It is one of the longest poems in the English language, the origin of Spenserian stanza.
stanza.zh: 这是英语语言史上最长的诗，是斯宾塞体的发端。
其中没有通道对应的节。

stanza.en: Now it's not until the fourth stanza of the prelude that we can fully understand the magnitude of the strange anxieties here.
stanza.zh: 直到序曲的第四段,我们才能完全明白这种奇怪焦虑的严重性。

stanza.en: We can't know exactly and this is one of the wonderfully unsettling things about this stanza we can't know exactly to whom Milton is addressing this stanza.
stanza.zh: 我们不能确切的知道,而这也是这一段很奇妙的不确定性所在,我们不能确切的知道弥尔顿这一段是在对谁讲话。

stanza.en: This idea leads him to the meditation that's in the second stanza there.
stanza.zh: 这一想法使他在,第二节里冥想。

starch.en: There's too much starch in your diet.
starch.zh: 你的日常饮食中淀粉含量太高。

starch.en: Sugar and starch are broken down in the stomach.
starch.zh: 糖和淀粉在胃里被分解。

starch.en: It's important to rinse the rice to remove the starch.
starch.zh: 淘洗大米去掉淀粉很重要。

starch.en: Then the polysaccharides are the complex carbohydrates, and that's starch, glycogen, and cellulose.
starch.zh: 多糖则是复杂的碳水化合物,淀粉,糖原,以及纤维素都是多糖

staple diet.en: The Chinese also eat a type of pasta as part of their staple diet.
staple diet.zh: 中国人也以一种面食作为他们的部分主食。

staple diet.en: Bamboo is the panda's staple diet.
staple diet.zh: 大熊猫的基本食物是竹子。

staple diet.en: Fish is a staple in the diet of many Africans.
staple diet.zh: 鱼是许多非洲人饮食中的主食。

stark.en: Stark took two whiskeys from a tray.
stark.zh: 斯塔克从托盘里拿了两杯威士忌。

stark.en: Social divisions in the city are stark.
stark.zh: 城市里各社会阶层有明确的分野。

stark.en: She seemed to have gone stark raving mad.
And in very stark ethical terms, I think that very helpful for everyone who is trying to live a life of integrity and morality.
stark.zh: 从严格的伦理角度来讲，这可以帮助人们,活出一个完整而道德的人生。

stark.en: The way that Muslims are both integrated in and contribute to American life, in our counterparts in Europe I think is a stark example for this.-Right.
stark.zh: 穆斯林既融入到了美国生活中,又为美国生活做出了贡献，这都好于欧洲一些国家,我认为这就是一个明显的例子-是的。

star turn.en: It is, true, the period of his life that established his name and fortune, that swift rise from undergraduate cabaret turn to star host on both sides of the Atlantic.
star turn.zh: 这真的是他生命中建立了他的名声和财富的阶段，他迅速从本科毕业的卡巴莱歌手崛起成了大西洋两岸的明星主持人。

star turn.en: As you might expect, Sigourney Weaver, in yet another Snow - White - eclipsing star turn for the Queen, is the only one to emerge unscathed.
star turn.zh: 也许如你所料，影片中的另一位明星西格妮· 韦弗，她饰演的皇后让主角白雪公主黯然失色，她是此部影片中唯一一位脱颖而出演员。

star turn.en: STAR TURN Michelle Obama chose a gown by the designer Jason Wu, 26, here fitting a look from his spring collection.
star turn.zh: 明星转身”， 米歇尔 · 奥巴马选择了一条长裙。 26岁的设计师杰森 - 吴，照片中正审视他 “春天之选”系列时装中的长裙。

status quo.en: By 492 votes to 391, the federation voted to maintain the status quo.
status quo.zh: 联盟以 492 票对 391 票投票决定维持现状。

status quo.en: While it remains to be seen whether air pollution can be controlled, the status quo is far from encouraging.
status quo.zh: 空气污染能否得到控制仍有待观察，而现状则远不足够让人为之振奋。

status quo.en: The status quo can be problematic, since a change in the course of action can sometimes be important and lead to a positive outcome.
status quo.zh: 现状可能是有问题的， 因为行动过程中作出改变有时很重要， 并会带来积极的结果。

staunchest.en: So, I once was the staunchest listener of western Medias.
staunchest.zh: 可以想像， 我曾经是西方媒体的最忠实听众。

staunchest.en: In the tech world, communities are defined by their staunchest advocates.
staunchest.zh: 在科技界中， 社区是由他们最可信赖的倡导者确立的。

staunchest.en: Even its staunchest supporters would accept that its interests appear murky to outsiders.
staunchest.zh: 即使其坚固的支持者也认为对外界而言其利益运作是不透明的。

staunch.en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.
staunch.zh: 他是政府开支控制的坚定支持者。

staunch.en: He is a staunch supporter of amateurism in intercollegiate athletics.
staunch.zh: 他坚决支持把学院之间的体育活动业余化。

staunch.en: The red plum blossom shows her quality in her staunch will.
staunch.zh: 红梅以坚定不移的信念表现她的品格。

statesmanship.en: He praised the two leaders warmly for their statesmanship.
statesmanship.zh: 他热情地赞扬了两位领导人的政治家风范。

statesmanship.en: In the absence of statesmanship, the chances are that only a crisis in the bond markets will provide the necessary impetus.
statesmanship.zh: 在缺少治国之才的情况下， 很可能只有债券市场的一次危机才能提供必要的动力。

statesmanship.en: He built America, for what our Republic is today is largely due to the prudence, the forethought, the statesmanship, the enterprise, the wisdom, and the ability of Benjamin Franklin.
statesmanship.zh: 他缔造了美国， 因为我们的共和国能有今天，在很大程度上归功于本杰明·富兰克林的深谋远虑、远见卓识、 治国之术、 进取精神、 大睿大智和精明能干。

statesmanship.en: What are the qualities necessary for sound statesmanship? How does statecraft? differ from other kinds of activities?
statesmanship.zh: 什么样的特质是正直政治家所应具备的风范,权术又如何,独善于其它类型的活动呢？

statesmanship.en: Aristotle's political science then is ultimately the supreme science of statecraft a term that again we don't hear much about--statecraft or statesmanship.
statesmanship.zh: 亚里士多德的政治科学,绝对是极致的权术科学,这是一个我们不太能听到的词汇,权术或领袖风范。

statesmanship.en: Again one of the oldest questions of political science very rarely asked by the political science of today that is very skeptical of the language of statesmanship.
statesmanship.zh: 再者，其中一个最古老的政治科学问题,今日的政治科学鲜少有人问到的是,政治语言极度深不可测,以其最古老的意义来看。

star-crossed.en: The phone was star-crossed from its released, and a few short weeks after launch.
star-crossed.zh: 这款手机子发布之始便时运不济，推出的短短几个星期后便折戟沉沙。

star-crossed.en: This is the story of Samsung and how it made a difference in the lives of several star-crossed mobile users.
star-crossed.zh: 这是三星的故事以及它如何在几个明星的生活有差异， 交叉移动用户。

star-crossed.en: According to local legend, the falls were formed when two star-crossed lovers incurred the wrath of a vengeful god.
star-crossed.zh: 当地有这样一个传说： 瀑布源于一对苦命的恋人，他们激怒了复仇的天神。

staunchly.en: She staunchly defended the new policy.

staunchly.zh: 那一家人是虔诚的新教徒。

staunchly.en: He was staunchly opposed to a public confession.
As a matter of style, the chorus would staunchly preach yes, for the sake of readability.
staunchly.zh: 作为一个格式风格问题，那是非常必要的，那样可读性更好。

steep in.en: The damage to American craftsmanship seems to parallel the steep slide in manufacturing employment.
steep in.zh: 对美国工艺的损害似乎与制造业就业的急剧下滑保持平行。

steep in.en: Potatoes and tobacco are grown in Andorra's steep mountain valleys.
steep in.zh: 安道尔陡峭的山谷里种植着土豆和烟草。

steep in.en: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
steep in.zh: 一部分原因是政府没有预料到航空旅行的急剧增长， 因此运输安全管理局现在正急着在线路上找到新的安检人员。

steal over.en: They can be a nuisance when they turn over your trash or steal your food while camping.
steal over.zh: 当他们打翻你的纸篓， 偷吃你们野餐的食物的时候，确实是讨厌鬼。

steal over.en: Sure, they can be a nuisance when they turn over your trash or steal your food while camping, but their adorable little masked faces make up for all that.
steal over.zh: 确实， 当他们打翻你的纸篓， 偷吃你们野餐的食物的时候，是个讨厌鬼， 但是他们那可爱的伪装似的小脸蛋会让你忘了其他的事情。

steal over.en: Clearly top executives at each company look over at the others' POTS of gold and dream of ways to steal them, or at least make it harder for the other guy to make money.
steal over.zh: 显然， 每家公司的高管都琢磨了对方赚得盆满钵满的方法及实现梦想的途径，并试图依葫芦画瓢， 或至少让对方难以赚到钱。

steaming.en: Dan smiled at him through a haze of smoke and steaming coffee.
steaming.zh: 丹透过缭绕的烟雾和咖啡氤氲出的热气朝他微笑。

steaming.en: Mrs. King went to the big black stove and ladled out steaming soup.
steaming.zh: 金太太走到黑色的大炉子前， 舀出热气腾腾的汤来。

steaming.en: Dad filled our plates with steaming stew and passed them around.
steaming.zh: 爸爸往我们的盘子里装满了热气腾腾的炖菜，然后把菜递给了我们。

stencil.en: Stencil it on your forehead if you must.
stencil.zh: 如果有必要请印在自己的脑门上提醒自己。

stencil.en: It is based on screen printing, which USES a stencil and paint to create an image.
stencil.zh: 该技术基于屏幕打印， 即使用一张蜡纸和油墨来创建一个图像。

stent.en: The stent manufacturers make billions more.
stent.zh: 支架生产商比药厂更可获利多几十亿。

stent.en: The tube is supported by a metallic support, or stent.
stent.zh: 人工管腔内由金属支撑物或者支架支撑。

stent.en: Before placing a stent, dye is injected and X-rays taken to look for blockages.
stent.zh: 在安装支架以前， 染料将被注入并且 X光被采取寻找障碍。

steer clear of.en: I think a lot of people, women in particular, steer clear of these sensitive issues.
steer clear of.zh: 我认为很多人， 尤其是女性，有意避开这些敏感问题。

steer clear of.en: Only about one woman in a thousand carries her bag on the left, and I tended to steer clear of them.
steer clear of.zh: 一千个人中大概只有一个女人会把包背在左边， 而我往往会避开她们。

steer clear of.en: Birds prefer not to take any chances —and to steer clear of all insects that look, sound, or fly like a bumblebee to avoid being stung.
steer clear of.zh: 鸟类宁愿不去尝试更多的机会——它们要避开所有如大黄蜂的长相、 声音和飞行模式的昆虫， 以避免被蛰。

step change.en: We need a step-change in education and training delivery to ensure we have the highly - skilled workforce we need to stay ahead of the global competition.
step change.zh: 我们需要逐步改变所提供的教育和培训， 确保拥有所需要的高技能员工， 保持在全球竞争中的领先地位。

step change.en: In a country imbued with ancient traditions of conformity, where elders are respected and education is still centred on testing and rote learning, this marks a fundamental step-change.
step change.zh: 在一个被灌输了古老的顺从传统的国家， 在一个老人受到敬重， 而教育仍然以考试和机械学习为中心的国家， 这标志着一种根本的变革。

step change.en: A step change has taken place in young people's attitudes to their parents.
step change.zh: 年轻人对父母的态度已发生了彻底的改变。

stealthy.en: The old man glided away, stooping, stealthy, cat-like, and brought the low bench.
stealthy.zh: 老人弯着腰，像猫一样鬼鬼祟祟地走了， 把那张矮凳搬了过来。

stealthy.en: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second floor.
stealthy.zh: 我会悄悄溜进去， 轻手轻脚地看一下二楼的情况。

stealthy.en: You could sneak in stealthy, or charge into.
stealthy.zh: 你可以潜行进入， 或者冲进去。

step out on.en: Our country needs more scientists who are willing to step out in the public arena and offer their opinions on important matters.
step out on.zh: 我们的国家需要更多的科学家， 他们愿意走到公众舞台上， 提供他们对重要事情的看法。

step out on.en: Toad got down on the step, and as the train slowed down to almost a walking pace, he heard the driver call out, " Now, jump!"
step out on.zh: 蟾蜍踩下踏板， 火车减速至与步行差不多时， 他听到司机一声喊：“现在， 跳！”

step out on.en: Note: This step may be difficult to carry out on a single system because of memory constraints.
step out on.zh: 注意： 由于内存限制， 这个步骤可能难以在单个系统上执行。

sterilize.en: Sulphur is also used to sterilize equipment.
sterilize.zh: 硫磺也用来给设备消毒。

sterilize.en: The machine uses minute quantities of ozone to sterilize and deodorize refrigerated food vehicles.
sterilize.zh: 这个机器用微量臭氧对食物冷藏车进行消毒和除臭。

sterilize.en: He boiled his syringe and fired his knife to sterilize them.
sterilize.zh: 他把注射器放到水中煮，把刀子放在火上烧来进行消毒。

sterile.en: He was able to bring large sterile acreages back to fertility.
sterile.zh: 他能把大片不毛之地变回沃土。

sterile.en: He always made sure that any cuts were protected by sterile dressings.
sterile.zh: 他总是确保所有伤口都用无菌的敷料包好。

sterile.en: This top fits over the bottle and keeps the teat sterile.
sterile.zh: 这个盖子盖在瓶子上， 保持奶嘴无菌。

sterile.en: Much easier to keep a flask of cells under very sterile, very reproducible conditions than it is to keep a small animal, right?
sterile.zh: 保存一小瓶细胞,该细胞可在无菌条件下再生,这要比保存小动物容易的多

sterile.en: and I think a lot of people might think that it's a very sterile subject,
sterile.zh: 许多人也许认为文学枯燥无味，

stern.en: He cast a stern glance at the two men.
stern.zh: 他严厉地瞪了那两名男子一眼。

stern.en: Our captain gave us a stern lecture on safety.
stern.zh: 我们的船长在安全问题上给了我们严厉的批评。

stern.en: Because these things are unpaired, we have already seen how unpaired electrons play a role in the Stern -Gerlach experiment.
stern.zh: 因为它们都是未成对的，我们已经发现,在 Stern -Gerlach实验中,未成对电子扮演怎样一个角色了。

stethoscope.en: Listening to a purring cat through a stethoscope is a great relaxation technique.
stethoscope.zh: 用听诊器听猫发出的呼噜声是很好的放松技巧。

stethoscope.en: In specialties ranging from cardiac care to pediatric care, they could become as essential in daily medicine as the stethoscope.
stethoscope.zh: 在心脏护理至儿科护理的专业领域中， 它们在日常医学中可能会像听诊器一样不可或缺。

stethoscope.en: The stethoscope is older than the x-ray, the ballpoint pen, Popular Science and pretty much everything else in your doctor's office.
stethoscope.zh: 听诊器比 X 射线、 圆珠笔、《大众科学》 以及你医生诊所里绝大部分物件还要古老。

stiff-necked.en: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.
stiff-necked.zh: 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉， 不可再硬着颈项。

stiff-necked.en: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their fathers, who did not trust in the Lord their God.
stiff-necked.zh: 他们却不听从，竟硬着颈项，效法他们列祖，不信服耶和华他们的神。

stiff-necked.en: But that attitude had changed abruptly when they were approached for a loan by a stiff-necked Brant Culhane when his fortunes sagged.
stiff-necked.zh: 倔强的波澜特卡亨斯的资产不足，当他与他们交涉贷款的时候，那种态度突然发生了变化。

stiff.en: He rubbed his arms and stiff legs.
stiff.zh: 他揉了揉他的两条胳膊和两条僵硬的腿。

stiff.en: She greeted him with stiff formality.
stiff.zh: 她拘谨地按礼节向他致意。

stiff.en: Linseed oil will soften stiff leather.
stiff.zh: 亚麻籽油可软化僵硬的皮革。

stiff.en: And I'm sure you don't remember, but one of the things I had in my recipe, is beat egg whites until stiff. OK.
stiff.zh: 我相信你们不记得了，但是我说过我食谱中的一件事情是，搅拌蛋清直到变浓稠，好。

stiff.en: I don't know, a very English, sort of stiff upper lip kind of man.
stiff.zh: 我不知道，一个英国式的，坚定沉稳的男人。

stifle.en: She managed to stifle a yawn.
She makes no attempt to stifle a yawn.
stifle.zh: 她并未试图忍住一个哈欠。

stifle.en: The food did nothing to stifle her queasiness.
stifle.zh: 这些食物也没能遏制住她的恶心感。

stilted.zh: 我们说了些客气呆板的套话。

stilted.en: We made stilted conversation for a few moments.
stilted.zh: 我们不自然地客套了几句。

stilted.en: When we do meet again, it's stilted.
stilted.zh: 我们再次见面时， 就更加不自然了。

stipend.en: The first impulse leads us to provide housing, food stamps, medical care and a cash stipend for families in need.
stipend.zh: 第一个冲动促使我们为有需要的家庭提供住房、 食品券、 医疗和现金津贴。
助学金方案获得了成功。

stipend.en: Some will receive a stipend; others will pay their own way.
stipend.zh: 有些学生会得到奖学金； 其他人将自掏腰包。

stillborn.en: Both are wary of following an initiative that could be stillborn.
stillborn.zh: 两国对一个可能胎死腹中的新举措持谨慎态度。

stillborn.en: The economic recovery could be stillborn if interest rates rise too far too fast.
stillborn.zh: 如果利率上升得过高过快， 经济复苏很可能会流产。

stirred.en: He stirred his coffee with a spoon.
A noise stirred me from sleep.
stirred.zh: 响声把我从睡梦中惊醒。

stirred.en: She was stirred by his sad story.
stirred.zh: 他那悲惨的故事打动了她。

stoke.en: These demands are helping to stoke fears of civil war.
stoke.zh: 这些要求激起了对内战的恐惧。

stoke.en: Jerry forced scrap wood through the vents in the grill to stoke the fire.
stoke.zh: 杰里从烤架的通风孔塞一些小木片来使火更旺一些。

stoke.en: " Wait," said he, " I will just stoke up the fire a little for you."
stoke.zh: 等一下。” 他说，“我去给你添点火。”

stockpile.en: An unprecedented number of unsold cars in Japan have forced Toyota to stockpile them in the parking lots of Fuji Speedway.
stockpile.zh: 日本未售出的汽车数量达到前所未有的水平， 迫使丰田汽车在富士高速公路停车场大量囤积。

stockpile.en: Chile has given up its entire stockpile.
stockpile.zh: 智利已放弃其全部库存。

stockpile.en: Sure, times are tight and it's hard to stockpile.
stockpile.zh: 当然， 时间紧， 很难储存。

stomach upset.en: Paul was unwell last night with a stomach upset.
This may cause stomach upset, ulcers, headache, backache, high blood pressure, and in severe cases, this can lead to panic attacks or a panic disorder.
stomach upset.zh: 这可能会引起胃部不适、 溃疡、 头痛、 背痛、 高血压， 甚至在严重的情况下，这可能导致惊恐发作或惊恐障碍。

stole.en: She stole a glance at her watch.
They stole the car just for the hell of it.
stole.zh: 他们偷这辆汽车只是为了寻求刺激。

stole.en: This is proof positive that he stole the money.
stole.zh: 这就是他偷钱的肯定证据。

stole.en: Could it be that the hidden throb I stole from them did not affect their future? I had possessed her, and she never knew it.
stole.zh: 它是不是我从那些人物那获取隐藏的脉搏,我为她着迷，她并不知晓。

stole.en: You don't publish results that you stole from others and represented as your own.
stole.zh: 不用发表你从其他人那偷来的结果,而当成是自己的。

stigmata.en: Many received the stigmata in various forms.
stigmata.zh: 许多收到五伤， 在各种形式。

stigmata.en: And, frankly, who can blame Jones for wanting to shake off the Starbucks stigmata?
stigmata.zh: 并坦率地说， 谁又能责怪琼斯想要摆脱星巴克伤？

stigmata.en: At index endoscopy, 2 patients had active hemorrhage and 14 had stigmata of recent hemorrhage.
stigmata.zh: 在指数胃镜检查中， 2 例患者有活动性出血， 14 例有最近出血痕迹。

stop short at.en: The terrible motor - car drew slowly nearer and nearer, till at last he heard it stop just short of him.
stop short at.zh: 那辆可怕的汽车慢慢地越开越近， 最后他听见它在离他不远的地方停住了。

stop short at.en: While this could work in the very short term, the reality is that there is no way to stop home price declines at this point.
stop short at.zh: 尽管这会在短期内起到作用， 事实是在现在价格点位上， 没有方法来阻止房屋价格下降的走势。

stop short at.en: I start hand gestures but stop short of pointing at the necessary areas.
stop short at.zh: 我继续设法把事情说清楚， 开始做手势， 只是没敢把手指向那个说明问题的地方。

stomach-churning.en: The stench from rotting food is stomach-churning.
stomach-churning.zh: 腐烂食物散发的恶臭让人反胃。

stomach-churning.en: EVEN by its own notoriously cyclical standards, investment banking has been on a stomach-churning ride in the past five years.
stomach-churning.zh: 即便考虑到其众所周知的周期性因素， 投行业在过去五年里仍经历令人反胃的颠簸旅程。

stomach-churning.en: With over a thousand parts to play around with, you can create some truly stomach-churning rides, watching each unique guest react to them.
stomach-churning.zh: 在超过一千个区域都可以玩， 你可以创建一些真正的让你的胃翻滚的游乐设施， 看着每一个独特的客人对它们的反应。

storm off.en: A storm was brewing off Port Angeles in the far north of Washington State.
storm off.zh: 一场暴风雨正在华盛顿州最北端的安吉利斯港外酝酿。

storm off.en: A chunk of the cliff had cracked off in a storm.
storm off.zh: 山崖上的一块石头在暴风雨中崩塌下来。

storm off.en: When he was fishing off the island he was caught in a storm and almost drowned.
storm off.zh: 他离岛出海钓鱼时遭遇暴风雨袭击， 差点被淹死。

straightlaced.en: With his Boston accent, bushy Cliff Clavin mustache, and fondness for pleated pants and button-down shirts, he looked like a dotcom engineer's straightlaced father.
straightlaced.zh: 贝迪耶长着浓密的克里夫 ·克莱文式八字须，一口波士顿腔， 喜欢带褶皱的裤子和有领扣的衬衫， 看起来像网络工程师的教父。

stowaway.en: The crew discovered the stowaway about two days into their voyage.
stowaway.zh: 船员们在航行大约两天后发现了那名偷乘者。

stowaway.en: Airlines took the view that stowaway incidents should not happen.
stowaway.zh: 航空公司认为偷乘飞机这样的事是不应该发生的。

stool.en: He hoisted himself onto a high stool.
stool.zh: 他抬身坐上了一张高凳子。

stool.en: He hitched himself onto the bar stool.
stool.zh: 他一跃坐到了酒吧间的高凳上。

stool.en: The stool had a torn, red plastic seat.
stool.zh: 这条无靠背凳子有一个破了的、 红色的塑料坐部。

stool.en: When Thoreau sits on his little stool outside his cabin at Walden Pond and he hears the train go by over the ridge, and he puts his hands over his ears he doesn't want to hear it-- he's representing something.
stool.zh: 在瓦尔登湖的木屋外,梭罗坐在他的小凳子上,他听到火车的声音穿越桥梁,他捂住了耳朵,他一点也不想听到这个声音,他代表着某种想法

story arc.en: The show is - unlike many other dramas - to have an ultimate story arc, and so at some point, the Prison Break gang will have to stop running when the show comes to its natural conclusion.
story arc.zh: 这部剧集和其他剧集不同， 它有一个基本的故事框架。 所以从某些方面来说， 越狱帮将不得不在剧集自然结束时停止逃亡。

story arc.en: A career plan is like a story arc - there is a beginning, an end, and a lot of events in between.
story arc.zh: 职业规划就像一个故事的线索 - - - 有开端、 结尾和其间的一系列事件。

story arc.en: The creation of writer Roy Thomas, the homage to Bugs Bunny was featured in the first story arc to come after the adaptation of the film.
story arc.zh: 这个人物是在向兔八哥致敬。他由作家罗伊 · 托马斯创作， 出现在第一批电影之外的漫画故事中。

straight face.en: What went through Tom's mind I can't imagine, but he did manage to keep a straight face.
straight face.zh: 汤姆心里在想什么我想像不出来， 但是他确实装着一脸严肃。

straight face.en: We often keep a straight face or use an unsmiling expression when we're making a joke.
straight face.zh: 当我们开玩笑的时候，我们经常绷着脸或使用不笑的表情。

straight face.en: He kept a straight face and remained speechless.

strait-laced.en: He was criticized for being boring, strait-laced and narrow - minded.
strait-laced.zh: 他被批评为乏味、 古板守旧及心胸狭窄。

strait-laced.en: My old aunts are very strait-laced.
Singapore seems to have gone from strait-laced container port to gambling mecca in one bound.
strait-laced.zh: 新加坡似乎已从一个传统的集装箱港口城市一跃成为了赌徒们的圣地。

strapping.en: He was a bricklayer – a big, strapping fellow.
strapping.zh: 他是个砌砖工 — 一个高大健壮的年轻人。

strapping.en: He was a big strapping guy but short on brains.
strapping.zh: 他五大三粗， 但头脑简单。

strapping.en: The messenger bent and scratched at his knee where the strapping chafed.
strapping.zh: 信使弯身挠膝盖上被带子擦痛的地方。

strand.en: She was wearing a strand of crystal beads.
Pauline wore a silk dress with a strand of pearls.
strand.zh: 保利娜穿了一条带有一串珍珠的丝绸连衣裙。

strand.en: She wore a single strand of pearls around her neck.
strand.zh: 她脖子上戴着单串珍珠。

strand.en: He does a great deal else in it, but I'm isolating this strand, which is what's relevant to what we're talking about.
strand.zh: 他在书里还讲了很多别的东西，但我要把这点单拎出来，因为只有这一点和我们要讨论的相关。

strand.en: You then denature again, each one of these strands gets separated, primers bind, turn on the polymerase, a new strand is made.
strand.zh: 然后你可以再次使产物链变性,使各链解旋,再结合引物,激活聚合酶,再生成新链

strangled.en: In a strangled voice he said, " This place is going to be unthinkable without you."
strangled.zh: 他哽咽地说道：“没有你这个地方会变得不可想象。”

strangled.en: Life is strangled with polite lies.
strangled.zh: 生命里礼貌的谎言让人窒息。

strangled.en: Private firms are strangled with red tape.
strangled.zh: 私人企业则被官方颁布的繁文缛节扼杀。

straw poll.en: A straw poll conducted at the end of the meeting found most people agreed with Mr. Forth.
straw poll.zh: 会议结束时所做的非正式民意测验表明大多数人赞同福思先生。

straw poll.en: I took a quick straw poll among my colleagues to see how many agreed.
straw poll.zh: 我在同事中很快做了一个民意测验看有多少人赞同。

straw poll.en: She was born 100 miles up the road —as she endlessly reminded locals in advance of the Republican Party ’s “ straw poll ” in Ames, Iowa on Saturday.
straw poll.zh: 星期天在爱荷华州的埃姆斯举行了共和党参选人的“模拟投票”，而在这之前，巴赫曼就不断地提醒当地人 —— 她的出生地距此地仅仅100 英里路程。

streak.en: His record reveals a tough streak.
streak.zh: 他的经历说明他个性坚强。

streak.en: He has always had a rebellious streak.
Rain had begun to streak the windowpanes.
streak.zh: 雨已开始在窗玻璃上留下条痕。

streak.en: How can we prevent murderous schoolyard violence in children who have access to weapons,poor parental supervision, and a mean streak?"
streak.zh: 如何防止校园暴力,这些暴力事件通常是由掌握武器，缺乏父母监管，或受到教唆的孩子引起的“

streak.en: If you can do all that, I think the chances are that you're going to hit a lucky streak because luck comes and goes.
streak.zh: 如果你可以做到这些，我认为你很可能要,运气连碰了,因为运气总是来来去去。

stretch back.zh: 腘绳肌(大腿后部肌群) 拉伸练习。

stretch back.en: Yet the histories of both firms stretch back into the 19th century, to when they dispatched young men on ships from Liverpool and Rotterdam to faraway places.
stretch back.zh: 两家公司的历史都可以追溯道 19 世纪， 他们派遣年轻人从利物浦和鹿特丹出发到很远的地方去。

stretch back.en: London's roots as a centre of commerce stretch back many centuries.
stretch back.zh: 伦敦作为商贸中心的基础可以追溯到许多世纪以前。

strenuously.en: He still works out strenuously every morning.
strenuously.zh: 他仍然每天早晨努力锻炼。

strenuously.en: The government strenuously denies the allegations.
strenuously.zh: 政府坚称那些说法不是事实。
不过菲尔普斯还是极力地反对。

strenuous exercise.en: It is best not to do strenuous exercise for a few hours and not smoke or drink alcohol for two hours.
strenuous exercise.zh: 献血后的几小时内最好不做重体力活动， 两小时之内不要吸烟，不要饮酒。

strenuous exercise.en: When a thick cloud of air pollution settled in over London last week, experts warned those with health problems to avoid strenuous exercise.
strenuous exercise.zh: 上周， 当伦敦笼罩在污染严重的空气中时， 专家警告存在健康问题的人应避免剧烈运动。

strenuous exercise.en: I think yoga suit me best, because I don't like strenuous exercise.
strenuous exercise.zh: 我认为瑜伽更适合我， 因为我不喜欢剧烈运动。

strait-jacket.en: Her ambition was strait-jacket by her family.
strait-jacket.zh: 她的抱负被她的家庭扼杀了。

strait-jacket.en: She telephoned the police and she telephoned a psychiatrist; she told them to hurry to her house and bring a strait-jacket.
strait-jacket.zh: 她先后给警察局和精神科医生打电话， 告诉他们赶紧到自己家里来，并且要带上约束衣（用来束缚精神病患者—译者注）。

strait-jacket.en: This invariance requirement has been a strait jacket on the free invention of scientists.
strait-jacket.zh: 这个不变性要求， 已经成了套在科学家的自由创造上的一件紧身衣。

stray.en: A stray dog came up to him.
stray.zh: 一只走失的狗来到他跟前。

stray.en: The dog was a stray which had been adopted.
stray.zh: 这只狗是被收养的流浪狗。

stray.en: Tourists often get lost and stray into dangerous areas.
stray.zh: 旅游者们经常迷路走进一些危险区域。

stray.en: Or to choke a stray cat to death with your bare hands?
stray.zh: 抑或，亲手掐死一只流浪猫？

strewn with.en: The way ahead is strewn with difficulties.
strewn with.zh: 前面的道路布满艰难险阻。

strewn with.en: The front room was strewn with books and clothes.
The floor was strewn with clothes.

strike a chord.en: Find local charities that strike a chord - food pantries, the humane society, a homeless shelter, or a local museum or library - and write a check to help them out.
strike a chord.zh: 找到当地能够引起共鸣的慈善机构 —— 餐具室， 人道协会， 流浪汉之家， 或者是一个当地的博物馆或图书馆 —— 然后寄去一张支票帮助他们。

strike a chord.en: Yet, although most people's voices don't seem to strike a chord one way or the other, research has shown that a person's voice can influence whether others find him alluring or unattractive.
strike a chord.zh: 虽然绝大多数人的声音都不会像和弦那么好听， 研究却表明声音会影响一个人对于他人有吸引力与否。

strike a chord.en: [ But ] there are actual things that can strike a chord in every one of us, as to lead us to some sort of suddenly - found self - identity.
strike a chord.zh: 但是 ] 确有一种东西能让我们共鸣，让我们忽然之间有一种自我认同。

strike a compromise.en: Can you strike a compromise between how you want to live and those things you desire?
strike a compromise.zh: 你能够将自己如何生存和自己想要的东西达到妥协吗？

strike a compromise.en: To alleviate this, you must strike a compromise so that parallel deployment is minimized; for example, your application teams could agree upon a deployment schedule.
strike a compromise.zh: 要实现这一点， 您必须进行折中， 将并行部署减至最低程度； 例如， 您的应用程序团队可能会对一个部署调度达成一致意见。

strike a compromise.en: With legislators of both parties holding firm to their positions, the question becomes whether leaders can strike a bipartisan compromise and convince their members to support it.
strike a compromise.zh: 两党议员各持己见，所以目前的问题是两党领导人是否能够达成妥协， 并劝服其他议员来支持这个议案。

strike a chord with.en: Calls for a more pro - poor, pro - labour stance strike a strong chord with the party's rank and file.
strike a chord with.zh: 对更亲穷人、亲劳工立场的呼吁强烈打动了非国大的支持民众。

strike a chord with.en: You may even strike a chord with enough people to spark a movement.
strike a chord with.zh: 你甚至能引起不少人的共鸣，进而能够发起活动。

strike a chord with.en: Women's natures are constructed so as to make relationships and communication their top priorities, so hearing and receiving messages of affection will definitely strike a chord with them.
strike a chord with.zh: 女人的天性就是把感情和沟通放在首位。 因此感情上的倾听和倾诉对于女性来说绝对是能引起共鸣的。

stringent.en: He announced that there would be more stringent controls on the possession of weapons.
stringent.zh: 他宣布在武器的持有方面将会有更严格的控制。

stringent.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
stringent.zh: 严格的解雇条例反而会影响生产率的增长， 阻碍社会的繁荣发展和整体福利。

stringent.en: " In some cases the quality requirements are so stringent that even if you wanted to have a human do the job, you couldn't," Burnstein says.
stringent.zh: 在某些情况下， 质量要求会非常严格， 即使你想让人来做这项工作也不行。”伯恩斯坦说道。

stringer.en: He picked up extra money as a local stringer for the New York Herald.
stringer.zh: 他通过做《纽约先驱报》的本地特约记者赚了些外快。

stringer.en: That way, whoever is on the spot becomes a " just-in-time stringer."
stringer.zh: 这样， 在现场的任何人都可以成为一个及时的特约记者。

stringer.en: The bottom line, for Stringer and Avon, is always the bottom line.
stringer.zh: 对于斯丁格和伊旺， 底线永远是底线。

string bean.en: Include the new bean properties in the subKeys string.
string bean.zh: 在 subkeys 字符串中包含新的 bean 属性。

string bean.en: The value attribute outputs the bean value as a string when rendered.
string bean.zh: 属性在呈现时将be an 值输出为字符串。

string bean.en: A form bean containing a String array for the radio buttons and a String for the specifically selected button.
string bean.zh: 一个表单 bean ， 包含单选按钮的 String 数组和特意选中的按钮的 String 。

strobe light.en: This optical illusion, called the wagon wheel effect, also can occur in the presence of a strobe light.
strobe light.zh: 这个错觉，被称为 “马车轮效应”， 也可能发生在有闪光灯的情况下。

strobe light.en: Flash or strobe light lets you photograph in dark places without having to increase your camera's ISO setting or use a tripod, as long as the subject is within the range of your light.
strobe light.zh: 有了闪光灯， 你就可以不用增加照相机的 ISO 刻度， 或使用三脚架的情况下就可以在暗处拍照， 只要拍摄物在闪光灯的有效范围里。

strobe light.en: Without a strobe light to animate its riot of colors, this Fijian reef in 45 feet ( 14 meters ) of water remains as a fish would see it.
strobe light.zh: 不需用闪光灯来凸显这块水下 45 英尺 ( 14 米 )斐济暗礁的奔放活力， 鱼儿自会感受到。

strum.en: Now strum the chord any way you like, and record it.
strum.zh: 现在你喜欢的任何方法拨动弦， 并录下它。

strum.en: In guitar you can strum a chord and you've got the sound.
strum.zh: 在吉他上， 你随便拨个和弦，你就得到那个和弦了。

strum.en: We'd sit with a guitar, and one of us would strum a chord.
strum.zh: 我们抱着一把吉他坐着， 我们中的一个会弹一个和弦。

strophic.en: Now these two forms brought together, synthesized as a single strophic form in Shelley, are coded in entirely different ways.
strophic.zh: 将这两种形式融合在一起，成为雪莱的单一诗节形式，而这两种形式则完全不同。

strike up.en: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
strike up.zh: 在一系列研究中， 研究人员指导芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通工具的通勤者与附近的人进行交谈。

strike up.en: Go for a walk outside and strike up a conversation with a neighbor.
strike up.zh: 去外面走走， 主动向你的邻居发起一次谈话。

stub.en: I have every cheque stub we've written since 1959.
stub.zh: 我有自 1959年以来我们填写过的每一张支票存根。

stub.en: She would sit there drawing with the pencil stub.
stub.zh: 她会坐在那儿用铅笔头画画。

stub.en: He pulled the stub of a pencil from behind his ear.
stub.zh: 他从他的耳朵后面抽出了一个铅笔头。

stub.en: If you bang your toe or stub your toe you feel pain.
stub.zh: 如果你砸到了脚或是绊了一跤,你会感到疼痛

students majoring in the humanities.en: The number of students majoring in the humanities has declined by about half.
students majoring in the humanities.zh: 主修人文学科的学生数量已经下降了近一半。

stuffy.en: The stuffy' 50 s gave way to the swinging' 60 s.
stuffy.zh: 古板乏味的 50 年代被时髦活跃的 60 年代所取代。

stuffy.en: It gets very hot and stuffy in here in summer.
Museums have been trying hard to shed their stuffy image.
stuffy.zh: 博物馆一直努力改变自己沉闷的形象。

stupendous.zh: 科托作了一场令人惊叹的演出。

stupendous.en: He was a man of stupendous stamina and energy.
stupendous.zh: 他是个有着一流耐力、精力充沛的人。

stupendous.en: This stupendous novel keeps you gripped to the end.
stupendous.zh: 这部精彩的小说会让你想一口气读完。

stubby.en: He pointed a stubby finger at a wooden chair opposite him.
stubby.zh: 他用粗短的手指指了指他对面的一把木椅。

stubby.en: Through stubby spinneys of akeake, I saw the bend of a river, as silvery as the underside of a fern.
stubby.zh: 透过矮壮的新西兰坡柳小树林我看到了河湾， 像蕨类植物叶子背面一样闪着银光。

stubby.en: These species also differ morphologically: grass dwellers are slender with long tails, tree-dwellers are stocky with long legs, twig dwellers are slender but stubby -legged.
stubby.zh: 这些物种在形态上也有所不同：呆在草上的动物体型纤细， 尾巴很长；呆在树上的动物体格健壮， 腿长；而呆在树枝的动物体型纤细， 但腿短。

stumbling block.en: The major stumbling block in the talks has been money.
stumbling block.zh: 谈判的主要绊脚石一直是钱。

stumbling block.en: Conflicts between the Israelis and Palestinians have been called a major stumbling block to Middle East peace.
stumbling block.zh: 以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的冲突被称为中东和平的主要绊脚石。

stumbling block.en: However, there is still a big stumbling block.
stumbling block.zh: 然而， 仍然有一个很大的障碍。

stumbling block.en: Milton's own faculty of memory - this is the idea that I'm going to be floating here - seems to provide something like, or pose a stumbling block or an obstacle for, his attempt to write an original, divinely inspired poem.
stumbling block.zh: 在这里我想说,弥尔顿自己的记忆系统,似乎想提供某种东西，或者想在他写出一部原创的，伟大的诗作的尝试上设置一个障碍。

stupor.en: The pain roused him from his drunken stupor.
stupor.zh: 疼痛让他从醉酒昏迷中醒过来。

stupor.en: He came home to find her in a drunken stupor.
stupor.zh: 他回到家里发现她处于酒后恍惚状态。

stupor.en: He drank himself into a stupor.
Suppose Parker in his semi- stupor says "Okay."
stupor.zh: 假设派克在半昏迷状态下说了，好的“

subcutaneous.en: Birds store energy as subcutaneous fat deposits or " body reserves "; changes in these reserves can be reliably estimated by measuring changes in body mass.
subcutaneous.zh: 鸟类以皮下脂肪沉积或 “身体储备”的形式储存能量； 通过测量体重的变化， 可以可靠地估计这些储备的变化。

subcutaneous.en: The skin consists of three layers: the epidermis, dermis and subcutaneous tissue.
subcutaneous.zh: 皮肤有三层： 表皮、 真皮和皮下组织。

subcutaneous.en: In the first stage, the trypanosomes multiply in subcutaneous tissues, blood and lymph.
subcutaneous.zh: 在第一阶段， 锥虫在皮下组织、 血液和淋巴中繁殖。

sturdy.en: She was a short, sturdy woman in her early sixties.
sturdy.zh: 她是一位六十出头、 矮小结实的女人。

sturdy.en: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.
sturdy.zh: 如果你必须爬上去，就用一个稳固的平台或者一个结实的梯子。

sturdy.en: They would peel large sheets of bark from the tree to form lightweight yet sturdy canoes.
sturdy.zh: 他们会从树上剥下大片的树皮， 做成轻便而结实的独木舟。

sturdy.en: His typical American farmer, Farmer James, was of course a Pennsylvanian sturdy, probably had some German blood in him.
sturdy.zh: 是一个典型美国农民,他是一个宾夕法尼亚人,强壮,也许还带有一些德国血统

sturdy.en: I think Freud would say that women have superegos, they're just not the sort of sturdy ones that men have.
sturdy.zh: 我想弗洛伊德会说，女性也是有超我的，但她们的超我并没有男性的超我强大。

subject matter.en: The choice of subject matter is irrelevant.
She's searching for subject matter for her new book.
subject matter.zh: 她要写一部新书， 正寻找题材。

subject matter.en: His choice of subject matter has been regarded as lowbrow.
subject matter.zh: 他选择的主题被认为是浅薄的。

subject matter.en: Now the subject matter that he's chosen for this poem, for this so - called first poem, couldn't possibly be more appropriate.
subject matter.zh: 现在他选这首诗的主题很重要，这所谓第一首诗可能不太恰当。

subject matter.en: Very frequently, as is the case in Gadamer, this meaning is called "the subject matter ": that is to say, what - - in thinking about literature in terms of form and content, let's say - - we'd call "content."
subject matter.zh: 高达美，又把这一含义称为主题：,当我们研究文学的,形式和内容方面时，主题即内容“

subliminal.en: Colour has a profound, though often subliminal, influence on our senses and moods.
subliminal.zh: 颜色对我们的感觉和情绪有一种很深远的影响， 尽管常常是潜意识的。

subliminal.en: Such sentences do not always occur in thinking, and when they do they are merged with vague imagery and the hint of unconscious or subliminal activities going on just out of range.
subliminal.zh: 这样的句子并不总是出现在思维中，即使出现了， 它们也会与模糊的意象和无意识或潜意识活动的暗示混杂在一起。

subliminal.en: And yes, the unconscious effects of subliminal images may be a variant of blindsight, although the jury remains out on just how similar the two phenomena are.
subliminal.zh: 是的， 飞快的图像造成的无意识效果也许是盲视的一种变形， 尽管这两种现象之间的相似之处的评判还在进行当中。

subliminal.en: Another example is some weird studies done in a discipline of social psychology known as terror management which involves subliminal death primes.
subliminal.zh: 另一个例子是在社会心理学中进行的,关于恐惧管理的一些古怪的研究,恐惧管理涉及到了,阈下死亡意念的促发。

subliminal.en: The idea of subliminal death primes is this.
subliminal.zh: 阈下死亡意念的促发是这样进行的。

subliminal.en: The flashing of these subliminal words, a fancy term meaning below the level of consciousness, you don't know you're seeing them has dramatic effects on how you answer those questions.
subliminal.zh: 这些阈下词语的闪现，“阈下“是指低于意识水平，“subliminal “，meaning，–,也就是说你并没有察觉到，自己在看这些词语,阈下词汇的闪现对你如何回答那些问题,产生了显著的影响。

subject.zh: 生物是我最喜欢的学科。
英语是我学得最好的一门科目。

subject.en: Prices may be subject to alteration.
subject.zh: 价格可能会受变更影响。

subject.en: So the reasons for this really enormous shift in plans, and the enormous shift in subject matter, are worth exploring.
subject.zh: 弥尔顿的计划变化为何如此之大，他对主题的选择为何有这么大的改变，是值得探究的。

subject.en: So you know, that's not a class that MIT is... subject MIT is typically known for, but we have everything, so...
subject.zh: 你知道，麻省理工学院没有什么特别出名的课程，但是我们的课程涵盖一切领域。所以……

subdued.en: He seemed a bit subdued to me.
subdued.zh: 我觉得他当时有点闷闷不乐。

subdued.en: The two would sit together on the Heidi's favorite spot, and Peter, quite subdued, behind them.
subdued.zh: 他们俩就一起坐在海蒂最喜欢的地方， 彼得则闷闷不乐地跟在他们后面。

subdued.en: One by one he subdued his father's trees By riding them down over and over again Until he took the stiffness out of them - And not one but hung limp, not one was left for him to conquer.
subdued.zh: 他一株一株地征服他父亲的树,一次又一次地把它们骑在胯下,直到把树的倔强劲儿完全制服：,一株又一株都垂头丧气地低下来。

subdued.en: Having thus subdued her, he extinguished her life.
subdued.zh: 征服了她之后，他结束了她的性命。

sublimity.en: Huckleberry was filled with admiration of Tom's facility in writing, and the sublimity of his language.
sublimity.zh: 哈克贝利对汤姆流畅的文笔，豪迈的话语，十分钦佩。

sublimity.en: Its true spirit lies in sublimity and divinity.
sublimity.zh: 教育的真精神在于教育的高贵性和神性。

sublimity.en: The soul which loves and suffers is in a state of sublimity.
sublimity.zh: 在恋爱和痛苦中的心灵是处在卓绝的状态中。

subservient.en: Her willingness to be subservient to her children isolated her.
subservient.zh: 她对她的孩子们顺从的意愿使她陷于孤立。

subservient.en: The woman's needs are seen as subservient to the group interest.
subservient.zh: 这名妇女的需要被视为从属于集体利益。

subservient.en: That is to say, it is subservient to the natural world; its importance is that it refers to that world.
subservient.zh: 也就是说，这些学科都是自然世界的奴仆;,它们存在的价值就是去解释那个自然世界。

subservient.en: They are subservient to an idea that they have to express, which is the idea of God, right, and God is real.
subservient.zh: 它们臣服于那个需要它们阐释的观点，上帝的观点，是的，上帝也是实实在在的。

subpar.en: Employees lacked professional credentials, he said; equipment and materials were subpar.
subpar.zh: 员工缺乏专业认证； 设备和材料不达标。

subpar.en: The trick is to not feel subpar when a travel snob overshadows your story with one of their own.
subpar.zh: 当你遇到高傲的旅客用他们的经历来贬低你的时候， 窍门就是别觉得自己低人一等。

subtext.zh: 潜台词并不是那么晦涩。

subtext.en: The subtext was clear: “ You can trust us; we ’re pure.”
subtext.zh: 潜台词很清楚：“你可以相信我们， 我们很单纯。”

subtext.en: The subtext is that much tougher regulation is required.
subtext.zh: 这句话的潜台词是， 更加强硬的调控是必须的。

subtext.en: With this accusation of the misuse of borrowed funds, we recognize the strange and, I think in this context, rather ill-fitting subtext behind Comus' seduction.
subtext.zh: 通过误用钱币的指责，在这个文本中，我们发现了Comus其中的诡异，和其唆使背后的潜台词。

substratum.en: There is a broad substratum of truth in it.
substratum.zh: 这其中有广泛的事实做基础。

substratum.en: The settlement of pile top in pile foundationconsists of pile compression and settlement of substratum.
substratum.zh: 采用实体深基础法的思想， 桩顶沉降分为桩身压缩和桩端沉降。

substratum.en: After cable duct construction, the Permit Holder shall reinstate the affected stream bed of Ho Chung River to its original conditions using natural substratum.
substratum.zh: 在电缆管道建成后， 许可证持有人须用天然底土修复受影响的蚝涌溪流河床，使其回复原貌。

stumbling-block.en: The major stumbling block in the talks has been money.
stumbling-block.zh: 谈判的主要绊脚石一直是钱。

stumbling-block.en: Conflicts between the Israelis and Palestinians have been called a major stumbling block to Middle East peace.
stumbling-block.zh: 以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的冲突被称为中东和平的主要绊脚石。

stumbling-block.en: However, there is still a big stumbling block.
stumbling-block.zh: 然而， 仍然有一个很大的障碍。

stumbling-block.en: Milton's own faculty of memory - this is the idea that I'm going to be floating here - seems to provide something like, or pose a stumbling block or an obstacle for, his attempt to write an original, divinely inspired poem.
stumbling-block.zh: 在这里我想说,弥尔顿自己的记忆系统,似乎想提供某种东西，或者想在他写出一部原创的，伟大的诗作的尝试上设置一个障碍。

subsume.en: Subsume all of the military under one, with authority.
subsume.zh: 把军事部门归总于一个部门并授予权限。

subsume.en: In order to handle this aspect, subsume relationships are of prime importance.
subsume.zh: 为了处理方面这， 包含关系具有重要性最好时期。

subsume.en: In the opportunity choosing mode, we subsume the business and tourism as the group for choosing.
subsume.zh: 在机遇型产业导向选择中， 本文将商贸、 旅游业纳入待选支柱产业群。

subsume.en: You know, yes, yes, you know, we care about you, but you have to subsume your interest, your personal interest.
subsume.zh: 是的，是的，你懂的，我们关注你，但你必须让个人利益服从集体利益。

subtlety.en: She analyses herself with great subtlety.
subtlety.zh: 她非常敏锐地分析了自己。

subtlety.en: African dance is vigorous, but full of subtlety, requiring great strength and control.
subtlety.zh: 非洲舞蹈很有活力， 但充满微妙性， 需要很大的力量和很强的控制力。

subtlety.en: Nobody that we have dealt with has ever taken as much time to understand the subtlety of the science and all the different complications.
subtlety.zh: 我们接触过的所有人都没有像阿尔·戈尔那样花那么多时间去理解科学的微妙之处和各种各样的复杂情况。

subtlety.en: Rather, his subtlety shows itself in his deliberate concealment of it, in the ways in which he masks himself in obviousness.
subtlety.zh: 他的狡猾表现在他故意地隐藏这种隐约，而且是以很直白的方式表现的。

subtlety.en: OK. Now, having said that, and I've actually got a subtlety I'm going to come back to in a second, there ought to be a better way to do this. OK?
subtlety.zh: 我们已经明白了一些，一会儿要讲的微妙之处,应该有更好的方法对不对？,应该有更好的思路的？

subtlety.en: So it isn't that Hitchcock is not capable of writing of subtlety He knows everything he does.
subtlety.zh: 所以不是希区柯克,不能写出很微妙的东西,他知道他在干什么。

suburban.en: And there isn't good public transportation from inner city Detroit to those suburban malls.
suburban.zh: 从底特律市中心到那些市郊的商场并没有好的公共交通。

suburban.en: Meg is a lawyer-mom in suburban Washington, D.C.
suburban.zh: 梅格是华盛顿郊区的一名律师妈妈。

suburban.en: At first sight it looked like a typical suburban road accident.
suburban.zh: 乍一看， 这像是一起典型的郊区交通事故。

suburban.en: And in it you really talk about what it is to grow up as a Muslim in suburban America.
suburban.zh: 在这本书中，您讲到了,作为一位穆斯林，在美国市郊成长的经历。

suburban.en: L.A.'s not as exciting as New York, I guess. It's more suburban and residential than New York.
suburban.zh: 我认为洛杉矶没有纽约精彩，她更属于郊区，更适宜居住。

succulent.en: Think of purslane as a great alternative to lettuce: the leaves and stems are crisp, chewy, succulent, and they have a mild lemony taste.
succulent.zh: 把马齿苋想成是生菜的一个伟大的替代品： 叶和茎是脆的、 耐嚼、 多汁， 而且它们有淡淡的柠檬味。

succulent.en: The different vegetational parts differ in their food qualities: lower down, there are succulent, nutritious leaves; higher up are the harder stems.
succulent.zh: 植物的不同部位具有不同的食用价值：靠下面的部位是营养、 多汁的叶子；上面更高的部位则是更为坚硬的茎杆。

succulent.en: The early explorers and settlers told of abundant deer in the early 1800 s and yet almost in the same breath bemoaned the lack of this succulent game animal.
succulent.zh: 早期的探险家和殖民者都讲述过十九世纪早期出现的大量的鹿群， 但几乎同时，他们也为现在很难找到这种美味的猎物而感到惋惜。

suitor.en: My mother had a suitor who adored her.
suitor.zh: 我的母亲曾有一位爱慕她的求婚者。

suitor.en: The company was making little progress in trying to find a suitor.
suitor.zh: 该公司在寻找一家求购公司方面进展甚微。

suitor.en: The new judge is 50-year-old David Suitor who's regarded as a conservative.
suitor.zh: 这名新法官是 50 岁的、被视为右倾人士的戴维·休特。

suitor.en: I heard one of them say to an imaginary suitor, "and you without health or a home."
suitor.zh: 我听到有人对臆想的原告说，你没有健康，你没有家庭“

suffice it to say.en: Suffice it to say that afterwards we never met again.
suffice it to say.zh: 不必多言， 后来我们再也没见过面。

suffice it to say.en: Suffice it to say that the gun was his.
suffice it to say.zh: 只要说那枝枪是他的就够了。

suffice it to say.en: Suffice it to say, it can really hurt your career if not done properly.
suffice it to say.zh: 我只蜻蜓点水地提一提： 如果操作不当， 它可能会损害你的事业。

suck it up.en: Warriors push through it and suck it up, right?
suck it up.zh: 勇士促使它完成并从中吸取能量， 对不对？

suck it up.en: Suck it up, because rewriting is one of the most important steps in writing your screenplay.
suck it up.zh: 算了， 因为改写是创作剧本过程中的一项最重要的步骤。

suck it up.en: But businesses don't exist to make us feel accepted. Shouldn't employees just suck it up?
suck it up.zh: 但是商业不是为了让我们获得认同感， 难道雇员不只是简单的奉承？

sulk.en: He went off to sulk in his room.
sulk.zh: 他回到自己屋里， 生起闷气来。

sulk.en: Jo was in a sulk upstairs.
He went off in a sulk.
It's not that the facts about death give you reason to stay in your room and sulk.
sulk.zh: 不是说关于死亡的事实,给了你呆在房间里生气的理由。

sulk.en: It's just that the facts about death cause you to stay in your room and sulk.
sulk.zh: 而只是说关于死亡的事实,导致你呆在房间里生气。

sullen.en: She gave him a sullen glare.
sullen.zh: 她满脸不高兴地瞪了他一眼。
鲍勃脸色苍白，闷闷不乐。

sullen.en: The offenders lapsed into a sullen silence.
sullen.zh: 这些罪犯陷入了愤懑的沉默。

sullen.en: And by his smile, I knew that sullen hall,-- By his dead smile I knew we stood in Hell.
sullen.zh: 看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂-,看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂。

sullen.en: Reopen no old wounds. Be as if you had never returned and looked in to me to see my laboring humilities, my few scrubbed pennies, hungry to grab, quick to deprive, sullen, unloved, mean-minded son of my flesh. Son! Son!"
sullen.zh: 不要再来碰我的伤疤，像你从前没有回来看过我似的,来看我的辛苦和谦卑，看我被掏得一干二净的钱袋，饿了抢，急了打，我亲生的没有感情，冷酷自私的儿子！“

sudsy.en: I tossed my husband's dishes into the sudsy water.
sudsy.zh: 拿起丈夫从盘子扔进满是泡沫的水池里。

sudsy.en: Don't use plasticor paper throw-away products and do dishes together out of a sudsy bucket usinggreen dishwashing soap.
sudsy.zh: 不要使用塑料或是纸质的一次性产品， 一起下厨烹饪几道可口的菜肴， 使用绿色洗碗皂代替桶装肥皂水。

sudsy.en: Fox knocked some snow off his window and dipped a rag into a bucket of sudsy water. " I think it's because the snow doesn't stick to Windows when they are clean," said Fox.
sudsy.zh: 狐狸先生扫落了窗户上的雪， 又把抹布放到装满肥皂水里的桶里洗了洗，才说道，“我想， 这可能是因为窗子擦干净后，雪就不会再粘在上面了吧。”

summum bonum.en: This is what our summum bonum is.
summum bonum.zh: 这才是我们的至善之所在。

sunken.en: Her eyes were sunken and black-ringed.
sunken.zh: 她的双眼凹陷且有黑眼圈。

sunken.en: The sunken sail boat was a glimmer of white on the bottom.
sunken.zh: 这条沉没的帆船在海底呈一道白色微光。

sunken.en: This sighting occurred during my dive to a sunken wreck off Sardinia.
sunken.zh: 这次亲眼所见发生在我向撒丁岛外一艘沉船潜水的期间。

sunken.en: The moon says to him:]'Oh, I've been scanning pond and hole And waterway hereabout For the body of one with a sunken soul Who has put his life-light out.
sunken.zh: 月亮对他说],哦，我一直在审视着池塘和地洞,还有在附近的排水沟,因为一个人的灵魂已沦陷,熄灭了他的生命之光。

sundry.en: The club is open to all and sundry.
sundry.zh: 这个俱乐部什么人都可以加入。

sundry.en: She was known to all and sundry as Bella.
I made tea for all and sundry at the office.
sundry.zh: 我为该办公室里的每个人沏了茶。

summary execution.en: Summary: When debugging kernel problems, being able to trace the kernel execution and examine its memory and data structures is very useful.
summary execution.zh: 简介： 调试内核问题时， 能够跟踪内核执行情况并查看其内存和数据结构是非常有用的。

summary execution.en: The summary is displayed in graphical format showing the test execution status based on the test execution results.
summary execution.zh: 总结会以图像化的格式显示出来，它显示了基于测试执行结果的测试执行状态。

summary execution.en: If you don't select that option, the default format builds a report file that summarizes the selected runs and creates individual HTML files for each selected execution linked from the summary page.
summary execution.zh: 如果不选择该项，则默认构建一个报告文件， 该文件概述了选定的运行， 并为每个选定的实执行建立单个 HTML 文件。

superior.zh: 他总是显得那么有优越感。
芬奇富有优越感地一笑。
敌人拥有战术上的优势。

superior.en: Roman doctrine, of course, had prized the state of celibacy, insisting that it was the superior state over marriage.

talon.en: The TALON SWORDS is one of the robots most recently fielded in Iraq.
talon.zh: 是最近装备在伊拉克的机器人之一。

talon.en: Dampening Talon: This ability will now show up as its own icon when it is affecting a target.
talon.zh: 潮湿之爪： 当这个技能影响一个目标的时候， 将显示自己的图标。(看了半天没懂，直译是这样的。)

tallow.en: Don't you know one about bacon and tallow candles?
tallow.zh: 你不知道一个关于腊肉和蜡烛的故事吗？

tallow.en: There are Palm butter, Palm tallow, Elaeis guineensis oil.
tallow.zh: 有棕榈油， 棕榈脂， 油棕油。

tallow.en: Boil the tallow in the water. Skim and keep skimming.
tallow.zh: 把动物脂放在水里煮，把漂浮物统统捞起来。

tambourine.en: He was slapping his tambourine against his maroon wide-wale corduroys.
tambourine.zh: 他拿着小手鼓拍打着他栗色的宽边灯芯绒衣服。

tambourine.en: Joseph played the drums, and sometimes the tambourine, in a band called Fields of Grass.
tambourine.zh: 约瑟夫在一个名叫“草地”的乐队敲鼓， 有的时候则敲手鼓。

tambourine.en: She stood biting her lip, watching, for nearly an hour, until Joseph put his tambourine down and opened his eyes.
tambourine.zh: 她咬着嘴唇站在那里， 看着，等了将近一个小时， 直到约瑟夫放下手鼓， 睁开眼睛。

tamper-proof.en: It is built on the hardened, tamper-proof DataPower platform.
tamper-proof.zh: 它构建于经过硬化的防篡改 datapower平台上。

tamper-proof.en: To prevent a recurrence, the FDA mandated new tamper-proof seals for over - the - counter drugs.
tamper-proof.zh: 为避免此类状况再次发生， 美国食品管理局对非处方药的非干扰密封做出了新的规定。

tamper-proof.en: Once they do, they ’re presented with a tamper-proof reward screen they can show the retailer to redeem the prize.
tamper-proof.zh: 一旦他们完成了任务， 屏幕上就会出现防篡改的奖励画面，他们可以将它出示给零售商兑换奖励。

tantalizing.en: A tantalizing aroma of roast beef fills the air.
tantalizing.zh: 烤牛肉诱人的香味弥漫在空气中。

tantalizing.en: The tantalizing aroma of fresh coffee wafted towards them.
tantalizing.zh: 新鲜咖啡那诱人的香味向他们飘来。

tantalizing.en: By a tantalizing quirk of fate, the pair have been drawn to meet in the first round of the championship.
tantalizing.zh: 由于命运的捉弄， 这对选手被抽中在锦标赛的第一轮相遇。

tall tales.en: Father spends his anger like a profligate; just a few hard strokes to endure, and by evening he'll be consoling us with tall tales and oranges that fit perfectly in our palms.
tall tales.zh: 父亲发泄起怒火来就像个败家子儿， 只需要忍受寥寥几下狠抽， 到了晚上， 他就会用荒诞不经的故事和正好能握在掌心里的橙子来安慰我们。

tall tales.en: In their attempts to distance themselves psychologically from their tall tales, liars will tend to communicate using fewer personal pronouns.
tall tales.zh: 从心理学上讲， 撒谎者会试图与其所吹的大话拉远距离， 他们会倾向于少用人称代词。

tall tales.en: Spices that once commanded exorbitant prices - and prompted merchants to invent tall tales to obscure their origins - can now be found in the supermarket.
tall tales.zh: 曾经价格奇昂的香料 —— 促使商人为掩盖产地而编造谎言—— 如今则可在超市购得。

tangible.en: Unlike meditation, craft activities result in tangible and often useful products that can enhance self-esteem.
tangible.zh: 与冥想不同的是， 手工活动会产生有形的、 往往有用的产品， 这些产品可以增强自尊。

tangible.en: But unlike meditation, craft activities result in tangible and often useful products that can enhance self-esteem.
tangible.zh: 但与冥想不同的是， 手工活动会产生有形的、 往往有用的产品， 可以增强自尊心。

tangible.en: They would have to concentrate on natural processes that continue at a constant rate and that also leave some sort of tangible record in the rocks.
tangible.zh: 他们必须专注于以恒定速度持续的自然过程， 并且在岩石中留下某种有形的记录。

tangible.en: There's something else I wanted to say to indicate this notion of men being the polis as opposed to anything tangible.
tangible.zh: 我还想说点其他的,来解释一下人是城邦人,而不是任何实体地方的人这样的观点

tangible.en: So, if you want to designate anything it has to be by tangible things like pottery,particularly painted pottery,because it's easier to categorize.
tangible.zh: 所以如果你想标注某段时期,你必须借助有形的事物,就像陶器,尤其是彩绘陶器,因为它们更容易分类

tarry.en: Hugo did not tarry for the miracle.
tarry.zh: 雨果并没有等待奇迹的出现。
我闻到了柏油熔化了的味道。

tarry.en: Why not tarry yet a little?
tarry.zh: 为什么不再多待一会儿呢？

task force.en: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
task force.zh: 去年， 一个联邦特别工作组敦促对基因检测相关的专利进行改革。

task force.en: The task force is comprised of congressional leaders, cabinet heads and administration officials.
task force.zh: 该任务队由国会领导人、 内阁首脑和行政官员构成。

task force.en: The mayor's handpicked task force has now begun prosecuting a dozen city officials.
task force.zh: 市长亲自挑选的工作小组现在已经开始起诉十几名市政官员。

tarnished.en: Accusations of tax evasion have tarnished his clean image.
tarnished.zh: 逃税的指控玷污了他清廉的形象。

tarnished.en: The mirrors had tarnished with age.
tarnished.zh: 这些镜子因年深日久而照影不清楚。

tarnished.en: The silver candlesticks were tarnished and dusty.
tarnished.zh: 银烛台都发乌了，满是灰尘。

tattletale.en: Tattletale! I'll make you pay for snitching on me!
tattletale.zh: 大嘴巴！ 你把我的秘密说出去了，我要你付出代价！

tattletale.en: Knowing all the details helps frame the situation, allows for the best decision-making to occur and makes you look like a mature and informed colleague rather than an opportunistic tattletale.
tattletale.zh: 知道所有细节有助于了解总体情况， 可以做出最好的决策， 也能使你看起来像个成熟和明智的员工， 而不是投机取巧、搬弄是非的人。

tapestry.en: The walls were covered with tapestry with a forest scene embroidered on it.
tapestry.zh: 墙上挂着绣有森林景色的挂毯。

tapestry.en: She put her hand accidentally upon the tapestry near her, and then sprang back, feeling quite startled.
tapestry.zh: 她不小心把手放在身边的挂毯上， 然后吓得后退， 感到十分吃惊。

tapestry.en: Yes, there was the tapestry door.
tapestry.zh: 没错，挂了壁毯的门在这。

tapestry.en: Each book, each writer, each voice reflects another thread in the rich tapestry of human experience, human response to life and its puzzles, human reflection on the sublime and the depraved.
tapestry.zh: 每本书，每个作者，每种声音,反映了纷繁人类历程画卷中的一个侧面,人类对生活和生活困惑的反应，人类对高尚和腐败的思考。

tapestry.en: I tried to find it on Google really quick and nothing came up, but I think there is this idea of how you organize a tapestry in that fashion.
tapestry.zh: 我试图在谷歌上查找但是没有结果,但是我想有这么个想法,就是怎么用那种方式编织挂毯

tattle.en: Love really need courage to face the tattle and prate.
tattle.zh: 爱真的需要勇气， 来面对流言蜚语。

tattle.en: The two gossips, when coming together, would tittle- tattle to the slander of others.
tattle.zh: 那两个长舌妇，碰到一起时总要喋喋不休地诽谤别人。

tattle.en: Like Western celebrities, they excite much tattle, albeit not in the party-controlled media.
tattle.zh: 像西方名人一样， 他们的私生活引起人们的极大兴趣—— 尽管不能见诸党控制的媒体。

tattle.en: Did you hear his frenzied tattle?
tattle.zh: 你听见这疯狂的闲谈了吗？

taunt.en: He became a taunt to his neighbours.
taunt.zh: 他成了邻居们嘲讽的对象。

taunt.en: They do not taunt you to finish what you started.
taunt.zh: 它们并不会在一旁嘲笑你，迫使你看完已经开始的书。

taunt.en: Don't chant things like " loser " or taunt them when they lose.
taunt.zh: 不要反复喊着 “失败者” 或者奚落他们。

taut.en: She began to hear her own taut, shallow breathing.
taut.zh: 她开始听到自己紧张、 短促的呼吸。

taut.en: His body was solid and taut.
taut.zh: 他身体结实， 肌肉发达。

taut.en: Her face was taut and pale.
taut.zh: 她神色紧张， 脸色苍白。

tautology.en: A tautology that evolves in time?
tautology.zh: 一个同义反复的进化时间？

tautology.en: Application of this to tautology and contradiction.
tautology.zh: 应用于重言式和矛盾式。

tautology.en: The reason it looks like a tautology, because you look around, nothing seems to have its velocity forever.
tautology.zh: 其原因听起来像是绕圈子,因为你看看四周,似乎一切都不可能永远运动下去

tautology.en: What's important in My Fair Lady is to - repeat the repetitiousness of verse-- the rain in spain falls mainly on the plain -in terms of the tautology of the plot.
tautology.zh: 重要的是窈窕淑女中,这种韵律的加强-,“西班牙之雨大多洒落于平原之上“,韵律的反复加强了情节。

tax credit.en: Another proposal would make a tax credit for research and development permanent.
tax credit.zh: 另一项提案是为研发制定固定的税收减免方案。

tax credit.en: Proposes to increase the child and dependent care tax credit.
tax credit.zh: 建议增加儿童和家属照管的税收优惠。

tax credit.en: But the tax credit that has been driving its growth is about to expire.
tax credit.zh: 不过， 一直驱动本州经济增长的税收抵免即将结束。

teaser.en: Note that the teaser image shows a fireman holding a baby.
teaser.zh: 看看这幅图片，画着一个消防员举着一个婴儿。

teaser.en: A teaser is one way to advertise, and a homepage advertises too ( even a website ).
teaser.zh: 内容摘要就是广告的一种方式， 而首页也是在做广告( 甚至是一个网站)。

teaser.en: This data includes the node type, title, teaser, body, creator, and creation time.
teaser.zh: 这些数据包含节点类型、 标题、 摘要、 主体、创建者和创建时间。

teaser.en: Well, let's just give a teaser of some of the details before we move on to actual interesting functionality.
teaser.zh: 在转去介绍,其他更实际有趣的知识前,我先让大家注意一个小细节。

teaser.en: And it turns out-- a little teaser for our security discussion as time passes that a lot of the times when software is compromised and you download Photoshop like a cracked version of Photoshop or something like that.
teaser.zh: 这对于即将讨论的安全性问题来说,只是一个小插曲，随着科技的发展,很多时候，如果工具受损,你会下载到一个版本不全的,或其他类似的东西。

teaser.en: But it turns out that on Macs and if you have the right software on PCs, you can kind of get a teaser of what this environment tends to look like and be forewarned, what you're about to see is intentionally very underwhelming.
teaser.zh: 事实上，它是运行在苹果机上的,如果你在电脑上有正确的软件，可以去看看这个环境大致是怎么样的,提前说下，这个程序不会让你印象深刻,我是故意这样做的。

tear-stained.zh: 罗尼克擦干沾满泪水的脸。

tear-stained.en: Obama's tear-stained cheeks, a tear streams down his cheek.
tear-stained.zh: 奥巴马泪水沾湿的脸颊， 一滴眼泪顺着脸颊流下。

tear-stained.en: I found a crumpled tear-stained sheet stuffed in the back of his desk, an English paper.
tear-stained.zh: 我在他桌子深处找到一张皱巴巴的满是泪迹的纸。

taxing.en: Since there is no way for me to avoid exams, I am currently questioning what kind are the most taxing and ultimately beneficial.
taxing.zh: 既然无法逃避考试， 于是我目前在想，哪种考试是最费力但根本上是有益的。

taxing.en: This shouldn't be too taxing for you.
taxing.zh: 这对你来说不至于太费劲。

taxing.en: It's unlikely that you'll be asked to do anything too taxing.
taxing.zh: 不大可能叫你去做任何太费劲的事。

taxing.en: And the poor don't deserve, don't deserve the benefits that would flow from taxing Michael Jordan to help them.
taxing.zh: 你是说穷人不应得到这些福利,不值得通过向乔丹征税来救济他们。

taxing.en: Are you saying that taxing Michael Jordan, say, at a 33 percent tax rate for good causes to feed the hungry is theft?
taxing.zh: 你是说按33%的税率向乔丹征税,来支持公益事业，解决温饱是盗窃行为吗？

technophobe.en: He was a complete technophobe who never used e-mail.
technophobe.zh: 他是一个特别惧怕科技的人，从没用过电子邮件。

technophobe.en: As a resolute technophobe, Buffett sat out the incredible run-up in technology stocks during the late 1990 s.
technophobe.zh: 作为一名坚决的技术恐惧者， 巴菲特坐视 90 年代科技股不可思议的暴涨。

technophobe.en: If this criticism of Google, Facebook, Twitter and Wikipedia had come from an outsider-a dyed-in-the-wool technophobe -then nobody would have paid much attention.
technophobe.zh: 如果这个矛头直指谷歌， 脸书， 微博， 维基的批评来自于一个外行人 —一个彻透彻脑的电脑白痴—那么谁也不会有什么反应。

technophobia.zh: 随着年龄的增长， 技术恐惧感越来越强烈。

technophobia.en: Simple technophobia is not usually the reason.
technophobia.zh: 简单地说是技术恐惧症不是常见原因。

technophobia.en: Another reason not to get too excited is the reflexive conservatism and technophobia of medical folk.
technophobia.zh: 另一个不至于变得过于刺激的原因在于反弹性的保守主义和医学大众的科技恐惧。

technophile.en: Arthur Antin is my 83 - year - old technophile grandfather.
technophile.zh: 亚瑟 · 昂丹是我八十三岁的祖父， 一名技术兴趣者。

technophile.en: Even in technophile California people have started to resist smart meters.
technophile.zh: 即使是在技术之都的加利福尼亚， 人们都开始排斥智能电表了。

teeny.en: Spiders do not take well to farming, and as they are mostly teeny little creatures, they don't produce enough silk to be useful in large-scale production.
teeny.zh: 蜘蛛不适宜大规模养殖， 而且由于蜘蛛多为微小的生物，所以它们产出的蛛丝不足以用于大规模生产。

teeny.en: I'll tackle that teeny, tiny problem in my column next week.
teeny.zh: 下个星期， 我会在我的专栏里解决一下这个小而又小的问题。

teeny.en: Secretly he'll freak out if you take him to Ruth's Chris, even just the one teeny time.
teeny.zh: 如果你带他去茹丝葵， 他会私下里高兴得发疯的， 就算你只带他去一次。

teeny.en: I mean they take up a teeny bit but essentially when we're thinking about the set up of the atom, we don't have to account for them as using up a lot of the mass we're discussing.
teeny.zh: 所以我们可以假设电子没有质量,它们占据了，非常小的一部分,所以当我们考虑,原子的构造的时候,不用考虑它们的质量。

teeny.en: With her" is a very teeny -tiny little word in Hebrew, so I guess a lot of translations figure they can leave it out.
teeny.zh: 和她一起“，在希伯来语中，是一个无足轻重的词，所以，我猜想很多翻译大家，把它省略了。

teeny.en: Now we can think about the fourth period, and the fourth period is where we start to run into some exceptions, so this is where things get a teeny bit more complicated, but you just need to remember the exceptions and then you should be OK, no matter what you're asked to write.
teeny.zh: 现在我们可以考虑第四周期，而且在第四周期,我们会遇上一些特例，所以事情有,一点复杂，但是你只需要记住,这些特例然后就没有问题了，无论你被要求写什么。

teetotaler.en: Perhaps this was partly because he was a nonsmoker and a teetotaler.
teetotaler.zh: 这也许一半是由于他不吸烟、也不喝酒的缘故。

teetotaler.en: She always refuses wine and only drinks water - I think she's a teetotaler.
teetotaler.zh: 她总是拒绝喝酒， 只肯喝水 —— 我想她是个禁酒主义者。

teetotaler.en: My Dad was a teetotaler who didn't permit alcohol in the home, not even for cooking.
teetotaler.zh: 我爸爸是一位不准许在家里出现酒精甚至用于做饭的酒精的滴酒不沾者。

teleology.en: What room does teleology leave for freedom?
teleology.zh: 目的论给自由留下了空间吗？

teleology.en: That order was known from Nature and its teleology.
teleology.zh: 这个秩序是从自然中和它的目的论中所发现的。

teleology.en: If there is one common thread to much of Aristotle's work it lies in his conception of teleology, or purpose.
teleology.zh: 如果亚里斯· 多德的著作中有一个共同的主轴的话， 即是在于他的目的论这个概念。

teleology.en: It has a project; it has a teleology.
teleology.zh: 这既有计划性;,也有目的性。

telepathy.en: You never tell me what you're thinking. Am I supposed to use telepathy?
telepathy.zh: 你从来不告诉我你在想什么。 我是不是该用心灵感应术呢？

telepathy.en: The implication was that the ganzfeld method had revealed real evidence for telepathy.
telepathy.zh: 这意味着甘兹菲尔德的方法揭示了心灵感应的真实证据。

telepathy.en: The problem stems at least in part from the lack of any plausible mechanism for telepathy.
telepathy.zh: 这个问题至少部分是源于缺乏合理的心灵感应机制。

teleological.en: The teleological framework of reasoning, I believe
teleological.zh: 目的论的推论的原则， 我相信

teleological.en: Can evolution evolve its own teleological purpose?
teleological.zh: 进化能进化自己的目的吗？

teleological.en: Well, in line with his teleological account of justice.
teleological.zh: 嗯， 在他那正义的目的论，在其叙述的主线上。

teleological.en: Observance of God's commandments is, as Levenson puts it, the teleological end of history.
teleological.zh: 遵守上帝的戒条，是这段历史的目的。

teleological.en: He sets out to give a deliberately and thoroughly materialistic and non- teleological physics of human nature.
teleological.zh: 他阐明了一种,谨慎而彻底的唯物主义的,非目的论的人性的物理。

temporality.en: Could “the access to pluridimensionality and to a delinearized temporality ” really be a subject?
temporality.zh: 对多元维度和去线性化的暂时性二者的接触”能算真正的主语吗？

temporality.en: IPR generally have the features of intangibility, exclusivity, territoriality and temporality.
temporality.zh: 知识产权一般具有无形性、专用性、 地域性、 时间性特征。

temporality.en: But this change of the relationship between art and time also changes the temporality of art itself.
temporality.zh: 但这种艺术与时间关系的变化也使艺术的时间性和艺术本身也发生变化。

temporality.en: Now, Milton understands the problems besetting; what we could think of as the poem's confused temporality; he understands this a lot better than we do.
temporality.zh: 现在，弥尔顿明白了我们,认为诗歌暂时性混乱问题的原因所在;,他比我们要明白的多。

temporality.en: I took those same references the exact opposite way,'cause I thought that essentially he's referring to the temporality of our moral structure, and how it's just this arbitrary code which our society has decided upon.
temporality.zh: 我对那些参考的理解完全不同，因为我认为本质上他提到了我们道德基准的暂时性,还提到它们如何只是我们社会,随意决定的准则。

temporality.en: He's already been playing around with the temporality of the poem.
temporality.zh: 他一直因为自己暂时还是一个诗人而玩耍。

tempestuous.en: For years, the couple's tempestuous relationship made the headlines.
tempestuous.zh: 多年来这对夫妻间紧张起伏的关系总是登上报纸头条。

tempestuous.en: After a tempestuous two-month voyage they landed at in icy November, what is now Plymouth, Massachusetts.
tempestuous.zh: 他们在海上颠簸折腾了两个月之后， 终于在酷寒的十一月里， 在现在的马萨诸塞州的普里茅斯登陆。

tempestuous.en: I could only wonder what the Vikings arriving here thought after battling the tempestuous Atlantic in nothing more than a longboat.
tempestuous.zh: 我忍不住猜想， 在区区一艘长船里， 那些维京海盗在与暴怒的大西洋奋战之后， 到达这里时他们会作何感想。

temptress.en: Brand New Ed Hardy Women's Temptress Skull Black Watch!
temptress.zh: 品牌新海关哈女性氏风月颅骨黑色手表！

temptress.en: The typical 007 movie has two Bond girls: the girl friend and the temptress.
temptress.zh: 典型的 007 电影邦德有两个女孩： 女孩的朋友和妖妇。

thorax.zh: 他们对他的胸腔周围进行了仔细的检查， 试图靠近箭头及其周围的组织。

thorax.zh: 这两种昆虫的飞行机理比较复杂， 胸部长有较多肌肉， 这样它们才能有力量振动翅膀。

thorny.en: The question of who should pay for reskilling is a thorny one.
thorny.zh: 谁应该为再培训买单是一个棘手的问题。

thorny.zh: 例如， 即将投入使用的自动驾驶汽车带来了棘手的伦理问题。

thorny.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
thorny.zh: 与此同时， 该政策并没有解决关于家庭作业的真正棘手的问题。

thorny.en: There are widespread controversies about it, and many of the courses you would take in law school are meant to try to get to the bottom of these thorny questions.
thorny.zh: 这个问题有很多争议，法学院的很多课都旨在,把这些棘手的问题弄得水落石出。

thoroughbred.en: I have only one; but that one is altogether a thoroughbred Lion.
thoroughbred.zh: 我一胎只有一个， 但是那是一个完完全全纯种的狮子。

thoroughbred.zh: 这一切表明， 谷歌 “一招鲜吃遍天” 的本事， 真的相当优良。

thoroughbred.zh: 不过这种手术在国内外的纯血马中几乎没有成功的先例。

thoroughgoing.en: He was very earnest and thoroughgoing about it, and the affair took quite a long time.
thoroughgoing.zh: 他做事很认真， 很彻底， 这件事花了很长时间。

thoroughgoing.en: Nevertheless, a good number of thoroughgoing land animals later turned around, abandoned their hard-earned terrestrial re-tooling, and returned to the water again.
thoroughgoing.zh: 尽管如此， 后来还是有相当数量的完全陆生动物做出改变， 离开了它们辛辛苦苦重新改造的陆地， 并回到了水里。

thoroughgoing.en: The second type of reproacher is the thoroughgoing scolder, who never lets up reprimanding the lover.
thoroughgoing.zh: 第二种责难者是彻头彻尾的责难者， 他从不松懈谴责情人。

threadbare.en: She sat cross-legged on a square of threadbare carpet.
threadbare.zh: 她盘腿坐在那块破旧地毯的一方上。

threadbare.en: The furniture was threadbare; he'd obviously picked it up for nothing.
threadbare.zh: 那件家具破破烂烂； 显然他没花什么钱就捡来了。

thralldom.en: The nation will soon be liberated from the foulest thralldom.

three score years and ten.en: We hand Jack to you. We won't accompany him three score years and ten. From now on you should help each other and care each other and love each other.
three score years and ten.zh: 我们把杰克交给你了， 我和老伴不能陪他一辈子，从今往后， 你们要互相帮助， 互相关心，互相爱护。

three sheets to the wind.en: Tom was three sheets to the wind and couldn't walk across the room without stumbling.
three sheets to the wind.zh: 汤姆喝得酩酊大醉， 在房间里一走动就跌跌撞撞。

thrice.en: She looked round her thrice, but no one followed her.
thrice.zh: 她向四周看了三次， 但没有人追她。

thrice.en: They should think not twice, but thrice, before ignoring such advice.
thrice.zh: 对于这种性质的建议， 他们应该再三考虑后才决定是否予以忽略。

thrice.en: He's the thrice -married Lothario of the pocket-protector set.
thrice.zh: 他是结过三次婚的口袋护套登徒子。

thrice.en: Suddenly the vision begins to transform and he begins to hear the voice of Paul, " Thrice was I beaten, twice was I imprisoned, in shipwrecks often, in peril often."
thrice.zh: 突然之间，视觉的幻想开始改变,他听到了保罗的声音，“我被人打过三回，囚禁两次，经常受苦受难“

throw a fit.en: She'll throw a fit if she finds out.
throw a fit.zh: 她要是发现了， 一定会大发雷霆。

throw a fit.en: Once kids started carrying book bags, that bulky traditional lunch box was hard to fit inside." But you can't just throw a sandwich in a backpack," Jayasekara says.
throw a fit.zh: 一旦孩子们开始背书包， 那种笨重的传统午餐盒就很难装进去了。“但你不能只往背包里扔个三明治。” 贾阿塞卡拉说。

throw a fit.en: This would throw me into a fit of rage but I discovered recently there is a way to make a backup of your " about: config " preferences in case anything goes wrong.
throw a fit.zh: 这肯定回让我抓狂的， 但是最近我发现了一种备份你的“about ： config” 偏好设置的方法， 以防日后出什么问题。

throng with.en: Mr Wright's appearance at the National Press Club on April 28th before a massed throng of reporters provided him with the perfect opportunity to set those seconds in context.
throng with.zh: 月 28 日，当赖特出现在全国新闻俱乐部，面对一群蜂拥而至的记者的时候， 他本有一个绝好的机会解释视屏上那数秒钟的言论， 使其不要被断章取义的理解。

throng with.en: With the country in recession, Mr Obama delivered a sombre speech from the steps of the Capitol building to a throng of people on the National Mall.
throng with.zh: 人们聚集在国家大草坪上，聆听了奥巴马在国会大厦西侧阶梯上发表的对当前不景气的局势忧虑不堪的演讲。

throng with.en: THE streets of Germany's main cities still throng with shoppers; no shops are shuttered.
throng with.zh: 德国主要城市的街道上，购物的人流依然不断， 没有商店关门停业。

thrombosis.en: He could have died after developing deep vein thrombosis during a flight to Sydney.
thrombosis.zh: 他在飞往悉尼的航班上引发成深部静脉血栓之后，差点送命。

thrombosis.en: Passengers on long-haul flights are being warned about the risks of deep vein thrombosis.
thrombosis.zh: 长途航班上的乘客须注意可能出现深静脉血栓。

thrombosis.en: These are known as deep vein thrombosis (DVT).
thrombosis.zh: 这被称为深部静脉血栓症。

throw down the gauntlet.en: The technical feature, difficulties and throw down the gauntlet of every EMC research areas are presented in this paper based on Electromagnetic Compatibility ( EMC ) fundamentals.
throw down the gauntlet.zh: 在简介电磁兼容学科的基础上， 阐述了电磁兼容的各个研究领域的技术特点及面对的困难和挑战。

throw down the gauntlet.en: Now go throw down the gauntlet and see how you fare against the competition!
throw down the gauntlet.zh: 现在就开始挑战吧！ 看看你的竞赛会是怎样！

throw down the gauntlet.en: Throw down the gauntlet, make sure they know you believe they can do it, and ask: " Challenge accepted?"
throw down the gauntlet.zh: 撂下挑战， 这样他们就会知道你相信他们能做到，不妨再问一句：“敢不敢试试？”

throw about.en: We shouldn't spit in public places or throw litter about.
throw about.zh: 我们不应该在公众场合随地吐痰，乱丢垃圾。

throw about.en: L ast October, while tending her garden in Mora, Sweden, Lena Pahlsson pulled out a handful of small carrots and was about to throw them away.
throw about.zh: 去年10月，莉娜·帕尔森在瑞典莫拉打理花园时，摘了一把小胡萝卜，准备扔掉。

throw about.en: W hen I was about seven years old, my grandfather took me to a fish pond on a farm and told me to throw a stone into the water.
throw about.zh: 我七岁的时候，爷爷带我去农场的一个鱼塘，叫我往水里扔一块石头。

throw about.en: The strategies I'm about to throw away now, they're not - - it isn't that they're not best responses, they are best responses to something.
throw about.zh: 我要剔除的策略,并非都不是最佳对策,它们可能是某种情况下的最佳对策

throw about.en: For example, if you're talking about the chalk - - if I throw the chalk, you will have to know where it is and how fast it's moving.
throw about.zh: 比如说,这支粉笔,如果我扔出这支粉笔,你就像知道它的位置和速度

throw about.en: Whatever you think those are. Here, you might imagine different people disagreeing about - - oh, but throw in something - - but if what you want to do is write the great American novel, then you've got the experience of staying up late at night not knowing how to make the plot work out, crushing pieces of paper and throwing them away.
throw about.zh: 你能想到的都在里面，可能有人不同意 -,插入某某东西，比如你想,创作最伟大的美国小说，于是你获得熬夜的体验,纠结于如何构建情节，撕碎稿纸，扔在一边。

throw in.en: You can have the piano for $200, and I'll throw in the stool as well.
throw in.zh: 你花200元就可以买走这架钢琴，另外奉送这张琴凳。

throw in.en: Then they would make a clamor, or throw in a burning plastic bag.
throw in.zh: 然后他们会大声嚷嚷， 或者扔一个点着的塑料袋进去。

throw in.en: If you buy a refrigerator, we will throw in a microwave oven.
throw in.zh: 如果你买一台电冰箱， 我们免费赠送一台微波炉。

throw in.en: Was the story hard to follow? Was it self - contradictory, and in what ways? Anything? Just don't even be polite, just throw it right out there. Yes?
throw in.zh: 有没有什么地方不连贯？或者自相矛盾？,有何矛盾？有吗？说出来，现在，在这里，好吗？

throw in.en: It doesn't matter what that letter says - - I can crumple it up and throw it in the wastebasket.
throw in.zh: 不管信上怎么说,我都可以揉成团扔进垃圾箱了

throw in.en: But if I join a fraternity and they pour cow poop on my head and make me stand in the rain for a month wearing pantyhose while they throw rocks at me I then think - - after it I think "God, I went through a lot of stuff to get into this fraternity.
throw in.zh: 但如果我加入之前，他们要往我头上泼牛粪,要我穿着女内裤在雨中站一个月,他们还朝我扔石头,事后我就会想,”为了加入这个兄弟会我吃了不少苦头“

throwaway.en: Now they are producing throwaway razors.
throwaway.zh: 他们正在生产一次性剃须刀。

throwaway.en: She was very upset at what to him was just a throwaway remark.
throwaway.zh: 对他来说这只是随口说说而已，而她听了却很不高兴。

throwaway.en: We can turn the most luxuriant forests into throwaway paper products.
throwaway.zh: 我们可以把最茂密的森林变成一次性的纸制品。

thrash out.en: Its success is founded on the fact that humans are particularly efficient at expressing useful ideas and understanding when we write on whiteboards or thrash out ideas in small groups.
thrash out.zh: 它的成功基于这样一个事实： 当人们在白板上书写或在小组内通过讨论解决问题时， 他们表达有用想法和对事物的理解的效率特别高。

thrash out.en: The meeting lasted until well into the night as the two sides tried to thrash out their differences once and for all.
thrash out.zh: 会议持续到很晚， 因为双方都想彻底探讨出彼此的差异以便解决问题。

thrash out.en: The group made the proposal amid mounting frustration over negotiations for the Copenhagen climate change conference in December, which will thrash out a sequel to the Kyoto agreement.
thrash out.zh: 该联盟是在哥本哈根气候变化会议协商屡遭挫败的情况下， 提出这项建议的。 这项建议将解决京都议定书所带来的问题。

thumb drive.en: The move comes after part of a South Korea - U.S. operational plan was accessed by a hacker through a USB thumb drive used by an officer at the Combined Forces Command here.

thumb drive.en: However, an external hard drive or USB thumb drive can always be lost or damaged so you will never have full peace of mind that your data is really safe.
thumb drive.zh: 然而， 硬盘驱动器或 usb ，也可能随时丢失或损坏， 所以对于你的数据是否安全你永远不会感到踏实放心。

thumb drive.en: Until recently, a thumb drive served as the best way to transport large files.
thumb drive.zh: 近年来， 移动存储器一直是传输大文件的最佳方式。

thyroid.en: Located near the base of the neck, the thyroid is a large endocrine gland that produces hormones that help control growth and metabolism.
thyroid.zh: 甲状腺位于颈部的底部附近， 是一个很大的内分泌腺体， 它产生激素， 协助控制生长和新陈代谢。

thyroid.en: You may have a thyroid problem.
thyroid.zh: 你的甲状腺可能有问题。

thyroid.en: Swab neck skin with Betadine where thyroid area is.
thyroid.zh: 在颈部甲状腺皮肤上用棉签涂抹碘伏。

thyroid.en: Enzymes, thyroid, etc., the abs, the serotonin, you can pick some part of the body.
thyroid.zh: 比如,酶,甲状腺素等等,还有生物素,血清素,你也可以选择身体的某一部位来写

ticker.en: They look at the stock ticker to see where the stock price is.
ticker.zh: 他们查看股票行情收报机以了解股票价格。

ticker.en: AT&T's ticker symbol on the New York Stock Exchange will remain T.
ticker.zh: 美国电话电报公司的股票代码在纽约证券交易所仍将是T。

ticker.en: A half million people watched the troops march in New York's ticker tape parade.
ticker.zh: 有 50万人观看了部队在纸带纷飞的纽约列队前进。

tick off.en: For fleet cars, the data can also be relayed to a control centre, so that Big Brother can tick off transgressing drivers.
tick off.zh: 对于车队而言， 这些数据也能传送到控制中心， 所以管理公司能勾出（识别出）违法行驶的司机。

tick off.en: The Web accessibility checklist may seem daunting at first, but fortunately most portlets do not use things like animation, graphs, or frames, so you can quickly tick off most of the checklist items.
tick off.zh: 可访问性检查表一开始可能会令人头疼， 但幸运的是大多数 portlet 不使用象动画、 图片或框架之类的东西， 所以您可以快速地勾掉检查表的大多数项目。

tick off.en: You quickly tick off the 13 organizations that have sent you letters, a three - page request summary that serves as the first step in the proposal submission process for the foundation.
tick off.zh: 你快速列出那 13个曾给你寄过信件的组织，还有一份三页长的申请信概要 —申请信是向该基金会申请拨款的第一步。

tight-knit.en: Long - standing, tight-knit, protecting each other.
tight-knit.zh: 这种关系持续时间长久、 紧密，成员之间相互保护对方。

tight-knit.en: The big question was who in this tight-knit community would dare to run against him.
tight-knit.zh: 主要问题在于， 在这个关系紧密的社群中， 谁敢和他对抗？

tight-knit.en: But in Japan, they are upending the tight-knit business culture to an even greater extent.
tight-knit.zh: 但是在日本， 他们很大程度上颠倒了这种紧凑的商业文化。

tie the knot.en: Tie-the - Knot - Trait 1: She's Exciting and Always evolving.
tie the knot.zh: 结婚特质 1 ： 她令人兴奋而且不断进步。

tie the knot.en: Tie-the - Knot - Trait 3: She Makes it Clear he's not Her Entire life.
tie the knot.zh: 结婚特质 3 ： 她很清楚， 他不是她的全部生命。
