tie the knot.zh: 在最近一期的采访中， 皮特和朱丽也被追问到了结婚的事情， 已经 “同居” 六年的他们至今还没有结婚。

tight corner.en: I live on a farm, and we have dozens. The path between the doghouse and the porch, the tight corner around the house on the south side, horse trails, the line between one gate and the next.
tight corner.zh: 我住在一个农场里，那里有许多许多 —— 犬舍到门廊间的小径、 房子南面紧贴墙角的转弯处的小道、 马匹踩出来的土痕，还有从一扇门到下一扇门之间的小路。

tight corner.en: We are certainly in a tight corner, but with perseverance we shall manage to get out of it.
tight corner.zh: 我们肯定已处于困境， 但只要坚持住，我们就定能摆脱困境。

tight corner.en: Unless he gets some money, soon he will be in a tight corner.
tight corner.zh: 除非他马上搞到钱，不然他就会陷入困境。

tilt at windmills.en: He is a man of great intelligence and courage so he couldn't tilt at windmills.
tilt at windmills.zh: 他是个既聪明又有勇气的人，决不会凭空攻击的。

time-honored.en: Studying the fruit fly, a household nuisance but a time-honored experimental subject, has enabled the secrets of how embryos develop to begin to be unraveled by scientists.
time-honored.zh: 果蝇在家中招人讨厌， 但却是一个历史悠久的实验对象。 通过研究果蝇，科学家们得以揭开胚胎发育的秘密。

time-honored.en: The time-honored values of integrity of character, good work, friendship, family and community have often been sacrificed in the rush to riches.
time-honored.zh: 正直的品格、高质量的工作、 友谊、 家庭社区等具有悠久历史的观念， 常常在追求财富的过程中被牺牲。

time-honored.en: From time-honored to unexpected and downright strange, every culture has one.
time-honored.zh: 从久享盛名的方法到你意想不到的和新奇怪异的方法， 每种文化都有。

time-honored.en: According to a time-honored tradition in finance, it says that it's a promise to pay $1, but it's not worth $1 today.
time-honored.zh: 由于资金有时间价值,他说他承诺支付一美元,但在此时此刻它并不值一美元

time-honored.en: It's in recognition of what we can think of as this time- honored historical irony that Milton writes such a memorable line, a wonderful line, in his sonnet on the new Presbyterian regime.
time-honored.zh: 这刚好跟我们这次所想的相应 -,这个令人尊敬的历史性讽刺，弥尔顿写得如此有纪念意义，如此绝妙，在十四行诗里，他所写的新长老派的政体。

tilt toward.en: Lisbon would tilt the balance of power a bit toward Luxembourg, but not as far as its opponents fear.
tilt toward.zh: 里斯本条约会将权力的天平向卢森堡稍稍倾斜， 但并不像那些反对人士担心的那么严重。

tilt toward.en: The tilt of Earth's axis, toward the Sun at some times of the year and away from the Sun at other times, is responsible for the annual cycle of seasons.
tilt toward.zh: 地轴的倾斜在一年中的某些时候朝向太阳， 而在其它时间远离太阳， 造成了每年的季节循环。

tilt toward.en: Political will might finally tilt toward some sort of national health plan.
tilt toward.zh: 政治意愿可能最终会倾向于某种全民医疗方案。

tidbit.en: The optimum recipes of Scomber japonicus grilled fish tidbit were very complex.
tidbit.zh: 制作鲐鱼休闲鱼肉粒的最佳工艺配方非常复杂。

tidbit.zh: 更新： 这是另外一个关于此网站好玩的报道。

tidbit.zh: 这是一则有趣的小报道： 我真的很喜欢摩托罗拉 xoom 。

tidbit.en: So, a little tidbit of knowledge for you that's somewhat trivial.
tidbit.zh: 这是他的一些,花边新闻。

tinny.en: He could hear the tinny sound of a radio playing a pop song.
tinny.zh: 他能听到收音机播放流行歌曲的尖细而刺耳的声音。

tinny.en: They can be very tinny or huge!
tinny.zh: 他们可有的很小，有的却很大！

tinny.en: His prose is tinny, and the mentions of his children dull and cutesy.
tinny.zh: 他的文笔不算好， 提到他的孩子们时既无趣又做作。

tinker with.en: What I got from it is how writers, Murakami included, often tinker with and rework their stories.
tinker with.zh: 这件事给我的启发就是， 作家，包括村上春树在内， 经常修改、 修正他们的故事。

tinker with.en: But he was much more than just a clever tinker with things and words.
tinker with.zh: 但是， 他远不仅只是一个善于摆弄东西和词藻的能工巧匠。

tinker with.en: It has already proved possible to tinker with this genetic inheritance, with startling results.
tinker with.zh: 事实已经证明可能对这种基因遗传进行修补， 并产生了令人吃惊的结果。

time and again.en: She badgered her doctor time and again, pleading with him to do something.
time and again.zh: 她一再纠缠医生， 恳求他做点什么。

time and again.en: Time and again, Mr. Heaney returns to the image of the pen. He began his long career writing of such a pen, nestling snug as a gun between finger and thumb.

time and again.en: I reminded her time and again yesterday.
time and again.zh: 我昨天一次又一次地提醒她。

time and again.en: And again, this points out something I wanted to me - - I mentioned last time, list can be heterogeneous, in the sense that the elements can be multiple different types.

tip off.en: The man was arrested after an anonymous tip-off.
tip off.zh: 有人匿名举报后， 那个人被抓了起来。

tip off.zh: 在警方收到一名平民的举报之后，这名男子在家被捕了。

tip-top.zh: 这座房子的状况没得挑。

tip-top.zh: 确保你的个人简历是经常更新的并有一个好的外形。

tithe.zh: 的收入进入捐献盒，” 妈妈要求说。妈妈的话我照办了。

tithe.zh: 人若赎这十分之一的什么物， 就要加上五分之一。

titillate.en: The pictures were not meant to titillate audiences.

tokenism.zh: 没人喜欢定量： 定量看上去有些做表面文章和不公平竞争的意思。

tokenism.zh: 妇女甚至还没有达到黑人所达到的象征性的平等水平。

tokenism.zh: 年轻人需要出头，这不是形象工程。 如果我们球队里年轻人太少，那么就得制造机会。

tomfoolery.en: Were you serious, or was that a bit of tomfoolery?
tomfoolery.zh: 你是认真的， 还是仅仅胡闹而已？

tomfoolery.zh: 也无法胜任唱歌、……，他用愚蠢无聊的举动来取悦自己。

toner.zh: 如果你曾经醒来觉得你的脸有点肿胀， 这种爽肤水是你最好的选择， 它可以镇静和收紧你的皮肤。

toner.zh: 特纳尔先生： 最后两个问题。

toner.zh: 我们是传统碳粉的最大制造商。

tongue-in-cheek.zh: 在本图中， 我希望用一种戏谑、 荒诞的方式来表现纽约。

tongue-in-cheek.en: Well that's a - - so it's sort of tongue in cheek,'you know this is really good, I love to eat this, but I'm doing it because it's good for me' is the message there.
tongue-in-cheek.zh: 它有种特别的口感,"你知道这真的非常好,我喜欢吃它,但我吃它更是因为它对我有益",这就是我想要表达的

top dog.en: Reynolds has never concealed his ambition to be the top dog.
top dog.zh: 雷纳尔德从不掩饰他要成为领军人物的雄心。

tormentor.zh: 和法丽雅不同的是，折磨阿美娜的人是个女人：她丈夫哥哥的大老婆。

tormentor.zh: 就像那条链子，它提取了,生命中如磐石般不朽的精华，将雨水变成石头，将生命变成,折磨你的人笔下的画像。

torrent.en: The stream had become a raging torrent.
torrent.zh: 小溪变成了一条汹涌的急流。

torrent.zh: 因为你会了解戴高乐,你会了解各种上层人物,不过你也要了解普通人,那些十九世纪末,和二十世纪,大潮中的人们

unpalatable.en: But before we try to emulate geniuses or encourage our children to do so we should note that some of the things we learn from them may prove unpalatable.
unpalatable.zh: 但在我们试图模仿天才或鼓励我们的孩子这样做之前，我们应该注意到，我们从他们身上学到的一些东西可能并不适合我们。

unpalatable.en: But if we--and that seems the least unpalatable of the alternatives.
unpalatable.zh: 这似乎是最能让人接受的选择了。

unpalatable.en: That seems like a very unpalatable combination of views.

unrelenting.en: She established her authority with unrelenting thoroughness.
unrelenting.zh: 她以彻底的一丝不苟树立了自己的权威。

unrelenting.en: He was unrelenting in his search for the truth about his father.
unrelenting.zh: 他不顾一切地搜集有关他父亲的事实真相。

unregenerate.en: Initially grace and the unregenerate will are opposed to each other.
unregenerate.zh: 开始时 ﹐ 恩典与未重生的人的意志是互相对抗的。

unregenerate.en: Solomon spoke of the unregenerate heart as one which is inclined to excessive fantasy.
unregenerate.zh: 所罗门曾说不知悔改的心是因为有太多的幻想。

unremarkable.en: An unremarkable shrub on the gravel plain moved and resolved into an ostrich.
unremarkable.zh: 砾石平原上的一株不起眼的灌木移动了一下， 变成了一只鸵鸟。

unremarkable.en: And, of course, its lavatories were unremarkable.
unremarkable.zh: 当然， 它的厕所也是稀松平常的。

unremarkable.en: They don't wear much makeup. Their outfits are unremarkable.
unremarkable.zh: 她们不化浓妆， 穿着平凡。

unreservedly.en: We apologize unreservedly for any incorrect behaviour by Mr. Taylor.
unreservedly.zh: 我们对泰勒先生做出的所有错误行为毫无保留地道歉。

unreservedly.en: She has devoted herself unreservedly to the great cause.
unreservedly.zh: 她毫无保留地献身于这伟大的事业。

unreservedly.en: We apologize unreservedly for any offence we have caused.
unreservedly.zh: 若有得罪， 我们深表歉意。

unsavory.en: Employers and landlords are now using credit checks to filter out candidates and unsavory tenants.
unsavory.zh: 现在雇主和房东都通过信用历史来挑选求职者与房客。

unsavory.en: The smallish birds have an unsavory habit: they dive-bomb intruders and defecate on them as a defense.
unsavory.zh: 小白额燕鸥是世界上最小的燕鸥， 它们有一种名声不太好的习性：它们会俯冲轰炸入侵者，并向入侵者排放粪便以作为防卫。

unsavory.en: In Asian men, however, many Americans are more likely to see the mark of an unsavory, untrustworthy alien.
unsavory.zh: 可这要换了亚洲男性， 很多美国人更有可能认为这是一个声名狼藉， 靠不住的异乡客的标志。

unsavory.en: So some have noted, one scholar in particular has noted that The struggle with the angel is the final purging of the unsavory qualities of character that marked Jacob's past career.
unsavory.zh: 一些人也意识到，特别是一位学者发现,与天使的斗争是最终净化,净化雅各布过去生涯中不体面的品质。

unscrupulous.en: These kids are being exploited by very unscrupulous people.
unscrupulous.zh: 这些孩子正被极不道德的人利用。

unscrupulous.en: The new law will be a charter for unscrupulous financial advisers.
unscrupulous.zh: 新的法律会使不诚实的金融顾问有机可乘。

unscrupulous.en: When he is without virtue, man is the most unscrupulous and savage of the animals.
unscrupulous.zh: 一旦失去美德， 人就是最不讲道德、最为凶残的野兽。

unscrupulous.en: I wanted to list a few errors that are well-known and that are exploited by unscrupulous people in finance.
unscrupulous.zh: 我先罗列一些大家熟知的错误,这些错误常常被无良的人在金融领域中利用

unscrupulous.en: Therefore, when he is without virtue, man is the most unscrupulous and savage of the animals."
unscrupulous.zh: 因此,一旦失去美德,人就是最不讲道德最为凶残的野兽"

unseemliness.en: He was somewhat ashamed of his own unseemliness.
unseemliness.zh: 他的演技给我的印象是有点做作。

unseemliness.en: It is the manuscript of our contract, adjust it by yourself if you find any unseemliness.
unseemliness.zh: 附件二是我们的合同底稿，如有不合适的，请您修改。

unseemliness.en: On the early stage of the structural life-construction, the structural risk probability gets the maximal point. The safety accident will happen if the unseemliness way is adopted.
unseemliness.zh: 在结构寿命的初始阶段 ——施工阶段结构的风险概率最大， 如果处理不当，很容易导致安全事故的发生。

unearned.en: Unearned fees are money a business collects from a customer up front for services the company has yet to perform.
unearned.zh: 未得费用是企业从客户那里预先收取的公司尚未执行的服务的费用。

unearned.en: The abolition of incomes unearned by work.
unearned.zh: 第十一条，取缔不劳而获的收入。

unearned.en: The worst guilt is to accept an unearned guilt.
unearned.zh: 最严重的罪行是接受一个不劳而获的罪行。

unrivalled.en: They offer those condemned to spend five days a week in an urban environment an unrivalled area of freedom to unwind and take part in a range of leisure activities, such as hunting, riding and hiking.
unrivalled.zh: 它们为那些每周有五天都得待在城市里的人提供了一个无与伦比的自由空间， 让他们放松身心， 参加各种休闲活动， 比如打猎、 骑马和远足。

unrivalled.en: The advantage of hydrogen is its unrivalled simplicity: one electron circles a single proton.
unrivalled.zh: 氢的优势是其结构非常简单： 一个电子环绕一个质子。

unrivalled.en: It also has an unrivalled distribution system among small shops in India and parts of Africa.
unrivalled.zh: 该公司在印度和非洲的部分地区的小商店还有着无可抗衡的销售系统。

unseemly.en: It would be unseemly for judges to receive pay increases when others are having to tighten their belts.
unseemly.zh: 在其他人都得勒紧裤腰带过活的时候给法官们加薪是不合适的。

unseemly.en: The pampering is almost unseemly, some ( including the Palestinians ) might say.
unseemly.zh: 这种纵容， 有些人（甚至就巴勒斯坦）看来也许都会说， 是不适宜的。

unseemly.en: It feels unseemly to complain about not getting a raise when your neighbor is unemployed.
unseemly.zh: 如果你的邻居已经失去工作，你就会觉得不必为自己没加上工资而抱怨。

unseemly.en: You find various kinds of disreputable and maybe unseemly things going on there.
unseemly.zh: 你可以发现多种肮脏,不得体的事物都在港口发生。

unsettling.en: Phil had several unsettling dreams every night.
unsettling.zh: 菲尔每晚都做好几个令他不安的梦。
这是一个使人不安的消息。

unsettling.en: Though no great technical feat, the procedure opens a range of unsettling possibilities.
unsettling.zh: 虽然这不是什么伟大的技术壮举，但这一过程开启了一系列令人不安的可能性。

unsettling.en: So that can be unsettling when we think of this as happening at a certain contemporaneous moment in the history of thought.
unsettling.zh: 如果把这个问题放在思想史的特定时期来想,它可能是难以解决的。

unsettling.en: We can't know exactly and this is one of the wonderfully unsettling things about this stanza we can't know exactly to whom Milton is addressing this stanza.
unsettling.zh: 我们不能确切的知道,而这也是这一段很奇妙的不确定性所在,我们不能确切的知道弥尔顿这一段是在对谁讲话。

unsullied.en: She had the combined talents of toughness, intellect, experience and unsullied reputation.
unsullied.zh: 她坚强、 有智慧、 有经验， 也有清白的名声。

unsullied.en: Now, unsullied from its tireless journey.
unsullied.zh: 而今，它在不倦的旅程中依然一尘不染。

unsullied.en: He will do anything to keep it unsullied, and save his fine reputation.
unsullied.zh: 为了保持家族的名誉不被玷污，维持他的良好的名声， 他什么都会做的。

unsullied.en: So according to Wellhausen, the early period of ancient Israel must have been characterized by a free, more natural form of religion, an intimate relationship with God, unencumbered or unsullied by the legalistic cultic obsessions of priests and cult.
unsullied.zh: 据Wellhausen，古代以以列早期,一定是以自由自然的宗教形式为特色的，与上帝关系亲密，不受任何阻碍,牧师和仪式痴迷于遵从律法，造成阻碍。

unspoiled.en: The port is quiet and unspoiled.
unspoiled.zh: 这个港口很安静，有未受破坏的自然美。

unspoiled.en: An unspoiled coral reef encloses the bay.
unspoiled.zh: 未经破坏的珊瑚礁围绕着该海湾。

unspoiled.en: Bringing a new and unspoiled day.
unspoiled.zh: 带来全新而自然的一天。

untarnished.zh: 在另外一个场地， 食物总是保持干净。

untarnished.zh: 保留了完整而未被破坏的灵魂的圣徒们会不会帮助他销毁魂器呢？

untarnished.en: Those wanting a 21 st-century assessment will have to wait for a new generation, untarnished by forgotten feuds and loyalties, to read Marx with unblinkered eyes.
untarnished.zh: 那些希冀能以 21 世纪的观点重新评判的人，只能等待未来一代人以不偏不倚的态度研读马克思了，他们没有受以前内部争斗以及忠诚思想的“侵蚀”。

untenable.en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
untenable.zh: 从知识、 道德和现实的角度来看， 这种论点是站不住脚的。

untenable.en: That is clearly an untenable view, since editors can often intensify reader interest in a news topic by giving it frequent coverage.
untenable.zh: 这显然是站不住脚的观点， 因为编辑通常可以通过频繁报道来增强读者对新闻话题的兴趣。

untenable.en: Once man came to be seen as developing in the process of evolution, the idea of a substance which is contained in his essence seemed untenable.
untenable.zh: 一旦人类被看作是在进化过程中发展起来的，那么“人类是包含在他的本质中的一种物质”的观点似乎就站不住脚了。

unswervingly.en: We will unswervingly follow this road.
unswervingly.zh: 我们将坚定不移地沿着这条道路走下去。

unswervingly.en: The conviction that we stand on the right path, and unswervingly go on.
unswervingly.zh: 确信自己站在正确的道路上， 并且坚定不移的走下去。

unswervingly.en: China will unswervingly promote the protection of intellectual property rights.
unswervingly.zh: 中国坚定不移地推进保护知识产权工作。

untethered.zh: 或许更重要的， 温州人已经不再受到他们原来地域的束缚。

untethered.zh: 在一个科技的时代里，有越来越多的陈词滥调正从受它们根源的束缚中摆脱。

untiringly.zh: 适度” 是经济学家不懈追求的、同时也是难以真正实现的“最优” 目标。

untiringly.en: You will be a donkey. You will work untiringly from sunrise to sunset carrying burdens on your back.
untiringly.zh: 你， 会成为一头驴。 从日出到日落，你将背负着压力， 不知疲倦地工作。

untiringly.en: We will convey the correct Chinese culture untiringly so that the world could understand China, the real China.
untiringly.zh: 我们将以不懈的努力，将正确的中国文化传达， 让世界真正读懂中国，读懂真正的中国。

untrammeled.zh: 西班牙的舞蹈热情奔放， 我很喜欢。

untrammeled.en: To put untrammeled reasons and individual freedom at the center of a civilization is to live with the conflict, the turmoil, the instability, and the uncertainty that these things create.
untrammeled.zh: 把自由理性和个人自由置于,文明的中心就会伴随着冲突与矛盾,混乱和不安定,以及一些其他的不良影响

unutterably.zh: 我忽然感到无法言说的压抑。

unutterably.zh: 哈克往后退了几步，他轻轻地喘着气， 但心里充满了说不出的感激。

unutterably.zh: 这对于有血有肉的人是太难堪啦—— 连我都受不了啦！

unwavering.en: She has been encouraged by the unwavering support of her family.
unwavering.zh: 她家人坚定地支持鼓舞着她。

unwavering.en: We've been unwavering on those for a decade.
unwavering.zh: 十年来， 我们始终毫不动摇地坚持这一投入水平。

unwavering.zh: 谢谢你们对以色列坚定的支持。

unwarranted.zh: 这种批评基本上是毫无道理的。

unwarranted.zh: 普通警察没有看到这块油漆污点， 或者对它做了一些毫无根据的假设。

up to the hilt.zh: 我想把的房子扩建一下， 但我的抵押已经全部用完， 因此我不得不搁数年再说了。

upheaval.zh: 他对噪音、 杂乱和持续动荡逆来顺受。

vitriolic.en: Without question he's the most terrifying of all of the mourners, and he gives an angry, powerful, vitriolic speech about the terrible state of England - the terrible state of the Church of England and, as a consequence, of the terrible state of England in 1637.
vitriolic.zh: 毫无疑问他是所有送葬者中最可怕的，他做了一番愤怒，有力，刻薄的讲话,大谈英格兰的糟糕状况,-1637年间英格兰教堂的糟糕状况，及由此产生的英格兰的糟糕状况。

voracious.en: All otters have a voracious appetite.
voracious.zh: 所有的水獭都有一个贪吃的胃口。

voracious.en: Joseph Smith was a voracious book collector.
voracious.zh: 约瑟夫 · 史密斯是一个如饥似渴的藏书家。

voracious.en: Life is voracious, it swallows all the dead.
voracious.zh: 生命是贪婪的， 它吞噬所有死亡。

voluntarism.en: Yet the AFL's voluntarism had accommodated certain exceptions: the AFL had supported government intervention on behalf of injured workers and child laborers.
voluntarism.zh: 然而， 劳联的自愿主义包容了某些例外情况：劳联曾支持政府代表受伤工人和童工进行干预。

voluntarism.en: The problematic part of the agenda is voluntarism.
voluntarism.zh: 日程有问题的部分在于志愿主义。

voluntarism.en: Faith used to drive a lot of voluntarism, civic engagement and self-reliance.
voluntarism.zh: 过去，是忠诚促使了许多自愿主义， 城市约定和自我信赖。

votary.en: He was a votary of golf.
votary.zh: 他是高尔夫球忠实信徒。

votary.en: The two votary lamps in front of the figure of Buddha are glittering slightly.
votary.zh: 佛像前面点着两盏长明灯，闪着微微的淡光。

votary.en: Akshay Babu, who had made the passion in English literature living to us, was himself a votary of the emotional life.
votary.zh: 阿卡什先生，这位使我们逼真地感到英国文学强烈情感的人， 他自己就是一个性情中人。

vuca.en: In this volatile, uncertainty, complex and ambiguous ( VUCA ) World today, it is important that every good company possesses that best talents that is available out there.
vuca.zh: 在当今这个变幻莫测的时代， 人才是所有优秀企业所看重的。

vote down.en: But if shareholders vote his plans down now, it may encourage Huang to see he's fighting a losing cause.
vote down.zh: 但如果股东现在投票反对他的计划， 这或许会促使黄光裕意识到自己打的是一场必输的战斗。

vote down.en: As users watch the sheep morph on their computer screen they can vote for the ones they like and vote down the ones they don't.
vote down.zh: 当用户看着他们电脑上变化的电子羊时他们可以进行投票。

vote down.en: If an answer is obviously wrong ( or inferior in some way), you vote it down.
vote down.zh: 但如果答案明显是错的( 或者比较差 )，也可以给它减一票。

vulgar taste.en: He is a man of vulgar taste.
vulgar taste.zh: 他是个有低级趣味的人。

vulgar taste.en: I want to express some meaning and taste, this vulgar technique is just appropriate for my works.
vulgar taste.zh: 我表现一些意思， 味道， 恰恰需要的就是这种表现粗俗的手法。

vulgar taste.en: We Chinese place a high value on the saving, a traditional virtue, and wasting food will be regarded as vulgar taste and the lack of social responsibility.
vulgar taste.zh: 我们中国人将 “节俭” 这传统美德看得很重， 浪费食物会被视为没品和缺乏社会责任感。

vulture.en: Within it sat either a Fox, a Hawk, or a Vulture.
vulture.zh: 里面不是坐着一只狐狸，就是坐着一只老鹰， 或是其他秃鹫。

vulture.en: When someone calls you a " vulture ", it is not a compliment.
vulture.zh: 当有人叫你 “秃鹫”的时候， 那不是恭维之词。

vulture.en: Although these birds did not have it, another study found Bacillus anthracis in vulture faeces.
vulture.zh: 虽然这些鸟儿没有感染疾病， 另一项研究在秃鹫粪便里发现了湾炭疽杆菌。

wacko.en: I mean, it's really going wacko.
wacko.zh: 我的意思是， 它真的发疯了。

wacko.en: What does the word " Wacko " mean?
wacko.zh: 在英语中“wacko”是什么意思呢？

wacky.en: As if just riding a unicycle didn't look funny enough, add mallets and balls and you've got a truly wacky spectacle.
wacky.zh: 就好像仅仅骑独轮车看起来还不够滑稽一样， 加上木槌和球， 你就得到了一个真正古怪的景象。

wacky.en: Some of his friends are pretty wild and wacky characters.
wacky.zh: 他的一些朋友是那种放荡不羁又怪里怪气的人。

wacky.en: Always sign with your (entire) real name, not some wacky nickname like Ry-Ry or Biff.
wacky.zh: 一定要签上你的真实姓名 （全名）， 而不是 Ry -Ry 或 Biff 这样的古怪昵称。

wail.en: I joined my wail to theirs, loud and bitter.
wail.zh: 我和他们一起恸哭，哭声又高又痛苦。

wail.en: Banshees wail and weep, but they never howl.
wail.zh: 女妖会哀号哭泣， 但她们从不嚎叫。

wail.en: One more wail would go the round in that wind by night.
wail.zh: 到了晚上， 在那样的狂风中，还会传来一声哀号。

wad of cash.en: We all like feeling good about ourselves. But can a little praise really trump a slice of pizza, a great party or a wad of cash?
wad of cash.zh: 我们都喜欢自我感觉良好， 但是一点点表扬是不是真的会带来一片披萨，一场聚会， 或者一卷钞票？

wad of cash.en: But can a little praise really trump a slice of pizza, a great party or a wad of cash?
wad of cash.zh: 但一个小小的称赞真的能击败一块比萨、一个很棒的聚会或一叠钞票吗？

wad of cash.en: Handling a wad of cash may be as good at killing pain than aspirin, a new study suggests.
wad of cash.zh: 一项最新研究表明，数钞票的止痛效果堪比布洛芬或阿司匹林等止痛药物。

wait in the wings.en: Continue to remind her that you want to date her, you don't just want to be her friend (that is, you don't want to wait in the wings ).
wait in the wings.zh: 要不断地提醒她， 你想与她约会并非仅仅是只想做普通朋友 (换句话说，你不想做替补品 )。

wait in the wings.en: Young ballerinas wait in the wings at a recital.
wait in the wings.zh: 芭蕾舞小演员们在一个表演会的舞台两侧等待着。

wait in the wings.en: They make me think of films about the theatrical world in which trembling chorus girls wait to make their entrances in draughty wings, captured like Degas dancers.
wait in the wings.zh: 他们让我想起了有关戏剧界的电影，电影里颤抖的合唱女孩们等待着从通风的舞台两侧上台， 就像德加（Degas）舞者。

waive.en: He resolved to waive rank and make friends with the calf.
waive.zh: 他决定放弃高贵身份， 和这头小牛做朋友。

waive.en: We should continue to waive fees, increase guarantees, and expand the size of SBA-backed loans for small businesses.
waive.zh: 我们应该继续减免费用、 提高保障， 扩大小型企业管理局提供的小企业贷款规模。
目标)： 我放弃这个权利。

waffling.en: The senator was accused of waffling on major issues.
waffling.zh: 人们指责参议员在主要问题上立场模糊。

waffling.en: Stop waffling and answer the question!
waffling.zh: 别东拉西扯， 回答问题！

waffling.en: Laura was not fooled by the waffling reply.
waffling.zh: 劳拉不想听到这种模棱两可的回答，这简直就是在糊弄。

wade through.en: It has taken a long time to wade through the "incredible volume" of evidence.
wade through.zh: 已经花费了很长时间来研读这宗“卷帙浩瀚” 的证据。

wade through.en: The lake was not frozen sufficiently to bear her, but it was low enough that she could wade through it.
wade through.zh: 湖上还没有足够的厚冰可以托住她， 但是水又不够浅， 她不能涉水走过去。

wade through.en: The cold is too awful for anything, and the snow will soon be too deep for us to wade through.
wade through.zh: 天气真是冷得可怕， 雪很快就会积得厚到我们趟不过去了。

waiver.en: " We just need a waiver," Verlaine said.
waiver.zh: 我们只需要办一张弃权证就行了。” 魏尔伦说。

waiver.en: She picked up the waiver and scanned it.
waiver.zh: 玛格·丽特拿起弃权声明书，扫视了一遍。

waiver.en: This waiver was extended in the WTO to end 2006.
waiver.zh: 这项豁免在 WTO 下也得以延续，期限到 2006年年底。

waiver.en: We have this one parting gift-- just a little legal waiver for the cameras if you would.
waiver.zh: 我这有份临别赠礼-,准许我们使用您肖像权的声明，希望您笑纳。

walk-on.en: It is simple pleasures, such as a walk on a sunny day, which have a cumulative effect on our mood.
walk-on.zh: 诸如在晴朗的日子散步这样简朴的乐趣对我们的情绪有累积性益处。

walk-on.en: There's nothing like a brisk walk on a cold day!
walk-on.zh: 冷天出来快步走走，简直太舒服了。

walk-on.en: We went for a walk on the common.
You walk in the front door, Christ in majesty -on the left side are the damned writhing and on the right side are the blessed looking a good deal happier.
walk-on.zh: 你走进大门口,威严的基督,左边是受诅咒之人在受煎熬,右侧是受保佑的人,看起来快乐得多

war-torn.en: Crowds at Tel Aviv's main square added to the growing call for withdrawal from the war-torn territory.
war-torn.zh: 特拉维夫大广场上的人群进一步呼吁从这个饱受战争蹂躏的地区撤军。

war-torn.en: Afghanistan will play soccer at the Asian Games. Mongolia's withdrawal has given the war-torn nation a confidence boost.
war-torn.zh: 阿富汗将参加亚运会足球比赛， 蒙古的退出给这个饱受战争摧残的国家带来了信心。

war-torn.en: For the Princess, the trip to this war-torn country was an excellent opportunity to use her popularity to show the world how much destruction and suffering landmines can cause.
war-torn.zh: 对王妃来说， 这次访问这个饱受战争蹂躏的国家是一个绝佳的机会， 利用她的声望向世界展示地雷能造成多大的破坏和痛苦。

warden.en: If Jan had gone to the officers she trusted, they would have had to repeat her story to the same warden.
warden.zh: 如果简去找了她信任的警官， 他们就不得不向同一个典狱长重复她的故事。

warden.en: He was a warden at the local parish church.
warden.zh: 他是本地教区教堂的监察员。

warden.en: The letter closed with sincere greetings which I did not think referred to me, but the warden was sincere about the issue.
warden.zh: 这封信结尾真诚的问候我认为不是跟我说的， 但是那个监狱长对待此问题倒是很真诚的。

wanderlust.en: His wanderlust would not allow him to stay long in one spot.
wanderlust.zh: 他酷爱旅游， 无法在一个地方久留。

wanderlust.en: When we met, you warned me of your wanderlust.
wanderlust.zh: 但我们相遇之时， 你就警告我说你有漫游癖。

wanderlust.en: Now they roam the Earth, following an insatiable wanderlust.
wanderlust.zh: 现在他们漫游地球， 跟随一个永不知足的旅行热潮。

wallflower.en: She'd rather stay home than be a wallflower.
wallflower.zh: 她宁愿留在家里， 而不愿当壁花。

wallflower.en: She'd rather dance by herself than be a wallflower.
wallflower.zh: 她宁愿独自跳舞， 而不愿当壁花。

wallflower.en: A wallflower is a man whose phone doesn't ring - even when he's in the bath.
wallflower.zh: 所谓局外人就是那些电话从不响的男人 —— 即使当他们在洗澡的时候。

wand.en: You can't simply wave a wand and get rid of nuclear weapons.
wand.zh: 你们不可能一挥魔杖就消除核武器。

wand.en: Visitors can expect to be searched with a metal-detecting wand.
wand.zh: 游客们可能会被用金属探测棒搜身。

wand.en: With a wave of her magic wand, she changed the frog into a handsome prince.
wand.zh: 她魔杖一挥，把青蛙变成了英俊的王子。

wand.en: Satan's spear is to the tallest pine what the tallest pine is to a little, bitty wand.
wand.zh: 撒旦的长矛对于最高的松木而言就如同最高的松木,对比一根小小的棍子一般大。

wand.en: So what she's going to do is start loading up the electrons, and you see this wand here move slowly, and it takes a while to do it, start become perpendicular.
wand.zh: 所以她将要加载电子，你们看到这个棒慢慢地移动，这个需要一段时间，开始变得垂直了。

warlock.en: The Warlock: [angrily] Who is this man?
warlock.zh: 魔术师”(大怒)： 这个男人是谁？

warlock.en: Pets - We saw an Undead Warlock get his first level pet quest.
warlock.zh: 宠物 —— 我们看到一名不死族术士接受了他的初级宠物任务。

warlock.en: He never claimed to be a warlock, and therefore we all thought he was.
warlock.zh: 他从不声称要作一个术士，也正是因为如此， 我们都认为他是一个术士。

waste away.en: It seems such a waste to throw good food away.
waste away.zh: 把好的食物扔掉似乎太浪费了。

waste away.en: To my mind, the reports talk too much about the carbon dioxide produced by the trucks that deliver the fresh goods to the shops and take the waste away.
waste away.zh: 在我看来， 这些报告过多地谈论了卡车产生的二氧化碳，而这些卡车把新鲜的货物运送到商店，然后把垃圾运走。

waste away.en: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
waste away.zh: 废料被安全地封存， 直到其不再有辐射。

water-tight.en: The paper introduces the anticlastic and water-tight performance of low content polypropylene fiber concrete.
water-tight.zh: 本文介绍了低含量聚丙烯纤维混凝土的抗弹性和防水性能。

water-tight.en: The assembling, actuating, water-tight test of pump - turbine globe valve and its quality control are introduced.
water-tight.zh: 介绍了抽水蓄能水轮机球阀装配、动作及密封漏水试验工艺性与质量控制。

water under the bridge.en: He was relieved his time in jail was over and regarded it as water under the bridge.
water under the bridge.zh: 他对自己的刑期已满而感到如释重负， 把那视为桥下之水过往之事而不再挂怀。

water under the bridge.en: Walk the road will go through Longchuan bridge bridge steady stream of vehicles and the water under the bridge quiet leisurely splash.
water under the bridge.zh: 步行路途中， 会经过龙川桥，桥上川流不息的车辆和桥下沉静悠然的流水相映成趣。

water under the bridge.en: The quarrel between the couple was water under the bridge.
water under the bridge.zh: 这对夫妻间的吵架，已经是无法挽回的过去。

wash your dirty linen in public.en: The saying, "Don't wash your dirty linen in public," specifically tells us that we should not discuss intimate family matters in public, especially if they are of a shameful nature.
wash your dirty linen in public.zh: 俗云：“家丑不可外扬”， 它明确地提醒我们不应在公众场合讨论私人的家务事， 特别是如果那些事本来就不是很光彩的话。

wash your dirty linen in public.en: Do not wash your dirty linen in public.
wash your dirty linen in public.zh: 不要在稠人广众下洗脏衣服。

watertight.en: The rules state that samples must be enclosed in two watertight containers.
watertight.zh: 条例规定样品必须用两个不漏水的容器封装起来。

watertight.en: If she could just establish the time the picture had been taken, Mick would have a watertight alibi.
watertight.zh: 只要她能确定拍这张照片的时间， 米克就可以有一个无懈可击的不在现场的证据。

watertight.en: Only teak matches oak's expansion coefficient and stays watertight.
watertight.zh: 只有柚木才能达到橡木的膨胀系数， 并保持水密性。

waylay.en: Greenpeace managed to assemble a small flotilla of inflatable boats to waylay the ship at sea.
waylay.zh: 绿色和平组织设法聚集了一支充气艇小舰队去拦截海上的那艘船。
拦路抢劫 —— 通常都这样。

waylay.en: Oh, most anybody. Waylay people—that's mostly the way.
waylay.zh: 遇谁抢谁吧，拦路抢劫——都是这样干的。

waxing and waning.en: For those living near the equator in particular, its waxing and waning was more conspicuous than the passing of the seasons.
waxing and waning.zh: 尤其对于那些生活在赤道附近的人来说， 它的盈亏比季节的变化更为明显。

waxing and waning.en: The moon's waxing and waning greatly influences the Chinese lunar calendar and Chinese philosophy, in pursuit of immortal spirit of life and mysterious wisdom.
waxing and waning.zh: 在中国人追求 “永生” 和 “玄妙智慧” 的过程中， 月亮的圆缺变化极大地影响了中国的历法和哲学。

waxing and waning.en: Its regular phases make the moon a very convenient timepiece, and the periods of its waxing and waning form the basis of many of the oldest calendars.
waxing and waning.zh: 其规律性的月相使之成为一种非常方便的计时器， 很多古老日历的发明都源自对月圆月缺变化的观察。

weakling.en: You were never a ninety-eight pound weakling.
weakling.zh: 你从来就不是一个体重98 磅、体质孱弱的人。

weakling.en: My quitting strategy surely made me a coward and a weakling.
weakling.zh: 我的放弃策略肯定让我成了懦夫、胆小鬼。

weakling.en: On his way to Amman, Mr Bush did not talk as if he felt like a weakling.
weakling.zh: 在去安曼的路上， 布什一言不发，似如虚弱之人。

wayward.en: If you come across a wayward chunk of moon, don't try to cash in on it.
wayward.zh: 如果你遇到一大块形状不规则的月球岩石， 不要企图拿它卖钱。

wayward.en: These passions, like great winds, have blown me hither and thither, in a wayward course, over a deep ocean of anguish, reaching to the very verge of despair.
wayward.zh: 这些激情像狂风， 把我恣情吹向四方，掠过苦痛的大海，迫使我濒临绝望的边缘。
亚原子粒子可能是任性的。

weak at the knees.en: His sudden smile made her go weak at the knees.
weak at the knees.zh: 他突然笑了笑， 使得她两膝发软。

weak at the knees.en: The letter should look as beautiful as your feelings - a note scrawled in biro on the back of a beer mat is not going to make your Bella go weak at the knees.
weak at the knees.zh: 情书要看起来要与你所投入的感情一样美丽 ——用圆珠笔潦草地把信写在啤酒垫背后的话，怎么会使你的那个“她”非你不嫁呢？

weak at the knees.en: Rudolph, the Adonis of the silent films, had one great quality - to make women feel weak at the knees.
weak at the knees.zh: 鲁道夫，这部无声电影中的美男子， 有一个绝妙的本事—— 使女人感到两腿发软。

weasel from.en: Demand for coffee brewed with beans plucked from the dung of the furry, weasel- like creatures - - known locally as luwaks - - is surging among well - healed connoisseurs around the world, exporters say.
weasel from.zh: 出口商说， 世界各地恢复消费能力的内行人士， 对于这种取自像鼹鼠一样的小动物 —— 被当地人称之为麝香猫的便便中的咖啡豆， 所酿造的咖啡需求量激增。

weasel from.en: Obama said that we didn't knuckle under, weasel from and hesitate when facing with challenges.
weasel from.zh: 奥巴马说，在面临挑战的时候， 我们没有屈服，我们没有逃避也没有犹豫。

weasel from.en: Made from yellow weasel hair, the brush uplifts browpowder effects with a more natural appearance.
weasel from.zh: 刷毛精选优质黄狼毛，能使眉粉的作用和效果提升，使眉妆更加自然饱满。

weatherbeaten.en: Not far from the road stood a weatherbeaten old barn of reddish-grey brick and tile.
weatherbeaten.zh: 离大路不远，有一个久经风吹雨打的老仓房，由灰中带。

weatherbeaten.en: At one table, a weatherbeaten man sits alone selling DVDs of " activist news " and collecting names and addresses.
weatherbeaten.zh: 在一张桌前， 一个饱经风霜的男人独自坐在那儿贩卖 “活动家新闻”的 DVD ， 同时收集人们的姓名和住址。

weatherbeaten.en: When the hearse backed up to a wooden sidewalk before a naked, weatherbeaten frame house, the same composite, ill-defined group that had stood upon the station siding was huddled about the gate.
weatherbeaten.zh: 灵车退到一座饱经风霜的木屋的木头过道边， 大门口挤着的又是火车站月台上那团模模糊糊的人群。

weathered.en: The rocks get broken down into smaller and smaller particles as they are weathered.
weathered.zh: 岩石在风化过程中被分解成越来越小的颗粒。

weathered.en: Her face was weathered by the sun.
The company has weathered the recession.

wayfarer.en: " Nice little farm," replied the wayfarer, briefly.
wayfarer.zh: 一个不错的小农场。” 过路的人简短地回答。

wayfarer.zh: 你是这凄清的大街上孤独的旅人。

weighty.en: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
weighty.zh: 这样重要的事情值得进行更高级别的讨论吧？

well-connected.zh: 古贝尔先生和彼得斯先生在好莱坞并不普遍受人爱戴， 但他们有着良好的社会关系。

well-connected.en: While Kearns warns that the setting was artificial, he says it's possible that greater persuasive power could lie with well-connected individuals in the everyday online world too.
well-connected.zh: 虽然卡恩斯警告说， 这种设置是人为的，但他表示， 日常网络世界中人际关系良好的人们也可能有很强大的说服力。

well-connected.zh: 霍布斯的个性或者个人主义,是与人类或人类福祉的概念紧密相连的,就像在为好生活的奋斗当中,获得了胜利。

well-aged.en: Sunset is a late - blooming flower. Sunset is a well-aged wine.
well-aged.zh: 夕阳是晚开的花，夕阳是陈年的酒。

well-aged.en: Some research suggests that the explanation for rising rates of mortality, mental - health problems, and addiction among poorly - educated, middle -aged people is a shortage of well- paid jobs.
well-aged.zh: 某项研究表明， 在受教育程度低的中年人当中， 死亡、 心理健康问题以及染上毒瘾的比例不断上升，要归因于缺乏高薪水的工作。

well-aged.en: The average older man was aged 38, while the average woman was over a decade younger, however some men aged well into their 60 s were also in attendance.

welfare state.en: Their aim is to reduce people's dependency on the welfare state.
welfare state.zh: 他们旨在减少人们对福利制度的依赖。

welfare state.en: The state is still the main provider of welfare.
welfare state.zh: 政府仍然是福利的主要提供者。

welfare state.en: Again, I have a couple of quibbles here about whether the European welfare state is too expensive for Europe to afford.
welfare state.zh: 在此， 我对欧洲因为社会福利状况太昂贵而不堪承受这一观点不敢苟同。

well-documented.en: Her views on the treaty are well-documented and oft - repeated.
well-documented.zh: 她对这项条约的观点被完好地记录下来且一再被重复。

well-documented.en: The relationship between getting more sleep and making better food choices is well-documented.
well-documented.zh: 更充足的睡眠和选择更好的食物之间的关系有据可查。

well-documented.en: There have been numerous well-documented extinctions of indigenous species caused by the introduction of non - indigenous predators and pathogens.
well-documented.zh: 由于引入了非本地的捕食者和病原体， 已经有许多本土物种灭绝的记录， 证据确凿。

well-intended.en: First, that well-intended guarantees eventually lead to a bubble.
well-intended.zh: 首先， 出于好心的担保最终导致泡沫。

well-intended.en: But the most powerful aspect of technology lies in its unbounded potential to solve the problems that come alongside its well-intended purposes.
well-intended.zh: 但是，新技术最有利的一面就在于它能够解决无限的问题，前提是它的出发点是好的。

well-intended.en: Those who seek to halt genetics in its tracks may soon learn that lesson anew, as rogue scientists perform experiments in defiance of well-intended bans.
well-intended.zh: 那些寻找停止遗传学在它自己的轨道上的， 也许很快就能学到重新的一课， 由于流氓科学家进行的不顾那些用心良苦的禁令的试验。

well-meaning.en: What's the one word of advice a well-meaning professional would give to a recent college graduate?
well-meaning.zh: 一个好心的专业人士会给刚毕业的大学生什么样的忠告呢？

well-meaning.en: When well-meaning campaigners want us to pay attention to global warming, they often end up pitching beyond the facts.
well-meaning.zh: 当善意的活动人士希望我们关注全球变暖问题时， 他们往往会言过其实。

well-meaning.en: Most parents are well-meaning, but some of them aren't very helpful with the problems their sons and daughters have in adjusting to college.
well-meaning.zh: 大多数父母都是善意的， 但一些父母并不能有效帮助他们的儿女解决适应大学生活的过程中所遇到的问题。

well-meaning.en: Nevertheless, to secure the distinction in actual practice, to say, "Okay. This is the meaning and now this is how I'm going to make it significant" - well, it seems unlikely indeed that this is something anyone could ever accomplish.
well-meaning.zh: 然而，若在实际操作中,你试着去体现这个区别，你会说，好的，这是意思,现在我来将它变成意义“,可是，实际上似乎谁都,无法完成这个任务。

well-received.en: Overall, the use of sound in film was well-received by audiences, but there were still many technical factors to consider.
well-received.zh: 总的来说， 观众很喜欢有声电影， 但是这其中仍然有很多技术因素需要考虑。

well-received.zh: 剧评家对这出戏反应良好。

well-rounded.en: The wine list is well-rounded and modestly priced.
well-rounded.zh: 这份酒单内容全面，且酒的价格适中。

well-rounded.zh: 这些女孩们接受了科学、 文学、 语言和历史的全面教育。

well-rounded person.en: Liberal arts learning helps you become a well- educated, well-rounded person – someone who's interested in the world and interesting to others.
well-rounded person.zh: 文科学习帮助你成为一个受过良好教育且人格完满的人， 对世界感兴趣且对别人来说很有趣的人。

whiney.zh: 训练说话的语调 - 高而烦躁的语调并不会让人感到权力。

whip.zh: 我们可以临时分配一个变量，将这个值暂时存放在这个变量中。

work up to.zh: 下面的编辑示例首先从最简单和最常见的构造开始， 并逐步过渡到较复杂的构造。

work up to.en: They work up to 13 hours a day, live in cold, dirty, overcrowded dormitories and eat poor food.
work up to.zh: 她们每天工作 13 小时以上， 住在寒冷、 肮脏又过于拥挤的宿舍， 吃的是简单的食物。

work up to.en: You might start on the flats and work up to more demanding and difficult terrain.
work up to.zh: 你可以先在平路上练习， 再慢慢挑战要求更高、 难度更大的路面。

work-around.en: It's important to note that the increased flexibility didn't encourage them to work around the clock.
work-around.zh: 必须指出的是， 增加工作灵活性，但并不鼓励员工全天候工作。

work-around.en: T he boy's father was coming home from work around this time.
work-around.zh: 这时，男孩的父亲下班回家了。

work-around.en: S ome people seem willing to work around the clock in their narrow specialty.
work-around.zh: 有些人似乎愿意在他们狭隘的专业领域夜以继日地工作。

work-around.en: There's no change in them, and then we also looked at some at non - state functions, work and heat, and saw that those aren't zero going around a cycle. Of course you can do work in a cyclic process, and heat can be exchanged with the environment at the same time.
work-around.zh: 它们不会有变化，然后我们研究了,一些非态函数，功和热量，并看到,沿着循环行进一周的话,它们并不是零，当然你可以在,一个循环过程中做功，而同时热量可以在系统,与外界环境之间进行交换。

workbench.en: The vice is bolted to the workbench.
workbench.zh: 这虎钳是用螺栓固定在工作台上的。

workbench.en: This section describes the basics of the workbench.
workbench.zh: 本部分描述了工作台的基础。

working definition.en: Toreutics definition is - the art or process of working in metal especially by embossing or chasing.
working definition.zh: 金属浮雕的定义是在金属上加工的工艺或过程， 特别是通过压花或雕刻。

working definition.en: In fact, we are hard pressed for a good working definition for life in the cosmic context.
working definition.zh: 实际上， 我们正在做一项艰苦的工作 ——给宇宙生命下一个定义。

working definition.en: Lyubomirsky's working definition of happiness — " a joyful, contented life " — gets at both the feelings and judgments necessary for overall happiness.
working definition.zh: 柳波默斯基给幸福下了一个实用的定义，认为幸福就是指快乐而又满足的人生。 有了这个定义，就可以给总体幸福提供必要的感觉和判断依据。

wouldbe.en: With enough ice, we wouldbe able to chill the drinks.
wouldbe.zh: 有了足够的冰， 我们就能冰这些饮料了。

wouldbe.en: The young leopard separated from its mother wouldbe eaten by other beast.
wouldbe.zh: 与母亲离散的幼豹很可能被其他的野兽吃掉。

wouldbe.en: They had been told by their grandmothers that who ever did so wouldbe sure to have new clothes before the end of the year.
wouldbe.zh: 他们把它放在嘴面前， 想要一口气把整朵的花球吹走，因为祖母曾经说过： 谁能够这样做，谁就可以在新年到来以前得到一套新衣。

wormwood.en: S weet wormwood is a common plant in China and Tu Youyou is the woman who used the special power of the plant to save millions of lives.
wormwood.zh: 在中国，青蒿是一种常见的植物，而屠呦呦就是那个用这种植物的特殊力量拯救了数百万人生命的女人。

wormwood.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
wormwood.zh: 至终却苦似茵？， 快如两刃的刀。

wormwood.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
wormwood.zh: 他用苦楚充满我， 使我饱用茵。

worrywart.en: I admit it. I'm a worrywart.
worrywart.zh: 我承认，我就是一个自寻烦恼的人，我这辈子都是这样。

worrywart.en: Raghuram Rajan, a former IMF chief economist and professor at Chicago's Booth School of Business, is one worrywart.
worrywart.zh: 国际货币基金组织前首席经济学家、 芝加哥大学商学院金融学教授拉古·拉姆•瑞占就是其中一位杞人忧天的人。

worrywart.en: Such a person is often said to be a worry wart, also rendered as worrywart or worry-wart in some literary references.
worrywart.zh: 这种极度忧虑的人就被称为是 “杞人忧天”（拼写为 worry wart 、 worrywart 或 worry-wart都可以）。

wreak.en: These insects can wreak havoc on crops.
wreak.zh: 这些昆虫可严重危害农作物。

wreak.en: Decades of stress can wreak havoc on your health.
wreak.zh: 数十年的压力会严重破坏你的健康。

wreak.en: These can get inside the cells and really wreak havoc.
wreak.zh: 这些毒性分子会进入细胞内并造成严重破坏。

wretchedness.en: She saw the other's life, and it was sorrow and distress, horror, and wretchedness.
wretchedness.zh: 她看到了另一个人的生命， 它是悲伤、 痛苦、 恐怖和不幸的化身。

wretchedness.en: Hunger and wretchedness rise superior to fears in the long run.
wretchedness.zh: 从长远来看， 饥饿和不幸会战胜恐惧。

wretchedness.en: Her wretchedness made him feel miserable.
wretchedness.zh: 她的不幸让他感到十分难受。

wretchedness.en: If You would deal thus with me, kill me rather, I beg You, and let me see no more of my wretchedness!"
wretchedness.zh: 如果您这样对待我，还不如杀了我，我请求您，不要再让我如此的可怜“

wrong-headed.en: Ending " wrong-headed methods " that have failed pupils and making sure every teacher has the resources to deliver synthetic phonics teaching.
wrong-headed.zh: 结束导致学生失败的“错误的方法”， 确保每位教师都拥有用于原音拼合法教学的资源。

wrong-headed.en: He calls it captainitis because, he says, " crew members of multi - pilot aircraft exhibit a sometimes deadly passivity when the flight captain makes a clearly wrong-headed decision ".
wrong-headed.zh: 他称其为“机长综合症”，他说是因为 “当机长做出一个明显错误的决定时，有多个飞行员的飞机上的机组人员有时会表现出致命的被动性”。

wrong-headed.en: Posner may be wrong-headed, but he has bite and verve.
wrong-headed.zh: 也许波斯纳刚愎自用， 但他还有些尖锐和魄力。

wrestle with.en: His favorite funny tagline," Never wrestle with a pig."
wrestle with.zh: 他最喜欢的有趣标语是：“永远不要和猪摔跤。”

wrestle with.en: I think Milton is encouraging us to question, to wrestle with the theological certainties that the rest of the poem labors to establish.
wrestle with.zh: 我认为弥尔顿鼓励我们去质疑，去与神学上的确定性搏斗，而这正是这首诗的其余部分所努力建立的。

wrestle with.en: When people wrestle with computer problems, one of the most common pieces of advice they receive is that they should update the BIOS.
wrestle with.zh: 当人们与计算机问题展开搏斗时， 他们收到的一个最为常见的建议就是应该更新 BIOS 。

wunderkind.en: Carson Maulers is a wunderkind in the 20th century of American literary history.
wunderkind.zh: 卡森 ·麦卡勒斯是二十世纪美国文学史上一位神童。

wunderkind.en: Wunderkind isn't derogatory, unless you're 40 and described as' once a wunderkind', " Dolan said to Slant Magazine."
wunderkind.zh: 神童并不是贬称， 除非你 40岁的时候被人说成是‘ 曾经的神童’”，多兰告诉《观点》 杂志。

wunderkind.en: The novel ’s literary merit, let’s be clear, is really beside the point; Hegemann could very well be the wunderkind people claim she is.
wunderkind.zh: 明白地讲，谈论这本小说的文学价值确实有点跑题了； 赫格曼可能的确是人们所称的神童。

wrongheaded.en: He told them exactly how wrongheaded they were.
wrongheaded.zh: 他实实在在地跟他们说他们有多执迷不悟。

wrought by.en: Indeed, I really believe in the benefits wrought by global warming.
wrought by.zh: 说真的， 我确实相信全球变暖带来的好处。

wrought by.en: They faulted senior managers for not recognizing the signs of workplace strife wrought by bad bosses.
wrought by.zh: 他们指责高层管理者未及时发现办公室里因坏领导而引起的冲突苗头。

wrought by.en: But doing so will not end the upheaval wrought by technological innovation in the telecoms sector or overcapacity in the car industry.
wrought by.zh: 但这样做对于电信部门的技术革新或汽车行业的产能过剩也于事无补。

zealotry.zh: 他们的支持已近乎狂热。

zealotry.en: Even so, there is some fear of zealotry.
zealotry.zh: 即便如此，还是担心狂热分子。

zealotry.en: That zealotry first revealed itself when he was a teenager.
zealotry.zh: 这狂热的第一次显露了出来， 当他是少年。

yelp.en: I learn of their Yelp account.
yelp.zh: 我知道了他们 Yelp 的账户。

yelp.en: From the corner of the store, he heard his son yelp, " What!"
yelp.zh: 在商店角落里， 他听到他的儿子大叫：“什么！”

yelp.en: You can write a draft review, but you have to visit the Yelp website to post it.
yelp.zh: 你可以写一篇评论草稿， 但你需要访问 Yelp 网站才能发布它。

yelp.en: Complimented, my eye. She kissed me on my pure brow," and my darling emitted that new yelp of merriment which, perhaps in connection with her theatrical mannerisms, she had lately begun to affect."
yelp.zh: 是的，夸奖我的眼睛，她亲吻了我漂亮的眉毛“,我亲爱的洛丽塔发出了欢快的叫喊声，那也许和她戏剧性的行为方式有关，她随后开始变得做作起来“

yelp.en: I learn of their Yelp account.
yelp.zh: 让我了解到他们的 Yelp 的账户。

yom kippur.en: And the holiest day is Yom Kippur, known as the Sabbath of Sabbaths.
yom kippur.zh: 最神圣的日子是赎罪日，它是安息日中的安息日。

yom kippur.en: At least that's what I was praying for in synagogue during Yom Kippur!
yom kippur.zh: 至少赎罪日那天， 我会在犹太会堂为此祈祷！

yom kippur.en: September 18th was the fast - day of Yom Kippur (observed by 69% of Israeli Jews, according to the same official statistics ) and it ended an hour earlier thanks to the premature start of winter.
yom kippur.zh: 月 18 日是犹太赎罪日，全天禁食（据同一官方数据显示，有69% 的以色列人过此节日）。 沙斯党称， 由于冬天早到，赎罪日提前了一个小时结束。

zero in on.en: They help us to zero in on a problem so we can deal with it.
zero in on.zh: 它们帮助我们把精力集中在一个问题上， 这样我们就可以处理它。

zero in on.en: The markets have failed to zero in on this problem, because of all the other squeaky wheels in the global economy, but sooner or later, they will latch on it.
zero in on.zh: 由于全球经济中所有其他吱吱作响的车轮， 市场未能关注到这个问题， 但迟早他们会意识到这一点。

zero in on.en: So when it comes to carbs, zero in on quality, not quantity.
zero in on.zh: 所以谈到碳水化合物， 要注重其质量， 而不是其数量。

zero in on.en: The reason in our radial probability distributions we start - - the reason, if you look at the zero point on the radius that we start at zero is because we're multiplying the probability density by some volume, and when we're not anywhere 0 from the nucleus, that volume is defined as zero.
zero in on.zh: 在径向概率密度里，我们开始,如果你们看半径的零点，我们从零点开始,因为我们用概率密,度乘以体积,而当我们，在离核子很近的地方,体积是，所以我们会在这里。

ziggurat.en: Only the king and priests could enter a ziggurat.
ziggurat.zh: 只有国王和祭司才能进入神庙内。

ziggurat.en: We think he went off north to the Wailing Ziggurat.
ziggurat.zh: 我们认为他向北去哀嚎通灵塔了。

ziggurat.en: The seventh layer of Mount Celestia can be reached only by climbing the ziggurat.
ziggurat.zh: 要到达天堂山的第七层只能从金字塔神殿向上攀登。

yawning gap.en: There's a yawning gap between rich and poor.
The yawning gap between blacks and whites persists across demographic lines.
yawning gap.zh: 白人与黑人之间的差异一直延续到人口统计学领域里。

yawning gap.en: So the House budget proposal revealed a yawning gap between the two parties' priorities.
yawning gap.zh: 因此， 众议院预算提案说明， 两党在政策优先安排方面存在巨大的差异。

想.en: I think this is probably a size of lumber, but you can't get away from the mythology of that number.
想.zh: 我想这可能是木材的一种规格，但是你不得不去想,这数字中的神话意味。

想.en: And now, it's like everyone just wants to be in Central Park, picnics all the time in the summer.
想.zh: 而现在，好像人人都想去中央公园，在夏天，他们随时都想在这里野餐。

想.en: I think that the distinction Iser is making between reading and interpretation can be understood in much the same way.
想.zh: 我想伊瑟尔想指出的,阅读与诠释之间的差异也基本上也可以这样理解。
